Ageless Wonder.name: Ageless Wonder
Ageless Wonder.sa1: Well-timed BLOCKS grant AUTO-BLOCK, FINAL STAND and IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Ageless Wonder.sa2: Inflict IMMOBILIZE for 10 seconds and gain 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION when either fighter blocks a projectile.

role_strategy: Ageless Wonder is an offensive utility fighter that can gain AUTO-BLOCK, FINAL STAND and IMMUNITY to significantly increase her survivability in a fight. Furthermore, Ageless Wonder can inflict IMMOBILIZE and gain stacks of PRECISION when either fighter blocks a projectile, preventing players from dashing while increasing her damage output from guaranteed critical hits.

While almost all of Ageless Wonder's buffs have a defensive aspect, the perfect block restriction and the shorter than average duration means that she's incredibly lackluster on a defense team. Instead, players will gain more value out of her by using her buffs to counter certain gimmicks on offense.

IMMUNITY and FINAL STAND can be used in order to ignore DEBUFF-based as well as reflect damage gimmicks and Abilities, respectively. As the AI used for the defense teams are pretty aggressive, Ageless Wonder can get these buffs pretty frequently.

Her secondary Signature Ability can be used in order to easily gain PRECISION stacks from using projectiles such as GRAVITY SLINGSHOT, SAGAN BEAM and CRESCENT CUT. PRECISION is a powerful BUFF that ignores opponent's Signature Abilities, preventing on death abilities from Kill Joy, Shadow Puppet and Immoral Fiber from activating. For this purpose, DESTRUCTION PILLAR is an excellent move, since it deals a significant amount of damage in one hit. CRESCENT CUT is also very useful due to its ability to inflict GUARD BREAK on blocked hits, which can be used in combination with Ageless Wonder's IMMOBILIZE in order to apply pressure from afar.
CRESCENT CUT is also very useful due to its ability to inflict GUARD BREAK on blocked hits, which can be used in combination with Ageless Wonder's IMMOBILIZE in order to apply pressure from afar.

While all of the above makes Ageless Wonder a good variant for the purpose of countering certain gimmicks, she lacks in terms of raw damage output due to her below average ATK stat. Because of this, she's hard to use effectively in high-streak Prize Fights and Rift.
Marquee Ability: As an offensive fighter, RED SHIFT is the recommended Marquee Ability for Ageless Wonder to increase her overall damage output, which she very much wants.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Ageless Wonder is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown. Note that Crit Rate is a bit redundant on her as she does gain precision.
Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage by using PRECISION.

Altar Ego.name: Altar Ego
Altar Ego.sa1: While near an opponent and not BLOCKING, inflict a random DEBUFF for 5/7/10 seconds every 2 seconds.
Altar Ego.sa2: When using a TAUNT, remove all opponent DEBUFFS. For each DEBUFF removed, deal damage equal to 15/20/25% of Double's ATTACK to the opponent. Opponents defeated while TAUNTING cannot be revived.

role_strategy: Altar Ego is an offensive fighter that relies on inflicting the opponent with tons of DEBUFFS, which she can then use to remove a whole chunk of her opponent's health with a TAUNT. She also has valuable utility, being able to prevent revives by killing opponents with the TAUNT. With one of the highest ATK stat in the entire game, Altar Ego is a great offensive variant that can easily take down some of the stronger defenders in the game.

Among Double's Diamond variants, Altar Ego's unique niche is in using a TAUNT to kill and prevent the revival of defenders. This is particularly effective against defenders that can revive themselves such as Plot Twisted, Death Wish, and Last Hope, as well as variants that can revive their allies like Kill Joy. However, because the damage done by the TAUNT relies on the number of active DEBUFFS, Altar Ego will have to inflict multiple stacks of DEBUFFS quickly, which can be done through Double's Marquee Ability, CHAOS. Due to Altar Ego's naturally high ATK stat, players will often find that relying on CHAOS and multiple DEBUFFS is more than enough to take down some of the tougher defenders in the game, and the TAUNT naturally takes up a move slot that could be taken by a damaging move instead. Hence, it is best to simply see the TAUNT as an active button to prevent revival against the aforementioned variants.

Due to Altar Ego's naturally high ATK stat, players will often find that relying on CHAOS and multiple DEBUFFS is more than enough to take down some of the tougher defenders in the game, and the TAUNT naturally takes up a move slot that could be taken by a damaging move instead. Hence, it is best to simply see the TAUNT as an active button to prevent revival against the aforementioned variants.

Altar Ego can be a problem on defense, as she can inflict DEBUFFS while she's being hit as well as inflict a lot of damage if she happens to have a TAUNT equipped. However, her defensive prowess is easily bested with the use of IMMUNITY, and Double's naturally low health stat and Altar Ego's lack of other defensive abilities make her very fragile.

Marquee Ability: CHAOS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Altar Ego, as it provides another winning condition by inflicting tons of DEBUFFS to cripple the opponent's defense, as well as massively fueling her TAUNT-based damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Altar Ego is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Meter Gain and Special Cooldown are also stats which players can choose to invest in.

Angel Maker.name: Angel Maker
Angel Maker.sa1: When TAGGING from Umbrella, the incoming Fighter gains 3 stacks of ENRAGE, 3 stacks of MIASMA, and IMMUNITY for 15/18/20 seconds each at the cost of up to 35/30/25% of Umbrella's MAX HEALTH.
Angel Maker.sa2: When Umbrella TAGS IN, gain 3 stacks of EVASION, 3 stacks of REGEN, and IMMUNITY for 10/12/15 seconds each and DRAIN 25/30/35% BLOCKBUSTER METER from the opponent.

role_strategy: Angel Maker is an offensive support fighter with a TAGGING based abilities. When TAGGING from Umbrella, provides her teammates with immense extra DPS from ENRAGE and MIASMA, as well as IMMUNITY to deal with enemy debuffs, but this all comes with the cost of 25% of Umbrella's MAX HEALTH. Her second Signature Ability on Umbrella`s TAG IN gives her access to EVASION which provides her safety net when TAGGING IN, REGEN which can compensate her 25% MAX HEALTH loss from her first Signature ability, IMMUNITY, and DRAINS 35% BLOCKBUSTER METER from the opponent.

Angel Maker first ability makes her incredibly versatile, allowing her to be used with almost every character in the game. Her first Signature Ability allows variants to gain BUFFS that synergize with their own Signature Abilities. For example, TAGGING IN Iron Matron, or Risky Ginger, will grant them ENRAGE, which can be used to activate their Signature Abilities. Another example is TAGGING IN Furmidable, to gain IMMUNITY and make her SPECIAL MOVE hits UNBLOCKABLE.

You can use her 35% BLOCKBUSTER METER DRAIN to charge up Tier 3 Blockbuster right after tagging in, and finish off the opponent with it, completely negating the 25% max HP cost, and preventing the enemy from respawning.

Marquee Ability: Angel Maker will benefit from either Marquee Ability depending on her use. SWEET VICTORY will further boost her damage output by granting ENRAGE stacks upon the death of her opponent, allowing her to snowball damage against incoming fighters.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive support fighter, Angel Maker is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special Investmet: One niche investment for Angel Maker can be Tag Cooldown, allowing you to tag her in and out quicker and gaining buffs on your other fighters more often, but this is not a necessity by any means.

Apex Complex.name: Apex Complex
Apex Complex.sa1: While the opponent's HEALTH is above 65/50/35%, DASH ATTACKS inflict CURSE and grant HASTE for 10/12/15 seconds each on HIT.
Apex Complex.sa2: Inflict WITHER for 5 seconds and deal damage equal to 5% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH every 4/3/2 seconds while near the opponent and benefiting from HASTE.

role_strategy: Apex Complex is an offensive fighter with powerful utility in the form of CURSE and HASTE obtained from a single dash attack. On top of a high base ATK stat, Apex Complex can also control the opponent's meter through WITHER and deal direct damage to the opponent, solidifying her as a solid offensive variant.

The ability to inflict CURSE from a single dash attack is very powerful, as it prevents defensive BUFFS from activating. With HASTE, Apex Complex will charge blockbusters really fast, unlocking access to Fukua's powerful blockbusters such as INEVITABLE SNUGGLE, BEST FRIENDS FOREVER and TWICE SHY. With easy access to HASTE, Martial Outlaw is a great support variant that will provide additional utility to Apex Complex by access to ARMOR BREAK and HEAVY BLEED from her attacks, further bolstering her offensive output. Pairing her with fighters like Raining Champ and Rhythm Rider will allow her to gain Haste even while the opponent is below 35% Health. Rhythm Rider being an exception as he also increases the duration of her buffs. Fukua's dash attack is among the best in the entire game for intercepts and combos, highlighting Apex Complex's simple yet powerful abilities.

With easy access to HASTE, Martial Outlaw is a great support variant that will provide additional utility to Apex Complex by access to ARMOR BREAK and HEAVY BLEED from her attacks, further bolstering her offensive output.

Pairing her with fighters like Raining Champ and Rhythm Rider will allow her to gain Haste even while the opponent is below 35% Health. Rhythm Rider being an exception as he also increases the duration of her buffs.
Fukua's dash attack is among the best in the entire game for intercepts and combos, highlighting Apex Complex's simple yet powerful abilities.

Fukua already has plenty of meter control in her kit, so WITHER can be a bit redundant at times. Furthermore, with a high base ATK and Fukua's powerful blockbusters that allow her to be aggressive and deal significant damage, the ability to inflict direct damage on the opponent may not be as impactful. Regardless, Apex Complex's second ability serves as a nice bonus on top of her powerful first Signature Ability.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activates when a certain percentage of health is lost, which is unfavorable when used offensively. Players who are proficient at Fukua will have ways to minimize damage as much as possible and avoid getting hit. Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, Apex Complex can be built as a Critless Variant.
Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, Apex Complex can be built as a Critless Variant.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Apex Complex is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like LOBS OF LOVE or TWICE SHY. While fighters should completely ignore Meter Gain due to her access to HASTE.

Armed Forces.name: Armed Forces
Armed Forces.sa1: 10% chance when either Fighter is HIT to gain ARMOR and UNFLINCHING for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Armed Forces.sa2: When Cerebella gains a BUFF, 50/75/100% chance to transfer 1 DEBUFF from herself to the opponent.

role_strategy: Armed Forces is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that can provide her with ARMOR and UNFLINCHING upon a hit, as well as transferring a DEBUFF active on her to her opponent whenever she receives a BUFF. Along with a high HP stat, this means she's a great tank.

Since Armed Forces relies on her BUFFS for defense, it is recommended to use variants that can remove BUFFS such as Silent Kill, Doublicious and Summer Salt when facing her. Variants that can inflict CURSE such as Purrfect Dark and Shadow Ops can also prevent her from gaining BUFFS. Furthermore, fighters that can inflict HEX to completely disable her Signature Ability such as Red Velvet are also recommended to completely shut her down. Neither CURSE nor HEX can be transferred back to Armed Forces' opponent. CURSE prevents her from triggering her Signature Ability, while HEX removes her abilities entirely. While she has the ability to gain her BUFFS from her own hits, her low ATK stat and the lack of offensive buffs mean that she's not well-suited for offense.
Neither CURSE nor HEX can be transferred back to Armed Forces' opponent. CURSE prevents her from triggering her Signature Ability, while HEX removes her abilities entirely.
While she has the ability to gain her BUFFS from her own hits, her low ATK stat and the lack of offensive buffs mean that she's not well-suited for offense.
Marquee Ability: UPPER HAND is the best marquee for Armed Forces, as it allows her to control the opponent's meter on throws.
stat_investment: General Investment: If built defensively, Armed Forces is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. If built offensively, Armed Forces is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: If built offensively, Meter Gain would help her perform better on the field.
rift_battles: Due to her air element, Armed Forces mixes well with the Into Thin Air catalyst, removing any CURSE or HEX applied onto her every 15 seconds. Catalyst such as Autoimmune, Angry Flinch and Amour Rating will also help her become a potent defensive unit in Rift Battles.

Assassin's Greed.name: Assassin's Greed
Assassin's Greed.sa1: When either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER, the opponent loses 15/20/25% of their remaining HEALTH and suffers HEAVY BLEED for 5 seconds.
Assassin's Greed.sa2: Gain 3/4/5% HEALTH per second while nearby an opponent suffering BLEED.

role_strategy: Assassin's Greed is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that severely punishes opponents from using a blockbuster while granting her incredible regeneration for survivability. With the highest HP stat of all Valentines, Assassin's Greed is a very potent defender that is difficult to kill without a proper strategy due to her terrifying regenerative abilities.

Assassin’s Greed can also be used offensively with her own BLOCKBUSTERS also activating her ability. This helps Assassin’s Greed deal more consistent damage despite her low ATK stat with the current HP% removal and HEAVY BLEED. Furthermore, applying BLEED on the opponent also helps her survivability by providing healing from her second Signature Ability.

Marquee Ability: ICU is the recommended Marquee Ability for Assassin's Greed, providing her an alternative way to gain healing without relying on her Signature Ability. This allows her to be a better defensive wall that cannot be worn down by BLEED effects.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Valentine, Assassin's Greed is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense. When built offensively, Assassin's Greed is best built with Attack, Piercing and Meter Gain

Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant when built defensively. Accuracy is useful offensively to negate the opponent's Resistance so she can inflict BLEED and HEAVY BLEED more reliably.
rift_battles: Assassin's Greed excels at denying blockbusters on defense which makes it difficult to defeat her on top of her high HP stat. Assassin's Greed forces opponents to either lose points from not defeating her with a blockbuster, or lose points from the health loss. This allows her to be a formidable defender even in single nodes.

Assassin's Greed can be potent when paired with Kill Joy and Last Hope that can grant her further REGEN support from the bench. Catalysts such as Last Words and Autoimmune also makes it harder to swiftly defeat her, forcing opponents to rely on raw power to deal with a team of triple light Valentine node that excels at stalling for time.

Baba Yaga.name: Baba Yaga
Baba Yaga.sa1: Gain DEADEYE for 10/12/15 seconds when HITTING an opponent in the air. While benefitting from DEADEYE, HYPE MODE is extended to last for 15 seconds and Beowulf gains a HYPE CHARGE when the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN.
Baba Yaga.sa2: While in HYPE MODE, after a THROW, the opponent is shot into the air. Inflict HEX for 5/7/10 seconds while in HYPE MODE and hitting the opponent in the air.

role_strategy: Baba Yaga is an offensive Beowulf with a Signature Ability that grants him DEADEYE when HITTING the opponent in the air, allowing him to ignore the opponents DEFENSE and BUFFs like UNFLINCHING, EVASION and THORNS. Furthermore, through gaining DEADEYE, Baba Yaga’s HYPE MODE is extended and is able to gain additional HYPE CHARGES through KNOCKING DOWN the opponent, allowing for HYPE MODE to trigger quickly. Baba Yaga can build HYPE CHARGE very fast, gaining 2 HYPE CHARGES when doing his A3, WULFSHOOT or normal GRAB as long as he has DEADEYE. The fastest route to 3 stacks of HYPE CHARGE is completing A3 -> AROO READY? while the enemy is knocked down.

Baba Yaga can build HYPE CHARGE very fast, gaining 2 HYPE CHARGES when doing his A3, WULFSHOOT or normal GRAB as long as he has DEADEYE. The fastest route to 3 stacks of HYPE CHARGE is completing A3 -> AROO READY? while the enemy is knocked down.

It is important to trigger HYPE MODE consistently in order to to shoot the opponent into the air after each THROW and inflict HEX after hitting the opponent in the air, ignoring the opponents SIGNATURE ABILITY. As the Signature Ability suggests, only the opponent needs to remain AIRBORNE to inflict HEX. Use attacks that keep the opponent in the air for long to inflict HEX more often and also extend combos. Moves like HURTING HURDLE, GIGAN ARM SWEEP, GIGANTIC ARM and AIRWULF work well to attack AIRBORNE opponents while Beowulf remains grounded.

As the Signature Ability suggests, only the opponent needs to remain AIRBORNE to inflict HEX. Use attacks that keep the opponent in the air for long to inflict HEX more often and also extend combos. Moves like HURTING HURDLE, GIGAN ARM SWEEP, GIGANTIC ARM and AIRWULF work well to attack AIRBORNE opponents while Beowulf remains grounded.

When shooting the opponent into the air, they will be hit by a sniper attack, indicated by a reticle on screen. This attack temporarily staggers the opponent mid-air, before knocking them down. Be aware of this effect, otherwise you may miss your next attack while the opponent is in the air.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability and will help keep Baba Yaga on the upper hand as he deals damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Baba Yaga is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is recommended on Baba Yaga to inflict HEX more reliably. Meter Gain may or may not be built depending on whether you add Beowulf's TAUNT to his moveset.

Bad Hair Day.name: Bad Hair Day
Bad Hair Day.sa1: 10% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED for 3/5/7 seconds.
Bad Hair Day.sa2: 10/12/15% bonus to CRIT RATE if opponent has BLEED.

role_strategy: Bad Hair Day is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around BLEED effects. She has an inherent ability to inflict BLEED on-hit which allows her to deal massive damage against the toughest of defenders as BLEED ignores base stats and drains 1% max HEALTH per second. At 5 stacks of BLEEDS, the opponent's health will be drained by 5% per second.
At 5 stacks of BLEEDS, the opponent's health will be drained by 5% per second.

Equip multi-hit moves such as DRILL TEMPERED, HAIRBALL and DRILLATIONSHIP to increase the chances of inflicting BLEED from her Signature Ability. Furthermore, moves such as FRENCH TWIST, RINGLET SPIKE and GREGOR SAMSON have a chance to inflict BLEED as well and can be used in conjunction with her Signature Ability.

However, it is important to watch out for fighters such as Bloodbath and Valentine with the ICU Marquee Ability as they will convert those BLEEDS into REGEN, nullifying Bad Hair Day's abilities. To counter these fighters, it is best to bring a teammate that can inflict CURSE such as Graveyard Shift, Purrfect Dark and Sketchy to prevent the REGEN and allowing Bad Hair Day to inflict permanent BLEEDS on them.

While the Crit Rate boost on Bad Hair Day's second Signature Ability sounds nice at first, it's often more of a detriment than a benefit; She can't do much damage outside of BLEEDS because of her incredibly low ATK stat, and Painwheels with their Marquee Abilities unlocked will be an absolute pain to deal with.

Frayed Ends and Bad Hair Day are both Bronze Filias that rely on BLEED in slightly different ways. While Bad Hair Day doesn't have to rely on moves to inflict BLEEDs because of her already having a chance to do so every hit, Frayed Ends generally has better reward for landing BLEED with the caveat of needing certain moves to do so reliably. As a result, Bad Hair Day functions better as an introduction to Filia's base kit, while Frayed Ends has more value later on when the player has a decent grip on Filia already. Both ultimately struggle for late-game use due to their rarity and lack of utility besides BLEED, however.

Marquee Ability: Given Bad Hair Day's natural affinity to BLEED, THE FIRST CUT is the best Marquee Ability for her as it allows her to convert her rather short BLEEDS into permanent BLEEDS, making it much easier to whittle an opponent's health down to 15.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Bad Hair Day is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase Bad Hair Day's overall damage. Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting BLEED.

Bad Ms Frosty.name: Bad Ms Frosty
Bad Ms Frosty.sa1: 50% chance on CRITICAL HIT to inflict ARMOR BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds.
Bad Ms Frosty.sa2: Gain UNFLINCHING for 3/4/5 seconds when DASHING. DISABLE the opponent BLOCKBUSTERS while benefiting from UNFLINCHING.

role_strategy: Bad Ms Frosty is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that inflicts ARMOR BREAK upon a CRITICAL HIT, allowing her to deal with ARMOR intensive units like Curl Scout, Heavy Metal, and Blue Screen while controlling their blockbuster usage. Coupled alongside her UNFLINCHING she can easily intercept opponents while DISABLING their BLOCKBUSTERS to ensure the engagement is in her favor. ARMOR BREAK not only removes ARMOR but also increases damage taken by 20%.
ARMOR BREAK not only removes ARMOR but also increases damage taken by 20%.
UNFLINCHING doesn't last long so make sure to dash as much as possible to DISABLE the opponents BLOCKBUSTERS so they are forced to fight Bad Ms Frosty without invulnerable reversals.

Filia's Prestige Ability, which inflicts DEATH MARK when countering opponent attacks, pairs pretty nicely with Bad Ms Frosty's Signature Ability, as both like having a high Crit Rate stat. The combination of the two make Bad Ms Frosty a potential critical hit abuser.
Marquee Ability: LEECH is the best Marquee Ability for Bad Ms Frosty, as it allows her to recover from accidents and chip damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Bad Ms Frosty is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate is the most important stat for Bad Ms Frosty. Accuracy will ensure that her ARMOR BREAK will not be resisted by enemies.

Bare Bones.name: Bare Bones
Bare Bones.sa1: Gain THORNS for 8/10/12 seconds when using a SPECIAL MOVE.
Bare Bones.sa2: When reaching 3 stacks of THORNS, remove all THORNS and gain MIASMA for 10/12/15 seconds.

role_strategy: Bare Bones is an offensive fighter that gains THORNS for every special move. If she manages to stack 3 of them, she'll replace all of them with a stack of MIASMA. This makes her able to drain the opponent's health and meter consistently as long as she is using her special moves often.

When using Bare Bones, it is recommended to use special moves as much as possible to start stacking THORNS and converting them to MIASMA. A recommended set is to use SUCTION OBSTRUCTION, HOP TO IT, MARIE GO 'ROUND and BELLOWS BLAST. Use SUCTION OBSTRUCTION, a command grab, to force the opponent into the corner. Then, use SUCTION OBSTRUCTION followed by MARIE GO 'ROUND or BELLOWS BLAST in quick succession. While waiting for the opponent to rise up after being knocked down, use HOP TO IT or another SUCTION OBSTRUCTION to quickly gain an additional stack of THORNS Rinse and repeat until Bare-bones gets multiple stacks of MIASMA and reduces the opponent's health in the corner.

Then, use SUCTION OBSTRUCTION followed by MARIE GO 'ROUND or BELLOWS BLAST in quick succession.
While waiting for the opponent to rise up after being knocked down, use HOP TO IT or another SUCTION OBSTRUCTION to quickly gain an additional stack of THORNS
Rinse and repeat until Bare-bones gets multiple stacks of MIASMA and reduces the opponent's health in the corner.

While usable in defense, Bare Bones as a bronze variant will not have enough stats to be a great defender. She will also completely rely on the AI to use special moves, which can be inconsistent. Thus, it is best to use her offensively where the player has greater control in activating her abilities.
Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Bare Bones is IMPROVED INCINERATION to remove dead bodies and gain additional damage boost from the ENRAGE and extra blockbuster meter.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Bare Bones is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Due to her access to MIASMA, Meter Gain can be ignored.

Bassline.name: Bassline
Bassline.sa1: On TAG IN, gain HEAVY REGEN for 5/7/10 seconds and 20/25/35% BLOCKBUSTER METER..
Bassline.sa2: Landing a DASH ATTACK grants ARMOR for 5/7/10 seconds and removes 1 DEBUFF from Big Band.

role_strategy: Bassline is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants HEAVY REGEN and BLOCKBUSTER METER upon TAG IN. As he gains these BUFFs on TAG IN, it is best to put him as the second or third fighter in your defense team.
When he is on-field, he is able to gain ARMOR and remove 1 DEBUFF so long as he successfully lands a DASH ATTACK. This is better controlled by the using player than the defending AI.

For players starting out, it can be effective to build a team based around TAG INS with characters such as Icy Hot, Scrub, and Sketchy. All these fighters are Bronze fighters that can easily be obtained.
In the early game, pairing him with Rerun which reduces cooldown for TAG INS can be helpful to TAG IN more often.
He can otherwise be used for new players who struggle against opponents inflicting DEBUFFS. Having a reliable DEBUFF removal option is useful against some fighters like Frayed Ends.

Marquee Ability: As a defensive variant, FRONTMAN is the recommended Marquee Ability for Bassline as it provides Resistance and damage reduction to make him more durable and more resistant to DEBUFFS. SOLOIST can be used if players try to use him offensively with his 2nd Signature Ability.

Early Game Investment: Bassline is not the best of bronzes, as he lacks offensive power and is not the best of defenders. Investing in Bassline in the early game is not recommended, as players don't need defensive fighters that early.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Bassline is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.

Special investment: Players can optionally build Tag Cooldown on Bassline to take the most use out of his Signature Ability, but it is not recommended as his Signature Ability does not hold much value.

Beast King.name: Beast King
Beast King.sa1: Inflict WITHER and CURSE for 5/7/10 seconds each when dealing at least 10% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH from a single HIT.
Beast King.sa2: Inflict 10/15/25% bonus damage for each DEBUFF stack applied to either fighter.

role_strategy: Beast King is an offensive fighter with the ability to inflict two powerful DEBUFFS: WITHER which reduces the opponent's meter every second and CURSE which prevents the opponent from gaining BUFFS. Furthermore, his second Signature Ability grants him bonus damage for every DEBUFF stack, which significantly increases his damage output to insane levels. This combination of abilities allows Beast King to overwhelm his opponents easily without having to worry about defensive BUFFS or getting punished with a blockbuster. Beast King's second Signature Ability gives bonus damage for every DEBUFF stack on either side. Hence, DEBUFFS inflicted on Beast King from modifiers or opponent's Signature Abilities will only increase his damage output and make it easier to take down enemies.

Beast King's second Signature Ability gives bonus damage for every DEBUFF stack on either side. Hence, DEBUFFS inflicted on Beast King from modifiers or opponent's Signature Abilities will only increase his damage output and make it easier to take down enemies.

Beast King's first Signature Ability requires him to inflict more than 10% which can easily be achieved through one-hit moves such as GIGAN ARM SWEEP, HURTING HURDLE and GIGANTIC ARM. Even without these moves, Beowulf has access to various other moves that can inflict other DEBUFFS such as BLEED, SLOW, CRIPPLE and ARMOR BREAK to boost his damage output from his second Signature Ability and break through 10% of the opponent's health.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability and will help keep Beast King on the upper hand as he deals damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Beast King is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: There are two main ways to build Beast King, one being with Crit Damage and equipping three to four HURTING HURDLES. This build allows him to do significant damage per HURTING HURDLE and spam the special move with enough Special Cooldown. The other way to build Beast King is to equip Blockbusters like LUPINE PUMMEL and AIR WULF and build Meter Gain. As a fighter that inflicts debuffs, Accuracy is a common stat to build among both these builds.

Beat Box.name: Beat Box
Beat Box.sa1: Gain ENRAGE for 3/4/5 seconds after using a SPECIAL MOVE.
Beat Box.sa2: Gain 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER when using a SPECIAL MOVE.

role_strategy: Beat Box is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around using special moves to gain stacks of ENRAGE and blockbuster meter.

A common strategy is to equip Beat Box with four special moves and one Tier 3 blockbuster. Use these four special moves in succession to gain 100% meter for an UNBLOCKABLE Tier 3 blockbuster. Some special moves that are recommended include those that can provide openings (NOISE CANCEL) or extend combos (CYMBAL CLASH). Use these special moves in quick succession. An example of a combo would be CYMBAL CLASH -> CYMBAL CLASH -> GIANT STEP -> SWEET CLARINET or GIANT STEP -> GIANT STEP -> GIANT STEP -> GIANT STEP
Some special moves that are recommended include those that can provide openings (NOISE CANCEL) or extend combos (CYMBAL CLASH).
Use these special moves in quick succession. An example of a combo would be CYMBAL CLASH -> CYMBAL CLASH -> GIANT STEP -> SWEET CLARINET or GIANT STEP -> GIANT STEP -> GIANT STEP -> GIANT STEP
Please note that you only get the ENRAGE and meter after you use the special move, so the special move itself will not benefit from it.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Beat Box will benefit from SOLOIST as his Marquee Ability. This compliments with Big Band's Prestige Ability that provides UNBLOCKABLE dash attacks while also supplementing HEAVY REGEN as a form of recovery.

Early Game Investment: Beat Box is one of the best of bronzes, as he can quickly spam blockbusters and deal significant damage through his enrage stacks. Newer players are recommended that they invest in this variant, as he will help you a lot in story mode. But they are also recommended to keep him in silver tier until the player finishes story mode.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Beat Box is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Special Cooldown is the most important stat to build on Beat Box. Players can also build Crit Rate and Crit Damage to further increase his damage output. Players are advised to not build Meter Gain as it makes his Signature Ability redundant.

Bellarina.name: Bellarina
Bellarina.sa1: When landing a DASH ATTACK, DRAIN 15% BLOCKBUSTER METER and gain DEADEYE for 10/12/15 seconds, and gain permanent 5/10/15% ATTACK.
Bellarina.sa2: While benefitting from DEADEYE, gain EVASION for 5/7/10 seconds when DASHING and transfer 1 opponent BUFF when HITTING an AIRBORNE opponent.

role_strategy: Bellarina is an offensive Cerebella, weaving in DASH ATTACKS and hitting AIRBORNE opponents with grace to gain DEADEYE and steal BUFFs.

Bellarina also gains permanent ATTACK boosts and has extra ways to control BLOCKBUSTER METER the more she DASH ATTACKS. It's very important to keep incorporating her DASH ATTACK to make the most use of her ability. Bellarina's Signature Ability only accounts for the first hit of her DASH ATTACK. The second hit will not activate her 1st Signature Ability, but it does push the opponent into an AIRBORNE state. Bellarina's ATTACK boost only accounts for her BASE ATTACK stat, not her TOTAL ATTACK stat.

Bellarina's BUFF transfer occurs as long as the opponent is midair. This means Cerebella can remain grounded as long as she can attack an AIRBORNE opponent. Players tend to use CERECOPTER as a reliable multi-hit special move and can transfer a lot of BUFFs quickly. Completing D2 -> CERECOPTER can activate both her 1st and 2nd Signature Ability quickly. While weight/character dependent, MERRY GO RILLA -> D2 -> BATTLE BUTT/DIAMONDS ARE FOREVER remains a reliable combo to quickly incorporate a DASH ATTACK, and will transfer 1-2 BUFFs by keeping the opponent midair.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability is useful for Bellarina. UPPER HAND will provide her better meter control which may be needed since 15% meter drain can be quite minimal, especially since it's hard to incorporate more than 3 DASH ATTACKS into Cerebella combo. Otherwise, RING LEADER will provide unique utility with SPECIAL MOVE DISABLE and TAG-IN DISABLE, preventing the possibility of the enemy randomly switching or using a BURST as you combo.

Big Baddy.name: Big Baddy
Big Baddy.sa1: While Big Band is alive, opponents deal 20/30/40% less damage with SPECIAL HITS and BLOCKBUSTER HITS.
Big Baddy.sa2: When Big Band successfully lands a DASH ATTACK, drain 5% HEALTH from the enemy. When Big Band is HIT during his DASH ATTACK, he gains 2 stacks of AUTO-BLOCK for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Big Baddy is a defensive and supportive variant who provides teamwide damage reduction to SPECIAL and BLOCKBUSTER moves, while also punishing skilled players for intercepting his attacks.

While he is alive, all teammates take less damage from SPECIAL and BLOCKBUSTER moves, improving the survivability of himself and all teammates. This prioritises him to be defeated first, or otherwise it extends the survivability of all team members.

Big Baddy also adds some extra personal defenses, with access to AUTO-BLOCK to punish players aiming to intercept him. With his CHARACTER ABILITY allowing him to absorb 1 HIT while dashing, he is able to get 4 stacks of THORNS on a successful intercept against him. It’s safer to let him attack you while you block, then counterattack afterwards.

Despite primarily being a defensive variant, Big Baddy can also be used offensively. With his HEALTH DRAIN, Big Baddy can quickly chip at enemy health and do it even more consistently if he has his PRESTIGE ABILITY.
Marquee Ability: As a defensive variant, FRONTMAN is the stronger Marquee for Big Baddy. However, due to his HEALTH drain, Big Baddy can be used offensively and use the SOLOIST Marquee as well
stat_investment: General Investment: On offense, Big Baddy is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. On defense, he is best built with Health, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense. When using his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, keep in mind that Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.
Special Investment: On defense, Crit Resist may be added to weaken Crit-based fighters against him.

Big Top.name: Big Top
Big Top.sa1: Once per match, RESURRECT with 10/25/50% HEALTH when defeated. Also gain INVINCIBLE and UNFLINCHING for 6/7/8 seconds.
Big Top.sa2: When either Fighter is KNOCKED DOWN, remove 1 DEBUFF from self and gain HEAVY REGEN for 6/8/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Even though Big Top seems defensive, she is best in an offensive position. Her access to a revival safety net as well as debuff removal shines mostly when the player has more control over when and where to activate it.

Her access to HEAVY REGEN and debuff removal makes her a good fighter to counter BLEED and debuff heavy fighters. But her very below average attack stat holds her back from showing her offensive prowess.
Marquee Ability: UPPER HAND is the best marquee for Big Top, as it allows her to control the opponent's meter on throws.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Big Top is best built with Attack, Piercing, Special Cooldown and Meter Gain
Special investment: HP will make her more beefy, allowing her to withstand more chip damage.

Bio-Exorcist.name: Bio-Exorcist
Bio-Exorcist.sa1: With at least 1 DRAGON CHARGE and not BLOCKING, DRAIN 1/1.5/2% of a nearby opponent's HEALTH per second.
Bio-Exorcist.sa2: While CHARGED, DRAIN 15/20/25% HEALTH from each living teammate when suffering a HIT that would be fatal.

role_strategy: Bio-Exorcist is a fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to DRAIN the health of nearby opponents, which enables her to theoretically defeat any defenders, even those that are much stronger than herself. Bio-Exorcist's second Signature Ability provides her increased longevity in the fight at the expense of her teammate's health in the bench. Both abilities allow Bio-Exorcist to long-shot tough teams by herself, as long as players can sustain at least 1 DRAGON CHARGE.

Bio-Exorcist relies on DRAGON CHARGE to activate her abilities. Hence, being aware of moves that consume a DRAGON CHARGE is critical for her success. Furthermore, given Squigly's excellent combo game, it can be easy to trap the opponent in an extended combo and continually drain the opponent's health quickly. The drain also increases Bio-Exorcist's health back, allowing her to counter fighters that rely on damage reflect, such as Dread Locks or any Painwheel with the TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability. Squigly's Prestige Ability that provides DRAGON CHARGES easily synergizes very well with Bio-Exorcist. It is recommended to to unlock her Prestige Ability to fully make use of Bio-Exorcist's ability to drain the opponent's health quickly.

Bio-Exorcist's resurrection ability is best used as a last resort, especially against unblockable Tier 3 blockbusters. However, this only works with those that kill the fighter on the last hit. Hence, Big Band's STRIKE UP THE BAND and Parasoul's INFERNO BRIGADE, which can kill an opponent on any hit, can easily take down Bio-Exorcist after she resurrects.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability works with Bio-Exorcist, since both conditions require her to be dead. EVIL DEAD can be useful on the offense to inflict both CURSE and WITHER, making it easier for the next fighter to defeat opponents. DEAD ALIVE is better to be used defensively, providing other teammates FINAL STAND to increase the longevity of your defensive fighters and stall for time. Allies whose health was drained by Bio-Exorcist's second Signature Ability can stand near Squigly's body to help them stay alive longer in their weakened state. Due to the nature of Squigly's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Bio-Exorcist as a Critless Variant

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Bio-Exorcist is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Biohazard.name: Biohazard
Biohazard.sa1: While above 50% HEALTH, gain 6 BUCKSHOTS when reloading with no SHOTS remaining. BUCKSHOTS deal 25/35/50% bonus DAMAGE and remove 1 opponent BUFF on hit.
Biohazard.sa2: While below 50% HEALTH, regain 50/75/100% of Black Dahlia’s MAX HEALTH when reloading with no SHOTS remaining.

role_strategy: Biohazard is an offensive Black Dahlia who aims to maximise the use of BUCKSHOTS for quick high damage pressure while also having the ability to fully heal herself if she takes too much damage instead

Biohazard’s primary damage is focused on BUCKSHOTS, so players will need to effectively use her 6 bullets in rapid speed to begin utilising her primary form of damage quickly. Be careful how you use BUCKSHOTS in the combo however, as they not only wallbounce the enemy, but push Black Dahlia slightly backwards, which can affect your positioning.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Biohazard will benefit from METAL BREAKDOWN as her Marquee Ability, increasing her damage output with ARMOR BREAK and the extra damage boost to her SPECIAL SHOTS.
Due to the nature of Biohazard's Signature Ability and the utility Black Dahlia's kit provides, it is suggested that players build a Critless copy of her if they can.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Biohazard is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special Investment: This variant does not need any special investment

Biting Cold.name: Biting Cold
Biting Cold.sa1: Gain 1 stack of BARRIER and THORNS for 5/7/10 seconds every 3 seconds while near a dead body.
Biting Cold.sa2: Gain 3/4/5 stacks of REGEN for 10 seconds and 50% BLOCKBUSTER METER when defeating an opponent. Defeated opponents cannot be revived.

role_strategy: Biting Cold is a defensive fighter that gains numerous benefits while near a dead body or defeating an opponent. The ability to gain BARRIER and THORNS just by standing near a dead body is a very powerful and dangerous defensive ability. On the other hand, the ability to gain stacks of REGEN and meter after a successful revenge kill allows Biting Cold to survive longer in a fight and continually be a threat. Importantly, disabling the ability to revive defeated opponents prevent players from using Valentine's Forbidden Procedure blockbuster and punishes players that rely on it.

Biting Cold can be used offensively, as she directly counters some of the toughest revival-based defenders, such as Kill Joy. Plot Twisted, Last Hope, Dead of Winter, Grim Fan and Death Wish. While she doesn't have any offensive abilities on her own, players can make use of Painwheel's wide arsenal of moves that can inflict DEBUFFS such as ARMOR BREAK, BLEED and DEATHMARK and gain BUFFS such as ENRAGE to make up for it. However, it is recommended to pair her with a dedicated offensive variant to easily whittle the enemy's health down low and then TAG IN Biting Cold to deal the finishing blow.
Marquee Ability: TAINTED BLOOD is the recommended Marquee Ability for Biting Cold.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Painwheel, Biting Cold is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance. If used on offense, Biting Cold is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output on offense.

Blitz & Glamour.name: Blitz & Glamour
Blitz & Glamour.sa1: While on the opponent's side of the stage, Cerebella has a 15% chance on HIT to inflict INVERSE POLARITY and ARMOR BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Blitz & Glamour.sa2: After 10/7/5 seconds while on her own side of the stage, Cerebella REMOVES all DEBUFFS from herself and gains IMMUNITY and REGEN. These BUFFS are removed when KNOCKED DOWN.

role_strategy: Blitz & Glamour is a fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her BUFFS and a chance to inflict DEBUFFS depending on which side of the stage she is on. When on her own side of the stage, she removes all DEBUFFS and gains IMMUNITY and REGEN. However, when on the opponent's side of the stage, she gains the ability to inflict INVERSE POLARITY and AMOUR BREAK. This makes her an excellent fighter offensively and the only Cerebella with IMMUNITY. The BUFFS gained on the player's side of the field do not have a timer, so Blitz & Glamour is functionally immune to debuffs for the entire match after gaining them, unless she gets knocked down or hit with buff removal.

Blitz & Glamour is one of the few variants that can inflict INVERSE POLARITY, the others being Terror Byte, Grin Reaper, Furmidable and Psykid. INVERSE POLARITY is a powerful DEBUFF that reverses all effects of healing, making Blitz & Glamour a powerful counter to defensive variants that rely on healing, such as Valentine with the ICU Marquee Ability and Dahlia with NO TIME TO DIE Marquee Ability.

The ability to remove all DEBUFFS on herself while providing IMMUNITY and REGEN is invaluable in an offensive position. Players can choose to move back to her own side of the stage when crippled with DEBUFFS such as CURSE from Unholy Host.

Marquee Ability: UPPER HAND is the best marquee for Blitz & Glamour, as it allows her to control the opponent's meter on throws. RING LEADER can also stop defenders from tagging out while inflicted with INVERSE POLARITY, but it is not recommended
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Blitz & Glamour is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is the most important stat for Blitz & Glamour, but players can also build Meter Gain to help her keep pressure on the opponent.

Blood Drive.name: Blood Drive
Blood Drive.sa1: 15% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED on yourself and HEAVY BLEED on opponent for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Blood Drive.sa2: When using a SPECIAL MOVE or BLOCKBUSTER, remove all BLEEDS and gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds per BLEED removed.

role_strategy: Blood Drive is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that inflicts BLEED to herself and her opponent, making her a risky fighter to use. However, Blood Drive has the ability to convert all her BLEEDS into stacks of ENRAGE by the use of a move, allowing her to increase her damage output massively.

Blood Drive is a suicidal fighter that will require quick use of blockbusters and special moves to be effective. It is recommended to pair Blood Drive with support fighters that can help her gain REGEN such as Graveyard Shift and Surgeon General. Do note however that the latter will lock Blood Drive out of being bled because of IMMUNITY, which means she won't be able to increase her damage output while it's up. While HEAVY BLEED will do a decent amount of damage over time, it pales to the damage Blood Drive can do with a high amount of ENRAGE stacks. Hence, it is better to see her as a DPS rather than a bleeder.

While HEAVY BLEED will do a decent amount of damage over time, it pales to the damage Blood Drive can do with a high amount of ENRAGE stacks. Hence, it is better to see her as a DPS rather than a bleeder.
Blood Drive works well on defenders that can inflict BLEED such as Assassin's Greed, Dread Locks, and Twisted Mettle as she can just turn them into ENRAGE stacks with the use of a move.

Marquee Ability: GRUDGE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Blood Drive as it provides a safety net to survive attacks from the opponent when a mistake is made while also increasing her damage output from the stacks of ENRAGE. Unfortunately, due to Blood Drive's HP gradually decreasing during the fight without healing support, she can't use either Marquee Ability well often on offense.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Blood Drive is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting BLEED. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

Bloodbath.name: Bloodbath
Bloodbath.sa1: If either fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER, both fighters are afflicted with BLEED for 5/7/10 seconds.
Bloodbath.sa2: 25/50/100% chance to convert all BLEED effects on self into REGEN.

role_strategy: Bloodbath is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability revolving around BLEEDS but unlike other fighters that can inflict BLEED, Bloodbath is unique as she has the ability to convert self-inflicted BLEEDS into REGEN. This allows her to be a powerful fighter that can wear down some of the toughest defenders such as Heavy Metal via BLEED while keeping her health high via REGEN.

Bloodbath relies on spamming blockbusters to inflict BLEED and gain REGEN. Hence, it is best to equip multiple blockbusters, especially those that can trigger Sekhmet, and use them consecutively in order to inflict multiple stacks of BLEED at the same time while also gaining multiple stacks of REGEN.

Bloodbath's second Signature Ability makes her IMMUNE to any BLEED effects, allowing her to counter some Filia and Painwheel variants that rely on BLEED. Notably, Bloodbath is a strong fighter to use against Dread Locks as her HEAVY BLEED will be converted to REGEN to recover back health that is lost from the recoil damage.

Like most other fighters that utilize BLEED effects, Bloodbath is countered by defenders with easy access to IMMUNITY such as Dream Band or those that can easily gain REGEN such as any Valentine with the ICU Marquee Ability. To overcome these opponents, it is highly recommended to equip CHAOS BANISH that not only removes their IMMUNITY or REGEN, but also inflicts HEALBLOCK to disable any form of healing. It is still important to note that against these opponents, Bloodbath will primarily rely on her raw strength rather than her BLEEDS to defeat them.

Bloody Valentine.name: Bloody Valentine
Bloody Valentine.sa1: Regain 5/7/10% HEALTH when either Fighter uses a SPECIAL MOVE.
Bloody Valentine.sa2: Regain 5/10/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER.

role_strategy: Bloody Valentine is a fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her health when a special move is used, giving her survivability, while also filling her Blockbuster meter(s) by a flat amount whenever a Blockbuster is used, which means she'll have access to them much more frequently. Both of these abilities can be triggered by either side's move usage.

When playing as Bloody Valentine, equip blockbusters such as SEKHMET FURY, which grants her ENRAGE and boosts her damage. Special moves such as CHAOS BANISH and WEIGHT OF ANUBIS are recommended for combo extension and health regeneration. In particular, CHAOS BANISH removes all BUFFS from the opponents, while UPPER KHAT has a chance to STUN the opponent. These effects give Bloody Valentine the ability to face a wide range of defenders. While her health regeneration is less viable on offense than her meter regeneration, fights where the player's health gets drained frequently can make Bloody Valentine a good option, as she can heal it back with the use of special moves. It also can't be blocked by CURSE, unlike REGEN effects.

rift_battles: Bloody Valentine is one of the best offensive units when it comes to rift. The best healing in the game combined with Eliza's kit makes her an invaluable asset to have. With her easy healing, she can out heal catalyst such as Futile Resistance and Don't Poke The Buer as well as take on Painwheel variants with TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability with ease.

Blue Bomber.name: Blue Bomber
Blue Bomber.sa1: All BEAM and ENERGY attacks have a 25% chance on HIT to grant HASTE and inflict ARMOR BREAK For 7/10/12 seconds each.
Blue Bomber.sa2: Recover 25% HEALTH and gain 3/4/5 stacks of BARRIER when using a TIER 3 BLOCKBUSTER.

role_strategy: Blue Bomber is a fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to inflict ARMOR BREAK to increase her damage output while gaining stacks of BARRIER and regenerating health when an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster is used.

Blue Bomber has mediocre base stats, having a lower ATK than Prototype and a lower HP than M-3OW. Hence, Blue Bomber will have to rely completely on her Signature Abilities if she wants to deal any damage and survive fights.

On defense, Blue Bomber needs to activate her second Signature Ability as soon as possible for survival. But given the unpredictability of the AI, this may be hard to do. On offense, the stacks of BARRIER and health regeneration makes Blue Bomber a decent counter against fighters that reflect damage such as Dread Locks, Painwheel with Tainted Blood, or variants that can gain THORNS such as Criminal Mind.

Blue Bomber is better to be used offensively, giving control to the player when to use an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster as an inherent safety net. Furthermore, Blue Bomber's first Signature Ability to inflict ARMOR BREAK makes her a decent counter against defenders that rely on ARMOR such as Blue Screen, Heavy Metal and Resonant Evil. Notable BEAM and ENERGY special moves and blockbusters include THEONITE BEAM, PHASER BURN and CATASTROPHE CANNON: ALPHA. These moves can also inflict various DEBUFFS on the opponent when hit as well. Alternatively, there are two attacks in the upgraded ground combo that count as BEAM and ENERGY attacks.

Notable BEAM and ENERGY special moves and blockbusters include THEONITE BEAM, PHASER BURN and CATASTROPHE CANNON: ALPHA. These moves can also inflict various DEBUFFS on the opponent when hit as well. Alternatively, there are two attacks in the upgraded ground combo that count as BEAM and ENERGY attacks.
Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Blue Bomber depends on how she is going to be used. As an offensive fighter, PING CHECK may be useful to increase her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Blue Bomber is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
