Blue Screen.name: Blue Screen
Blue Screen.sa1: Gain a stack of ARMOR every 10/7/5 seconds. ARMOR is removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Blue Screen.sa2: When defeated, instantly detonate and inflict 25/35/50% bonus damage for each stack of ARMOR applied to Robo-Fortune.

role_strategy: Blue Screen is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her timeless stacks of ARMOR which is only removed when knocked down, making her impenetrable to long chain of combos. Furthermore, Blue Screen's detonation makes her a dangerous defender that can potentially take down players with her if not careful. Hence, Blue Screen is a formidable defender that requires careful play to properly counter. Note that getting killed by Blue Screen's detonation counts as a defeat.
Note that getting killed by Blue Screen's detonation counts as a defeat.
Marquee Ability: As a defensive variant, DDOS is the recommended ability for Blue Screen, which allows her to inflict POWER SURGE to opponents, reducing their HP when they use a blockbuster.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Robo-Fortune, Blue Screen is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Resistance and Defense.
Special investment: Special Cooldown will allow her to annoy the attacker by using Bursts and moves like PHASER BURN.
rift_battles: Blue Screen excels as a defensive wall in stalling time as she has a very high HP stat to soak damage with and an incredible defensive Signature Ability. Blue Screen synergizes very well with the Frost Armor catalyst, as it lets her inflict recoil damage and gain ARMOR stacks even easier.

Furthermore, Blue Screen's detonation ability makes it difficult to gain points for a blockbuster finish. On the moment that she detonates, players will have to use another blockbuster during her detonation to gain points. Projectile-based blockbusters are recommended for this as they often have a longer duration of effect. Eliminating Blue Screen with PRECISION hits is also a good way to bypass this.
playing_against: Due to Blue Screen getting ARMOR every few seconds, using characters with long-chain combos such as Squigly and Robo-Fortune can be less effective than using characters with short high damage combos like Cerebella and Beowulf. However, do note that certain blockbusters such as Squigly's DRAG N' DROP as well as Robo-Fortune's CATASTROPHE CANNON OMEGA has a chance to inflict ARMOR BREAK and remove BUFFS to bypass this problem.

Blue Screen depends a lot on her ARMOR stacks, so using fighters that can remove BUFFS such as Silent Kill and Doublicious are highly recommended, as these fighters allow you to remove her ARMOR stacks while still dealing considerable damage with combos. Furthermore, fighters that can inflict CURSE such as Purrfect Dark are also highly recommended as it completely nullifies Blue Screen's first Signature Ability.

When paired with catalyst such as Final Flight, it can be tricky to get the most points by killing her with a Blockbuster. Fighters like Gravedigger and Silent Kill are best for these nodes, as they either have buff removal or QUIETUS and PRECISION.

Fighters that can inflict ARMOR BREAK such as Pea Shooter and Star-Spangled may also be useful to remove her stacks of ARMOR. However, it is important to note that Blue Screen herself can remove the ARMOR BREAK when she gains ARMOR, so you will have to inflict ARMOR BREAK consistently to be effective.

Blue Streak.name: Blue Streak
Blue Streak.sa1: Grant DEADEYE and HASTE while Filia has at least 100/98/95% HEALTH. These BUFFS are removed when Filia’s HEALTH drops below 100/98/95%.
Blue Streak.sa2: Gain IMMUNITY, FINAL STAND and UNFLINCHING for 5/6/7 seconds each when using a BLOCKBUSTER while benefiting from DEADEYE. Also gain 3 stacks of PRECISION.

role_strategy: Blue Streak is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her DEADEYE and HASTE when her health is high. Using a Blockbuster while these buffs are active gives her several defensive BUFFS as well as 3 stacks of PRECISION. This combination of abilities allows Blue Streak to be a powerful variant that can easily fend off common defensive strategies.

Blue Streak's biggest power lies in the utility her BUFFS give her. DEADEYE allows her to ignore the opponent's defense and common defensive BUFFS such as EVASION, AUTO-BLOCK, UNFLINCHING and THORNS. This allows her to be a useful counter against common defensive variants such as That's All Folks!, Model Leader and Plot Twisted. Meanwhile, HASTE allows her to charge her Blockbusters very quickly, giving her frequent access to her BUFFS. Upon blockbuster use, she gains BUFFS such as IMMUNITY, FINAL STAND, PRECISION and UNFLINCHING. Out of these BUFFS, IMMUNITY and PRECISION are most noteworthy, as they allow Blue Streak to bypass debuff-reliant defenders like Resonant Evil or Freedom Fighter, as well as defenders with on-death effects such as Immoral Fiber.

Upon blockbuster use, she gains BUFFS such as IMMUNITY, FINAL STAND, PRECISION and UNFLINCHING. Out of these BUFFS, IMMUNITY and PRECISION are most noteworthy, as they allow Blue Streak to bypass debuff-reliant defenders like Resonant Evil or Freedom Fighter, as well as defenders with on-death effects such as Immoral Fiber.

Blue Streak gains massive utility with her BUFFS, but they all disappear as soon as she loses enough health. This makes her much more reliant on intercepting attacks than other variants, and much weaker against Painwheel variants with TAINTED BLOOD as their Marquee Ability. Alternatively, LEECH gives her a way to get the health she needs back.
Alternatively, LEECH gives her a way to get the health she needs back.

While Blue Streak has no inherent way to increase her own damage, her base ATK damage is sufficiently high enough to make her usable against tougher defenders regardless. Furthermore, access to BLEED in Filia's kit and health regeneration from LEECH, Filia's Marquee Ability, provides the necessary tools for Blue Streak to handle most situations with ease.
Marquee Ability: LEECH is the recommended Marquee Ability, since it allows Blue Streak a way to regain health back above her Signature Ability's requirement.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Blue Streak is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage is the most important stat for Blue Streak.

Bombshell.name: Bombshell
Bombshell.sa1: Gain ENRAGE, BARRIER or REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds when spawning a TEAR.
Bombshell.sa2: When DETONATING at least 3 TEARS at once, TEARS are UNBLOCKABLE and Parasoul changes outfits. DETONATING 5 TEARS at once inflicts STUN for 1/1.5/2 seconds on HIT.

role_strategy: Bombshell is an offensive fighter with the ability to gain one of three BUFFS that provides sustain (BARRIER and REGEN) and increased damage (ENRAGE) for every TEAR spawned. With multiple TEARS in the field, Bombshell can detonate them for powerful effects including unblockable damage and STUN, allowing Bombshell to potentially loop the opponent with a barrage of TEARS while gaining access to powerful BUFFS.

For her abilities, Bombshell would want to equip moves that can spawn TEARS easily, such as NAPALM SHOT, NAPALM SHOWER or NAPALM TOSS. This will immediately give her access to BUFFS while easily filling up the threshold condition for her second Signature Ability. With these moves, Bombshell can loop the opponent in the corner by continually generating TEARS and detonating them to STUN the opponent. Players can then follow up with a ground combo, a dash attack, a grab or an air juggle to gain meter for NAPALM SHOWER and generate more TEARS which can be detonated and repeat the cycle again.

With these moves, Bombshell can loop the opponent in the corner by continually generating TEARS and detonating them to STUN the opponent. Players can then follow up with a ground combo, a dash attack, a grab or an air juggle to gain meter for NAPALM SHOWER and generate more TEARS which can be detonated and repeat the cycle again.

Bombshell can gain multiple stacks of BARRIER easily, allowing her to synergize with support variants that revolve around BARRIER, such as Starlight Rose and Maid of Honor. Note that these two support variants provide recovery and damage, which is already present in the two other BUFFS that Bombshell gains (ENRAGE and REGEN), and thus may be a bit redundant in the long run.

Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Bombshell, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%. Due to the nature of Bombshell's Signature Ability and the utility her kit provides, players have the option of building her as a Critless Variant
Due to the nature of Bombshell's Signature Ability and the utility her kit provides, players have the option of building her as a Critless Variant
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Bombshell is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS.

Brain Freeze.name: Brain Freeze
Brain Freeze.sa1: While near the opponent, inflict IMMOBILIZE and SLOW for 7/10/12 seconds every 3 seconds. Reduce the opponent's ATTACK by 3% for every second they are IMMOBILIZED until they TAG OUT.
Brain Freeze.sa2: Deal 4/5/6% MAX HEALTH as damage to the opponent when either fighter is KNOCKED DOWN while the opponent is IMMOBILIZED.

role_strategy: Brain Freeze is a fighter with both offensive and defensive capabilities. Her first Signature Ability cripples the opponent's offensive options but only if close to her, ensuring success with consistent IMMOBILIZE to keep them there. The bonus MAX HEALTH damage is the cherry on top of an oppressive game-plan, with extra survivability gained from ATTACK reduction.

On offense, Brain Freeze should focus on getting close and staying there while using THROWS consecutively to capitalize on the MAX HEALTH damage. Merry Go Rilla and Diamond Drop will be the best throws for knocking the opponent down rapidly while keeping combo counts low to not waste time. Avoid fighting opponents with debuff removal or Immunity access.

The best way to counter Brain Freeze is to bring IMMUNITY or DEBUFF removing variants. Brain Freeze is helpless if her IMMOBILIZE and SLOW are not on the opponent. Playing from afar and keeping her away can prove useful in cases without Immunity. Notable Immunity supports are: Angel Maker, Magicurl, Sketchy, and Surgeon General.
Marquee Ability: RINGLEADER is the best marquee for Brain Freeze given her existing SLOW handles meter control. While disabling SPECIAL MOVES and TAG INS ensures the opponent is helpless.
stat_investment: General Investment: If built defensively, Brain Freeze is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. If built offensively, Brain Freeze is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: If built offensively, Meter Gain would help her perform better on the field.
rift_battles: As a WATER element fighter, Brain Freeze synergizes very well with the Frost Armor catalyst, which can significantly increase her durability as a defender. Furthermore, the Autoimmune catalyst can also be useful to prevent players from using common BLEED strategies to cripple her down.

Brass Bandit.name: Brass Bandit
Brass Bandit.sa1: Remove 1 opponent BUFF, grant ENRAGE for 10 seconds and DRAIN 3% HEALTH every 15/12/10 COMBO HITS.
Brass Bandit.sa2: Reset the timer of all active BUFFS for every 30/25/20% HEALTH lost by either Fighter.

role_strategy: Brass Bandit is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that provides BUFF removal, recovery and damage every 10 COMBO HITS. Furthermore, his ability to reset the timer of all active BUFFS provides synergy with a lot of support variants that can further enhance his capabilities in a fight. Altogether, Brass Bandit is a powerful offensive variant that provides a lot of utility to takedown even the strongest defenders in the game.

The ability to reset the timer of Brass Bandit's BUFFS is very powerful and allows Brass Bandit to continually stack ENRAGES from his first Signature Ability. Not to mention, this opens up a lot of synergy points with support variants that can provide Brass Bandit other forms of BUFFS, such as IMMUNITY from Surgeon General and Sketchy and BARRIER from Rock Star.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Brass Bandit will benefit from SOLOIST as his Marquee Ability. This compliments Big Band's Prestige Ability that provides UNBLOCKABLE dash attacks while also supplementing HEAVY REGEN that can be reset from his own Signature Ability.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Brass Bandit is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Players can build Crit Rate and Crit Damage to further increase his damage output. Meter Gain is also recommended.

Buffer Zone.name: Buffer Zone
Buffer Zone.sa1: When Robo-Fortune TAGS IN, remove all opponent BUFFS, inflict HEX and DISABLE TAG INS for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Buffer Zone.sa2: All BEAM and ENERGY attacks have a 10% chance on hit to grant BARRIER and UNFLINCHING for 5/7/10 seconds each. Also, transfer all active BUFFS to the incoming Fighter when TAGGING from Robo-Fortune.

role_strategy: Buffer Zone is a hybrid variant that utilizes TAG INS to gain advantages over the opponent through DEBUFFS and the ability to transfer BUFFS to another fighter. Furthermore, as an active fighter she can gain BARRIER and UNFLINCHING through BEAM and ENERGY attacks, providing sustainability and survivability during the fight.

On offense Buffer Zone is best paired with Rock Star that provides meter when BARRIER expires, allowing Buffer Zone to continually use blockbusters that are BEAM attacks such as CATASTROPHE CANNON OMEGA. When using this strategy, it is better to not upgrade her abilities so that her BARRIER only lasts for five seconds, allowing a faster way to gain meter via Rock Star's ability. The only disadvantage to this ability is her low ATK stat, making it difficult to use this against BUFF heavy defenders.
When using this strategy, it is better to not upgrade her abilities so that her BARRIER only lasts for five seconds, allowing a faster way to gain meter via Rock Star's ability.
The only disadvantage to this ability is her low ATK stat, making it difficult to use this against BUFF heavy defenders.
Due to her access to HEX as well as BUFF removal, Buffer Zone can counter fighters like Death Wish, removing FINAL STAND and inflicting HEX to stop her Signature Ability from activating.

On defense, Buffer Zone can be paired with fighters like Buzzkill, Fly Trap, Vapourwave Vixen and Evergreen Evil. Their air type allows them to synergize with catalyst, such as Into Thin Air, making it harder for the opponent to get a Blockbuster kill.
Marquee Ability: On offense, the recommended Marquee Ability for Buffer Zone is PING CHECK to further increase her offensive output. If used on defense, DDOS Marquee Ability is recommended.
stat_investment: General Investment: If used offense, Buffer Zone is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown. If built defensively, Buffer Zone is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Resistance and Defense.
Special investment: Meter Gain will allow her to use blockbusters more often on offense, while Accuracy increases the chances of her gaining BARRIER and UNFLINCHING.

Buzzkill.name: Buzzkill
Buzzkill.sa1: For each 20/15/10% HEALTH the opponent loses, inflict INVERSE POLARITY and WITHER for 10 seconds.
Buzzkill.sa2: While Painwheel's HEALTH% is higher than the opponent's, gain 1 stack of EVASION every 10/7/5 seconds.

role_strategy: Buzzkill is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to wear down regenerative defenders with INVERSE POLARITY and limit their options with WITHER and EVASION. This, on top of having the highest base ATK stat of any other Gold-tier fighters (tied with Hack n' Splash, Rogue Agent, and Tyrannical etc.), makes Buzzkill a hard-hitting, evasive REGEN counter.

Buzzkill is one of the few variants that can inflict INVERSE POLARITY, the others being Terror Byte, Grin Reaper, Furmidable and Psykid. INVERSE POLARITY is a powerful DEBUFF that reverses all effects of healing, making Buzzkill a powerful counter to defensive variants that rely on healing, such as Valentine with the ICU Marquee Ability and Dahlia with NO TIME TO DIE Marquee Ability.

Gaining EVADE is an exceptional way to close in on opponents, and Buzzkill gains it incredibly frequently to the point that she has an exceptionally easy time starting combos in the vast majority of scenarios. It is however countered by opponents with passive buff removal or DEADEYE. Given the higher HEALTH% requirement on SA2, it may be necessary to pair Buzzkill with a support that grants regen like Lucky Lure and Surgeon General.
Given the higher HEALTH% requirement on SA2, it may be necessary to pair Buzzkill with a support that grants regen like Lucky Lure and Surgeon General.
Marquee Ability: TAINTED BLOOD is the recommended Marquee Ability for Buzzkill, as it allows her to play a defensive role when paired with catalyst such as Into Thin Air.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Buzzkill is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting INVERSE POLARITY and WITHER. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

Candy Crusher.name: Candy Crusher
Candy Crusher.sa1: Gain REGEN every 5/4/3 seconds while OVERSTUFFED. REGEN is removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Candy Crusher.sa2: Once per match, gain permanent HASTE when reaching 5/4/3 stacks of REGEN.

role_strategy: Candy Crusher is an offensive fighter that gains timeless REGEN stacks while OVERSTUFFED, while also gaining permanent HASTE if she manages to get a certain amount of them. This make Candy Crusher a durable fighter that has much easier access to blockbusters than usual.

To gain REGEN, Candy Crusher will need to stay in OVERSTUFFED for some time, which can easily be done by equipping Umbrella's THROW-based blockbusters and special moves, such as SALT GRINDER, HUNGERN RUSH, TONGUE TWISTER and FEEDING TIME. Normal grabs will also fill up the HUNGER METER towards OVERSTUFFED. On the flip side, it's important to avoid using moves that drain the Hunger meter while aiming for REGEN stacks. After the stacks hit the cap, they can be used liberally.
On the flip side, it's important to avoid using moves that drain the Hunger meter while aiming for REGEN stacks. After the stacks hit the cap, they can be used liberally.

It is important to note that Candy Crusher can gain permanent HASTE regardless of where the REGEN comes from. This means she can be paired with variants such as Icy Hot or Inner Pieces to TAG IN with stacks of REGEN, allowing her to gain permanent HASTE without the need of specific move sets.

Marquee Ability: As Candy Crusher has no innate way of increasing her damage output besides increasing her Blockbuster usage, SWEET VICTORY is recommended. While the safety net of BITTER END can be nice, Candy Crusher often has no need for it due to her frequent access to command grab Blockbusters.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Candy Crusher is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Due to her access to HASTE, Candy Crusher does not need to build Meter Gain.

Chameleon Twist.name: Chameleon Twist
Chameleon Twist.sa1: Gain MIASMA for 5/7/10 seconds when HITTING an attacking opponent.
Chameleon Twist.sa2: 5% chance when HIT while a BLOCKBUSTER is charged to gain EVASION and MIASMA for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Chameleon Twist is a fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to gain the MIASMA buff when used in both offense and defense. MIASMA is a strong BUFF that allows her to drain opponent's health and meter simply by being near to the opponent which allows her to execute combos with blockbusters faster while keeping her health ahead of the opponent without having to worry of getting punished with the opponent's blockbuster.

On the offense, Chameleon Twist gains MIASMA by hitting a dashing opponent, also known as intercepting. This can easily be done at a close distance through a normal ground combo or by the use of Fukua's arsenal of projectile-based special moves and blockbusters such as FOREVER A CLONE, SWARM EMBRACE, and GOODNIGHT KISS.

When used defensively, Chameleon Twist can gain both MIASMA and EVASION simply by being hit while having a fully charged blockbuster. This allows her to be a slippery defender that can prevent blockbusters through her MIASMA. However, the chance of activation is quite low and requires some RNG to work.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activates when a certain percentage of health is lost, which is unfavorable when used offensively but can be useful when used defensively. Either Marquee Ability will work with Chameleon Twist, although WRAITH'S WRATH is more preferred as it provides her with some survivability as she will mostly be relying on MIASMA for damage and thus may not need the increased damage output from SPECTRAL SPITE.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Chameleon Twist is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Chaos Theory.name: Chaos Theory
Chaos Theory.sa1: When TRANSMUTING, inflict BLEED on yourself and gain ENRAGE for 6/8/10 seconds each. Also when TRANSMUTING to the LIGHT element, gain BLESSING.
Chaos Theory.sa2: DASH ATTACKS remove all BLEEDS. DRAIN 3/4/5% HEALTH per BLEED removed.

role_strategy: Chaos Theory is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that inflicts BLEED on herself and grants ENRAGE when transmuting. She also gains BLESSING when transmuting into the Light Element.

The condition of having to transmute continuously makes her unable to effectively use Double's CHAOS Marquee Ability. This removes one of the most appealing things that Double offers in battle from being offered by Chaos Theory.

Although ENRAGE does boost her offensive prowess, it is again held back by the conditions needed to get said buff. Though with the regular Double build, which consists of high crit rate, she can pair well with Seraph Soldier, allowing her to quickly regain health that she might have lost due to bleed and chip damage. But the need of a diamond support to take use out of her Signature Ability does make her a very niche fighter that most would find unappealing to use.

Fighters like Scarlet Viper, with a similar Signature Ability of inflicting BLEED and gaining ENRAGE, is far more appealing as Eliza has access to REGEN to naturally remove her bleed, combined with her very useful kit.
Marquee Ability: CHAOS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Chaos Theory.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Chaos Theory is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Due to her very fragile nature, players can build HP or Block Proficiency on her to increase her survivability.

Chill Guy.name: Chill Guy
Chill Guy.sa1: When the active Fighter blocks a HIT, apply 1 stack of SLOW for 10/13/15 seconds. When the opponent reaches 5 stacks of SLOW, remove all SLOW stacks and inflict STUN for 6 seconds.
Chill Guy.sa2: When any teammate HITS a stunned opponent, inflict ARMOR BREAK and gain DEADEYE for 5/8/10 seconds each.

role_strategy: Chill Guy is an offensive support fighter with a Signature Ability that allows him and his teammates to inflict SLOW and STUN on an enemy, giving you the opportunity to safely start a combo, and gives his teammates access to DEADEYE and ARMOR BREAK when hitting a STUNNED opponent.

Chill Guy makes it very easy for teammates to gain DEADEYE and inflict ARMOR BREAK by using a single TAG IN. This makes Chill Guy a very good support fighter to use in Prize Fights and Rift Battles to counter certain modifiers and fighters. Note that you can get DEADEYE simply by using moves or characters that can STUN your opponent, like Parasoul`s EGRET DIVE, or Cold Stones first SA.
Note that you can get DEADEYE simply by using moves or characters that can STUN your opponent, like Parasoul`s EGRET DIVE, or Cold Stones first SA.
Chill Guy can be used as a counter to Scratching Post Catalyst, because the STUN that he inflicts lasts longer than the STUN that you suffer from Scratching Post Catalyst.
Marquee Ability: As an offensive fighter, DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability and will help keep Chill Guy on the upper hand as he deals damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Chill Guy is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: Investment in Accuracy will ensure that his DEBUFFS aren't resisted by the enemy. Investing in Meter Gain is not ideal, as Beowulf has access to HASTE through his TAUNT.

Class Cutter.name: Class Cutter
Class Cutter.sa1: All HITS from a BLOCKBUSTER or SPECIAL MOVE have a 10% chance to be UNBLOCKABLE and inflict DEATH MARK for 10/12/15 seconds.
Class Cutter.sa2: Inflict HEAVY BLEED and HEAL BLOCK for 10 seconds when dealing at least 10/7/5% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH from a single HIT.

role_strategy: Class Cutter is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to deal significant damage to the toughest defenders. Unlike other Filia variants, Class Cutter has the capability to inflict HEAL BLOCK, allowing her to deal significant damage against common fighters that are used to counter Filia's BLEED by turning them into REGEN, such as Bloodbath or any Valentine with the ICU Marquee Ability.

Class Cutter has a significantly high base ATK stat, and in conjunction with all the DEBUFFS she inflicts along with unblockable blockbusters and special moves, Class Cutter has the tools to significantly land massive damage to opponents of any kind. However, as she relies on these DEBUFFS to cripple defenders, fighters that can gain IMMUNITY such as Dream Band can be troubling for her to take down. All of Class Cutter's moves have a chance to inflict a long-lasting DEATH MARK, increasing crit damage for the duration. This, along with a decently built Crit Rate, can make Class Cutter a good critical damage dealer.

All of Class Cutter's moves have a chance to inflict a long-lasting DEATH MARK, increasing crit damage for the duration. This, along with a decently built Crit Rate, can make Class Cutter a good critical damage dealer.

A lot of Filia's moves have high hit counts, which can make it harder to trigger her second Signature Ability, especially against high streak Prize Fight teams. WIDOW'S PEAK, BLOWOUT and TRICHOBEZOAR are exceptions to this, having very low hit counts and high burst damage. WIDOW'S PEAK is especially notable as it inflicts ARMOR BREAK, removing ARMOR stacks and softening up defenders for hits right after.

Defensively, Class Cutter can be a dangerous opponent to face as she has access to unblockable special moves that can be used at the start of the match. There really is no way to counter this, as it comes down to chance. However, quickly back-dashing at the start of the match may avoid such attacks from hitting.

Marquee Ability: LEECH is the recommended ability for Class Cutter, despite THE FIRST CUT complementing her heavy bleed. This is due to her Signature Ability which inflicts bleed consistently and reliably, as well as other Filia moves capable of inflicting BLEED to lower the enemy's Health quickly before Class Cutter's Debuffs expire. Due to this, Class Cutter tends to prefer LEECH to sustain herself during battle, with high bursts of healing when landing Critical Hits thanks to DEATH MARK.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Class Cutter is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage are the most important stat for Class Cutter. Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS will not be resisted by enemies, and there's a higher chance of her Special Moves and Blockbusters being unblockable.

Claw & Order.name: Claw & Order
Claw & Order.sa1: CRITICAL HITS have a 25/35/50% chance to reset the timers of all opponent DEBUFFS except STUN and DOOM.
Claw & Order.sa2: Set the opponent's SPECIAL MOVES on cooldown and DISABLE their BLOCKBUSTERS for 10/12/15 seconds when dealing at least 10/7/5% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH from a single HIT.

role_strategy: Claw & Order is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to lock the opponent's blockbusters and special moves after doing enough burst damage. She can also reset the timers of all opponent DEBUFFS, allowing her to completely prevent the opponent's blockbusters and special moves throughout the game, while also resetting DEBUFFS inflicted by herself or her teammates.

Claw & Order relies primarily on burst damage to activate her second Signature Ability. Hence, typical combos such as FIBER UPPER > EL GATO > CAT SLIDE are recommended as they can deal a massive amount of damage in a relatively low number of hits. FIBER UPPER also inflicts ARMOR BREAK, which she can then reset constantly for more damage.

Claw & Order's first Signature Ability allows her to reset the timers of all DEBUFFS. It is important to remember that Ms. Fortune has access to special moves and blockbusters that can inflict various DEBUFFS: BURST inflicts DEATH MARK CAT SCRATCH inflicts DEATH MARK or ARMOR BREAK (only when blocked) FIBER UPPER inflicts ARMOR BREAK HIT PAWS inflict BLEED CAT SCRATCH FEVER inflicts DEATH MARK
BURST inflicts DEATH MARK
CAT SCRATCH inflicts DEATH MARK or ARMOR BREAK (only when blocked)
FIBER UPPER inflicts ARMOR BREAK
HIT PAWS inflict BLEED
CAT SCRATCH FEVER inflicts DEATH MARK
Ms Fortune's Prestige Ability also inflicts GUARD BREAK, which she can reset as well. This makes it far easier to keep on the offense once she fills her Prestige gauge.

Claw & Order can be paired with Sundae School to increase the duration of DEBUFFS, or Sheltered and Clue Chaser to increase her Crit Rate. Red Velvet also makes a great partner as she can inflict HEX, which Claw & Order can then reset indefinitely.

Using Guest Stars, Claw & Order is able to get access to useful DEBUFFS without the need of teammates, making her one of the best Ms. Fortunes. Guest Stars, like Brain Drain: Head Trauma, allows her to stack many debuffs while also having access to DEBUFFS like HEX.
Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Claw & Order is BOOP, giving her stacks of ENRAGE and further increasing her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Claw & Order is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature ability activating, while also elevating her overall damage.
This variant's color palette is based off the original Xbox 360 with its caption being a direct quote from Super Troopers (2001).

Clue Chaser.name: Clue Chaser
Clue Chaser.sa1: While Filia is alive, increase the active fighter's CRIT RATE by 5/7/10% every 3 COMBO HITS (up to 50/75/100%).
Clue Chaser.sa2: Filia's critical HITS above 20/15/10 combo hits ignore the opponent Fighter's ARMOR and DEFENSE.

role_strategy: Clue Chaser is an offensive-support variant who provides Crit Rate for her whole team, and defense busting abilities for herself.

As she won't need any Crit Rate nor Piercing invested to deal with high defense builds, Clue Chaser is a solid early game choice that scales well into late game. By first hitting a standard ground combo, Clue chaser's second ability will be active for most if not all of your harder hitting special moves and blockbusters.
By first hitting a standard ground combo, Clue chaser's second ability will be active for most if not all of your harder hitting special moves and blockbusters.
Marquee Ability: LEECH is the best Marquee Ability for Clue Chaser, as it allows her to recover from accidents and chip damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Clue Chaser is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special Investment: As her second ability ignores all forms of defense and her first grants up to 100% Crit Rate, it is possible to build her with only Attack and Crit Damage as high as possible, with all extra stats in one of Accuracy or Meter gain. However, is it advised to simply build a set for Windswept and reuse that set for Clue Chaser.

Cold Stones.name: Cold Stones
Cold Stones.sa1: THROWS have a 10/15/20% chance to inflict STUN for 6 seconds.
Cold Stones.sa2: Deal 25/35/50% bonus damage against STUNNED opponents.

role_strategy: Cold Stones is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows him the chance to STUN opponents with his THROWS. STUN prevents all action by the opponent, providing a window of time to freely attack with increased damage from his second Signature Ability. This makes Cold Stones a great budget option for beginners to practice with.

Beowulf has a lot of ways to THROW the opponent, allowing Cold Stones to activate his ability easily: Beowulf's air juggle finisher is a THROW. WULF SHOOT is a special move that THROWS the opponent. Blockbusters such as LUPINE PUMMEL, AIRWULF and WULFMANIA also THROWS the opponent. LUPINE PUMMEL especially can reliably STUN due to its incredible hit count, especially while in HYPE MODE.
Beowulf's air juggle finisher is a THROW.
WULF SHOOT is a special move that THROWS the opponent.
Blockbusters such as LUPINE PUMMEL, AIRWULF and WULFMANIA also THROWS the opponent. LUPINE PUMMEL especially can reliably STUN due to its incredible hit count, especially while in HYPE MODE.

While his second Signature Ability increases his damage output against STUNNED opponents, it is best to use the STUN as a control tool instead. Preventing a TAG OUT or stopping the opponent from using a blockbuster will often be more beneficial in the long run.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability, as Cold Stones will often have more health than the opponent due to his excellent control ability.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Cold Stone is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: Accuracy investment will allow him to inflict STUN reliably. Investing in Meter Gain is not ideal, as Beowulf has access to HASTE through his TAUNT.

Comet Custodian.name: Comet Custodian
Comet Custodian.sa1: Once summoned, Hilgard will remain on stage until Marie is KNOCKED DOWN or TAGS OUT. While Hilgard is on stage, Marie has a 20/35/50% chance to prevent an incoming DEBUFF and inflict HEAL BLOCK and CURSE for 10 seconds each.
Comet Custodian.sa2: Remove all opponent BUFFS and increase damage by 33/66/100% for the rest of the COMBO when the opponent BOUNCES off a wall.

role_strategy: Comet Custodian is an offensive Marie variant with access to DEBUFF Prevention, BUFF Removal, HEAL BLOCK, CURSE, and greatly increased damage after wall-bounces. She also has the unique ability of summoning Hilgard indefinitely with Hilgard's Howl and Hilgard's Haymaker, allowing for entirely new combos that no other Marie has access to.

Marie has access to wall-bounces with three of her moves: Hilgard's Haymaker, Scrub 'N' Smash and Hoover Maneuver. These can be chained between them to maximize the amount of wall-bounces in a single combo, constantly removing any defensive buffs the opponent could get while also dealing massive amounts of damage. It is possible to chain multiple Hilgard's Haymakers in a single combo due to Hilgard being indefinitely summoned. Marie's outtake move, Formal Challenge, can also be used for wall-bounces but only against the last remaining opponent.

Normally, opponent's Resistance will counter Marie's Accuracy, but because of her access to QUIETUS in her kit, which negates Resistance, Comet Custodian gets all the benefits from her Accuracy.

Corrosive Agent.name: Corrosive Agent
Corrosive Agent.sa1: Remove all DEBUFFS and gain 1/2/3 stack(s) of BARRIER when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER.
Corrosive Agent.sa2: With 5 stacks of BARRIER, all SHOTS are UNBLOCKABLE and inflict SLIME on HIT for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Corrosive Agent is a fighter who cleanses all DEBUFFS on herself before applying up to 3 stacks of BARRIER every time a blockbuster is used. On top of that, all of her SHOTS are UNBLOCKABLE and inflict SLIME while she has 5 stacks of them, making her hard to defend against. These abilities mean she can protect herself from blockbusters effectively as well as being able to crack open defenses with ease.

With a low ATK stat and lacking any damage multipliers, Corrosive Agent's utility in offense is in her DEBUFF cleanse, access to BARRIER, and dealing UNBLOCKABLE damage. This is especially useful in Rift Battles where damage isn't incredibly important, and her utility is appreciated. BARRIER allows her to tank a lot of damage to ensure high health bonus fights while the DEBUFF cleanse allows her to ignore plenty of modifiers and popular catalysts such as Curse of Knowledge, Slow-Mo and Darknut with a blockbuster. SLIME makes her useful in fights where the opponent gains a lot of BUFFS, such as fights against Heavy Metal or That's All Folks!. UNBLOCKABLE shots in combination with ICE SHOT allows Corrosive Agent to get hits and start combo chains easily.

Cosmic Rebel.name: Cosmic Rebel
Cosmic Rebel.sa1: Every 5th non-projectile COMBO HIT inflicts DEATH MARK for 10/12/15 seconds.
Cosmic Rebel.sa2: CRITICAL HITS grant IMMUNITY for 3/4/5 seconds, INVINCIBLE for 1 second, and 25% increased CRIT DAMAGE while the opponent is suffering from DEATH MARK.

role_strategy: Cosmic Rebel is an offensive variant that relies on DEATH MARK and CRITICAL HITS to gain IMMUNITY and INVINCIBLE for each of her attacks, allowing her to overcome the effects of reflect-based damage and DEBUFFS with ease. With careful use and preparation, Cosmic Rebel can be a powerful offensive pick to counter many prominent defenders in the game.

Cosmic Rebel will first have to reach 5th combo hits to inflict DEATH MARK and start gaining INVINCIBLE for each of her critical hits. This may sound counter-intuitive if she's meant to counter reflect-based defenders, since her first 5 combo hits would not be immune to reflect. One solution to this is to bring support variants with access to healing such as Seraph Soldier to alleviate this initial reflect damage. Another solution is to inflict DEATH MARK through other means, such as a secondary character's ability or moves, before TAGGING IN Cosmic Rebel. Black Dahlia have easy access to DEATH MARK through her Prestige Ability and BURST Painwheel and Ms. Fortune can also inflict DEATH MARK through BURST and other moves Dream Demon and Raw Nerv can both inflict permanent DEATH MARK through their Signature Abilities

Creature of Habit.name: Creature of Habit
Creature of Habit.sa1: Gain 1 stack of MIASMA every 5/4/3 seconds.
Creature of Habit.sa2: When reaching 5 stacks of MIASMA, convert them to 5 stacks of ENRAGE and regain 25/35/50% MAX HEALTH. ENRAGE is removed when Double is KNOCKED DOWN or TAGS-OUT.

role_strategy: Creature of Habit is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants the player MIASMA rapidly and converts them to ENRAGE when max stacks are reached, leading to a fast gameplan of using miasma to charge blockbusters and spending them when the enrage comes in for a cashout, with a bonus MAX HP heal to make up for miasma being less present.

Players can choose to equip 4 special moves along with 1 unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster to gain maximum value from her Signature Ability by stacking multiple stacks of MIASMA while charging the blockbuster and then dishing out maximum damage with stacks of ENRAGE when it is charged. When using heavy amounts of special moves, Harlequin is a recommended support variant to bolster her damage output while reducing cooldowns of that special move faster.

Criminal Mind.name: Criminal Mind
Criminal Mind.sa1: Inflict DEATH MARK and gain THORNS for 5/7/10 seconds each when either Fighter deals at least 10% MAX HEALTH from a single HIT.
Criminal Mind.sa2: Opponents are inflicted with BLEED for 3/4/5 seconds when dashing while suffering from DEATH MARK.

role_strategy: Criminal Mind is a fighter with a Signature Ability that can be triggered both offensively and defensively by either fighter. Unlike most other defensive variants that revolve around damage reduction, Criminal Mind's defensive capabilities is tied onto her offensive traits through damage reflection via THORNS and damage infliction via BLEED. Although she has some defensive attributes, she performs best when used offensively.

Criminal Mind has the exact same stat distribution as Harlequin which boasts the highest ATK stat of all Gold-tier Cerebella. Thus, she has the offensive prowess to deal 10% of damage from a single hit using a wide range of Cerebella's one-hit moves such as MERRY GO-RILLA, BATTLE BUTT, DIAMOND DROP, and DIAMONDS ARE FOREVER. DEATH MARK further complements her offensive output by increasing the damage taken by opponents from CRITICAL HITS and while BLOCKING by 50%. Moves like LOCK N' LOADED allows her to take the most use out of her DEATH MARK, dealing incredible damage per single hit.

Crimson Cyclone.name: Crimson Cyclone
Crimson Cyclone.sa1: When either Fighter lands a THROW, gain ARMOR for 15 seconds. Cerebella's THROW HITS inflict HEAL BLOCK for 15 seconds and 50/75/100% of the damage inflicted is regained as HEALTH.
Crimson Cyclone.sa2: Gain 15% BLOCKBUSTER METER and have a 50% chance to refresh the COOLDOWN of all SPECIAL MOVES when landing a THROW. BLOCKBUSTERS deal 30% increased damage per stack of ARMOR on Cerebella.

role_strategy: Crimson Cyclone is a hybrid fighter with a Signature Ability that utilizes THROWS to gain defensive attributes, and SPECIAL COOLDOWN refreshes while inhibiting the enemies healing through HEAL BLOCK. With an attack bonus for each stack of ARMOR and inherent healing on damage dealt, this ensures she is able to deal big damage while being hard to crack even in the most overwhelming scenarios.
The SPECIAL MOVE refresh can be useful for builds that are missing sufficient Special Cooldown stats while increasing her tempo in MERRY GO-RILLA cycling.
PUMMEL HORSE, MERRY GO-RILLA. EXCELLEBELLA, DIAMOND DROP, GRAB BAG and ULTIMATE SHOWSTOPPER are considered THROW attacks and will work towards Crimson Cyclone`s Signature Ability activating.

With naturally high Attack stat and 30% boost for all damage Crimson Cyclone can also utilize DIAMONDS ARE FOREVER or DIAMOND DROP very well, Crimson Cyclone can also be paired with variants, which give ARMOR, such as Model Leader and Dead of Winter. However, do note Dead of Winter's SA2 can remove armor to prevent debuffs, so you may want to avoid her in debuff heavy matches.
Stat Investment
General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Crimson Cyclone is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Accuracy is an imortant stat for her, as it increases the chances of her second Signature Ability activating. Due to her access to passive Meter Gain, Meter Gain should be ignored.

Curl Scout.name: Curl Scout
Curl Scout.sa1: For every 5th COMBO HIT landed on either Fighter, remove 1 DEBUFF and gain ARMOR for 7/8/10 seconds.
Curl Scout.sa2: While benefiting from ARMOR, gain 1% HEALTH, 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second, and inflict WITHER for 4/5/6 seconds every 4 seconds.

Her passive healing ability, combined with her capacity to reduce her opponent's blockbuster Meter, makes her a challenging opponent to defeat without careful planning. Pair her with support variants such as Rose-Tinted and Model Leader that provides BUFFS from the bench in order to gain passive healing throughout the combat easily.

Dame Slayer.name: Dame Slayer

LIGHTNING SHOTS deal significantly less damage than other SHOT types, so the extra bonus damage will rarely make a big impact. Dark Lord.name: Dark Lord

Dark Lord.sa2: CRITICAL HITS inflict DEATH MARK, QUIETUS, or BLEED and grant ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds each.

role_strategy: Dark Lord is an offensive fighter that starts off crippled due to permanent FATIGUE, but gets an insane damage boost after the first kill. Paired with her second Signature Ability that gives her even more damage boost via ENRAGE, BLEED and DEATH MARK, she becomes the strongest hitting Eliza and one of the strongest variants in the entire game. Dark Lord has the highest base ATK stat out of all Eliza variants, already giving her a huge advantage in terms of damage.

Also worth to note, Eliza does not have to be the one to defeat the first opponent for her ability to trigger, kills from teammates will also remove her FATIGUE and grant her damage and crit boost. Dead Heat.name: Dead Heat
Dead Heat.sa1: Gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 5 seconds every 10 seconds while below 25/35/50% HEALTH.
Dead Heat.sa2: 50/75/100% chance for SPECIAL MOVES to be UNBLOCKABLE while benefitting from ENRAGE.

She has a high-risk, high-reward play style, rewarding players who can keep her under the threshold without dying with the ability to continuously go on the offensive.

When using Dead Heat on the offense, it is recommended for players to utilize strategies that prevent her from dying through a single combo. This involves having a support such as Valentine with the TRAUMA CENTER Marquee Ability to provide FINAL STAND and prevent death, while also providing access to Forbidden Procedure as a revival method for a backup strategy. An alternative strategy is to bring support fighters that can provide her with an alternative way to gain ENRAGE, such as Rerun, Inner Pieces, or Oh Mai.

As a Silver Squigly variant, Dead Heat may struggle in offense in high Prize Fight streaks, given her lower than average ATK stat. While the stacks of ENRAGE can help, Dead Heat will mostly rely on her ability to constantly provide pressure through her unblockable special moves and chip the opponent slowly through Squigly's long chain of combos. While at first glance Dead Heat looks like she promotes heavy use of special moves, one or two special moves are usually enough due to Squigly's naturally long combos. SILVER CHORD is the main recommendation since it staggers no matter if it's charged or not, though DRAG 'N BITE while having at least one charge is also a good option.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability works with Dead Heat, since both conditions require her to be dead. EVIL DEAD can be useful on the offense to inflict both CURSE and WITHER, making it easier for the next fighter to defeat opponents. Dead of Winter.name: Dead of Winter
Dead of Winter.sa1: While Squigly is alive, the active Fighter inflicts WITHER for 10 seconds and gains ARMOR every 15/12/10 seconds. These effects are removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Dead of Winter.sa2: When the active Fighter is benefiting from this ARMOR and about to suffer a DEBUFF, remove ARMOR to prevent it and gain 20/30/40% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Dead of Winter is a defensive and supportive Squigly, able to give ARMOR to the active fighter and cleanse DEBUFFS if they benefit from her ARMOR too. Moreover, she also inflicts WITHER on the enemy, disrupting BLOCKBUSTERS

Be aware that Dead of Winter can only remove DEBUFFS if the active fighter is benefiting from Dead of Winter's ARMOR. Be careful letting this activate because it also gives the active fighter 40% BLOCKBUSTER METER
To counter Dead of Winter, you need to knock the enemy down often. This will remove all the ARMOR and WITHER. Short combos are preferred to deal with Dead of Winter.
Marquee Ability: DEAD ALIVE is the recommended Marquee Ability as it can provide other teammates FINAL STAND, making it a good stalling tool.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Squigly, Dead of Winter is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Resistance and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.
rift_battles: Dead of Winter, as a Water variant, synergizes well with the catalyst Frost Armor because it adds extra ARMOR and helps add reflect damage. Furthermore, the Squigly-specific catalyst, Return to Sender, enhances her stall potential by instantly reviving her if she's suffering from a DEBUFF when receiving a fatal hit.

Deal Breaker.name: Deal Breaker
Deal Breaker.sa1: Grant IMMUNITY, HASTE, or ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER. Also inflict GUARD BREAK and 2 random DEBUFFS for 10 seconds each.
Deal Breaker.sa2: 50% chance to grant UNFLINCHING, REGEN, or ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds when a BUFF or DEBUFF on the opponent expires.

role_strategy: Deal Breaker is an offensive fighter that relies on blockbuster to gain various BUFFS and inflict GUARD BREAK. When a BUFF or DEBUFF on the opponent expires, she has the ability to gain another set of BUFFS, allowing her to stack multiple BUFFS for survivability and increased damage output.

Deal Breaker's guaranteed GUARD BREAK allows her to be aggressive in a fight. It is best to equip Tier 1 blockbusters that charge fast such as IMPENDING DOOM and ARGUS AGONY. IMPENDING DOOM is particularly noteworthy because it is a long-range blockbuster that can inflict STUN. With multiple stacks of GUARD BREAK, IMPENDING DOOM can be used from afar to open up combo routes. Once the hit connects, players can get close with Deal Breaker and start her combo game to build meter for other blockbusters and stack up more BUFFS. GUARD BREAK allows Deal Breaker to play like Fukua, with access to zoning tools from afar and the ability to get close quickly to start combo chains.
GUARD BREAK allows Deal Breaker to play like Fukua, with access to zoning tools from afar and the ability to get close quickly to start combo chains.

The BUFFS that Deal Breaker get from her first Signature Ability are all very potent. IMMUNITY prevents DEBUFFS from being applied, HASTE charges blockbusters faster (and reuse them again) and ENRAGE increases her damage output. After several BUFFS and DEBUFF expiry, Deal Breaker will have plenty of BUFFS to be a consistent damage dealer.

Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Deal Breaker as it provides the chance to reset the cooldown for her special moves, which are mostly projectiles, and reuse them almost immediately.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Deal Breaker is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase her overall damage, while Accuracy increase the chances of her gaining BUFFS.

Death Defier.name: Death Defier
Death Defier.sa1: Annie gains UNFLINCHING and 10/15/20% STAR POWER when DASHING. When activating STAR POWER at full meter, instantly empty it to gain 1 stack of permanent ENRAGE and MIASMA each.
Death Defier.sa2: When suffering a HIT that would be fatal, consume all permanent BUFFS on Annie to STUN the opponent for 1.5/2/2.5 seconds and then regain 5/10/15% MAX HEALTH per BUFF consumed.

role_strategy: Death Defier is an offensive Annie, aiming to play with by dashing around to eventually gain permanent ENRAGE and permanent MIASMA. With how much she tends to be running around, she is also able to play safely by being able to revive herself as long as she benefits from a permanent BUFF.

Death Defier can gain STAR POWER in 3 different ways. DASHING backwards, DASHING forwards for at least 0.2 seconds, or the beginning animation of her DASH ATTACK. She can only gain the STAR POWER once per dash, so you will not gain STAR POWER if you were to DASH forward and land a DASH ATTACK, or if you landed a DASH ATTACK then dashed away. You can gain STAR POWER again if the DASH is separated by another attack or waiting long enough.
Annie will require 7 permanent BUFFs if you want to revive her at full Health, but she is fortunately safe to use after being knocked out thanks to the short STUN WINDOW she places on the enemy.

Marquee Ability: Death Defier will benefit from RED SHIFT to further increase her damage output easily through subsequent uses of blockbusters and special moves. Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, Death Defier can also be used as a Critless Variant.
Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, Death Defier can also be used as a Critless Variant.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Death Defier is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage.

Death Wish.name: Death Wish
Death Wish.sa1: Every 7th COMBO HIT landed on Umbrella or the opponent TRANSFERS up to 1/2/3 enemy BUFF(S) to herself and inflicts HEX for 10 seconds.
Death Wish.sa2: Once per match when defeated, RESURRECT with 15/20/25% HEALTH and REVIVE all defeated teammates with 25% HEALTH.

role_strategy: Death Wish is a fighter with the ability to steal BUFFS and inflict HEX on the opponent every seven combo hits, providing Death Wish with a great amount of easily achievable utility. Additionally, her second ability revives her entire team on fatal hit, making her a strong variant with both offensive and defensive use.

HEX is a very powerful DEBUFF, disabling the use of Signature Abilities. The ability to steal BUFFS and inflict HEX simply through combo hits makes Death Wish the most consistent BUFF control and HEX user on offense. Furthermore, her ability also works while getting combo'd herself, making it hard for players to use their own Signature Abilities and BUFFS against her while on defense. BUFF stealing and HEX together is a very powerful combination, as it notably makes IMMUNITY useless against her as she can steal it for herself before inflicting HEX.
BUFF stealing and HEX together is a very powerful combination, as it notably makes IMMUNITY useless against her as she can steal it for herself before inflicting HEX.

Death Wish's second Signature Ability acts as a safety net for the entire team. It allows Death Wish to regain her health along with her dead teammates. This is very useful especially in defense where she can be put in the third spot and use her ability once her teammates are already defeated, similar to Kill Joy.

While her abilities can be triggered easily, there are still ways to bypass it. For one, characters that deal a lot of damage in a few hits will be able to lower Death Wish's health substantially without triggering the HEX and CURSE, and PRECISION can bypass both of her abilities. Finally, variants/characters with access to revive nullification in some way make Death Wish's revive ability less powerful. Good counters to Death Wish include Windswept, Dragon Brawler and Biting Cold. Additionally, when she is not in the first spot of the team, characters can use OUTTAKE to bring her into the field with her living teammates on bench to lower the effectiveness of her second Signature Ability.

Additionally, when she is not in the first spot of the team, characters can use OUTTAKE to bring her into the field with her living teammates on bench to lower the effectiveness of her second Signature Ability.

Marquee Ability: Death Wish will benefit from either Marquee Ability depending on her use. On offense, SWEET VICTORY will further bolster her damage output by granting ENRAGE stacks upon the death of her opponent, allowing her to snowball damage against incoming fighters. On defense, BITTER END will provide further sustain and FINAL STAND, delaying fights.
stat_investment: General Investment: On Offense, Death Wish is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. On defense, she is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her HEX is not resisted by enemies.

Decrypted.name: Decrypted
Decrypted.sa1: Inflict 15/20/25% bonus damage for each of the opponents living teammates.
Decrypted.sa2: Transfer 1 enemy BUFF to yourself and inflict WITHER for 5/7/10 seconds when entering SEKHMET MODE.

role_strategy: Decrypted is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her bonus damage depending on the number of living teammates, while also providing utility in the form of BUFF and meter control through stacks of WITHER.

When playing as Decrypted, placing her at the front of the team may yield better results, as this allows her to fight opponents while they still have allies and gain an extra bonus damage. However, Decrypted's base attack is naturally low, and she may struggle against naturally tough defenders such as Resonant Evil.

As a variant that can steal BUFFS for herself, Decrypted may be useful against Painwheel defenders with the GRUDGE Marquee Ability or against opponents that have access to timeless BUFFS such as Corrosive Agent, Overclocked, and X-Bot. Furthermore, Inner Pieces can be used as a support to transfer those BUFFS to other fighters.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work well with Decrypted. RITUAL SACRIFICE can be useful to quickly charge up blockbusters. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH can be useful as a safety-net when a mistake is made to get her back to full health. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Decrypted as a Critless Variant

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Decrypted is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Demon Artist.name: Demon Artist
Demon Artist.sa1: While CHARGED, inflict BLEED for 5/7/10 seconds for each 15% HEALTH lost by either Fighter.
Demon Artist.sa2: Gain ENRAGE and REGEN for 8/10/12 seconds each when using a BLOCKBUSTER while the opponent is suffering from BLEED.

role_strategy: Demon Artist is an offensive fighter that takes advantage of BLEEDS to increase her offensive output while providing regeneration. This combination of abilities allows Demon Artist to deal significant damage while keeping her health high, a unique trait among Squigly variants. Squigly variants tend to have a lower than average ATK stat, but Demon Artist have a respectable average ATK which is only amplified by easy access to ENRAGE from blockbuster usage. Health regeneration is not a common trait in Squigly's kit, allowing Demon Artist to stand out among other variants.

Diva Intervention.name: Diva Intervention
Diva Intervention.sa1: While in Sekhmet Mode, 25/35/50% of the damage inflicted by NON-BLOCKBUSTER attacks is regained as HEALTH.
Diva Intervention.sa2: While in Sekhmet Mode, NON-BLOCKBUSTER attacks deal 50/75/100% bonus damage and drain 4/6/8% of the opponent's BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Diva Intervention is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her attacks in Sekhmet Mode to drain the opponent's meter and regain health. Through her Sekhmet attacks, Diva Intervention can quickly build up blockbuster meter while reducing the opponent's, allowing her to control the opponent's blockbuster usage while making it very easy to spam blockbusters. SEKHMET'S BITE > CHARGE ATTACK is a simple but universal combo that easily depletes the meter from opponent Blockbusters while recovering at least a major part of all the player's Blockbusters, including SEKHMET'S BITE itself.

Diva Intervention can be teamed with fighters like Noble Mogul and Starlight Rose to further increase her damage output.

Marquee Ability: As an Eliza, Diva Intervention does not benefit much from her Marquee Ability. It is preferred that she is built critless to get the maximum use of her ability and Eliza kit. If not built critless, she benefits most from BLOOD OATH as she has a lot of meter gain in her Signature Ability already and BLOOD OATH provides a comfortable safety net. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Diva Intervention as a Critless Variant

Although not reliable, FEAST AND FAMINE gives her an extra form of health regen and buff control while in Sekhmet Mode. Thus, it's suggested that players invest in her Prestige Ability.

rift_battles: Diva Intervention is a great fighter to use against Painwheel nodes with Don't Poke the Buer catalyst. Without any investment in Crit Rate, Diva Intervention can deal multiple small hits that bypasses the Don't Poke the Buer catalyst through Sekhmet's CHARGE ATTACK. Furthermore, Diva Intervention can regain health back to overcome Painwheels with the TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability, while also having access to CHAOS BANISH that remove BUFFS to handle those with the GRUDGE Marquee Ability. Lastly, Diva Intervention can drain blockbuster meter to prevent fighters such as Neuromancer from punishing you with an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster.

Djinn Frizz.name: Djinn Frizz
Djinn Frizz.sa1: Every 15/12/10 seconds gain 3 random BUFF(S) for 5 seconds.
Djinn Frizz.sa2: 33% chance when using a BLOCKBUSTER to convert 1/2/3 BUFF(S) into permanent ENRAGE.

role_strategy: Djinn Frizz is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around short BUFFS that can be converted into permanent ENRAGE for increased damage output. With one of the highest base ATK stats in the game, Djinn Frizz is an absolute powerhouse that can easily deal massive amounts of damage that only increases over time.

As most available BUFFS are defensive in nature, Djinn Frizz has an in-built safety net when mistakes are made, especially if INVINCIBLE, FINAL STAND or HEAVY REGEN are acquired. However, these BUFFS only last for 5 seconds and are completely random. Hence, it is better to not rely completely on her BUFFS and to view it as additional support.

Furthermore, given the short window frame of 5 seconds, players will have to carefully time their blockbusters in order to maximize the chance of converting those BUFFS into permanent ENRAGE. Pairing Djinn Frizz with Evergreen Evil will increase the duration of your BUFFS by 5 seconds, allowing a greater window to convert those BUFFS into permanent ENRAGE. Some BUFFS such as HASTE, INVINCIBLE or HEAVY REGEN may be beneficial and players will have to decide whether these BUFFS are worth converting to ENRAGE given the situation.
Some BUFFS such as HASTE, INVINCIBLE or HEAVY REGEN may be beneficial and players will have to decide whether these BUFFS are worth converting to ENRAGE given the situation.

Marquee Ability: LEECH is the recommended Marquee Ability that allows her to regain some health back. With a sky-high base ATK stat which is only further boosted by stacks of ENRAGE, Djinn Frizz is one of the very few Filias that do not have to rely on BLEED effects to deal consistent damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Djinn Frizz is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her converting buffs into ENRAGE, while Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

Don Passione.name: Don Passione
Don Passione.sa1: When Eliza is about to suffer a DEBUFF, 50% chance to prevent it and inflict either BLEED, HEX or QUIETUS for 8/10/12 seconds.
Don Passione.sa2: Gain permanent MIASMA for each DEBUFF an opponent has while exiting Sekhmet Mode (max 1/2/3 per exit). MIASMA is removed when the opponent is no longer suffering a DEBUFF.

role_strategy: Don Passione is an offensive Eliza variant with access to permanent MIASMA, DEBUFF Prevention, HEX, BLEED and QUIETUS. She is the only Eliza with access to MIASMA and the only fighter with access to permanent MIASMA.
With her access to HEX and DEBUFF Prevention, she can easily counter fighters like Death Wish and Unholy Host, locking them out of their Signature Ability.

If placed in an environment without that many debuffs, Don Passione can team up with fighters like Hell's Belle, Purrfect Dark, Dream Demon and Raw Nerv to get the debuffs that she wants. She can also be equipped with a Brain Drain: Head Trauma Guest Star to get the debuffs that she wants.

When built with 50% Accuracy, Don Passione has a 75% chance to prevent DEBUFFS. If Don Passione is benefiting from IMMUNITY, not only will she prevent the DEBUFFS, but she will also have a 50-75% chance to inflict HEX, BLEED, or QUIETUS.
Normally, opponent's Resistance will counter Eliza's Accuracy, but because of her access to QUIETUS, which negates Resistance, Don Passione gets all the benefits from her Accuracy.

Marquee Ability: Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Don Passione as a Critless Variant. If not built Critless, BLOOD OATH is the recommended Marquee Ability for Don Passione, as it lets her recover from mistakes.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Don Passione is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: It is recommended that players don't invest in Meter Gain, as Don Passione has access to MIASMA and thus Meter Gain.

Double Exposure.name: Double Exposure
Double Exposure.sa1: Successful BEAM attacks of SPECIAL MOVES grant IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds and STUN the opponent for 2 seconds if they are not suffering from BLEED.
Double Exposure.sa2: When STUN expires on the opponent, grant EVASION for 10/12/15 seconds to Robo-Fortune and inflict HEAVY BLEED for 5 seconds to the opponent.

role_strategy: Double Exposure is an offensive Robo-Fortune, relying on her BEAM-based SPECIAL MOVES to gain IMMUNITY and EVASION, while also inflicting STUN and HEAVY BLEED as well.

Double Exposure's goal is to cycle the HEAVY BLEED and STUN continuously to deal consistent damage, while the opponent will struggle to attack back as they're stunned. Using moves like PHASER BURN or VARIABLE CUTTER will also inflict STUN onto the opponent, giving Robo-Fortune other means of stunning the opponent while they suffer HEAVY BLEED.

While Double Exposure does lean towards being a zoner based variant, the EVASION helps play more safely against fast opponents who try to rush forward quickly. This will also help Double Exposure against opposing zoners to dodge their projectiles while she lands her attacks first.
Marquee Ability: PING is the recommended Marquee for Double Exposure to boost her damage, and not have her rely primarily on HEAVY BLEED for damage only.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Double Exposure is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is necessary on Double Exposure to more reliably inflict HEAVY BLEED and STUN.

Doublicious.name: Doublicious
Doublicious.sa1: 10/15/25% chance on HIT to TRANSFER 1 BUFF from the opponent to yourself.
Doublicious.sa2: 10/15/25% chance when HIT to TRANSFER 1 DEBUFF from yourself to the opponent.

role_strategy: Doublicious is a fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around BUFF/DEBUFF transfer; stealing BUFFS for herself and transferring DEBUFFS to her opponents. Due to the combination of abilities, Doublicious is a very powerful fighter to be used offensively as she can steal defensive BUFFS such as ARMOR, IMMUNITY, REGEN and FINAL STAND that are common across defensive fighters.
As Double fighters are often frail, it is recommended to bring a support fighter such as Valentine with the TRAUMA CENTER Marquee Ability to prevent death when a mistake is made.

Marquee Ability: CHAOS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Doublicious which allows her to steal an opponent's BUFFS while also inflicting DEBUFFS at the same time, allowing her to easily wear down even the strongest of defensive fighters.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Doublicious is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.

Special investment: Due to her very fragile nature, players can build HP or Block Proficiency on her to increase her survivability. Players can also invest in Accuracy to increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating.
rift_battles: Doublicious particularly excels in Rift Battles where BUFFS are very prevalent. Darknut, Light Weight, Last Words, and Armor Rating are among catalysts that can be easily countered by Doublicious. Furthermore, the blockbuster BANDWAGON RUSHDOWN has a high chance to inflict HEX which allows Doublicious to clear nodes with strong defensive fighters such as Immoral Fiber, Vaporwave Vixen, and Assassin's Greed with relative ease by disabling their Signature Ability.

Dragon Brawler.name: Dragon Brawler
Dragon Brawler.sa1: Gain 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION when activating HYPE, and gain 100% increased CRIT DAMAGE while in HYPE MODE.
Dragon Brawler.sa2: Gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE and 25/35/50% BLOCKBUSTER METER when defeating an opponent while in HYPE MODE.

role_strategy: Dragon Brawler is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that increases his damage output while in HYPE MODE by using stacks of PRECISION and increased CRIT DAMAGE, while also providing him Blockbuster meter and ENRAGE when an opponent is defeated while in HYPE MODE. This allows him to quickly steam-roll teams after a single fighter is defeated.

Dragon Brawler is one of the few fighters that can gain on-demand PRECISION, a powerful BUFF that disregards an opponent's Signature Abilities. When timed correctly, this allows him to reliably finish opponents that rely on their death/fatal hits to activate their abilities such as Kill Joy, Immoral Fiber, Shadow Puppet, and Death Wish.

It is best to equip moves that have low hit-count to maximize Dragon Brawler's stacks of PRECISION such as GIGAN ARM SWEEP, HURTING HURDLE, GIGANTIC ARM, AIRWULF and THREE WULF MOONSAULT. It is important to note that THROWS do not crit, hence moves such as LUPINE PUMMEL and WULFMANIA that THROW the opponent will not consume stacks of PRECISION. HURTING HURDLE and GIGANTIC ARM has an increased critical hit chance, making it a great option while in HYPE MODE after using up the PRECISION stacks.

HURTING HURDLE and GIGANTIC ARM has an increased critical hit chance, making it a great option while in HYPE MODE after using up the PRECISION stacks.

One way to utilize Dragon Brawler is to activate HYPE MODE on the last fatal hit, using one-hit moves such as HURTING HURDLE or GIGAN ARM SWEEP. Once the first opponent is defeated, there will be four stacks of PRECISION left over. Then simply use THREE WULF MOONSAULT, an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster that does exactly four hits on the next incoming fighter. This will activate Dragon Brawler's second Signature Ability if it manages to kill, regaining an ENRAGE and a large amount of meter for the unblockable Blockbuster used and other Blockbusters.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability and will help keep Dragon Brawler on the upper hand as he deals damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Dragon Brawler is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: To get the most use out of his Crit Damage bonus, players are recommended to build Crit Rate and Crit Damage on Dragon Brawler. But do keep in mind that Crit Damage hard caps at 200% so you only need to build 100% Crit Damage for Dragon Brawler to be effective. If used with a taunt, Meter Gain can also be avoided.

Dread Locks.name: Dread Locks
Dread Locks.sa1: When HIT, reflect 15/25/35% of the incoming damage.
Dread Locks.sa2: If the opponent lands a CRITICAL HIT, inflict HEAVY BLEED for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Dread Locks is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that reflects damage back to the opponent. Furthermore, she can inflict HEAVY BLEED when hit, making her a dangerous defender without the proper counters.

Dread Locks primarily relies on her recoil damage as a defender. Hence, using fighters that can recover back health like Bio-Exorcist or through REGEN such as Bloodbath, Princess Pride, or any Valentine with the ICU Marquee ability are great counters to use. Another option is to use fighters that can inflict HEX to completely disable her Signature Ability, such as Red Velvet, Heart of Darkness and Rainbow Blight.
Another option is to use fighters that can inflict HEX to completely disable her Signature Ability, such as Red Velvet, Heart of Darkness and Rainbow Blight.

Hitting Dread Locks with PRECISION is also effective, as it would disregard her Signature Ability and no recoil damage will be taken. Characters with on-demand PRECISION from their TAUNTS are Parasoul and Ms. Fortune. Some fighter specific options are Star Shine and Windswept as their PRECISION is permanent.

Marquee Ability: Dread Locks prefers LEECH as her Marquee Ability as a defensive variant, since it can build more health for her to take more damage throughout the battle. This increases her sustainability, which can consequently increase the damage she reflects on opponents, while also pressuring her opponent to continue attacking Dread Locks to avoid her from any bonus healing, as LEECH heals on Blocked Hits as well.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Filia, Dread Locks is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this fighter.

Dream Band.name: Dream Band
Dream Band.sa1: MIRROR 1 opponent BUFF and reset its timer every 20/15/10 combo hits.
Dream Band.sa2: When either Fighter is KNOCKED DOWN, reset the timer of all active BUFFS and gain IMMUNITY for 5/7/8 seconds.

role_strategy: Dream Band is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows him to mirror BUFFS and to reset the timer of these BUFFS. With the highest HP stat in the game, Dream Band is a very durable fighter that can be difficult to take down easily.

Dream Band's ability to mirror BUFFS is the only way that he can gain other BUFFS outside of IMMUNITY by himself. Thus, pairing him with fighters such as Surgeon General or Rose-Tinted that can grant BUFFS from the bench is recommended. When facing Dream Band, this ability can be dangerous, as failure to block safely can lead to a string of multi-hit combos that steals your BUFFS and reset them every time he is knocked down.

The best way to counter Dream Band is to take down all his other teammates in the bench by using an OUTTAKE. Without any support, Dream Band has no other reliable way to gain BUFFS as long as you block safely. Equip blockbusters and special moves that can remove BUFFS such as Parasoul's CANOPY BOUNCE, Filia's DRILL TEMPERED and Eliza's CHAOS BANISH. Summer Salt, Locked In, Tyrannical and Stand Out are some of the best counter to Dream Band, as they can remove his BUFFS without knocking him down and also having high ATK stats, being able to brute force their way through his high HP. Fighters that THROW a lot, such as Cerebella and Beowulf are generally not recommended to use as they knock opponents down very frequently.

Being able to easily reset all his BUFFS, his damage can be consistent while he has little risk of being knocked out with his high HP stat.

Marquee Ability: As a defensive variant, FRONTMAN is the recommended Marquee Ability for Dream Band, as it provides Resistance and damage reduction to make him more durable and more resistant to DEBUFFS.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Dream Band is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.

This makes him very difficult to take down, as he gains IMMUNITY to avoid CURSE or HEX when knocked down. FINAL STAND can make him unkillable without a proper BUFF removal by continually resetting its timer. This BUFF can be obtained through Valentine's Marquee Ability, TRAUMA CENTER, Fighters like Fan Favorite, Rock Star or through catalysts such as Last Words and Final Fight.
