Dream Catcher.name: Dream Catcher
Dream Catcher.sa1: SPECIAL MOVES and TAG INS have a 25% chance on HIT to STUN the opponent for 4/5/6 seconds (does not affect Dark Fighters).
Dream Catcher.sa2: Every 3/2/1 second(s) while facing a STUNNED opponent, Peacock gains 1 stack of PRECISION, and her teammates gain 5% BLOCKBUSTER METER, and 5% HEALTH.

role_strategy: Dream Catcher is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that can STUN non-Dark fighters, which opens up a window for a PRECISION boosted attacks. Furthermore, she has a supportive role by providing her teammates numerous benefits while facing STUNNED opponents. At maximum investment, her teammates will gain 30% meter and 30% health.

Dream Catcher is a flexible fighter to use, but her best suited for secondary damage dealer/support role. She can TAG-IN with a chance to STUN and provide your primary fighter some meter and health back. With that said, she can deal serious damage as a primary fighter while also providing meter to your back-up fighters to finish the fights that she cannot. Dream Catcher synergizes very well with Eliza's UPPER KHAT which has a 50% chance on HIT to STUN the opponent for 6 seconds at max level. Use Eliza and quickly TAG IN Dream Catcher once the opponent is STUNNED. Dream Catcher can then deal tons of PRECISION damage with her special moves, while preventing defenders such as Immoral Fiber and Plot Twisted from activating their on-death Signature Abilities.

Dream Catcher synergizes very well with Eliza's UPPER KHAT which has a 50% chance on HIT to STUN the opponent for 6 seconds at max level. Use Eliza and quickly TAG IN Dream Catcher once the opponent is STUNNED. Dream Catcher can then deal tons of PRECISION damage with her special moves, while preventing defenders such as Immoral Fiber and Plot Twisted from activating their on-death Signature Abilities.

Dream Catcher's Signature Ability along with CAST PARTY can make her a dangerous opponent when faced in defense as she can come in unexpectedly and STUN your fighters to deal massive damage while also providing support to her teammates in the bench. Also beware of her bursts, as they can stun you as well.

Marquee Ability: Peacock's Marquee Abilities revolve around special moves and TAG INS, which can both activate Dream Catcher's STUN. While SPECIAL FEATURE can boost her projectile output as a primary fighter, CAST PARTY can be used if you plan to use her as a back-up fighter in the bench
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Dream Catcher is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage will increase her overall damage using her PRECISION.

Dream Demon.name: Dream Demon
Dream Demon.sa1: Inflict permanent DEATH MARK and gain ENRAGE for every 20/15/10% HEALTH lost by either Fighter.
Dream Demon.sa2: 50/75/100% chance for Fukua's DASH ATTACKS to be UNBLOCKABLE if the opponent is suffering from DEATH MARK.

role_strategy: Dream Demon is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that increases her damage output through DEATH MARK and stacks of ENRAGE while HP is lost on either side. DEATH MARK also makes her dash attacks unblockable which allows Dream Demon to start combos and finish opponents quickly without having to wait for an opening. DRILLATIONSHIP is a special move that can also inflict DEATH MARK alongside ARMOR BREAK and CRIPPLE. This provides Dream Demon another means of activating her second Signature Ability without the need to wait for 15 seconds. DRILLATIONSHIP also allows Dream Demon to stack two stacks of DEATH MARK, increasing damage of critical hits by 100% and also getting extra damage through ARMOR BREAK.

DRILLATIONSHIP is a special move that can also inflict DEATH MARK alongside ARMOR BREAK and CRIPPLE. This provides Dream Demon another means of activating her second Signature Ability without the need to wait for 15 seconds.
DRILLATIONSHIP also allows Dream Demon to stack two stacks of DEATH MARK, increasing damage of critical hits by 100% and also getting extra damage through ARMOR BREAK.
Dream Demon can be used similarly to Raw Nerv to apply permanent DEATH MARK at a fast pace, potentially useful for modes like Shards of the Undying.

Dream Demon's high ATK stat allows her to deal some significant damage even without her Signature Ability. With access to unblockable specials and blockbusters such as LOBS OF LOVE and INEVITABLE SNUGGLE, Dream Demon does not have to completely rely on her second Signature Ability to be an aggressive attacker. However, given how easy it is to inflict permanent DEATH MARK and gain ENRAGE she will be shelling out massive damage very fast.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activates when a certain percentage of health is lost, which is unfavorable when used offensively. Players who are proficient at Fukua will have ways to minimize damage as much as possible and avoid getting hit.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Dream Demon is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like LOBS OF LOVE or TWICE SHY.

Eager Deceiver.name: Eager Deceiver
Eager Deceiver.sa1: Well-timed BLOCKS have a 50/75/100% chance to grant 1 stack each of EVASION, BARRIER and BLESSING.
Eager Deceiver.sa2: 50% chance when using a BLOCKBUSTER while RAVENOUS to convert 1/2/3 BUFF(S) into permanent ENRAGE. Gain permanent PRECISION while benefiting from 5 stacks of this ENRAGE.

role_strategy: Eager Deceiver is an offensive fighter that can reliably gain a stack of EVASION, BARRIER and BLESSING each from well-timed blocks. This provides extra sustain for her, with BARRIER she may take additional hits, BLESSING will help in case you get a blunder, and EVASION will help you not to get hit in the first place. Furthermore, activating a blockbuster while RAVENOUS has a strong chance to convert BUFFS into permanent ENRAGE stacks, providing Eager Deceiver a significant boost in damage, and reaching 5 stacks will give you access to PRECISION - a really strong offensive buff that boosts her damage and makes her more versatile.

Eager Deceiver has the potential to deal massive amounts of damage, while having access to plenty of sustain from her BUFFS and Umbrella's health regeneration from her Prestige Ability, Marquee Ability and blockbusters such as FEEDING TIME and TONGUE TWISTER. This makes her a very strong fighter that can both take a hit and deal strong hits back. Her second Signature Ability can convert three BUFFS into permanent ENRAGE, regardless of where the BUFFS originate. Thus, BUFFS gained from support variants such as Surgeon General or Sketchy can also be converted into permanent ENRAGE with the use of a blockbuster. Hence, players should pay attention to the HUNGER METER and use their blockbusters wisely to avoid needless conversion.

Her second Signature Ability can convert three BUFFS into permanent ENRAGE, regardless of where the BUFFS originate. Thus, BUFFS gained from support variants such as Surgeon General or Sketchy can also be converted into permanent ENRAGE with the use of a blockbuster. Hence, players should pay attention to the HUNGER METER and use their blockbusters wisely to avoid needless conversion.

As Eager Deceiver needs to be RAVENOUS in order to be able to convert BUFFS into ENRAGE, she doesn't have as much use for THROW moves while not having 5 ENRAGE stacks. After the 5 ENRAGE stacks are reached however, there's more reason to use them.

Eager Deceiver is one of the few fighters that can gain permanent PRECISION, a powerful BUFF that disregards an opponent's Signature Abilities. When used correctly, this allows her to reliably finish opponents that rely on their death/fatal hits to activate their abilities such as Kill Joy, Immoral Fiber, Shadow Puppet, and Death Wish.
Marquee Ability: BITTER END is the recommended Marquee Ability for Eager Deceiver, as it allows her to survive longer in the match by having a FINAL STAND and HEAVY REGEN safety net.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Eager Deceiver is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her converting her BUFFS, Crit damage will help her deal additional damage while benefiting from PRECISION.

Epic Sax.name: Epic Sax
Epic Sax.sa1: Gain 1/2/3% damage bonus per COMBO HIT.
Epic Sax.sa2: Gain a random BUFF for every 20/15/10 COMBO HITS for 8 seconds.

role_strategy: Epic Sax is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants bonus damage and BUFFS depending on the number of COMBO HITS. Players will have to learn how to chain Big Band's moves and Blockbusters to maximize Epic Sax's offensive capabilities.

Big Band has a wide array of moves that can easily chain together while the opponent is in the air. A simple combo includes CYMBAL CLASH -> BEAT EXTEND -> SUPER-SONIC JAZZ. BEAT EXTEND is highly recommended to use as it deals a lot of COMBO HITS and chains easily with other blockbusters. TYMPANI DRIVE is harder to chain, but also has a lot of hits and deals a big amount of damage.

BEAT EXTEND is highly recommended to use as it deals a lot of COMBO HITS and chains easily with other blockbusters. TYMPANI DRIVE is harder to chain, but also has a lot of hits and deals a big amount of damage.

Most BUFFS that are available are defensive buffs which does not help Epic Sax's offensive output, unless ENRAGE is obtained. However, it allows Epic Sax to recoup lost health (via REGEN or MIASMA), be immune to DEBUFFS (via IMMUNITY), or possibly be INVINCIBLE.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Epic Sax will benefit from SOLOIST as his Marquee Ability. This compliments with Big Band's Prestige Ability that provides UNBLOCKABLE dash attacks while also supplementing HEAVY REGEN as a form of recovery.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Epic Sax is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Players can build Crit Rate and Crit Damage to further increase his damage output. Meter Gain is also recommended so that Epic Sax can do more combos.

Evergreen Evil.name: Evergreen Evil
Evergreen Evil.sa1: 5/7/10% chance when HIT while not at an ELEMENTAL DISADVANTAGE to gain REGEN and THORNS for 5 seconds, and to remove all DEBUFFS.
Evergreen Evil.sa2: When Double or any teammate gains a BUFF, its duration is increased by 3/4/5 seconds and Double gains 5% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Evergreen Evil is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her REGEN and THORNS when hit while not at an elemental disadvantage, increasing her survivability while also reflecting some damage taken. Her second Signature Ability increases the duration of BUFFS for your fighters, while also granting her BLOCKBUSTER METER for every BUFF received. As this ability works in the bench, Evergreen Evil also has a supportive role for your BUFF-reliant fighters.

Evergreen Evil is particularly dangerous to face, as you'll need to use a fighter with a specific element to safely face her. As a Double, she can transmute to another element while blocking, making it difficult to properly counter her abilities. Furthermore, her ability to remove all DEBUFFS makes her particularly immune to CURSE. The best way to counter Evergreen Evil safely is to inflict HEX through fighters such as Red Velvet and Rainbow Blight to completely nullify her Signature Ability, as other DEBUFFS will not work as she can easily remove them.

The best way to counter Evergreen Evil safely is to inflict HEX through fighters such as Red Velvet and Rainbow Blight to completely nullify her Signature Ability, as other DEBUFFS will not work as she can easily remove them.

Evergreen Evil will most likely be placed as the last fighter in the opponent's defense team. It is important to use OUTTAKE often to try and bring her out and defeat her first, as she increases the duration of her teammate's BUFFS while also gaining meter from it. This can be dangerous as she can tag in with a fully charged, unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster.
Marquee Ability: VOLATILITY is the recommended Marquee Ability for Evergreen Evil, which can increase her longevity in a fight when she gains FINAL STAND, INVINCIBILITY or MIASMA.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a Defensive Double, Evergreen Evil is best built with HP, Defense, Resistance and Crit Resist.
Special investment: Meter Gain is a stat to be avoided on Evergreen Evil, as she can gain Blockbuster Meter naturally.
rift_battles: Evergreen Evil is able to gain meter from teammates that gain BUFFS through catalysts such as Frost Armor, Armor Rating, Last Words, Final Fight. She works especially well with Vaporwave Vixen and Fly Trap with the GRUDGE Marquee Ability, as they can gain multiple BUFFS easily while also having the same elemental synergy with her.

Fan Favorite.name: Fan Favorite
Fan Favorite.sa1: While Beowulf is alive, all teammates gain FINAL STAND and UNFLINCHING for 5/7/10 seconds each every 20 seconds.
Fan Favorite.sa2: Inflict DEATH MARK and gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds each when activating HYPE MODE while Beowulf has living teammates.

role_strategy: Fan Favorite is an offensive support fighter with a Signature Ability to provide the team with FINAL STAND and UNFLINCHING periodically while having access to DEATH MARK and stacks of ENRAGE when activating HYPE MODE to increase his damage output.

Fan Favorite's first Signature Ability works in the bench but should not be relied on since it triggers only on certain times. Valentine with TRAUMA CENTER is still a superior choice for support for FINAL STAND, and variants like Lucky Lure and Raining Champ can support with UNFLINCHING more proactively while also giving other BUFFs.

As an offensive fighter, Fan Favorite can deal some decent chunk damage with ENRAGE and DEATH MARK. DEATH MARK increases Critical Damage, but Beowulf has plenty of moves that are THROWS, which cannot deal critical hits. It is recommended to equip a mix of THROW-based moves such as WULF SHOOT to activate HYPE MODE, and then equip moves such as HURTING HURDLE that guarantees critical hit and will deal a lot of damage.
It is recommended to equip a mix of THROW-based moves such as WULF SHOOT to activate HYPE MODE, and then equip moves such as HURTING HURDLE that guarantees critical hit and will deal a lot of damage.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability and will help keep Fan Favorite on the upper hand as he deals damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Fan Favorite is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown

Special Investment: As Fan Favorite is most often played with AROO READY? it is recommended to avoid investing in Meter Gain. Investment in Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow him take the most use out of DEATH MARK.

Fatal Fray.name: Fatal Fray
Fatal Fray.sa1: When either Fighter lands a BLOCKED HIT, suffer a random DEBUFF for 5/7/10 seconds and permanently decrease the opponent’s ATTACK and DEFENSE by 4% until Ms. Fortune TAGS OUT or is defeated.
Fatal Fray.sa2: When either Fighter successfully HITS with a SPECIAL MOVE, transfer all DEBUFFS to the opponent and gain EVASION for 5 seconds and IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds. If a DEBUFF was transferred, heal for 2% MAX HEALTH for each DEBUFF on the opponent.

role_strategy: Fatal Fray is a defensive Ms. Fortune, punishing players against blocking attacks to reduce ATTACK and DEFENSE, while DEBUFFING herself to eventually transfer onto the opponent with some healing alongside EVASION and IMMUNITY gained. Players will need to rely heavily on BLOCKBUSTERS, while hoping she does not use SPECIAL MOVES of her own to keep her sustain, while doing immense damage back with the DEFENSE shred.

Fatal Fray's first Signature Ability will rely on tactical play, aiming to intercept or grab Ms. Fortune, otherwise you will reduce your ATTACK at a considerable rate. Ms. Fortune's Dash Attack is slow, and predictable, most characters in game can easily intercept with their ground combo and some like Robo-Fortune or Fukua can intercept with their own Dash Attack as well,

Although she does inflict random DEBUFFS, Fatal Fray will not self-inflict HEX, SPECIAL MOVE DISABLE, STUN, DOOM or IMMOBILIZE. This does give her some leeway in her own safety, where the main DEBUFF she does not want to self-inflict often is BLEED, HEAVY BLEED, FATIGUE and BLOCKBUSTER DISABLE. The DEBUFFS she inflicts on herself can be dodged by giving her the Resistance stat.
The DEBUFFS she inflicts on herself can be dodged by giving her the Resistance stat.

Fatal Fray's weakness is most prevalent in using BLOCKBUSTERS or fast multi-hitting SPECIAL MOVES. She most prevalently focuses on denying single-hit or slow hitting SPECIAL MOVES like WEIGHT OF ANUBIS, WULFSHOOT, HURTING HURDLE, RINGLET SPIKE, ONSLAUGHT and LOBS OF LOVE. Fighters who can gain DEADEYE or inflict HEX can also use any SPECIAL MOVE otherwise, but players using DEADEYE will need to be aware of the DEBUFFS she will transfer to the player.

Fatal Fray has layers to her ability, because despite being a defensive variant with being able to heal, reduce ATTACK, and has a low ATTACK STAT, she also works offensively with her ability to reduce DEFENSE and control how many DEBUFFS she inflicts onto the opponent. As a Ms. Fortune, she is able to deal immense damage easily with moves like FIBER UPPER and EL GATO, while gaining EVASION and IMMUNITY for some safe utility to keep her pushing further into the fight.

As a Ms. Fortune, she is able to deal immense damage easily with moves like FIBER UPPER and EL GATO, while gaining EVASION and IMMUNITY for some safe utility to keep her pushing further into the fight.

Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Fatal Fray is MLEM to gain stacks of REGEN and further increase her survivability. BOOP can still be used however on a Fatal Fray built solely for offense.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Ms. Fortune, Health, Defense, Special Cooldown and Meter Gain are the main stats she aims for.

Special investment: Resistance may be avoided on Fatal Fray so that she does not resist her own DEBUFFS, however, this will depend on how you intend to use her. Crit Resist may be added to weaken Crit-based fighters against her.

Feared Faux.name: Feared Faux
Feared Faux.sa1: While Fukua’s Shadow Clone is active, SPECIAL HITS inflict CURSE for 5/7/10 seconds.
Feared Faux.sa2: While Fukua’s Shadow Clone is active, SPECIAL MOVE HITS deal 60/80/100% bonus DAMAGE.

role_strategy: Feared Faux is an offensive Fukua who actively uses her Shadow Clone special moves to apply high damage and CURSE enemies. Fukua has 2 Shadow Clones in her arsenal, being FOREVER A CLONE and SWARM EMBRACE. Upon activation, they will remain on field for 5 seconds, while siphoning 1% of Fukua’s MAX HP a second. The clones will automatically attack after 5 seconds or if reused again, before going on cooldown. Clones can also be attacked by the enemy, removing them from the field.

Fukua has 2 Shadow Clones in her arsenal, being FOREVER A CLONE and SWARM EMBRACE. Upon activation, they will remain on field for 5 seconds, while siphoning 1% of Fukua’s MAX HP a second. The clones will automatically attack after 5 seconds or if reused again, before going on cooldown. Clones can also be attacked by the enemy, removing them from the field.

Feared Faux aims to play a more calculated type of Fukua, managing her Shadow Clones alongside other moves to do high damage in short periods of time. While having a notably high skill floor, her damage is persistent with a damage boost while also denying access to buffs for enemies.

Feared Faux tends to rely on the synergy of Grabs or Unblockable attacks to open up combos that’d pair with her Shadow Clones. Utilising moves like LOBS OF LOVE or INEVITABLE SNUGGLE pair strongly with Fear Faux’s clones, which then can lead to a burst of high damage and inflict CURSE to start off a high damage combo.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activate when a certain percentage of health is lost, which is unfavorable when used offensively. Players who are proficient at Fukua will have ways to minimize damage as much as possible and avoid getting hit. Hence, it really does not matter which Marquee Ability is chosen for Feared Faux. SPECTRAL SPITE increases her damage output at low health, while WRAITH'S WRATH may allow her to survive fatal attacks.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Feared Faux is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Accuracy is necessary to apply CURSE more reliably due to defenders often building Resistance. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like FOREVER A CLONE or LOBS OF LOVE.

Feathered Edges.name: Feathered Edges
Feathered Edges.sa1: A well-timed BLOCK grants 1/2/3 stacks of BARRIER, and DISABLES opponent BLOCKBUSTERS and TAG INS for 10 seconds.
Feathered Edges.sa2: While benefiting from BARRIER, PROJECTILE HITS grant DEADEYE for 10/12/15 seconds

role_strategy: Feathered Edges is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that relies on well-timed blocks, gaining stacks of BARRIER while disabling the opponent's blockbusters and TAG INS when doing so. She also reflects and multiplies damage done by projectiles while under the effect of BARRIER, punishing any zoning the opponent might attempt.

Being one of the few users of DISABLE TAG-INS, Feathered Edges is best used on offense as she can forcefully keep her opponent in the fight, allowing her to take down the enemy team in a specific order. This makes her great for fights where the enemy relies on support from one specific fighter, as she can bring them out with an OUTTAKE and focus them down, weakening the other two enemies in the process.

Feathered Edges gains 3 stacks of BARRIER without any timers when barely blocking a hit, giving her good survivability. This is useful in offense, where the player can control when she blocks to tank reflect damage from variants like Dread Locks and Immoral Fiber. DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS is also useful to prevent opponents from punishing her through Tier 3 blockbusters.
DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS is also useful to prevent opponents from punishing her through Tier 3 blockbusters.

While she benefits from BARRIER, Feathered Edges has very easy access to DEADEYE, where using any PROJECTILE attack will give her the BUFF. DEADEYE helps her deal with annoying BUFFs like EVASION, UNFLINCHING, AUTOBLOCK and THORNS, while also helping her ignore the opponent's DEFENSE stat. With her low Attack stat, ignoring DEFENSE can be quite helpful to let her damage remain competitive with other offensive variants.

Marquee Ability: The optimal Marquee Ability depends on where you want to place Feathered Edges. As a more offensive oriented variant, SPECTRAL SPITE is recommended, which gives her more damage the lower her health percentage is. As a variant with no way to increase her damage otherwise, the boost is appreciated. Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, it is recommended that players build her as a Critless Variant.
Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, it is recommended that players build her as a Critless Variant.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Feathered Edges is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing HP will allow her to tank more damage through her BARRIER.

Feline Lucky.name: Feline Lucky
Feline Lucky.sa1: Gain 1/2/3 stack(s) of PRECISION every 7 seconds.
Feline Lucky.sa2: 2% chance when either Fighter lands a CRITICAL HIT to gain IMMUNE, INVINCIBLE, FINAL STAND, and UNFLINCHING for 10/12/15 seconds.

role_strategy: Feline Lucky is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that gives her the chance to gain various BUFFS that makes her invulnerable for some time on a critical hit, which she has frequent access to due to her gaining a few PRECISION stacks every few seconds. However, true to its name, the chances to activate this ability is notoriously low and is completely down to RNG, even when critical hits are guaranteed through PRECISION stacks. Hence, Feline Lucky is the epitome of a luck-based fighter and can be annoying to deal or work with depending on the odds.

Offensively, Feline Lucky is one of the few fighters that can gain PRECISION very easily, which she can use to counter on-death Signature Abilities of defenders such as Immoral Fiber and Last Hope. Her BUFFS when activated also protects her from any recoil damage that is seen in some defenders like Dread Locks and Criminal Mind. However, other Ms. Fortune and Parasoul variants have access to on-demand PRECISION via TAUNTS, with many having better offensive capabilities than Feline Lucky.
Marquee Ability: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, BOOP is the best Marquee Ability to increase her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Feline Lucky is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature ability activating and increase her overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION.

Final Fang.name: Final Fang
Final Fang.sa1: When the opponent gains a BUFF, MIRROR 1 of their BUFFS and inflict CURSE for 5/6/7 seconds.
Final Fang.sa2: 10/15/20% chance on HIT to inflict a random DEBUFF for 15 seconds while the opponent is suffering from a DEBUFF.

role_strategy: Final Fang is an offensive fighter that can easily stack up multiple DEBUFFS onto the opponent to severely weaken them while also preventing BUFFS for a short duration of time through CURSE. This allows her to be a decent counter to use against BUFF-heavy opponents.

Final Fang is a Valentine that has a very similar gimmick to Double's Marquee Ability, CHAOS. The ability to inflict CURSE while the opponent gains a BUFF is a useful BUFF control tool that is mostly used to activate her second Signature Ability. Final Fang will have to use multi-attack moves and blockbusters such as DEAD CROSS, CHECKMATE INCISION and LARYNGECTOMY to reliably inflict multiple DEBUFFS quickly. Furthermore, as Final Fang has a decent ATK stat with no inherent damage multipliers, she will have to rely on Valentine's tools in inflicting BLEEDS to reliably deal damage against tougher defenders. This also synergizes well with her second Signature Ability by using the BLEEDS she inflicts to start inflicting other random DEBUFFS.

Furthermore, as Final Fang has a decent ATK stat with no inherent damage multipliers, she will have to rely on Valentine's tools in inflicting BLEEDS to reliably deal damage against tougher defenders. This also synergizes well with her second Signature Ability by using the BLEEDS she inflicts to start inflicting other random DEBUFFS.

While Final Fang can easily get her game going when the opponent gets a BUFF, she gets stopped hard if that BUFF happens to be IMMUNITY, and DEBUFF removal can slow her down. Variants that have tools like those include Splitting Image, Rose-Tinted and Model Leader.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant that doesn't rely on her allies much, ICU is in most cases her preferred Marquee Ability, as it gives her access to healing when she fights an opponent who can inflict DEBUFFS on her. Trauma Center is mostly wasted as it doesn't give herself any benefits besides the Fighter Score boost leveling it provides.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Final Fang is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting DEBUFF.

Fire Branded.name: Fire Branded
Fire Branded.sa1: Gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds and remove 1 opponent BUFF when using a SPECIAL MOVE or BLOCKBUSTER.
Fire Branded.sa2: While in STAR POWER mode, CHARGE ATTACKS consume all stacks of ENRAGE, inflicting STUN, HEX and CURSE for 1/1.5/2 second(s) per stack consumed.

role_strategy: Fire Branded is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her ENRAGE and has access to BUFF removal whenever she uses a SPECIAL MOVE or BLOCKBUSTER. Her very high base ATK stat and with the damage boost provided by ENRAGE, allows Fire Branded to easily decimate the toughest of defenders through sheer force alone.

The addition of instant BUFF removal on using any equipped move (similar to Locked In) - notably Destruction Pillar - greatly enhances her offensive utility. This is very noticeable in fights where there is Trauma Center support, as she is able to keep removing FINAL STAND and not be stalled by it. Similar things can be said about Rose Tinted's support and the removal of THORNS stacks.

As the moves don't have to hit to trigger her first ability, a strategy that can be used is to keep "missing" specials to ensure the opponent will not benefit from buffs like THORNS and UNFLINCHING (in combination with other buffs, making them not the first to be removed). This will also build up Fire Branded's ENRAGE as a bonus.
Note that she removes en entire buff stack, so both 1 ARMOR or 5 ARMOR will be removed in the exact same way. This is always the BUFF closest to the center of the screen.

Furthermore, while in STAR POWER MODE, Fire Branded can also inflict STUN, CURSE and HEX through her charge attack at the cost of her ENRAGE stacks. The duration of each of the DEBUFFS increases by 2 seconds for each stack of ENRAGE removed - with a max of 10 seconds (5 stacks). The combination of HEX and CURSE is extremely deadly (STUN enabling an easier time restarting the combo or switching out), while her first ability can ensure no IMMUNITY is present to prevent the infliction of these DEBUFFS.

Having the restriction to only have her second ability work while in STAR POWER MODE essentially means this part has a timer of 20s before it can be used. This is for good reasons: nearly all defenders will be shut down by her sheer force if they can't rely on their ability or external BUFFS to survive. It is not to be underestimated.

Due to the access of HEX and CURSE, she can handle Notorious defenders such as; Death Wish, Curl Scout (her first ability already handles her), Corrosive Agent, Reimaged (be careful to convert ENRAGES with Fire Branded's ability, not Reimaged's), Shadow Puppet, Immoral Fiber, Dread Locks (with careful play).

Unholy Host still completely shuts her down, as no ENRAGE means there's no way to activate her second ability. The continuous removal of her (haste and) regen stacks does reduce her healing capabilities. Also be careful against Painwheels' TAINTED BLOOD Marquee as due to her high DPS an unlucky CRITICAL hit will reduce her health bar in a flash.

While she also inflicts STUN, this can be seen as more of a bonus and throwback to her old ability, as a STAR POWER charge attack always enables follow-ups. If anything, it is more of a restriction due to the fact it disables her entire second ability in rift against the (commonly used) autoimmune catalyst.

The STAR POWER condition does heavily favor not using STAR POWER MODE for anything other than activating her second ability. It is therefore advised to toggle it ON just before a charge attack and OFF again after hitting the opponent and inflicting the DEBUFFS. The damage increase all Annie's get from attacking in STAR POWER MODE is not required for Fire Branded due to her already high DPS.
For that reason, prestige on Fire Branded is even less useful than for other Annie's.

Marquee Ability: Fire Branded will benefit from RED SHIFT to further increase her damage output easily through subsequent uses of blockbusters and special moves. Stacked with her ENRAGE and attack stat, this leads to truly absurd damage numbers if built properly.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Fire Branded is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: To make sure her debuffs stick versus built defenders with Resistance, investing in Accuracy is highly recommended. Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage.

Firefly.name: Firefly
Firefly.sa1: While BLOCKING, the active fighter gains 4/5/6% HEALTH per second. When at 100% HEALTH, gain BLESSING for 8/10/12 seconds every second instead.
Firefly.sa2: While Painwheel is alive and the active Fighter is benefiting from BLESSING, grant 1/1.5/2% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second and a 50% chance on CRITICAL HIT to refresh SPECIAL COOLDOWNS.

role_strategy: Firefly is a fighter with both offensive and defensive capabilities, with the HP gain from BLOCKING and BLESSING at 100% HP being mostly defensive utility. The latter potentially provides amazing offensive support provided you have high CRIT CHANCE and BLESSING through its BLOCKBUSTER METER production and SPECIAL COOLDOWN refresh. With her and her team having easy access to healing it can save potentially unwinnable or tricky matches.

Because Firefly only needs to be alive to get benefit from SA2, other fighters can get benefit without being at 100% HP if they provide themselves with BLESSING. Phantom Threads is an amazing candidate because of her BLESSING to ENRAGE conversion and healing, easily creating a powerful feedback loop. Raining Champ is also an ideal partner, granting easy access to BLESSING that activates Firefly's SA2. This particularly benefits crit based characters that like to spam SPECIAL MOVES like X-Bot.
Debuffs like INVERSE POLARITY and QUIETUS can shut down Fireflies utility and easily catch you off guard if you are using her on offense.

Marquee Ability: TAINTED BLOOD is the recommended Marquee Ability to reflect some damage taken, which she can easily recover back via her Signature Ability. GRUDGE is an option to keep her safer in the event she is on field.
stat_investment: General Investment: Firefly on defense is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance. Firefly on offense is best built with ATK%, Piercing, Crit Rate, and Accuracy.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Flower Power.name: Flower Power
Flower Power.sa1: Every 2 seconds, unless either Fighter lands a HIT, suffer HEAVY BLEED for 2 seconds. When HITTING an attacking opponent remove up to 1/2/3 DEBUFF(S) from self.
Flower Power.sa2: While not suffering from any DEBUFF, Fukua gains IMMUNITY, INVINCIBILITY, and UNFLINCHING for 2/3/4 seconds each when HITTING an opponent in the air.

role_strategy: Flower Power is a Fukua variant with access to oppressive defensive BUFFS to amplify her offense uninterrupted, and a DEBUFF REMOVAL tied to successful intercepts of the opponents' attacks. This makes her a good utility-focused pick for offense purposes.

Given the punishment of HEAVY BLEED if no HITS occur, it is optimal to press the attack as much as possible and chain activations of her Signature Ability. Aerial hits in combos come naturally to Fukua given her forgiving DASH ATTACK and BLOCKBUSTER juggles that are easy to end combos with. This will create a feedback loop with Fukua gaining INVINCIBILITY, UNFLINCHING and IMMUNITY at the end of a combo just to keep giving her openings on the opponent. Using a SPECIAL MOVE like LOBS OF LOVE from afar can set Fukua up if she doesn't have her buffs or can force the opponent to approach you while you do.

Because Flower Power has the ability to get INVINCIBILITY consistently, she's a natural counter to sources of reflect damage like THORNS and TAINTED BLOOD. This is further helped by Fukua's natural ability to regenerate health through means of MIASMA from her TAUNT or INEVITABLE SNUGGLE.

While her defensive buffs are good for keeping her offense going without issue, the requirement of needing no active DEBUFFS on herself may prove itself an issue in fights where DEBUFFS are either too plentiful to clear consistently or are simply unavoidable. As a result, Flower Power may benefit from supports that have a degree of DEBUFF control, like Surgeon General and Angel Maker. Her buffs also last a very short amount of time, and as such Evergreen Evil can be considered as a support for the purpose of buff extension.
Her buffs also last a very short amount of time, and as such Evergreen Evil can be considered as a support for the purpose of buff extension.
Flower Power lacks any bonus damage sources in her Signature Ability and has a low ATTACK stat and thus appreciates supports like Seraph Soldier, Mad Malice, or Lucky Lure.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activate when a certain percentage of health is lost, which is unfavorable when used offensively. Players who are proficient at Fukua will have ways to minimize damage as much as possible and avoid getting hit. Given Flower Power's ability to stay unstoppable and invincible, SPECTRAL SPITE is recommended to increase damage output if at low health.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Flower Power is best built with Attack, Piercing, and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Due to benefit of INVINCIBILITY and lack of damage in her Signature Ability, investing in Crit Rate and Crit Damage can prove beneficial.

Fly Trap.name: Fly Trap
Fly Trap.sa1: Permanently increase Painwheel’s ATTACK by 25% for every 25/20/15% HEALTH lost by any Fighter. While Painwheel is the active Fighter, benched teammates also heal for 15/20/25% HEALTH.
Fly Trap.sa2: Gain 1/2/3 stacks of permanent REGEN when defeating an opponent. Gain MIASMA for 3/6/9 seconds every 3 seconds while benefiting from REGEN.

role_strategy: Fly Trap is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her permanent REGEN and timed MIASMA when defeating an opponent, while also gaining bonus attack when either any fighter loses health. With the highest base ATK stat of all fighters in the game, Fly Trap is an absolute powerhouse that can plow through the toughest defenses by sheer power alone.

Flytrap's ATTACK boosts can occur while she is both on and off-field. Since it is permanent, using teammates that can self or team revive can further boost the added damage such as Kill Joy, Last Hope, Bio-Exorcist, Death Wish and Reimaged. This can be further enhanced with Flytrap being able to heal off-field teammates if she is actively losing health or damaging the opponent as well. Flytrap's ATTACK boost will only scale off of her BASE ATTACK stat. Increasing the ATTACK stat via move stats will not be further scaled by her Signature Ability.
Flytrap's ATTACK boost will only scale off of her BASE ATTACK stat. Increasing the ATTACK stat via move stats will not be further scaled by her Signature Ability.

Flytrap's permanent REGEN cannot be removed unless she is knocked out and revived. using HEALBLOCK or INVERSE POLARITY can take advantage of these permanent BUFFS to chip at her health quickly, especially with her having the lowest HEALTH stat of any natural Diamond variant. While the REGEN cannot be removed easily, the MIASMA can be denied still, using DEBUFFS like HEX or CURSE will slow down the MIASMA gain Flytrap would have, also reducing her sustain and damage against much stronger foes. Inflicting HEX or CURSE before she gets a kill will also deny the REGEN otherwise.

While the REGEN cannot be removed easily, the MIASMA can be denied still, using DEBUFFS like HEX or CURSE will slow down the MIASMA gain Flytrap would have, also reducing her sustain and damage against much stronger foes. Inflicting HEX or CURSE before she gets a kill will also deny the REGEN otherwise.

Although mostly used for offense, Fly Trap can be a very dangerous defender due to her monstrous ATTACK stat, being able to heal low HEALTH teammates, access to the TAINTED BLOOD Marquee, and Into Thin Air catalyst in Rift. Players need to play very carefully around Flytrap, since landing a CRITICAL HIT or just taking a stray attack from Painwheel can mean the end of the fight.

Marquee Ability: TAINTED BLOOD is the preferred Marquee Ability for Fly Trap, as it allows her to be put on defense with catalyst, such as Into Thin Air. Due to the nature of her ability, Fly Trap can be played Critless.
Due to the nature of her ability, Fly Trap can be played Critless.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Fly Trap is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output further, and will scale with her first Signature Ability more effectively.
preferred_moveset: Pinion Dash / Gae Bolga Stinger / Snapdragon

Preferred Moveset: Pinion Dash / Gae Bolga Stinger / Snapdragon

Foot Soldier.name: Foot Soldier
Foot Soldier.sa1: HEAD HITS have a 50/75/100% chance to grant DEADEYE and 1 random BUFF for 7 seconds each. Also remove 1 DEBUFF from self.
Foot Soldier.sa2: Deal 5/7/10% bonus damage for each BUFF applied to either Fighter.

role_strategy: Foot Soldier is an offensive fighter that takes advantage of HEAD HITS to gain DEADEYE and a random BUFF while removing a DEBUFF from herself. Furthermore, her damage output gets stronger for every BUFF on either Fighter, making her a powerful offensive fighter against BUFF heavy defenders. DEADEYE ignores the opponent's DEFENSE and BUFFS such as AUTO-BLOCK, UNFLINCHING, EVASION and THORNS.
DEADEYE ignores the opponent's DEFENSE and BUFFS such as AUTO-BLOCK, UNFLINCHING, EVASION and THORNS.

Foot Soldier primarily requires mastery over Ms. Fortune's headless mode to fully make use of her abilities. DEADEYE is unique among other Ms. Fortune's and the ability to cleanse herself of DEBUFFS allows Foot Soldier to counter defensive strategies involving DEBUFFS such as Unholy Host.

The BUFF that Foot Soldier gains from her first Signature Ability is rather short and can be quite limited in how many she gains. Foot Soldier can be paired with support variants that extend BUFF duration such as Rhythm Rider and Evergreen Evil or support variants who can provide many BUFFs like Stone Sentinel, Lucky Lure, Angel Maker, Raining Champ or Starlight Rose to increase her damage output reliably from her second Signature Ability.
Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Foot Soldier is BOOP to gain stacks of ENRAGE and further increase her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Foot Soldier is best built with Attack, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will further increase her damage. Players should ignore investing in Piercing due to her access to DEADEYE and ARMOR BREAK through Ms. Fortune kit.

Fortune Cookie.name: Fortune Cookie
Fortune Cookie.sa1: After facing the same opponent for 10 seconds, Ms. Fortune suffers CURSE for 20/15/10 seconds, but gains permanent PRECISION, bypassing all BUFF and DEBUFF prevention effects.
Fortune Cookie.sa2: When CURSE is applied to Ms. Fortune, gain 1 stack of EVASION and HASTE for 10/20/30 seconds each, bypassing all BUFF prevention effects.

role_strategy: Fortune Cookie is an offensive fighter, with a Signature Ability that totally guarantees permanent PRECISION if she fights the same opponent for 10 seconds. She also sabotages herself, that applies her CURSE debuff every 10 seconds. Additionaly, if she suffers CURSE, automatically gains HASTE and EVASION, that gives some offensive confidence on every CURSE timelapse.

She shares places to be the fighter with most base ATK stats in the game with Painwheel's Fly Trap, with the bonus that she deals Critical Hits with permanent PRECISION from her Signature Ability, is one of the best Offensive fighters of Ms. Fortune.

The weak point of Fortune Cookie is that she's unable to gain support's buffs because of her CURSE, it's highly recommended to take her with some allies that grants enhancements without buffs or CURSE removals.
Take special care with Crit Counters like Painwheel's Markee Abilities (Specially Tainted Blood) or Black Dahlia's No time to die, that could make Ms. Fortune hits counterproductive.
"Feral Edge" or "El Gato" are great recommended moves for Fortune Cookie because their guaranteed probability to activate their effects.
Fortune Cookie's Signature Ability buffs are safe preventive, which makes some fighters like Eliza's Stand Out second ability unusuable against Ms. Fortune.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Fortune Cookie is best built with Attack, Piercing, Metter Gain and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: Taking in count that her first ability grants PRECISION permanently, Crit Rate is not needed for this variant. Priorize Critical Damage instead.

Frayed Ends.name: Frayed Ends
Frayed Ends.sa1: 20% chance when HIT to inflict BLEED for 3/5/7 seconds.
Frayed Ends.sa2: Deal 25/35/50% bonus damage against an opponent suffering BLEED.

role_strategy: Frayed Ends is a fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around BLEED effects, similar to Bad Hair Day. However, she requires getting hit to inflict BLEED instead, making it more difficult to constantly apply BLEED without losing some health relying on just her Signature Ability. Although her first Signature Ability may make her look like a defensive variant, Frayed Ends has poor base stats and can be defeated with relative ease. Hence, it is best to use her for offense, although Bad Hair Day is usually a simpler alternative on that front.

Although her first Signature Ability may make her look like a defensive variant, Frayed Ends has poor base stats and can be defeated with relative ease. Hence, it is best to use her for offense, although Bad Hair Day is usually a simpler alternative on that front.

When facing Frayed Ends, simply use fighters that can gain IMMUNITY from TAUNTS such as Squigly, Peacock, and Parasoul to completely nullify her abilities. Using low hit-count characters such as Cerebella, Painwheel, and Beowulf is also recommended, reducing the chances of her ability activating.

Filia as a character has a number of BLEED-inflicting moves at her disposal, so it is not necessary for Frayed Ends to rely on just her Signature Ability for BLEEDS. Equip moves such as RINGLET SPIKE and GREGOR SAMSON, all of which (have a chance to) inflict BLEED, to wear down the opponent. THE FIRST CUT is the recommended Marquee Ability for her, as it allows her to convert BLEEDS inflicted into permanent BLEEDS. While BLEED is inflicted, Frayed Ends deals damage comparable to Gold-tier Filias, making her damage output higher than it may seem on paper, despite having the lowest base ATK stat of all Filias. However, BLEEDs still usually do most of her damage output, so in practice it's not very influential.

While BLEED is inflicted, Frayed Ends deals damage comparable to Gold-tier Filias, making her damage output higher than it may seem on paper, despite having the lowest base ATK stat of all Filias. However, BLEEDs still usually do most of her damage output, so in practice it's not very influential.

It is important to watch out for fighters that are IMMUNE to BLEED such as Bloodbath and Valentine with the ICU Marquee Ability, as they will convert those BLEEDS into REGEN, nullifying Filia's BLEEDS.

Frayed Ends and Bad Hair Day are both Bronze Filias that rely on BLEED in slightly different ways. While Bad Hair Day doesn't have to rely on moves to inflict BLEEDs because of her already having a chance to do so every hit, Frayed Ends generally has better reward for landing BLEED with the caveat of needing certain moves to do so reliably. As a result, Bad Hair Day functions better as an introduction to Filia's base kit, while Frayed Ends has more value later on when the player has a decent grip on Filia already. Both ultimately struggle for late-game use due to their rarity and lack of utility besides BLEED, however.
Marquee Ability: THE FIRST CUT is recommended for Frayed Ends to turn BLEEDS into permanent BLEEDS, which will ensure that she can gain bonus damage from her second Signature Ability at all times.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Frayed Ends is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting BLEED through RINGLET SPIKE.

Freaky Friday.name: Freaky Friday
Freaky Friday.sa1: CRITICAL HITS inflict BLEED and DEATH MARK for 3/4/5 seconds each.
Freaky Friday.sa2: Gain HASTE for 10 seconds and 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION when defeating an opponent with a single HIT that deals at least 10% HEALTH.

role_strategy: Freaky Friday is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around critical hits to inflict massive damage from BLEED and DEATH MARK. In addition to these DEBUFFS, Freaky Friday's second Signature Ability further compliments her first by providing HASTE, charging blockbusters faster, and PRECISION, guaranteeing critical hits. This allows her to easily defeat teams by herself by constantly inflicting BLEED on the next opponent that comes in.

Equip moves such as DEATH CRAWL that is multi-hit to land multiple critical hits and multiple stacks of BLEED at the same time. Finish off the opponent with a PINION DASH or HATRED INSTALL, as these moves are single hit and can often deal enough burst damage to activate Freaky Friday's second Signature Ability.

Variants that use BLEED for the majority of their damage often get countered by variants that can remove DEBUFFS regularly, such as Evergreen Evil, have access to IMMUNITY, like Dream Band, or convert the BLEEDS into beneficial effects, such as Bloodbath and Valentines with the ICU Marquee Ability. In the case of Freaky Friday, this isn't as big of a problem due to her naturally high ATK stat. However, it is still recommended to have a source of CURSE, HEAL BLOCK or INVERSE POLARITY at hand to deal with the latter type of variants easier before time runs out.

In the case of Freaky Friday, this isn't as big of a problem due to her naturally high ATK stat. However, it is still recommended to have a source of CURSE, HEAL BLOCK or INVERSE POLARITY at hand to deal with the latter type of variants easier before time runs out.
Marquee Ability: GRUDGE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Freaky Friday, as it provides a safety net to survive hits when a mistake is made, while also increasing her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Freaky Friday is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase the chances of her inflicting bleed. Crit Damage will increase her damage output. Accuracy will ensure that her BLEED isn't resisted by defenders.

Freedom Fighter.name: Freedom Fighter
Freedom Fighter.sa1: 10% chance to inflict ARMOR BREAK and gain AUTO-BLOCK for 5/7/10 seconds when either fighter is HIT (includes Blocking).
Freedom Fighter.sa2: When BLOCKING a BLOCKBUSTER or SPECIAL MOVE attack, DISABLE opponent BLOCKBUSTERS for 10/12/15 seconds and inflict STUN for 4 seconds.

role_strategy: Freedom Fighter is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around blocking hits normally or triggering AUTO-BLOCK while getting combo'd to punish opponents by inflicting various DEBUFFS that severely cripples the opponent and making them prone to a counterattack.

Freedom Fighter's utility as a defensive fighter is dependent on mistakes made by players and how often AUTO-BLOCK activates. The player should keep watch for when AUTO-BLOCK is active and avoid using blockbusters or special moves while it's active so they don't accidentally get STUNNED.

Since the AI uses special moves very often, it is possible to use Freedom Fighter offensively to easily inflict STUN to opponents. However, it is important to remember that Freedom Fighter's stat distribution is more skewed towards HP, and he has below average ATK. Hence, players may struggle to defeat tough defenders such as Heavy Metal in high Prize Fight streaks due to the lack of damage.
Marquee Ability: CHALLENGER is the recommended Marquee Ability, as he will be tanking damage and finding himself with lower health often.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Beowulf, Freedom Fighter is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy would allow his first signature ability to be more consistent. While Special Cooldown would allow the AI to spam WULF SHOOTs.
rift_battles: Freedom Fighter relies heavily on misplays by players to be an effective defender. However, as a WATER element fighter, Freedom Fighter has access to the Frost Armor and High catalyst that can increase his survivability while also reflecting damage. Furthermore, it is heavily recommended to equip WULF SHOOT, as it bypasses blocking and immediately gives him a stack of HYPE.

Freeze Frame.name: Freeze Frame
Freeze Frame.sa1: PROJECTILE HITS inflict WITHER for 9 seconds. When the opponent reaches 5 stacks of WITHER, remove all WITHER stacks to inflict STUN for 2/3/4 seconds and set the opponent's SPECIAL MOVES and TAG-INS on cooldown.
Freeze Frame.sa2: When removing WITHER from the opponent, DRAIN 5/7/9% HEALTH and BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Freeze Frame is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that can inflict WITHER for meter control, preventing the opponent from using their blockbusters. When reaching enough stacks of WITHER, she will convert its utility to damage, healing, move resetting and tag disabling.

Since WITHER can stack, it's recommended Freeze Frame uses projectile-based SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS that are multi-hit and can trigger Freeze Frame's first Signature Ability multiple times, making the opponent's Blockbusters practically unusable. Once she can reach 5 stacks of WITHER, Freeze Frame's second Signature Ability will deal a burst of damage, equal to 250% of Freeze Frame's Attack stat, allowing her to potentially dish out massive damage to opponents within a short duration of time. It is thus recommended to equip moves such as BANG, BANG, BANG!, ARGUS AGONY, and DEADLY AIRPORT which are projectile-based moves that deal multiple hits to inflict multiple stacks WITHER.
It is thus recommended to equip moves such as BANG, BANG, BANG!, ARGUS AGONY, and DEADLY AIRPORT which are projectile-based moves that deal multiple hits to inflict multiple stacks WITHER.

When WITHER is removed, opponents will suffer from STUN and reset their tag-in and SPECIAL MOVES. This hopes for Freeze Frame to keep the opponent on field even after experiencing so many DEBUFFs. Because there is no limit on how often the 5 stack Wither can payoff, you can stack it many times and have increased potential with Chill Guy Beowulf.

Freeze Frame can still inflict damage through her second Signature Ability even if she's not in the field, assuming that the opponent does not TAG OUT and WITHER reaches 5 stacks via their own abilities.

Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Freeze Frame, as it provides the chance to reset the cooldown for her special moves, which are mostly projectiles, and reuse them almost immediately.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Freeze Frame is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special investment needed.

Fresh Heir.name: Fresh Heir
Fresh Heir.sa1: DASH ATTACKS have a 50/75/100% chance on HIT to DISABLE opponent BLOCKBUSTERS for 10 seconds.
Fresh Heir.sa2: Gain 25/35/50% BLOCKBUSTER METER when defeating an opponent whose BLOCKBUSTERS are DISABLED.

role_strategy: Fresh Heir is a fighter with an ability revolving around meter control. A simple dash attack disables the opponent's blockbusters, making Fresh Heir a very reliable meter control variant. Defeating an opponent whose blockbusters are disabled gives Fresh Heir herself meter, allowing her to fill her blockbusters up very quickly.

Fresh Heir's Signature Ability doesn't boost her damage output in any way, which means she will have to rely on Umbrella's abilities and move set to deal any substantial damage. As a Bronze, Fresh Heir may struggle with tougher defender in the higher tiers because of this.

Marquee Ability: Fresh Heir will benefit from SWEET VICTORY as her Marquee Ability, further bolstering her damage output through ENRAGE stacks when she defeats an opponent. This allows her blockbusters to deal significantly more damage against the next opponent. While BITTER END allows her to survive longer in the match by having a FINAL STAND and HEAVY REGEN safety net.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Fresh Heir is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Even though Fresh Heir has Meter Gain built in to her Signature Ability, it is still recommended to build that stat on her, as she only gains Blockbuster Meter upon a fighters' death.

Fur Monger.name: Fur Monger
Fur Monger.sa1: 50/75/100% chance to gain ENRAGE, THORNS or REGEN when FIRING a SHOT. These BUFFS are removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Fur Monger.sa2: All SHOTS deal 5/10/15% bonus damage for each BUFF applied to Black Dahlia.

role_strategy: Fur Monger is an offensive fighter that gains one out of three BUFFS for each SHOT fired. For every BUFF she gains, her SHOTS deal extra bonus damage allowing Fur Monger to be a reliable damage dealer that can easily snowball fights, as long as she does not get knocked down. Hence, there is a degree of proficiency that will be required when playing Fur Monger. ENRAGE and REGEN are the two BUFFS that are most crucial for Fur Monger. ENRAGE increases her damage output easily, and REGEN provides a degree of survivability that no other Black Dahlia variants have access to. THORNS is defensive and has no use in offense.

ENRAGE and REGEN are the two BUFFS that are most crucial for Fur Monger. ENRAGE increases her damage output easily, and REGEN provides a degree of survivability that no other Black Dahlia variants have access to. THORNS is defensive and has no use in offense.

Fur Monger wants to fire SHOTS as much as possible, even if it does not hit. Players will have to time her SHOTS well and combine them in juggles and combos to start stacking BUFFS fast. Furthermore, Fur Monger can also increase her damage from other BUFFS through her second Signature Ability. Hence, support variants that provide BUFFS such as Starlight Rose and Pickle Baller are recommended.

Furmidable.name: Furmidable
Furmidable.sa1: CHARGE ATTACK HITS grant IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds and 5 stacks of PRECISION.
Furmidable.sa2: While benefitting from IMMUNITY, SPECIAL MOVE HITS are UNBLOCKABLE. While benefitting from PRECISION, they inflict INVERSE POLARITY for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Furmidable is an offensive fighter that utilizes charge attacks to unlock BUFFS and enable powerful, unblockable special moves which counters healing and defensive strategies.

Ms. Fortune have access to powerful special moves that can be chained together easily: FIBER UPPER > EL GATO > CAT SLIDE. Together, the combo of these moves deal massive damage and is also exactly five hits, allowing Furmidable to make use of her PRECISION stacks effectively.

The BUFFS and DEBUFF that Furmidable is able to obtain and inflict have very powerful properties for an offensive fighter. The combination of all these utilities allow Furmidable to face off against a lot of tough defensive strategies: IMMUNITY makes her immune to all DEBUFFS PRECISION guarantees critical hits and ignores the opponent's Signature Abilities INVERSE POLARITY reverses the effects of all healings
IMMUNITY makes her immune to all DEBUFFS
PRECISION guarantees critical hits and ignores the opponent's Signature Abilities
INVERSE POLARITY reverses the effects of all healings

Furmidable can still make use of her second Signature Ability without relying on her first. She can be paired up with support variants that provide IMMUNITY, such as Sketchy and Surgeon General. Furthermore, Ms. Fortune has access to PRECISION from her TAUNT as well, making Furmidable a versatile fighter that does not have to rely on one specific play style.
By pairing her up with Inner Pieces and Blitz & Glamour or Noble Mogul, she can gain timeless IMMUNITY, allowing her to be an unstoppable force in the field.
Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Furmidable is BOOP, giving her stacks of ENRAGE and further increasing her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Furmidable is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Furry Fury.name: Furry Fury
Furry Fury.sa1: 10/15/20% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED and gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds each while Ms. Fortune's health percentage is higher than her opponent's.
Furry Fury.sa2: Remove 1 BUFF from a nearby opponent every 3/2/1 seconds while at 3 or more stacks of ENRAGE.

role_strategy: Furry Fury is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that has a chance to inflict BLEED on opponents and grant ENRAGE to herself for a short time, provided her health percentage is higher than her opponent's. Additionally, while Furry Fury has at least three ENRAGE stacks and is close to her opponent, she gains the powerful ability to remove an opponent's BUFF, which occurs very rapidly at max level. These abilities, combined with her high base ATK stat, make her a strong offensive variant.

Although the chance to inflict BLEED is only 20%, Ms. Fortune's high hit counts in many moves make it easy to trigger her Signature Ability. However, since she needs to have higher health than her opponent to access it, Furry Fury has less room for error than other variants, which is why it's important to get a grasp on Ms. Fortune's gameplay before using Furry Fury.

Furry Fury, like other BLEED variants, is vulnerable to opponents who have easy access to Regen, such as Valentine with the ICU Marquee Ability, or variants like Bloodbath. However, her high base ATK and frequent access to ENRAGE make her less hampered by this weakness than other BLEED fighters. As she gains the ability to rapidly remove BUFFS while having at least 3 ENRAGE stacks, Furry Fury is very effective against variants who gain non-permanent BUFFS frequently.
As she gains the ability to rapidly remove BUFFS while having at least 3 ENRAGE stacks, Furry Fury is very effective against variants who gain non-permanent BUFFS frequently.

Since Furry Fury needs to have higher health than her opponent to use her Signature Abilities, she benefits from health regeneration. Graveyard Shift and Surgeon General are good teammates for Furry Fury, as they provide this support.

Marquee Ability: Both Marquee Abilities are great options for Furry Fury. BOOP increases her ENRAGE stacks over time, making it easier to activate her second Signature Ability and increase her overall damage. Meanwhile, MLEM helps keep Furry Fury's health high, which is crucial for maintaining her first Signature Ability.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Furry Fury is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting BLEED and gaining ENRAGE, while Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

G.I. Jazz.name: G.I. Jazz
G.I. Jazz.sa1: Once per match, gain 3/4/5 stacks of REGEN and 3 stacks of ARMOR for 10 seconds each when falling below 25% HEALTH.
G.I. Jazz.sa2: While HEALTH is greater than 75/65/50%, gain 1 stack(s) of permanent ARMOR.

role_strategy: G.I. Jazz is a defensive fighter that utilizes Big Band's naturally high bulk to be an unstoppable defensive tank. His first Signature Ability provides him a layer of survivability through stacks of REGEN and ARMOR when he falls below a certain health threshold, while his second Signature Ability adds a permanent stack of ARMOR to reduce the damage he takes.

G.I. Jazz's primary role is to stall for time with his naturally high bulk. Hence, players need to come prepared with the right variants in order to take him down within the time limit. When facing against G.I. Jazz, it is recommended to use high damage dealing variants like Blue Streak, Class Cutter, Djinn Frizz or Phantom Threads that can easily gain stacks of ENRAGE to overcome his naturally high defenses. Variants with access to CURSE such as Purrfect Dark or Dark Horse are also useful to prevent his first Signature Ability from activating.

Regen X is also a great catalyst that synergizes well with G.I. Jazz, allowing him to quickly regenerate health when dropping below 25% HP.

Galactic Glamour.name: Galactic Glamour
Galactic Glamour.sa1: 25/35/50% chance on CRITICAL HIT to inflict GUARD BREAK for 10 seconds.
Galactic Glamour.sa2: 25/35/50% chance when suffering a CRITICAL HIT to gain AUTO-BLOCK for 10 seconds.

role_strategy: Galactic Glamour is a fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around critical hits to either inflict GUARD BREAK on offense or gain AUTO-BLOCK on defense, allowing Galactic Glamour to be used in both roles.

It is, however, recommended to use Galactic Glamour as an offensive variant that can inflict multiple stacks of GUARD BREAK to easily restart a long chain of combos as players will have more control in activating her Signature Ability through heavy investment in Crit Rate. While AUTO-BLOCK is a defensive BUFF, it does not provide Galactic Glamour additional defensive options to sustain her in fights considering that she has average base health. Players will also find it very easy to get around her AUTO-BLOCK through CURSE, HEX or by simply using a fighter with no investment in Crit Rate.

While AUTO-BLOCK is a defensive BUFF, it does not provide Galactic Glamour additional defensive options to sustain her in fights considering that she has average base health. Players will also find it very easy to get around her AUTO-BLOCK through CURSE, HEX or by simply using a fighter with no investment in Crit Rate.

As a fighter with a heavy emphasis on critical hits, both DESTRUCTION PILLAR and RE-ENTRY are special moves that can work very well with Galactic Glamour to further increase her damage output, as these moves rely on a critical hit to deal an extra 10% of the opponent's max health and gain ENRAGE. stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Galactic Glamour is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.

Gang Green.sa1: Squigly gains BLOCKBUSTER METER equal to 1/2/3% of her MOVE SPEED.
Gang Green.sa2: Gains 1 stack of MIASMA for 5 seconds every 3/2/1 second(s) while not BLOCKING near a dead body.

role_strategy: Gang Green is a fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to gain stacks of MIASMA simply by standing near a dead body and not blocking. This powerful Signature Ability enables her to drain both the opponent's meter and health every second through MIASMA, which is complemented by her first Signature Ability that grants her meter by simply moving throughout the fight. The combination of both abilities allows Gang Green to charge blockbusters quickly and take down the toughest of defenders by simply draining their health every second. Gang Green's first Signature ability activates from moving through being hit, moving through attacking, moving through the use of special moves like Drag 'n Bite and Draugen Punch, Gang Green falling after using or suffering an air combo, and the use of movement based blockbusters like Rage of the Dragon when used far away from the opponent, and Drag 'n Drop, which counts as movement when Gang Green drops for the last hits of the blockbuster.

Gang Green's Signature Ability works best if the dead body is in the opponent's corner of the stage. She also loses all her BARRIER when using her last DRAGON CHARGE, in return granting her 10% health per each BARRIER removed. This makes her awkward to use, as you try to conserve her dragon charges because you're much better off with the BARRIER instead of removing them for regen. Golden Gunner.name: Golden Gunner

Golden Gunner.sa2: With at least 3 stacks of PRECISION, all SHOTS are UNBLOCKABLE and deal 50/75/100% bonus damage.

Combined with PRECISION which guarantees critical hits and her second Signature Ability that amplifies her damage, Golden Gunner can deal a significant amount of damage, even for a Bronze.

Grand Mother.name: Grand Mother

Grand Mother.sa2: Permanently increase Double’s ATTACK and reduce the opponent’s DEFENSE by 0.5/0.75/1% each when inflicting a DEBUFF.

role_strategy: Grand Mother is an offensive Double, constantly inflicting DEBUFFs that almost never disappear while passively boosting her damage for each DEBUFF inflicted.

Grand Mother's first Signature Ability applies easy but short CURSE on dash attacks. This helps against BUFF-reliant defenders while she does short combo strings. While the CURSE is short, the second part to this ability also applies a new DEBUFF each time they expire. The more DEBUFFs that Grand Mother continues to inflict (whether from her own Signature Ability, Marquee Ability or stage Modifiers), the more DEBUFFs that the enemy will have as they continue to loop over and over.

Her second Signature Ability is a passive boost to Grand Mother, for every DEBUFF the opponent suffers, she gains a permanent ATTACK boost and reduces the opponent's DEFENSE. With this effect having no damage cap towards it, it is very highly encouraged that Double inflicts as many DEBUFFs continuously to up her damage while shredding opponent DEFENSE. DEFENSE typically maxes out at 50%, and so Grand Mother would aim to inflict 50 DEBUFFs quickly to shred an opponent's DEF stat. This can however, go further with the DEFENSE going NEGATIVE, helping Double deal more damage, and negate the effects of ARMOR too.

DEFENSE typically maxes out at 50%, and so Grand Mother would aim to inflict 50 DEBUFFs quickly to shred an opponent's DEF stat. This can however, go further with the DEFENSE going NEGATIVE, helping Double deal more damage, and negate the effects of ARMOR too.

role_strategy: Gust Buster is an offensive fighter with the ability to steal opponent's BUFFS to herself and converting those BUFFS into offensive BUFFS to further bolster her damage and utility. Gust Buster can steal BUFFS through SKELETAL SUMMONS, which are some of Marie's best special moves and blockbusters. Moves such as HILGARD'S HAYMAKER, CARPAL PUMMEL and HILGARD'S HOWL are moves that are commonly used for combos, so Gust Buster will naturally steal BUFFS just by playing normally.

Players will have to find spots to fully charge Marie's MORTUARY CHARGE to unlock her second Signature Ability. Once unlocked, a single CHARGE ATTACK will convert Gust Buster's BUFFS into BARRIER, MIASMA or ENRAGE for a significantly long duration. Gust Buster might change seven of those into the same BUFF, which would only show five (the maximum), leading to a 'loss' of two BUFFS.
