rift_battles: Heavy Metal is a potent defender that synergizes very well with catalysts that grants ARMOR such as Armor Rating, Frost Amour and High Waters. His built-in ARMOR as well as the extra defense brought on by FRONTMAN Marquee Ability makes him synergize extremely well with Big Band's Futile Resistance Catalyst.

Heavy Reign.name: Heavy Reign
Heavy Reign.sa1: 50% chance on CRITICAL HIT to gain 10/12/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Heavy Reign.sa2: 50% chance to gain 10/12/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER when suffering a CRITICAL HIT.

role_strategy: Heavy Reign is an offensive fighter who specializes in spamming her blockbusters constantly, which she can achieve by landing or receiving critical hits. This makes her damage output deceptively high, despite having the worst base ATK stat of all Parasoul variants in-game. It is important to note that critical hits from Heavy Reign's blockbusters themselves will not trigger her Signature Ability.
It is important to note that critical hits from Heavy Reign's blockbusters themselves will not trigger her Signature Ability.

As she needs critical hits in order to activate her Signature Ability, it's important to build a decent amount of Crit Rate on her. It's just as vital to check the enemy team composition, especially against variants that can punish critical hits, like Dread Locks or a Painwheel with either Marquee Ability. That's All Folks! is also a notable counter as she reduces the opponent's Crit Rate considerably while alive. Parasoul has access to EGRETS CALL, a Taunt that provides up to three stacks of Precision, guaranteeing critical hits and ignoring the opponent's Signature Ability.
Parasoul has access to EGRETS CALL, a Taunt that provides up to three stacks of Precision, guaranteeing critical hits and ignoring the opponent's Signature Ability.
Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Heavy Reign, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Heavy Reign is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating and Heavy Reign gaining Blockbuster Meter.

Hell's Belle.name: Hell's Belle
Hell's Belle.sa1: While the opponent's HEALTH is above 35%, 10/12/15% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED for 5 seconds and a random DEBUFF.
Hell's Belle.sa2: Every 10 seconds as the active Fighter, Fukua grants her teammates MIASMA for 10/12/15 seconds and EVASION.

role_strategy: Hell's Belle is an offensive fighter with a setup support ability that excels at applying pressure through DEBUFFS and enhancing her team's survivability.

The random DEBUFF that Hell's Belle inflicts is timeless. Hence, she can be paired with variants that can take advantage of DEBUFFS such as Don Passione and Heartless or variants that deal extra damage from DEBUFFS such as Beast King. Because of the ability's condition, it is best to keep Hell's Belle ATK low or to face against strong defenders so that she can inflict multiple stacks of timeless DEBUFFS easily before TAGGING IN other fighters to finish the job.

Because of the ability's condition, it is best to keep Hell's Belle ATK low or to face against strong defenders so that she can inflict multiple stacks of timeless DEBUFFS easily before TAGGING IN other fighters to finish the job.

EVASION is a very useful BUFF to prevent the next hit. This is helpful to safely TAG IN a secondary fighter that can take advantage of the random DEBUFFS that Hell's Belle inflict. Although her MIASMA has little use as it doesn't last long enough to be of use.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activate when a certain percentage of health is lost, which is unfavorable when used offensively. Players who are proficient at Fukua will have ways to minimize damage as much as possible and avoid getting hit. SPECTRAL SPITE is recommended to further increase her damage output at low health. Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, it is recommended that you build Hell's Belle as a Critless Variant.
Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, it is recommended that you build Hell's Belle as a Critless Variant.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Hell's Belle is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is the most important stat for Hell's Belle, as it increases the chances of her inflicting debuff and stops her debuffs being resisted by defenders.

Hellcat.name: Hellcat
Hellcat.sa1: Gain ENRAGE after every 12/10/8 seconds while above 50% HEALTH. ENRAGE is removed when dropping below 50% HEALTH.
Hellcat.sa2: Gain 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION when defeating an opponent while benefiting from ENRAGE.

role_strategy: Hellcat is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around ENRAGE stacks that is only kept when her health is above a certain threshold. When defeating an opponent while benefiting from ENRAGE, Hellcat gains stacks of PRECISION that guarantees critical hits, which bypasses Signature Abilities. This combination of abilities allows her to deal quick, massive damage against her other Bronze-tier peers.
The combo FIBER UPPER > EL GATO > CAT SLIDE does exactly five hits, allowing Hellcat to fully make use of all PRECISION stacks that are obtained from her second Signature Ability.
Marquee Ability: MLEM is the recommended Marquee Ability for Hellcat as she has her own timeless enrage through her Signature Ability.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Hellcat is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage will increase Hellcat overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION.

Hex Caliber.name: Hex Caliber
Hex Caliber.sa1: Every 10th COMBO HIT landed on Black Dahlia or the opponent grants UNFLINCHING for 5/7/10 seconds. Also gain permanent PRECISION while benefiting from this UNFLINCHING.
Hex Caliber.sa2: ALL SHOTS are UNBLOCKABLE and grant IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds while benefiting from PRECISION.

role_strategy: Hex Caliber is an offensive fighter with access to permanent PRECISION, unblockable shots and IMMUNITY. This combination of utilities, on top of Black Dahlia's offensive kit, makes Hex Caliber a very powerful offensive variant capable of dealing very high damage while ignoring a majority of defensive strategies with very little drawbacks. Black Dahlia can easily achieve 10 COMBO HITS without difficulty to gain permanent PRECISION which ignores Signature Abilities of very potent defenders such as Immoral Fiber, Death Wish, Plot Twisted and Evergreen Evil. Black Dahlia has access to DEADEYE which ignores certain defensive BUFFS (AUTO-BLOCK, THORNS, EVASION and UNFLINCHING) and DEATH MARK which increases the damage taken by the opponent from CRITICAL HITS. IMMUNITY prevents DEBUFFS like HEX or CURSE from crippling her and reducing her viability. Unblockable shots allows Hex Caliber to be aggressive by cornering the opponent and restarting combo chains easily.

Black Dahlia can easily achieve 10 COMBO HITS without difficulty to gain permanent PRECISION which ignores Signature Abilities of very potent defenders such as Immoral Fiber, Death Wish, Plot Twisted and Evergreen Evil.

Black Dahlia has access to DEADEYE which ignores certain defensive BUFFS (AUTO-BLOCK, THORNS, EVASION and UNFLINCHING) and DEATH MARK which increases the damage taken by the opponent from CRITICAL HITS.
IMMUNITY prevents DEBUFFS like HEX or CURSE from crippling her and reducing her viability.
Unblockable shots allows Hex Caliber to be aggressive by cornering the opponent and restarting combo chains easily.

In defense, Hex Caliber can be bothersome as her UNFLINCHING can disrupt the player's combo chain by ignoring all their attacks. Furthermore, Black Dahlia's Marquee Ability NO TIME TO DIE can also punish the opponent's CRITICAL HITS by gaining REGEN and HASTE to recover health and charge her blockbusters faster. However, these BUFFS can easily be countered by BUFF removal tools such as Eliza's CHAOS BANISH. So Hex Calibre is recomended to be built purely offensive.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Hex Caliber will benefit from METAL BREAKDOWN as her Marquee Ability to increase her damage output from ARMOR BREAK and the extra damage boost to her SPECIAL SHOTS.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Hex Caliber is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown and Crit Damage. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Players can also invest in Meter Gain. Players should completely ignore Crit Rate as she can have constant uptime of PRECISION.

High Ruler.name: High Ruler
High Ruler.sa1: Opponents have their BLOCKBUSTERS and TAG-INS DISABLED after 3/2/1 second(s) while near a TEAR.
High Ruler.sa2: Detonated TEARS inflict CURSE and HEX for 5/7/10 seconds on HIT. Dark Fighters also suffer FATIGUE for 5 seconds.

role_strategy: High Ruler is an offensive fighter with a powerful Signature Ability that prevents any retaliation from the opponent through smart use of Parasoul's TEARS. Having a TEAR in the field will prevent blockbusters and TAG INS, allowing High Ruler to trap the opponent in a 1v1 fight as long as they stay near her TEARS. When those TEARS are detonated, the opponent is inflicted with both CURSE and HEX, two of the most powerful DEBUFFS that prevents BUFFS and disables the opponent's Signature Abilities, and if the opponent happens to be of the Dark element, it will stun them for a short time too. All these abilities combined makes High Ruler a very powerful utility fighter that can severely cripple even the toughest of defenders.
High Ruler is balanced by a low ATK stat that is shared by Princess Pride, although Parasoul's offensive capabilities revolving around critical hits enables her to deal a decent amount of damage.
Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for High Ruler, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, High Ruler is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that she can inflict her DEBUFFS reliably.
rift_battles: Due to High Ruler's low ATK stat, she is best used in single or double nodes where there are no stat bonuses for the opponent. She is especially a great counter to common nodes involving Immoral Fiber or Blue Screen by the use of her second Signature Ability to inflict CURSE and HEX.

Hype Man.name: Hype Man
Hype Man.sa1: While in HYPE MODE, DRAIN opponent BLOCKBUSTER METER by 5/7/10% per landed HIT.
Hype Man.sa2: When activating HYPE MODE, teammates in reserve gain 25/35/50% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Hype Man is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows him to drain the opponent's Blockbuster meter while also providing his teammate's Blockbuster meter when activating Hype Mode. Hence, it is recommended to equip a WULF SHOOT that can gain HYPE upon successful use.
Hence, it is recommended to equip a WULF SHOOT that can gain HYPE upon successful use.

Hype Man drains meter even from his blockbuster hits, so equip blockbusters that can deal multiple hits, such as LUPINE PUMMEL and GEATISH TREPAK. During HYPE MODE, these moves will easily refill blockbuster meter, allowing you to chain these two moves together repeatedly.

Due to his ability to give his teammates easy Blockbuster meter, Hype Man is considered one of the best counters to the Into Thin Air catalyst. Not only does his drain give him the ability to quickly charge Blockbusters but also allows teammates to tag in with a Tier 3 Blockbuster ready to get the points for a Blockbuster kill.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability and will help keep Hype Man on the upper hand as he deals damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Hype Man is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: Due to his innate ability to gain Blockbuster Meter through his Signature Ability, try to avoid investing in Meter Gain.

Icy Hot.name: Icy Hot
Icy Hot.sa1: All teammates TAG IN with REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds.
Icy Hot.sa2: On TAG IN, all teammates gain 10/12/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Icy Hot is a support fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around TAG INS to gain blockbuster meter and REGEN, allowing the next incoming fighter quicker access to their blockbuster while recovering their health too.
Icy Hot's Signature Ability can activate while she's in the bench. Hence, Icy Hot is best kept in reserve to support her teammates while being away from danger.

For players starting out, it can be effective to build a team based around TAG INS with characters such as Scrub, Bassline, Rerun and Sketchy. All these fighters are Bronze fighters that can easily be obtained.

Marquee Ability: To add onto her support role, TRAUMA CENTER is the recommended Marquee Ability for Icy Hot to provide a safety net for your fighters by granting them FINAL STAND when you get punished for making a mistake.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Icy Hot is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Idol Echo.name: Idol Echo
Idol Echo.sa1: Gain 1 random BUFF and inflict 1 random DEBUFF every 3/2/1 second(s) while in a combo. All BUFFS and DEBUFFS are removed at the end of a combo.
Idol Echo.sa2: Fukua deals 5/7/10% more damage per BUFF applied to her. When Fukua gains 10 or more BUFFS, remove all opponent BUFFS.

role_strategy: Idol Echo is an offensive Fukua who builds high damage with an array of random BUFFS and DEBUFFS that she sets on the stage. Moreover, Idol also gets unique access to a full buff cleanse on the opponent which she utilizes to spam even more DEBUFFS.
Idol plays very chaotically, encouraging long and slow combos to maximize the number of BUFFS and DEBUFFS she can access for theoretically infinite damage.

Most Fukua combos do not usually reach to be over 10 seconds long, so she often relies on supports who can constantly provide buffs at all times, such as Raining Champ, Stone Sentinel, Mad Malice or Seraph Soldier. The more BUFFS she gains. the more damage she will do, so extend them as long as possible.

Amid all the chaos in her ability, Idol Echo can however consistently remove enemy buffs, either alone every 10 seconds per combo, or even faster when paired with some supports. In this, she can help remove annoying buffs like IMMUNITY or FINAL STAND to kill even faster.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activate when a certain percentage of health is lost, which is unfavorable when used offensively. Players who are proficient at Fukua will have ways to minimize damage as much as possible and avoid getting hit. Hence, it really does not matter which Marquee Ability is chosen for Idol Echo. SPECTRAL SPITE increases her damage output at low health, while WRAITH'S WRATH may allow her to survive fatal attacks.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Idol Echo is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage are other useful stats to give Idol to boost her damage further. Accuracy may otherwise be used so that she can DEBUFF opponent's more consistently.

Idol Threat.name: Idol Threat
Idol Threat.sa1: EVADING an attack grants FINAL STAND and ARMOR for 5/7/10 seconds.
Idol Threat.sa2: Inflict ARMOR BREAK for 5 seconds when HITTING an attacking opponent. Additionally, 100/150/200% of the damage inflicted is regained as HEALTH.

role_strategy: Idol Threat is a fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her FINAL STAND and ARMOR when evading an attack, while also inflicting ARMOR BREAK when she intercepts one. This combination of abilities allows to her to be an offensive variant with a degree of survivability.

The unique trait of Idol Threat lies in her second Signature Ability that allows her to regain HEALTH based on the damage she inflicts. Alongside this in-built LEECH ability, she also boasts the highest ATK stat of all Gold-tier Filias (tied only with Windswept) and can inflict ARMOR BREAK, increasing her damage output by 20%. Hence, this combination of traits makes her an excellent fighter to be used offensively, especially in fights with ARMOR involved. This is especially useful in Rift Battles, where every health point matters and ARMOR is common.
This is especially useful in Rift Battles, where every health point matters and ARMOR is common.

The FINAL STAND and ARMOR gained through her first Signature Ability give Idol Threat good survivability. But this can only be gained by EVADING an attack, which the AI is not consistent with. Hence, she is better suited to be used by the player offensively.

Her first Signature Ability activates even when using EVASION buff, so she pairs well with Pickle Baller to grant her easy PRECISION, Blockbuster Meter and an easy way to activate her Signature Ability.
Marquee Ability: LEECH is the preferred Marquee Ability for Idol Threat, as her own REGEN is not consistent.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Idol Threat is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her ARMOR BREAK will not be resisted by enemies.

Immoral Fiber.name: Immoral Fiber
Immoral Fiber.sa1: When defeated, deal damage equivalent to 25/35/50% of your MAX HEALTH.
Immoral Fiber.sa2: When defeated, heal all teammates by 25/35/50% of your MAX HEALTH.

role_strategy: Immoral Fiber is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that activates upon her death. With enough investment in HP, Immoral Fiber can be dangerous to face against without the proper counters. She can easily bring one of your fighters down with her while healing her teammates in the bench.
Marquee Ability: VOLATILITY is the recommended Marquee Ability for Immoral Fiber, which can increase her longevity in a fight when she gains FINAL STAND, INVINCIBILITY or MIASMA.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a Defensive Double, Immoral Fiber is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance.
Special investment: HP is the most important stat for Immoral Fiber, as it allows her to deal significant damage on death.
rift_battles: Immoral Fiber is one of the best defenders to have in your base, as she can force your opponent to use a specific fighter against her, to get the maximum amount of points. This can make it difficult to properly finish her, as the opponent may also have to worry about the two other fighters that may require a different kind of fighter and strategy to counter. It is important to note that if she is killed last and her Signature Ability activates to kill your last fighter, it will not count as a loss.
It is important to note that if she is killed last and her Signature Ability activates to kill your last fighter, it will not count as a loss.
playing_against: One way to counter Immoral Fiber is to deal the last hit with a stack of PRECISION which ignores any Signature Ability, preventing her on-death ability. Characters such as Parasoul that can gain PRECISION easily from EGRET CALL (TAUNT) is recommended to use.

The other way to counter Immoral Fiber is to inflict HEX, which disables her Signature Ability from activating. Fighters that can inflict HEX such as Red Velvet and Rainbow Blight are recommended to use.

Without the proper counters, one way to deal with Immoral Fiber is to simply tank her by using characters with a naturally high HP stat, like Big Band and Cerebella. However, this is not recommended and is very risky as Immoral Fiber can have her HP boosted up by modifiers or investment from moves which are not displayed in public.

In Denile.name: In Denile
In Denile.sa1: Inflict ARMOR BREAK for 5/10/15 seconds when entering Sekhmet Mode.
In Denile.sa2: Remove all DEBUFFS and gain IMMUNITY for 5/10/15 seconds when entering Sekhmet Mode.

role_strategy: In Denile is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that cleanses her DEBUFFS and grants her IMMUNITY when triggering Sekhmet, as well as inflicting ARMOR BREAK on the opponent. This makes her hard to nail down with DEBUFFS while making ARMOR a trivial problem for her. Given the unpredictability of the AI in triggering Sekhmet, it's better to use In Denile offensively.
Given the unpredictability of the AI in triggering Sekhmet, it's better to use In Denile offensively.
ARMOR BREAK removes all ARMOR stacks upon application, and In Denile can inflict it very frequently. Because of this, she's very effective against a lot of ARMOR-using variants.

While being able to break ARMOR as well as cleanse her own debuffs is nice, In Denile needs access to her Blockbusters to do so, making her very weak against DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS. Her bronze status also means her base stats aren't great, making her very replaceable with higher tier Eliza's.

In Denile is one of only two fighters with access to both DEBUFF Cleanse and IMMUNITY, making her a very valuable asset. The only other fighter being Weekend Warrior, but In Denile has access to Eliza's kit, giving her extra utility.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work well with In Denile. RITUAL SACRIFICE can be useful to quickly charge up blockbusters, allowing her to gain stacks of ARMOR and IMMUNITY faster. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH can be useful as a safety-net when a mistake is made to get her back to full health. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build In Denile as a Critless Variant
Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build In Denile as a Critless Variant
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, In Denile is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow In Denile to use her Signature Ability more often.

Indomitable.name: Indomitable
Indomitable.sa1: Grant DEADEYE and inflict HEAL BLOCK when the opponent's HEALTH drops below 60/70/80%. Both effects are removed if Parasoul is KNOCKED DOWN.
Indomitable.sa2: Transfer 1 opponent BUFF and gain MIASMA for 7 seconds every 5/4/3 seconds while on the opponent's side of the stage and benefiting from DEADEYE.

role_strategy: Indomitable is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that exerts control over the opponent from different angles. Health and meter is controlled through HEAL BLOCK and MIASMA, while defensive BUFFS are controlled through DEADEYE and BUFF transfer from her abilities. Altogether, Indomitable is a fighter that provides unique utility that makes her stand out among most Parasoul variants that rely on damage.

With reliable access to 1–2 stacks (up to 4 stacks at once if one has Evergreen Evil in their team) of MIASMA in the corner, Indomitable is among the few Parasoul variants that can reliably heal her health, the other being Princess Pride and Bombshell. She accomplishes this slower but with the additional benefit of controlling the opponent's meter while chipping out their health too. DEADEYE is a unique BUFF that is not widely accessible to most variants. This allows Indomitable to counter defensive BUFFS such as THORNS, AUTOBLOCK and UNFLINCHING which are commonly found in modes such as Rift Battles.

DEADEYE is a unique BUFF that is not widely accessible to most variants. This allows Indomitable to counter defensive BUFFS such as THORNS, AUTOBLOCK and UNFLINCHING which are commonly found in modes such as Rift Battles.

The only weakness to Indomitable is her low ATK stat, which may lead her to struggle in high Prize Fight streaks, where it may be a challenge to whittle down the opponent's health down to 80% to activate her abilities. However, this may be advantageous in Rift Battles where there is a lot of reflect damage and high damage can be detrimental against certain defenders like Painwheel.

Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Indomitable, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%. Due to the nature of Indomitable's Signature Ability and the utility her kit provides, players have the option of building her as a Critless Variant
Due to the nature of Indomitable's Signature Ability and the utility her kit provides, players have the option of building her as a Critless Variant
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Indomitable is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Infernal Twin.name: Infernal Twin
Infernal Twin.sa1: When hitting an attacking opponent, gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds and refresh the duration of all ENRAGES.
Infernal Twin.sa2: When HIT while benefiting from 5/4/3 stacks of ENRAGE, inflict FATIGUE for 5 seconds.

role_strategy: Infernal Twin is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability revolving around gaining stacks of ENRAGE, increasing her damage output easily, while also allowing her to inflict FATIGUE when hit, which acts as a safety net. Infernal Twin is similar to Sheltered, both relying on stacks of ENRAGE, but has the added ability to refresh the duration of her ENRAGES, allowing her to continually dish out significant damage even against opponents that are of higher tiers.

The condition to activate Infernal Twin's Signature Ability allows her to gain ENRAGE simply by blocking and quickly attacking when the opponent leaves an opening. Thus, it is important to learn each character's attack pattern to understand when to attack safely.

While she can inflict FATIGUE when hit, it requires at least three stacks of ENRAGE. FATIGUE is not a reliable measure of protection, as it's chance to STUN is only 50% when it expires. Players should not rely on FATIGUE, as Infernal Twin's low health means she is very easy to take out before it expires.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive unit, SPECTRAL SPITE is the more fitting option, giving Infernal Twin more damage the lower her health is. However, players should not be trying to keep their health as low as possible unless they know what they're doing.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Infernal Twin is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Inkfluencer.name: Inkfluencer
Inkfluencer.sa1: NON-BLOCKBUSTER PROJECTILES inflict SLIME and INK the opponent for 10 seconds each, and DRAIN 10/15/20% BLOCKBUSTER METER on HIT. BLOCKBUSTERS deal 20% more damage per stack of INK (up to 5 stacks).
Inkfluencer.sa2: Gain BARRIER when entering or exiting THE HOLE IDEA. While in THE HOLE IDEA, SPECIAL MOVES recharge 50/75/100% faster and gain 10/20/30% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second.

role_strategy: Inkfluencer is an offensive Peacock which aims to inflict SLIME and her unique DEBUFF, INK. When not attacking, she is also able to hide using THE HOLE IDEA to passively charge her SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS.

INK is a unique DEBUFF only for Inkfluencer, and does not have a MODIFIERS icon. Instead, it will be indicated by the color of the opponent. INK will forcefully change the color of the opponent, changing from a light shade of pink at 1 stack of INK, to a dark shade of red at 5 stacks of INK.
As a Peacock, Inkfluencer has a variety of NON-BLOCKBUSTER PROJECTILES she may use to inflict SLIME and INK. Some notable options she can use are: Peacock's L5
Peacock's L5

Inkfluencer's second SIGNATURE ABILITY is mainly used during downtime for Peacock. Whether the enemy is afar, knocked down, or the next enemy is tagging in, using THE HOLE IDEA can help gain reduce SPECIAL MOVE COOLDOWN and BLOCKBUSTER METER, and also allow Inkfluencer to gain some survivability with the BARRIER. Players inside THE WHOLE IDEA gain almost 50% BLOCKBUSTER METER if they stay for the full duration. Increasing your Meter Gain will also increase the BLOCKBUSTER METER gained while using THE HOLE IDEA
Players inside THE WHOLE IDEA gain almost 50% BLOCKBUSTER METER if they stay for the full duration.
Increasing your Meter Gain will also increase the BLOCKBUSTER METER gained while using THE HOLE IDEA

Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Inkfluencer as it provides the chance to reset the cooldown for her special moves, which are mostly projectiles, and reuse them almost immediately. This will help her inflict more INK on the enemy.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Inkfluencer is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy can be used if you want to inflict SLIME more reliably. With her high Attack stat, Crit Rate and Crit Damage can also be used to increase her damage higher.

Inkling.name: Inkling
Inkling.sa1: Deal 15/20/25% bonus damage for each living teammate.
Inkling.sa2: SPECIAL MOVES have a 15/20/25% chance to be UNBLOCKABLE while Peacock has living teammates.

role_strategy: Inkling is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her bonus damage and unblockable special moves as long as she has living teammates. Hence, Inkling works best as the first fighter in the match in order to reliably take advantage of her abilities without worrying about KO'd allies decreasing her damage.

Inkling's Signature Ability places greater emphasis on using special moves for unblockable hits, allowing Inkling to find openings easily. However, it is often good to have one or two blockbusters equipped, such as any of the unblockable Tier 3 blockbusters. It is important to note that each special move hit has an individual chance to be unblockable. Therefore, BANG, BANG, BANG!, dealing three hits, has a higher chance to break through.
It is important to note that each special move hit has an individual chance to be unblockable. Therefore, BANG, BANG, BANG!, dealing three hits, has a higher chance to break through.

It is important to keep distance between you and the opponent so that you can use special moves safely. Throwing the enemy is helpful as it knocks back the opponent and provides the distance to safely use special moves. This can be done right at the start of a match due to the size of Peacock's grab. Be cautious when throwing Cerebella however, as her BALANCING ACT can render you vulnerable.

Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Inkling, as it directly compliments her Signature Ability by providing the chance to reset special move cooldown and reuse it almost immediately.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Inkling is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her Special Moves being unblockable.
rift_battles: When used defensively, Inkling will mostly rely on her second Signature Ability that can make her special moves unblockable, which may deal substantial damage to your fighters. In conjunction with the Peacock-specific catalyst, Hollow Points, this can deal significant damage through HEAVY BLEED and ARMOR BREAK. Although this probably won't be enough to secure a kill, this may affect the health bonus points that are calculated as part of the Rift score.

Inner Pieces.name: Inner Pieces
Inner Pieces.sa1: When entering Sekhmet Mode, gain a BUFF for 10/12/15 seconds per teammate. The BUFF gained is determined by each teammate's ELEMENT.
Inner Pieces.sa2: 50/75/100% chance when TAGGING to or from Eliza for all active BUFFS to transfer to the incoming Fighter.

role_strategy: Inner Pieces is an offensive support fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her various BUFFS depending on your teammate's element. Aside from gaining these BUFFS, Inner Pieces has the ability to transfer BUFFS from herself or transfer BUFFS to herself, depending on whether she TAGS OUT or TAGS IN. Hence, Inner Pieces can act as a "transfer point" to transfer BUFFS between fighters and requires the right team setup to maximize her full potential. It is important to note that Inner Pieces will always gain BUFFS depending on the number of teammates, regardless of whether they are alive or not.
It is important to note that Inner Pieces will always gain BUFFS depending on the number of teammates, regardless of whether they are alive or not.
Note that for each BUFFS with multiple stacks, Inner Pieces can only transfer one stack.

As Inner Pieces can transfer BUFFS to herself from the previous fighter when she TAGS IN, it is recommended to bring at least one teammate who has timeless BUFFS such as Blue Screen, Overclocked, Risky Ginger and Thrill Shrieker. The condition to remove these BUFFS will still apply when transferred onto another fighter.
The condition to remove these BUFFS will still apply when transferred onto another fighter.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work well with Inner Pieces. RITUAL SACRIFICE can be useful to quickly charge up blockbusters that trigger Sekhmet, allowing her to gain BUFFS faster. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH can be useful as a safety-net when a mistake is made to get her back to full health. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Inner Pieces as a Critless Variant
Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Inner Pieces as a Critless Variant
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Inner Pieces is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow Inner Pieces to use her Signature Ability more often.

Ionic Icon.name: Ionic Icon
Ionic Icon.sa1: All teammates' TAG IN attacks inflict DEATH MARK for 10/15/20 seconds and STUN the opponent for 4 seconds. Peacock also gains 1/2/3 stack of BARRIER.
Ionic Icon.sa2: Every 15 COMBO HITS by a Light Element teammate removes 1 opponent BUFF and inflicts POWER SURGE for 10/12/15 seconds.

role_strategy: Ionic Icon is an offensive support variant that allows teammates to tag in safely, and gives all Light Element teammates BUFF removal and access to POWER SURGE. While she's alive, teammates tag in attacks inflict STUN, allowing for a safe tag in, and also inflicts DEATH MARK, significantly increasing their damage. Characters with usually sub-par tag ins (those that usually don't have a follow up like Umbrella's or Parasoul's) benefit the most from the free opening the stun provides.
Characters with usually sub-par tag ins (those that usually don't have a follow up like Umbrella's or Parasoul's) benefit the most from the free opening the stun provides.
ALL active hits are able to inflict the debuffs while the tag in attack is in use, hence using a projectile and tag out can also be a strategy.

Her second Signature Ability grants all light teammates utility through BUFF removal, which is extremely strong. The access to POWER SURGE also allows Light Element teammates to synergize with fighters like Wunderkind.
Marquee Ability: As a TAG IN based support fighter, CAST PARTY is the recommended Marquee Ability for Ionic Icon.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Ionic Icon is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS are not resisted by the enemy. With Tag Cooldown, Rerun becomes redundant for most use-cases. Do note that with rerun and Tag Cooldown it is possible to keep enemies stunned indefinitely.

Iron Matron.name: Iron Matron
Iron Matron.sa1: Detonated TEARS grant 1 stack of ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds on HIT.
Iron Matron.sa2: DASH ATTACKS are UNBLOCKABLE while benefiting from at least 3 stacks of ENRAGE. Successful DASH ATTACKS grant MIASMA and inflict ARMOR BREAK for 3/4/5 seconds each.

role_strategy: Iron Matron is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability built on rewarding constant and effective pressure through the use of unblockable dash attacks that provide MIASMA and inflict ARMOR BREAK, while being reliant on setting up tears and tear detonations for ENRAGE.

Iron Matron aims to set up quickly, using her early combos to flood the field with tears. These are then detonated to rapidly gain ENRAGE, enabling her to apply corner and combo pressure with unblockable dash attacks. Detonations are fastest and most reliable through the move NAPALM TRIGGER, and can be used as a combo extender if the opponent is hit by a tear while activating the attack
Detonations are fastest and most reliable through the move NAPALM TRIGGER, and can be used as a combo extender if the opponent is hit by a tear while activating the attack

Upon access to her unblockable dash attacks, Iron can easily farm MIASMA, and with effective combos and drain the opponent's health. Moreover, she will also inflict ARMOR BREAK, helping Iron Matron reliably deal incredibly high damage, removing the opponent's ARMOR and increasing her overall damage.
Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Iron Matron, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%.
Do note that due to her access to MIASMA and ARMOR BREAK, Iron Matron can be built Critless.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Iron Matron is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS.

Preferred Moveset: Inferno Brigade / Canopy Bounce / Silent Scope

Ivy League.name: Ivy League
Ivy League.sa1: Inflict SLOW for 5/7/10 seconds when spawning a TEAR. Opponents are IMMOBILIZED while near a TEAR.
Ivy League.sa2: DRAIN 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second while the opponent is near a TEAR.

role_strategy: Ivy League is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that excels at locking the opponent in place. Spawning TEARS will inflict SLOW, decreasing the rate at which opponents gain meter, while draining health and inflicting IMMOBILIZE to whittle away at an opponent's health reliably.

Parasoul can easily spawn TEARS without equipping any TEAR-spawning moves through normal gameplay. Furthermore, two stacks of SLOW is often more than enough to prevent the opponent's blockbuster meter from charging fully. By keeping a TEAR near the opponent, they will quickly be taking damage, whether it be from the life drain, or Parasoul dealing consistent chip damage with her attacks (even if they hit on BLOCK).

With her ability to lock an enemy in place, it's recommended to use Ivy League with projectile-based moves to stay away from the opponent while damaging them slowly. Use moves like NAPALM SHOT, MOTOR BRIGADE and SILENT SCOPE for consistent, far away damage.

Assuming no HP recovery is in play, Ivy League's Tears are capable of fully draining an enemy team's HP within 150 seconds, or 2:30. While this is impressive, in practice she will often need to do damage directly to take a well-built team down.

Marquee Ability: As Ivy League as a variant lacks in the offensive department, CRITICAL MASS is considered the better pick. As she'll spawn plenty of TEARS on the field during normal gameplay, having CRITICAL MASS will increase her crit damage considerably. Due to the nature of her ability, a critless copy of Ivy League is recommended.
Due to the nature of her ability, a critless copy of Ivy League is recommended.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Ivy League is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need 100% Crit Damage from move stat increases.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by defenders. Crit Rate and Crit Damage can be ignored if using a critless build.

Jack-O-Specter.name: Jack-O-Specter
Jack-O-Specter.sa1: Gain a random BUFF for 10/12/15 seconds when either Fighter uses a SPECIAL MOVE.
Jack-O-Specter.sa2: Inflict 3 random DEBUFFS on the opponent for 10/12/15 seconds each when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER.

role_strategy: Jack-O-Specter is an offensive Marie who utilizes luck to her advantage to gain an array of random BUFFS or inflict random DEBUFFS.

Due to how she gains buffs and inflicts debuffs, her move set can vary based on what people intend to focus on, with more SPECIAL MOVES providing BUFFS more often, or using BLOCKBUSTERS to apply DEBUFFS more often
Marquee Ability: IMPROVED INCINERATION is the best Marquee Ability for JACK-O-SPECTER as an offensive Marie that intends to maintain her buffs while inflicting as many DEBUFFS as possible
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Jack-O-Specter is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special Investment: Accuracy a worthwhile stat for Jack-O-Specter to ensure her DEBUFFS will not be resisted by enemies.

Jawbreaker.name: Jawbreaker
Jawbreaker.sa1: When TRANSMUTING, gain a random BUFF for 5/6/7 seconds.
Jawbreaker.sa2: Deal 10/15/20% bonus damage for each BUFF applied to Double.

role_strategy: Jawbreaker is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around gaining BUFFS when transmuting, which increases her overall damage output per BUFF gained. With one of the highest natural ATK stat in the game, Jawbreaker is an offensive powerhouse that can break through the toughest defenders by sheer force alone.

Jawbreaker can gain lots of potent BUFFS. Knowing when to transmute, and knowing when you can attack to maximize her damage boost, are crucial to success when playing as Jawbreaker. Most of the available BUFFS are defensive in nature (FINAL STAND, REGEN, INVINCIBILITY, ARMOR), which may overcome the low base health of Double fighters and allow Jawbreaker to survive longer in a fight. Jawbreaker can be paired up with support fighters like Starlight Rose and Surgeon General that grants consistent BUFFS while in the bench to easily increase her damage output.
Jawbreaker can be paired up with support fighters like Starlight Rose and Surgeon General that grants consistent BUFFS while in the bench to easily increase her damage output.

Marquee Ability: CHAOS is a very powerful ability that allows her to continually deal DEBUFFS when facing against BUFF-reliant opponents such as Heavy Metal and Untouchable. In addition, Jawbreaker can easily boost her damage through BUFFS gained while transmuting to the advantageous element. This combination is extremely powerful and provides Jawbreaker an advantage that no other Double variants can provide.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Jawbreaker is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Meter Gain and Special Cooldown are also stats which players can choose to invest in.

Just Kitten.name: Just Kitten
Just Kitten.sa1: 25/35/50% chance when suffering a DEBUFF to immediately convert that DEBUFF to a stack of PRECISION.
Just Kitten.sa2: 5/10/15% chance when either Fighter is hit by any non-projectile HIT to gain 1 stack of EVASION and HASTE for 10 seconds.

role_strategy: Just Kitten is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to convert DEBUFFS into PRECISION. This allows her to have the upper hand when placed in an DEBUFF heavy environment.

As Just Kitten has a respectable attack stat for a bronze, and combined with her PRECISION, she can deal a good amount of damage against defenders. Just Kitten can convert DEBUFFS such as CURSE or even HEX into PRECISION.
Just Kitten can convert DEBUFFS such as CURSE or even HEX into PRECISION.
After getting the first few hits in, she essentially becomes unhittable due to her EVASION being timeless. She is therefore a super safe offensive choice.
While having a decent attack stat, Just Kitten's viability in namely prize fights goes to another league with the help of Octoplasm's support role.

Marquee Ability: Because it allows extremely easy synergy with Octoplasm, it is recommended to pick the MLEM Marquee ability to constantly have REGEN applied. If you plan to use her solely as solo front runner, BOOP is the best Marquee Ability to increase her raw damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Just Kitten is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Damage will increase Just Kitten's overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION. Accuracy is replaces the need for Meter Gain, since it will help activate her 2nd Signature Ability more often to give her HASTE.

Kill Joy.name: Kill Joy
Kill Joy.sa1: Teammates gain permanent REGEN when first dropping below 25/35/50% HEALTH while at an ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGE.
Kill Joy.sa2: Once per match on DEATH, RESURRECT all defeated teammates with 15/20/25% HEALTH.

role_strategy: Kill Joy is a defensive support fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to revive all her fallen teammates upon her death. Furthermore, Kill Joy grants her teammates permanent REGEN when dropping below a certain health threshold while at an elemental advantage. This makes Kill Joy an excellent fighter to bring as she can ensure that your best fighters are alive to defeat opponents.

Kill Joy's revival ability makes her a threat to deal with defensively. Use OUTTAKES to force her out and defeat her first before moving onto the others. Another option is to defeat her with PRECISION to prevent her Signature Ability from activating. Characters with easy access to PRECISION includes Parasoul and Ms. Fortune.
Marquee Ability: Kill Joy would primarily benefit from TRAUMA CENTER as a Marquee Ability to stall for time when used defensively, or to provide a safety net for your fighters when used offensively.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Valentine, Kill Joy is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.
rift_battles: Kill Joy can also benefit from ICU as a Marquee Ability when used as a defender, providing her IMMUNITY to BLEED effects and stalling for time in conjunction with catalysts such as Last Words. Kill Joy is particularly potent when paired with Assassin's Greed and Last Hope to form a triple LIGHT Valentine node that excels at stalling for time.

Killing Time.name: Killing Time
Killing Time.sa1: CHARGE ATTACKS are extended with an extra hit and can be charged longer for extra damage. Landing a CHARGE ATTACK grants permanent DEADEYE and adds 1/1.5/2% BLOCKBUSTER METER for each hit landed until the end of her combo.
Killing Time.sa2: BLOCKBUSTER HITS inflict CURSE for 10 seconds. If a BLOCKBUSTER HIT occurs after a CHARGE ATTACK in the same combo, gain 3/4/5 stacks of permanent ENRAGE until the end of her combo.

role_strategy: Killing Time is an offensive Eliza, built for long, high damaging combos using her CHARGE ATTACKS for DEADEYE, ENRAGE, CURSE and BLOCKBUSTER METER.

Killing Time can hold the CHARGE ATTACK for an extended period of time, and gains an extra delayed attack up, indicated by her briefly glowing blue while charging up. This unique Attack will travel to the enemy to deal damage. When she she has boosted her CHARGE ATTACK, the final hit will do a different stagger animation on the opponent, and knock them upwards into the air. This helps CHARGE ATTACKS be a an attack used multiple times in Killing Time's combos. This change affects both Human and Sekhmet Eliza's Charge Attacks and activates even if the attack is missed. Killing Time will gain BLOCKBUSTER METER when holding her CHARGE ATTACK or when landing hits with her CHARGE ATTACK in both Human and Sekhmet form. The longer she holds the CHARGE ATTACK, the longer the opponent is staggered and also knocked into the air by her.

When she she has boosted her CHARGE ATTACK, the final hit will do a different stagger animation on the opponent, and knock them upwards into the air. This helps CHARGE ATTACKS be a an attack used multiple times in Killing Time's combos.

It's recommended to weave in at least one CHARGE ATTACK at the start of any combo so that Killing Time will start every combo with DEADEYE and 5 stacks of permanent ENRAGE.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work well with Killing Time. RITUAL SACRIFICE can be useful to quickly charge up blockbusters, allowing safer and more immediate CHARGE ATTACKS to be used. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH can be useful as a safety-net when a mistake is made to get her back to full health. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Killing Time as a Critless Variant

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Killing Time is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Lapis Luxury.name: Lapis Luxury
Lapis Luxury.sa1: Once per match when TAGGING IN, match the meter value of the opponent's highest BLOCKBUSTER METER and inflict ARMOR BREAK for 10/12/15 seconds.
Lapis Luxury.sa2: Once per match when using a TIER 3 BLOCKBUSTER, switch HEALTH percentages with the opponent and gain HEAVY REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds.

role_strategy: Lapis Luxury is a fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to change the course of battle in her favor through manipulation of her meter and health values. Lapis is able to match the meter value of the opponent's highest blockbuster meter when she tags in, and usage of an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster switches her health percentage with the opponent. In addition, she also inflicts ARMOR BREAK and gains HEAVY REGEN when activating each of her respective abilities.

The best way to use Lapis Luxury is to TAG IN when the opponent has a full meter to fully charge her blockbusters. Then, allow herself to get hit while having a Valentine with the TRAUMA CENTER Marquee Ability to keep her health at 1. Finally, use the fully charged LADY OF SLAUGHTER to activate her second Signature Ability and switch her 1 health with the opponent still at full health to immediately defeat them.

Lapis Luxury can be used defensively to easily get a fully charged blockbuster and punish opponents with an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster when she TAGS IN. However, the use of an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster to activate her second Signature Ability is completely dependent on the behavior of the AI and may not be reliable. Smart players will be able to avoid her ability altogether by keeping her meter low with fighters such as Cerebella with the UPPER HAND Marquee Ability and meter control variants such as Wind Stalker and No Egrets.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work well with Lapis Luxury. RITUAL SACRIFICE can be useful to quickly charge up blockbusters, allowing her to activate her second Signature Ability faster with an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH can be useful as a safety-net when a mistake is made to get her back to full health. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Lapis Luxury as a Critless Variant
Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Lapis Luxury as a Critless Variant
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Lapis Luxury is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Last Hope.name: Last Hope
Last Hope.sa1: While Valentine is alive, when any teammate is defeated, RESURRECT that teammate with 15/20/25% HEALTH. This effect only occurs once per other teammate.
Last Hope.sa2: Also grant HEAVY REGEN for 5/10/15 seconds.

role_strategy: Last Hope is a defensive and supportive fighter, giving everyone in her team a one-time resurrection, while also granting HEAVY REGEN upon revival. Her universal safety net works both offensively and defensively, stalling the match for time and also avoid one-hit-KOs that could happen any time throughout the fight.

Her largest weakness on defense is generally just being on the field because once she is knocked out, her Signature Ability will no longer activate to revive her teammates. While she can revive herself and has a high base Health, she lacks much else to keep her alive.
Using variants like Shear Force or Nightshade, and going against variants like Biting Cold also counter Last Hope, with their ability to Permakill and negate the revives for her team.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee can be used on Last Hope, however, Trauma Center is the recommended option to target her supportive capabilities in reviving a teammate and aiming to sustain them throughout a fight. ICU is the recommended Marquee Ability for Last Hope when built specifically for defense, providing a method to HEAVY REGEN, allowing her to be a better defensive wall that cannot be worn down by BLEED effects.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Valentine, Last Hope is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.
rift_battles: Last Words and Autoimmune are two catalysts that works very well with Last Hope to provide resistance to DEBUFFS and stalling for time through FINAL STAND. When paired along with Kill Joy and Assassin's Greed, opponent's will be forced to rely on raw power to deal with a team of triple light Valentine node that excels at stalling for time.

Last Hope has synergies with Marie's both offensively and defensively through the use of their Marquee, REINFORCED REVIVAL, which enables any teammate's revive to gain an increased 25% more health and permanent ARMOR. In use of this offensively, it benefits the main attacker to revive a total of 50% Health and try to fight again. Defensively, when paired especially with Megalomaniac, it allows Last Hope and another defender (besides Megalomaniac) to revive with 50% of their Max HP, Permanent ARMOR, and 15 seconds of HEAVY REGEN, which can increase their stall duration, while also helping Megalomaniac gain more stacks of ARMOR off-field.

Lethal Weapon.name: Lethal Weapon
Lethal Weapon.sa1: All SHOTS have a 50/75/100% chance to inflict BLEED for 10 seconds.
Lethal Weapon.sa2: Gain 1/2/3% METER and 1% HEALTH per second while nearby an opponent suffering BLEED.

role_strategy: Lethal Weapon is Black Dahlia's premier bleeder variant with a simple gameplay revolving around using her SHOTS to inflict BLEED onto her opponent, She also gains METER and HEALTH while nearby an opponent suffering from BLEED. This combination of abilities allows Lethal Weapon to be a reliable bleeder that can tear through even the toughest of defenders in high Prize Fight streaks. Her ability to gain METER and HEALTH while near a bleeding opponent may seem strong and can come in handy, it is not recommended to rely on it as a main method of gaining METER and HEALTH as the gain rate itself is very low.

Her ability to gain METER and HEALTH while near a bleeding opponent may seem strong and can come in handy, it is not recommended to rely on it as a main method of gaining METER and HEALTH as the gain rate itself is very low.

Her biggest weakness is her reliance on getting BLEED debuff on the opponent, as if her opponent can cleanse themselves of debuffs or has the ability to outright prevent them with IMMUNITY and RESISTANCE, Lethal Weapon will have a hard time finishing off stronger opponents. This is not helped by her having the current lowest base attack stats of any Black Dahlia, only going up to 7,335 ATK. To help counter opponent RESISTANCE, investing in ACCURACY is highly recommended.

Black Dahlia can fire two or three SHOTS in a normal combo sequence, which means inflicting multiple stacks of BLEED will be very easy to do. The ability to gain Meter while nearby an opponent suffering BLEED allows Lethal Weapon to reliably use Black Dahlia's unblockable Tier 3 Blockbuster, LAST CALL. LAST CALL reloads and fires all six of Black Dahlia's SHOTS, which will immediately inflict five stacks of BLEED on the opponent.
LAST CALL reloads and fires all six of Black Dahlia's SHOTS, which will immediately inflict five stacks of BLEED on the opponent.

EMPOWER is a crucial move to use with Lethal Weapon to inflict CURSE as BLEEDS are easily countered with variants that can gain REGEN easily such as Bloodbath and Valentine variants with the ICU Marquee Ability.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Lethal Weapon will benefit from METAL BREAKDOWN as her Marquee Ability to increase her damage output from ARMOR BREAK and the extra damage boost to her SPECIAL SHOTS.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Lethal Weapon is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her BLEED is not resisted by enemies.

Locked 'N' Loaded.name: Locked 'N' Loaded
Locked 'N' Loaded.sa1: When FIRING a SHOT, sacrifice 3% of Black Dahlia's MAX HEALTH to inflict WITHER and gain 5/7/8% BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Locked 'N' Loaded.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, DRAIN 3/4/5% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH per stack of WITHER and convert all stacks of WITHER on the opponent to INVERSE POLARITY for 3 seconds per stack.

role_strategy: Locked ‘N’ Loaded is an offensive Black Dahlia who relies on using her SHOTS and BLOCKBUSTERS for rapid Meter Control and Health Drain respectively, at the cost of some her own health.

Locked ‘N’ Loaded’s first Signature Ability is focused on gaining lots of BLOCKBUSTER Meter and inflicting Timeless WITHER on the opponent, at the cost of some of her Health per SHOT. The ability specifically activates when firing a shot, so the bullets do not have to directly hit the enemy, and multi-hitting bullet types will not stack Meter Gain or Health loss. Black Dahlia is unable to die from the HP Loss, so she can safely spam her bullets even while at 1 Health Point.
Black Dahlia is unable to die from the HP Loss, so she can safely spam her bullets even while at 1 Health Point.

Locked ‘N’ Loaded’s second Signature Ability consumes the WITHER she has inflicted to drain the opponent’s Max Health and inflict INVERSE POLARITY to make it more difficult for the opponent to mitigate their Health loss. When played efficiently, Locked will be able to heal more from the drain than the health she has lost. The INVERSE POLARITY length will fluctuate based on how many stacks of WITHER, lasting 3/6/9/12/15 seconds if the opponent had 1/2/3/4/5 stacks of WITHER

Locked In.name: Locked In
Locked In.sa1: While near a TEAR, 50/75/100% chance for SPECIAL MOVES to grant HASTE for 15 seconds and remove 1 opponent BUFF.
Locked In.sa2: While at least 1 TEAR is on the stage, CRITICAL HITS grant INVINCIBLE for 1 second and 5/7/10% of all CRIT DAMAGE dealt is regained as HEALTH.

role_strategy: Locked In is an offensive fighter with a lot of versatility in her abilities and base kit with access to HASTE, recovery, BUFF removal, INVINCIBLE on critical hits and impressive damage output from her high ATK stat and Marquee Ability. Altogether, this combination of utilities and damage makes her one of the best units in the game.

The ability to gain HASTE and remove an opponent's BUFF from a special move is very powerful: BUFF removal allows Locked In to counter defensive fighters such as Evergreen Evil, Curl Scout, Rose-Tinted and many other BUFF-heavy defenders. HASTE charges her blockbusters fast, which allows her to have a high DPS. With easy access to HASTE, Martial Outlaw can be paired with Locked In to provide additional utility through ARMOR BREAK and HEAVY BLEED, further boosting her damage output. An easy way to activate this ability would be to perform a grab and immediately use one of her TAUNTS to remove a BUFF and gain HASTE along with the TAUNT's BUFF (either PRECISION or IMMUNITY).
BUFF removal allows Locked In to counter defensive fighters such as Evergreen Evil, Curl Scout, Rose-Tinted and many other BUFF-heavy defenders.

Locked In's second Signature Ability makes her one of the best counters to reflect damage in the game. TEARS are naturally spawned throughout Parasoul's combos and landing a critical hit can easily be achieved through PRECISION given by the recommended special move, EGRET CALL, or stat investment through moves. Furthermore, any chip damage suffered will be recovered from those same critical hits, keeping her health full for the entire match. She is the best counter to Painwheel with the Tainted Blood Marquee Ability and any defensive variants with access to THORNS such as Evergreen Evil. With 1 TEAR on the field and access to IMMUNITY from her TAUNT, all critical hits she lands will provide INVINCIBLE, which completely blocks the reflection damage. It is thus recommended to not detonate TEARS in the field as it will hurt her performance in most cases. With maximum critical rate, Locked In will always trigger a 1-second INVINCIBLE for every hit she lands. However, you can pair her with Evergreen Evil to increase the duration of her INVINCIBLE from 1 second to 6 seconds. Important to note that Guest Star hits do not trigger her Signature Ability. So any critical hits from Guest Stars will not block the reflection damage, unless she already has INVINCIBLE.

She is the best counter to Painwheel with the Tainted Blood Marquee Ability and any defensive variants with access to THORNS such as Evergreen Evil. Love Crafted.name: Love Crafted
Love Crafted.sa1: While near an opponent, DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS and inflict HEAL BLOCK after 3/2/1 second(s).
Love Crafted.sa2: Every 10th COMBO HIT will land as a CRITICAL HIT, and will inflict DEATH MARK and HEAVY BLEED for 10/12/15 seconds.

role_strategy: Love Crafted is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to easily inflict DEATH MARK and HEAVY BLEED to wear down defenders quickly. Furthermore, Love Crafted can also disable blockbusters and inflict HEAL BLOCK just by being near an opponent, making her a strong offensive fighter capable of inflicting massive damage without fear of getting punished or countered by healing.

Given Squigly's excellent combo game, it is easy to land more than 10 combo hits while near the opponent to continually deal damage from HEAVY BLEED and locking the opponent down from any blockbusters and healing. Love Crafted will primarily depend on HEAVY BLEED to deal significant damage. Hence, fighters that convert BLEED into REGEN such as Bloodbath and any Valentine with the ICU Marquee Ability can make it difficult to defeat without losing time. Although Love Crafted can inflict HEAL BLOCK to prevent REGEN, it is recommended to equip moves such as DRAUGEN PUNCH that can inflict CURSE to completely prevent REGEN.

Lucky Lure.name: Lucky Lure
Lucky Lure.sa1: While Umbrella is alive, the active Fighter has a 30/40/50% chance to gain a BUFF based on a random teammate’s ELEMENT for 7 seconds when landing a CRITICAL HIT.
Lucky Lure.sa2: While Umbrella is alive, increase the active Fighter’s CRIT DAMAGE by 5/10/15% per stack of REGEN on the Fighter.

role_strategy: Lucky Lure is an offensive and supportive Umbrella, relying on herself or teammates to land CRITICAL HITS to provide Elemental BUFFs and CRIT DAMAGE to the active fighter.
The first Signature Ability provides BUFFs when landing a CRITICAL Hit. The BUFFs will vary based on her own, and her teammates elements.

Note that if you gain the maximum number of stacks of a certain BUFF, it will be excluded from the chance of gaining it again. Example, if you have HASTE in a team composed of only Air and Water teammates, every CRITICAL HIT will give REGEN regardless.

The second Signature Ability simply provides CRIT DAMAGE per stack of REGEN the active fighter currently has, up to 75%. With Lucky Lure already being a natural Air variant, CRITICAL HITS from her first Signature Ability will always have a chance to gain REGEN. The odds of REGEN can also be manipulated based on the team, with mono-air teams always providing REGEN from her first Signature Ability While Lucky Lure can only provide REGEN, HEAVY REGEN and permanent REGEN will also count towards boosting Crit Damage, only being stopped by the 200% Crit Damage Sub-Stat cap.

Marquee Ability: BITTER END is the recommended Marquee Ability for Lucky Lure, as it allows her to survive longer in the match by having a FINAL STAND and HEAVY REGEN safety net. The HEAVY REGEN will also help Lucky Lure gain a 15% Crit Damage bonus, so she will get extra damage while at a disadvantage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Lucky Lure is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Accuracy will increase the odds of Lucky Lure's first Signature Ability for activating for the whole team and Crit Rate will boost the odds of Lucky Lure's first Signature Ability activating for herself.

M-3OW.name: M-3OW
M-3OW.sa1: Deal 50/75/100% bonus damage while Robo-Fortune is far away from the opponent.
M-3OW.sa2: Gain INVINCIBLE for 3/4/5 seconds after 3 seconds while far away from the opponent.

role_strategy: M-3OW is a fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her benefits when far away from the opponent. Aside from a bonus damage to all her attacks, M-3OW also gains INVINCIBLE, which renders her immune to any form of attack. These two abilities together makes M-3OW a highly effective offensive zoner despite having the lowest base ATK stat among Robo-Fortunes. Despite her incredibly low base ATK stat, she does more damage than any Robo-Fortune in the game with the 100% bonus damage. As such, her zoning capabilities should not be underestimated and should be used as much as possible.

Despite her incredibly low base ATK stat, she does more damage than any Robo-Fortune in the game with the 100% bonus damage. As such, her zoning capabilities should not be underestimated and should be used as much as possible.

Given the aggressiveness of the AI, M-3OW is best to be used offensively where players have control in distancing themselves through the use of ranged attacks such as THEONITE BEAM, PHASER BURN and CATASTROPHE CANNON ALPHA. M-3OW's INVINCIBILITY is great for negating any big hits she might take while zoning, but it only lasts for 5 seconds at max and is not stackable. Hence, there is an awkward 1-second window between it going away and it being applied again where the opponent can sneak in a big hit. It's advised to keep an eye on opponent moves and apply caution for blockbusters or projectiles that the opponent can use in this small time window.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, M-3OW is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase her overall damage.

Mad Malice.name: Mad Malice
Mad Malice.sa1: While Marie is alive, her teammates' CRITICAL HITS have a 15/20/25% chance to grant ENRAGE for 10/13/15 seconds.
Mad Malice.sa2: Marie gains permanent ENRAGE for every 50/40/30% HEALTH lost by any teammate or opponent. Gain permanent PRECISION while benefiting from 5 stacks of this ENRAGE.

role_strategy: Mad Malice is an Offensive Support Marie variant that grants teammates ENRAGE and gains permanent ENRAGE and PRECISION herself. As a Diamond ENRAGE support, she is very similar to Seraph Soldier, but they both serve different roles.

Mad Malice shines most as a supporter, synergizing with most fighters in the game and increasing the active fighters damage output. The condition to get her ENRAGE is a simple Critical Hit which most fighters can easily achieve.

Unlike Seraph Soldier, the condition for Mad Malice's ENRAGE isn't steep, this allows fighters that already have low ATK stats to use her as a support to increase their damage, or kick star their Signature Abilities. (Dead Heat or Megasonic).

Although Mad Malice doesn't have Seraph Soldier's Trauma Centre Marquee ability, she has her own revives through her Character Ability. But she also lacks the incredible regen that Seraph Soldier provides.

Different to most support fighters, Mad Malice does not spend the entire match in the bench. She can tag in at the end of the match with 5 stacks of ENRAGE and PRECISION to deal with troublesome fighters like Death Wish or Shadow Puppet. This is a similar but better version of what Surgeon General tries to achieve.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive support Marie, Mad Malice is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her teammates have a higher chance of gaining ENRAGE. Due to her access to PRECISION Crit Rate should be avoided but Crit Damage will increase her damage output greatly.

Magicurl.name: Magicurl
Magicurl.sa1: When the active Fighter is about to suffer a DEBUFF, Filia sacrifices 10% MAX HP to give the active Fighter IMMUNITY for 3/4/5 seconds. This effect can only trigger once every 10 seconds.
Magicurl.sa2: Also deal 10% MAX HEALTH damage to the opponent and inflict HEAL BLOCK for 5 seconds. Filia’s BLOCKBUSTER or SPECIAL HITS have a 25/30/35% chance of healing her for 10% MAX HEALTH.

role_strategy: Magicurl is an offensive and supportive Filia focusing on being a teamwide anti-debuff variant with DEBUFF cleanse and IMMUNITY at the sacrifice of some of her own HEALTH, but she also exchanges it for extra damage on the opponent, HEALBLOCK to guarantee the damage, and high-self healing abilities to mitigate any HEALTH she has previously lost.

Magicurl provides off-field support to her teammates by being able to prevent any DEBUFF for 5 seconds every 10 seconds. This works well against defensive variants or modifiers with slow DEBUFF application such as Megalomaniac who inflicts STUN every 15 seconds, or Unholy Host who only inflicts CURSE when she or the opponent tags in. Magicurl however cannot prevent all DEBUFFS consecutively, and struggles when too many are inflicted, especially due to the ability also damaging herself as well as the IMMUNITY not being active at all times. When Magicurl is paired with an Evergreen Evil, IMMUNITY will be available at all times, providing a total of 10 second IMMUNITY every 10 seconds now if you are DEBUFFED. While Magicurl does lose 10% of her MAX HEALTH when she or a teammate suffers a DEBUFF, Magicurl is able to heal some of the HEALTH lost off-field from any SCRATCH DAMAGE she has.

Magicurl's second Signature Ability encourages some offensive power to her. Being able to inflict HEALBLOCK and deal 10% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH when her team suffers a DEBUFF, she is able to punish opponents for trying to DEBUFF them.

Magicurl's second Signature Ability also encourages some on-field time to self-heal through her SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS. Being able to use her MOVES for healing helps her maintain her HEALTH after preventing a lot of DEBUFFS for the team. Using moves like DRILL TEMPERED with it's very high hit count aid in Magicurl's healing speed. The high odds of her healing can mean the HEALTH lost from preventing DEBUFFS merely minor, yet still be a powerful support and damage dealer.

Marquee Ability: Due to her already high self-healing, either Marquee can be used on Magicurl. LEECH provides more reliable and consistent healing for Filia, while THE FIRST CUT can be used to do more damage since Magicurl is focused on high-hit-count combos to heal anyways, Due to the nature of her ability, Critless is also a viable strategy to consider for Magicurl.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Magicurl is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Maid of Honor.name: Maid of Honor
Maid of Honor.sa1: While Marie is alive, HITS blocked by all teammates have a 25/35/50% chance to convert 1 DEBUFF into a stack of BARRIER.
Maid of Honor.sa2: While Marie is alive, all teammates recover 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second while benefitting from BARRIER.

role_strategy: Maid of Honor is a support fighter that provides significant survivability through the conversion of DEBUFFS into BARRIER and providing regeneration for allies that are benefitting from BARRIER.

The ability to remove DEBUFFS by blocking allows Maid of Honor to be a very useful support to counter variants that rely on inflicting DEBUFFS such as Unholy Host and modifiers from Prize Fights or Catalysts in Rift Battles. Furthermore, variants that can gain BARRIER from their Signature Abilities but lacks regeneration such as Overclocked, Snake Bite, Corrosive Agent and Spell-Bent can benefit greatly from having Maid of Honor in the bench.

As a support variant, Maid of Honor also benefits from Marie's kit, especially her unique character ability in removing dead bodies. This provides her an edge over Starlight Rose which has a similar ability in supporting variants with BARRIER.

When used defensively with Rose-Tinted, Maid of Honor can make great defensive teams. Defense units like Curl Scout, Corrosive Agent and Treble Maker can punish the opponent for jumping into the battle without proper counters or a Tagout.

Marquee Ability: Since Maid of Honor would be in the bench for the majority of the fight, either Marquee Ability can work with Maid of Honor. IMPROVED INCINERATION will provide her some additional offensive output and meter, which can be useful to inflict QUIETUS onto the opponent with Marie's blockbusters. Meanwhile, REINFORCED REVIVAL can be a useful option to provide some survivability on dead teammates.
stat_investment: General Investment: If used offensively, Maid of Honor is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. If used defensively, Maid of Honor is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase the chances of her teammates converting debuffs.

Mana Flow.name: Mana Flow
Mana Flow.sa1: Squigly's standard BLOCKBUSTERS consume all DRAGON CHARGES to gain additional effects per DRAGON CHARGE. Gain 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER when gaining a DRAGON CHARGE and automatically gain 25% DRAGON CHARGE per second.
Mana Flow.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, gain permanent PRECISION until the COMBO ends. Permanently gain 10/15/20% ATTACK when spending a DRAGON CHARGE.

role_strategy: Mana Flow is an offensive Squigly able to passively charge her BLOCKBUSTER meter and DRAGON CHARGES overtime. While she has a DRAGON CHARGE, some of her BLOCKBUSTERS now deal additional attacks and all BLOCKBUSTERS will now stun-freeze the opponent for a few seconds, similar to Black Dahlia's ICE SHOT. With 1 stack of DRAGON CHARGE, a BLOCKBUSTER will cast a circle and temporarily stun the enemy. With 2 stacks of DRAGON CHARGE, the BLOCKBUSTER will cast a circle and freeze the opponent, dealing additional damage and a longer stun time.

In return, Mana Flow's BLOCKBUSTERS now have permanent PRECISION, and the DRAGON CHARGES she uses also boost her ATTACK permanently. Mana Flow will only increase her BASE ATTACK stat when receiving these permanent ATTACK boosts, and not her TOTAL ATTACK stat.

DEAD ALIVE is better to be used defensively, providing other teammates FINAL STAND to increase the longevity of your defensive fighters and stall for time.
