Martial Outlaw.name: Martial Outlaw
Martial Outlaw.sa1: Any teammate's CHARGE ATTACK HITS grant HASTE for 8/10/12 seconds.
Martial Outlaw.sa2: All teammates have a 15/20/25% chance on HIT to inflict ARMOR BREAK and HEAVY BLEED for 10 seconds each while benefiting from HASTE.

role_strategy: Martial Outlaw is an offensive support fighter that provides HASTE with every CHARGE ATTACK to all teammates, allowing them to charge their blockbusters faster. While benefiting from HASTE, teammates will also have a chance to inflict ARMOR BREAK and HEAVY BLEED to further increase their damage output. Altogether, Martial Outlaw is an effective support variant that can boost a fighter's offensive prowess, in particular against either ARMOR or REGEN defenders.

CHARGE ATTACKS between different characters have varying degrees of usefulness depending on their kit. Annie for example is a character who can reliably use their CHARGE ATTACKS due to GRAVITY SLINGSHOT making it easy to land one. Eliza is another great example of a character that can reliably use her CHARGE ATTACK after a knockdown while in SEKHMET MODE to stagger the opponent. Martial Outlaw is also a great support for characters and variants that can gain HASTE through their own kit or Signature Ability. Beowulf can easily gain HASTE with his TAUNT (AROO READY?) while variants like Candy Crusher and Hair Apparent can activate HASTE through their Signature Ability. Furthermore, support variants like Rough Copy and Sketchy can provide other sources of HASTE to characters who may not reliably use CHARGE ATTACKS.

Martial Outlaw is also a great support for characters and variants that can gain HASTE through their own kit or Signature Ability. Beowulf can easily gain HASTE with his TAUNT (AROO READY?) while variants like Candy Crusher and Hair Apparent can activate HASTE through their Signature Ability. Furthermore, support variants like Rough Copy and Sketchy can provide other sources of HASTE to characters who may not reliably use CHARGE ATTACKS.

Marquee Ability: As primarily a support variant, Martial Outlaw can benefit from either Marquee Ability. But since she will predominantly be used offensively, she can work as a secondary fighter and METAL BREAKDOWN will be the preferred ability to further bolster her offensive potential.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Martial Outlaw is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase the chances of her teammates inflicting HEAVY BLEED and ARMOR BREAK while Martial Outlaw is in the bench.

Masked Menace.name: Masked Menace
Masked Menace.sa1: While near an opponent, inflict CURSE and QUIETUS for 2 seconds after every 3/2/1 second(s).
Masked Menace.sa2: While the opponent is suffering from QUIETUS, landing a BURST inflicts permanent DOOM for 25/20/15 seconds and heals 15% HEALTH. DOOM is removed when the opponent gains a BUFF or Painwheel dies.

role_strategy: Masked Menace is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to inflict permanent DOOM on the opponent with a BURST and heal 15% HEALTH. She can also inflict CURSE and QUIETUS while near an opponent, this gives her access to great utility and BUFF control.

Masked Menace's permanent DOOM is removed when the opponent gains a BUFF or if she dies. Her access to CURSE allows her to control the opponent from getting BUFFS, for this to work she must be able to keep constant pressure on the enemy and stay near them.

By pairing her with fighters like Pickle Baller, she is able to evade through opponents attack and keep close to them. Fighters like Dark Horse, Unholy Host and Purrfect Dark also have access to timeless or long-lasting CURSE, which will stop opponents from getting buffs.

Due to her DEBUFFS being very short, it might be hard to inflict DOOM when modifiers like Super Serum or Time Dilation are active, for this, she can be paired with fighters like Heartless or Phantom Wrangler who have access to long-lasting QUIETUS. She can also be paired with fighters like Hell's Belle in hopes that she rolls timeless QUIETUS, but it is hardly ever consistent or reliable, so it is not a recommended strategy.
Marquee Ability: TAINTED BLOOD is the recommended Marquee Ability for Masked Menace, as it allows her to play a defensive role.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Masked Menace is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her CURSE and QUIETUS are not resisted. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output further.

Materia Girl.name: Materia Girl
Materia Girl.sa1: 20% chance to gain 5/7/10% STAR POWER meter when either Fighter is HIT (includes Blocking).
Materia Girl.sa2: While in STAR POWER MODE, gain permanent PRECISION, DEADEYE or HASTE, and 3/4/5% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second. The permanent BUFF is removed when exiting STAR POWER.

role_strategy: Materia Girl is an offensive fighter who can gain a steady supply of blockbuster meter as well as one out of three permanent BUFFS while in STAR POWER mode: PRECISION, DEADEYE or HASTE. She also has a 1 in 5 chance to gain STAR POWER meter whenever an attack connects, providing Materia Girl an exceptionally high (pseudo-infinite) STAR POWER mode uptime while being able to deal with problematic Signature Abilities and/or BUFFS with relative ease.

The BUFF gained when entering STAR POWER mode is random. Players will have to switch it on and off multiple times in order to gain the desired BUFF type for different situations: PRECISION is a powerful BUFF that guarantees a CRITICAL HIT while ignoring the opponent's Signature Ability. HASTE is a general all-purpose BUFF that charges blockbuster meter faster. DEADEYE is a versatile BUFF that ignores specific defensive BUFFS such as AUTO-BLOCK, UNFLINCHING, EVASION and THORNS as well as the opponent's Defense stats.
PRECISION is a powerful BUFF that guarantees a CRITICAL HIT while ignoring the opponent's Signature Ability.
HASTE is a general all-purpose BUFF that charges blockbuster meter faster.
DEADEYE is a versatile BUFF that ignores specific defensive BUFFS such as AUTO-BLOCK, UNFLINCHING, EVASION and THORNS as well as the opponent's Defense stats.

With these BUFFS, Materia Girl can face against a wide variety of opponents well: PRECISION against reflect-damage defenders like Dread Locks and Treble Maker and defenders with on-death abilities like Immoral Fiber and Death Wish. DEADEYE against defenders that rely on specific BUFFS such as Model Leader, Rose-Tinted, That's All Folks!, and Plot Twisted.

Marquee Ability: Materia Girl will benefit from RED SHIFT to further increase her damage output easily through subsequent uses of blockbusters and special moves. This is particularly effective on her since she will have access to her blockbusters very frequently.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Materia Girl is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating. While investing in Crit Damage will increase her damage further by taking use of her PRECISION. Building Meter Gain allows Materia Girl to forgo the HASTE buff and focus solely on utilising DEADEYE or PRECISION.

Mean One.name: Mean One
Mean One.sa1: Gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds for every BUFF gained by the opponent.
Mean One.sa2: Projectiles have a 25/35/50% chance on HIT to convert 1 opponent BUFF into a random DEBUFF.

role_strategy: Mean One is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that takes advantage of the opponent's BUFFS for her own advantage and turning those BUFFS against them by converting them into random DEBUFFS. This allows Mean One to be a powerful counter to BUFF-heavy fighters like Heavy Metal, Meow & Furever and That's All Folks!.

The most important thing to keep in mind when using Mean One is the matchup. Using her against fighters who primarily focus on inflicting DEBUFFS, such as Claw & Order or who have little to no way to BUFF themselves, such as Harlequin, will leave you with an average Peacock with no Signature Ability. Enemies with Marquee Abilities that grant BUFFS to them such as GRUDGE and VOLATILITY are great targets for Mean One. Be sure to check the opponent's Marquee Abilities before starting a fight.

Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Mean One as it provides the chance to reset the cooldown for her special moves, which are mostly projectiles, and reuse them almost immediately.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Mean One is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her converting the opponents BUFFS.

Megalomaniac.name: Megalomaniac
Megalomaniac.sa1: While Marie is alive, she gains permanent ARMOR and EVASION for 10 seconds for every 40/35/30% HEALTH lost by any teammate. 1 stack of ARMOR is removed when her opponent uses a BLOCKBUSTER.
Megalomaniac.sa2: While Marie is the active Fighter, is fighting the same opponent, and has at least 3 stacks of ARMOR, she inflicts STUN for 2/3/4 seconds every 10 seconds and DRAINS 10% BLOCKBUSTER METER every 5 seconds.

role_strategy: Megalomaniac is a defensive fighter that becomes stronger as her teammates takes damage, gaining defensive BUFFS that make her hard to take down. With enough ARMOR stacks, she can control the battle by inflicting STUN on the opponent and draining their BLOCKBUSTER meter. All of this makes Megalomaniac a dangerous defender to face against without proper preparation.

Other sources of ARMOR will count towards the condition of her second Signature Ability. Thus, variants that can provide ARMOR to their teammates such as Model Leader are great teammates to pair her with. Furthermore, catalysts such as FROST ARMOR or ARMOR RATING in Rift Battles also synergizes well with Megalomaniac's ability. Model Leader also removes DEBUFFS on her team, so her presence makes HEX and CURSE, two DEBUFFS that can shut down Megalomaniac, less effective.
Model Leader also removes DEBUFFS on her team, so her presence makes HEX and CURSE, two DEBUFFS that can shut down Megalomaniac, less effective.

Megalomaniac's permanent ARMOR stacks gets removed each time a blockbuster is used, making her weak against variants that can spam blockbusters easily such as Prototype, Candy Crusher and Heavy Reign. Notably, all the named variants also have elemental advantage over Megalomaniac, making them more effective than usual when it comes to dealing damage. Other measures of countering Megalomaniac include IMMUNITY, FINAL STAND, HEX and CURSE. Furthermore, using an OUTTAKE to bring her to the field will prevent her from entering the field with 5 stacks of permanent ARMOR, allowing players more room to defeat her.

Megasonic.name: Megasonic
Megasonic.sa1: When blocking a HIT, reduce damage taken by 25/50/75% and gain ENRAGE and THORNS for 10 seconds. One ENRAGE stack is removed every 10th COMBO HITS.
Megasonic.sa2: While benefiting from ENRAGE, 25/35/50% of the damage dealt is regained as HEALTH.

role_strategy: Megasonic is a fighter with a Signature Ability that grants him ENRAGE and THORNS when blocking a hit, allowing him to punish opponents with significant damage while regaining health for every hit. However, Megasonic's ENRAGE has a relatively short duration and is removed the longer he combos. Hence, unlike most other Big Band fighters, Megasonic requires specific move sets to be used effectively.

With stacks of ENRAGE and a respectable ATK stat, Megasonic can be used offensively to deal significant damage. However, it is highly recommended to equip moves with a low number of hit count such as BRASS KNUCKLES, GIANT STEP, SUPER-SONIC JAZZ and TAKE THE 'A' TRAIN to fully make use of his stacks of ENRAGE as they disappear for every successful hit. Megasonic can be paired with fighters that increase the duration of BUFFS, such as Evergreen Evil. Megasonic's second Signature Ability also works with ENRAGE stacks obtained externally, such as through support fighters like Rerun, Lucky Lure, Mad Malice or the combination of Inner Pieces and Thrill Shrieker or even Noble Mogul/Stone Sentinel and Starlight Rose to also gain ENRAGE. These ENRAGE stacks would not be removed when he hits since they don't come from his first Signature Ability, allowing Megasonic to heal consistently.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Megasonic will benefit from SOLOIST as his Marquee Ability. This compliments with Big Band's Prestige Ability that provides UNBLOCKABLE dash attacks while also supplementing HEAVY REGEN as a form of recovery. Due to the nature of his Signature Ability, Megasonic can be built Critless.

Special investment: Players can build Crit Rate and Crit Damage to further increase his damage output.

Mekastar.name: Mekastar
Mekastar.sa1: If none of Cerebella's BLOCKBUSTERS are fully charged, gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds and 5% BLOCKBUSTER METER every 3 seconds while not BLOCKING.
Mekastar.sa2: Gain BARRIER and inflict CURSE for 15 seconds each when using a BLOCKBUSTER. Also while benefiting from ENRAGE, 3% chance on HIT to instantly defeat the opponent if they have less than 30/40/50% HEALTH.

role_strategy: Mekastar is an offensive variant with an emphasis on blockbusters to deal damage and inflict CURSE. On top of that, she has the ability to instantly defeat the opponents below a certain threshold, making her a flexible offensive fighter to use in a variety of situations.

Mekastar's first Signature Ability grants her ENRAGE and meter passively when her blockbusters are not charged. To make use of this ability, it is best to equip more special moves than blockbusters in order to easily stack ENRAGES. MERRY GO-RILLA is especially recommended as it is a special move that allows Mekastar to be aggressive, satisfying the condition for her ability.

Due to her access to BARRIER, Mekastar synergizes well with a lot of supports. Fighters like Starlight Rose and Maid of Honor will increase her damage output and survivability. ENRAGE stacks given by Starlight Rose will also allow her second Signature Ability to trigger.

When aiming for the second Signature Ability, it is recommended to equip multi-hit moves such as PUMMEL HORSE, EXCELLEBELLA and GRAB BAG to increase the chances of activating her instant KO. These blockbusters are also Tier 2 and 3 which takes longer to charge, allowing her to stack ENRAGES from her first ability to satisfy the condition. Support variants such as Starlight Rose and Seraph Soldier can be paired with Mekastar to provide an additional source of ENRAGE from the bench. An example of a combo route that utilizes these moves: MERRY GO-RILLA > D2 > PUMMEL HORSE > G5 > EXCELLEBELLA

Meow & Furever.name: Meow & Furever
Meow & Furever.sa1: Gain FINAL STAND for 10 seconds and 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION for every 10% HEALTH LOST.
Meow & Furever.sa2: Enemy is inflicted with DEATH MARK for 10/12/15 seconds and STUN for 4 seconds when FINAL STAND expires.

role_strategy: Meow & Furever is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her FINAL STAND and stacks of PRECISION for every 10% health lost, allowing her to stall for some time. Furthermore, Meow & Furever can also inflict DEATH MARK and STUN when her FINAL STAND expires, which allows her to punish opponents with massive damage with a sliver of health. Meow & Furever can be a dangerous defender to face without the proper counters and precautions. It is important to note that unlike Wrestler X, the BUFFS that Meow & Furever gains for every health lost does not only activate once. Hence, any form of health regeneration will allow Meow & Furever to activate her first Signature Ability once her health gets reduced again.

Only the FINAL STAND from her first Signature Ability will trigger her second Signature Ability. Thus, modifiers and catalysts such as Last Words or support from fighters such as any Valentine with TRAUMA CENTER or Rock Star that can grant her FINAL STAND will not inflict STUN. This means that she's very susceptible to CURSE tactics if she's not on her last sliver of health, as passing a threshold with CURSE active will remove the FINAL STAND but not reapply it, leaving her with no method of survival.

Fighters such as Silent Kill, Doublicious and Summer Salt are thus recommended to use as their Signature Abilities can remove BUFFS from Meow & Furever. Some characters also have access to special moves and blockbusters that can remove BUFFS, such as Eliza with CHAOS BANISH, Filia with DRILL TEMPERED and Squigly with DRAG 'N' BITE.

If removing BUFFS is not an option, it is recommended to bring fighters that can gain IMMUNITY easily to avoid the STUN and DEATH MARK that can severely punish you. Some characters such as Parasoul, Peacock and Squigly have access to TAUNT that grant them IMMUNITY. Support fighters such as Surgeon General and Sketchy can also provide IMMUNITY.

Miss Mercury.name: Miss Mercury
Miss Mercury.sa1: 9/11/13% chance on HIT to gain 13% STAR POWER and inflict QUIETUS for 13 seconds.
Miss Mercury.sa2: When activating STAR POWER, instantly empty it to convert 1/2/3 BUFFS on the opponent to random DEBUFFS for 13 seconds. Also inflict CURSE for 13 seconds when activated at full meter.

role_strategy: Miss Mercury is an offensive Annie who builds fast STAR POWER and quickly releases it to turn opposing BUFFS into DEBUFFS, while inflicting CURSE to pause any more BUFFS they could receive.

Miss Mercury has high and consistent odds when it focuses on gaining STAR POWER, with any long combo reliably maxing her STAR POWER out quickly. Furthermore, she will apply QUIETUS to easily counteract the likes of FINAL STAND or BLESSING, but also helps synergise with her Second Signature Ability.

Upon activating Star Power, Miss Mercury can easily remove enemy BUFFS in trade for no STAR POWER. While she may lose any bedazzle to her STAR POWER, the ability to convert enemy BUFFS instantly for DEBUFFS is a worthwhile tradeoff. With Miss Mercury applying QUIETUS beforehand, this also makes it easier to apply her DEBUFFS.

At max STAR POWER, Miss Mercury will be guaranteed to apply CURSE. This can help Annie in situations with opponents still being able to gain more buffs like THORNS or AUTOBLOCK despite suffering so many DEBUFFS, aiding MISS MERCURY to fight for longer
Marquee Ability: REDSHIFT is the better Marquee for Miss Mercury to output more damage for her long combos.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an Offensive Annie, Miss Mercury will need Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate (for the Destruction Pillars) and Special Cooldown. Some Meter Gain may also be helpful for filling up Miss Mercury's Blockbusters to help extend long combos and gain more STAR METER.
Special investment: investing in Accuracy will help Miss Mercury increase her chances of converting opponent BUFFS into DEBUFFS and have a higher percent chance on gaining STAR METER.

Model Leader.name: Model Leader
Model Leader.sa1: While Annie is alive, she clears the active Fighter's DEBUFFS and grants ARMOR for 15 seconds every 30/25/20 seconds. Water teammates also gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 15 seconds.
Model Leader.sa2: Gain permanent AUTO-BLOCK for each 25/20/15% HEALTH lost. All Teammates benefiting from ARMOR or AUTO-BLOCK gain 4/5/6% BLOCKBUSTER METER when using a SPECIAL MOVE.

role_strategy: Model Leader is a defensive support fighter with a Signature Ability that clears all the team's DEBUFFS and grants them ARMOR every once in a while. Additionally, she gains permanent AUTO-BLOCK every time she loses a certain amount of health, making it difficult to start long chain combos against her without getting blocked.

Model Leader's first Signature Ability makes her a fearsome defender and a good defensive support fighter. The ability to clear all teammate DEBUFFS allows them to overcome common offensive strategies such as BLEED, CURSE, and HEX, which can make it difficult to take down the whole team within the time limit. Thus, it is advised for players to use OUTTAKES and eliminate Model Leader first before defeating the rest of her team. Her second Signature Ability gives her permanent stacks of AUTO-BLOCK as she loses health. This won't be very influential if the player can eliminate her in a single combo, but with her ARMOR and generally high health, this won't always be possible, and she becomes much more of a problem in those situations. At low health, five permanent stacks make it difficult to do full combos or even start combos against her in the first place, making throws or unblockable Blockbusters the only reliable combo starters as they can't be blocked. Because of this, characters with good combo routes starting with their throws fare better against her. Fukua, Parasoul and especially Annie are good examples of this.

Another tactic would be to utilize DEADEYE as it allows you to simply ignore AUTO-BLOCK as it was never there, with the best users of it being Black Dahlia and variants such as Indomitable, Psykid and Blue Streak. Because PRECISION gets consumed with each hit, you (ideally) have to use variants that get a lot of it like X-Bot, or variants with access to permanent PRECISION like Windswept and Hex Caliber. Due to AUTO-BLOCK only working when the opponent is standing on the ground, it will be beneficial to keep them in the air as much as possible during combos, for which you can use Eliza with her move WEIGHT OF ANUBIS, which is a command grab (cannot be blocked) and throws opponent in the air. Thus bypassing AUTO-BLOCK. By far the best Eliza variant to use against Model Leader is Stand Out as she has good damage output, gets additional damage boost with an Elemental Bonus and can outright prevent Annie from gaining permanent AUTO-BLOCK and ARMOR. Another option is DOOM, as it tends to be unremovable, bypassing Model Leader's debuff removal. Plus, it will kill her instantly upon expiration with no regard for ARMOR or AUTO-BLOCK, making her durability a non-factor. Notable DOOM users include Xenomorph, Dame Slayer and Guest Stars Brain Drain's Blastermind Brainstorm.

Marquee Ability: As a defensive fighter, BLUE SHIFT is the recommended Marquee Ability for Model Leader to increase her durability and force opponents to use longer combos to deal damage. This synergizes very well with Model Leader's own secondary Signature Ability that gives permanent AUTO-BLOCK, making it difficult to properly finish a combo without getting blocked.

rift_battles: Model Leader in Rift Battles can be a difficult opponent if you go unprepared due to her inherent synergy with Frost Armor, that significantly boosts her defensive attributes. Common strategies in dealing with Frost Armor often involve DEBUFFS such as BLEED, SLIME, CURSE, HEX and ARMOR BREAK, which can all be removed via Model Leader's first Signature Ability (unless she herself is HEXED).

When paired up with durable defenders such as Heavy Metal, Megalomaniac and Reimaged, or variants that often force player to deal with them in a specific order such as Rose-Tinted, Dark Might and (again) Megalomaniac, players can find it increasingly difficult to defeat Model Leader and her teammates in the allocated amount of time. Other catalysts such as Auto-Immune, Angry Flinch and Curse of Knowledge can also be very useful to significantly cripple the player's offense and cover up defenders' weaknesses.

Moody Magus.name: Moody Magus
Moody Magus.sa1: Gain a random BUFF for 10/20/30 seconds when defeating an opponent or using a MORTUARY CHARGE.
Moody Magus.sa2: Gain 1/1.5/2% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second while benefiting from a BUFF.

role_strategy: Moody Magus is an offensive fighter that gains a long-lasting random BUFF whenever she defeats an opponent or uses a MORTUARY CHARGE. While she's under the effect of any BUFF, she consistently gains meter, allowing her to spam blockbusters consistently throughout the fight.

Given her low ATK stat as a bronze, Moody Magus will struggle to deliver any meaningful offensive output on her own without any support. However, once she manages to defeat one opponent or use a MORTUARY CHARGE, she becomes more effective and gains access to consistent meter charge and a very long-lasting BUFF. It is recommended to ally Moody Magus with support fighters in the bench that can provide BUFF support to allow her to start gaining meter early. Such variants include Surgeon General, Sketchy, Rock Star, Starlight Rose and Pickle Baller. Another alternative is to equip Marie's TAUNT, which will provide Moody Magus with a random BUFF to start activating her second Signature Ability. A third option is to use Moody Magus as a secondary fighter. Use your main fighter to kill the first defender, then TAG IN Moody Magus and use her MORTUARY CHARGE to gain a random BUFF and meter from her abilities.

Moonstruck.name: Moonstruck
Moonstruck.sa1: Inflict WITHER for 10 seconds and gain 10/12/15% STAR POWER meter when landing a CRITICAL HIT with a projectile.
Moonstruck.sa2: Once per match when activating STAR POWER at full meter, REVIVE and HEAL teammates by 50/75/100% of Annie's missing HEALTH.

role_strategy: Moonstruck is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to revive and heal teammates when activating STAR POWER, providing a supportive role for the team. Furthermore, Moonstruck can also inflict WITHER while gaining STAR POWER meter when landing a critical hit. This allows Moonstruck to continually refill her STAR POWER without much effort, (allowing for a semi-infinite STAR POWER) while preventing the opponent from using blockbusters to punish you. Moonstruck is the only Annie variant with meter control, which is invaluable as Annie specializes in long chain combos which can quickly charge the opponent's blockbuster meter.
Moonstruck is the only Annie variant with meter control, which is invaluable as Annie specializes in long chain combos which can quickly charge the opponent's blockbuster meter.

It is highly recommended to equip Moonstruck with multi-hit projectile special moves and blockbuster such as CRESCENT CUT, GRAVITY SLINGSHOT and SAGAN BEAM to fully make use of her Signature Ability and increasing the chance to get a critical hit.

Note that the higher your Crit Rate is, the less these moves are needed as the stars created during STAR POWER MODE will start to critical hit sufficiently enough to maintain STAR POWER MODE. Sagan Beam as a tier 1 blockbuster is always recommended as it allows charging STAR POWER METER to full the fastest (as in, from match start to when you are able to use it).
Marquee Ability: Moonstruck will benefit from RED SHIFT to further increase her damage output easily through subsequent uses of blockbusters and special moves.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Moonstruck is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage.
Preferred Moveset

Due to her (pseudo-) infinite STAR POWER, moon is able to keep dashing after using Destruction Pillars for some extra damage. Once you have a high enough Crit Rate, Gravity Slingshot and/or Crescent Cut become redundant.
Sagan Beam: Reliable tool for self-healing. Also helps Moonstruck build up STAR POWER quickly and consistently with more chances for CRITICAL HITS.
Pillar of Creation: Annie's highest damage single-hit BLOCKBUSTER (if it crits). Great to do a high burst of damage and often used for BLOCKBUSTER kills or used as a combo extender.
Gravity Slingshot: Long multi-hit BLOCKBUSTER. Helps Moonstruck build up STAR POWER quickly and consistently with more chances for CRITICAL HITS.

Crescent Cut: Single-hit PROJECTILE move. Can be used for a chance of extra STAR POWER, but not highly recommended. When used in STAR POWER, Crescent Cut hits a total of 3 times, helping inflict GUARD BREAK and more reliably give extra STAR POWER.

Destruction Pillar: Annie's best SPECIAL MOVE, able to combo into itself, deal high bursts of damage, invincible on start-up and the added ability to deal extra damage if it is a CRITICAL HIT. Not STAR POWER reliant for damage or utility, so it helps Moonstruck maintain her STAR POWER for longer.

Ms. Trial.name: Ms. Trial
Ms. Trial.sa1: When HITTING an attacking opponent, remove 1 of the opponent's BUFFS and gain 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION.
Ms. Trial.sa2: PRECISION HITS have a 50/75/100% chance to ignore the opponent's DEFENSE and ARMOR.

role_strategy: Ms. Trial is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to remove opponent's BUFFS while gaining stacks of PRECISION. Furthermore, PRECISION hits does not trigger the opponent's Signature Ability, and with her SA, precision also ignores the opponent's defense and ARMOR, allowing her to deal massive amount of damage to the toughest defenders. However, the condition to her Signature Ability enforces the player to intercept (hitting a dashing opponent) instead of simply blocking. Hence, there is a level of skill required to use her effectively, but in her full potential, Ms. Trial can be a great offensive fighter for massive burst damage and BUFF removal.

Careful enemy selection may come in handy when playing Ms. Trial, as some characters are easier to intercept than others. Using her against opponents with a very quick dash such as Beowulf and Painwheel can make triggering her Signature Ability difficult. Ms. Trial can also hit a dashing opponent with her detached head in headless mode.

Mummy Dearest.name: Mummy Dearest
Mummy Dearest.sa1: Using a SPECIAL MOVE sacrifices 10% of Eliza's MAX HEALTH to gain 15/25/35% BLOCKBUSTER METER and HEAVY REGEN for 10 seconds.
Mummy Dearest.sa2: Gain BLESSING and IMMUNITY for 20/25/30 seconds each when entering SEKHMET MODE.

role_strategy: Mummy Dearest is a fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to charge blockbusters faster by using special moves, although it comes with a sacrifice of some of her HP, which is regained back over time through HEAVY REGEN. This allows her to spam blockbusters very easily, which helps her trigger her second Ability, giving her IMMUNITY and a stack of BLESSING every time she enters SEKHMET mode. This make Mummy Dearest a highly tanky variant with easy access to her Blockbusters.

As the AI often uses special moves, Mummy Dearest can be a dangerous defender that should not be underestimated, as she can punish you with an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster if left unchecked, which will also activate her second Signature Ability. Mummy Dearest can be paired with Evergreen Evil to increase the duration of Mummy's BUFFS, while also allowing Evergreen to gain meter from the bench.

Mummy Dearest's biggest strength is her utility and access to BUFFS such as BLESSINGS and IMMUNITY, which makes her immune to detrimental DEBUFFS from modifiers while active. In conjunction with Eliza's wide tools such as buff removal from CHAOS BANISH, a command grab in WEIGHT OF ANUBIS and STUNS from UPPER KHAT, Mummy Dearest can be a strong offensive fighter in a lot of situations. Mummy Dearest may not have the highest damage output, but her tools and access to SEKHMET loops allows proficient players to navigate through fights against tougher defenders easily, although it may take time to finish off her opponents.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability works on Mummy Dearest. However, as she can gain healing and meter easily on her own, she gains less from it compared to other Eliza variants. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Mummy Dearest as a Critless Variant

Special investment: It is recommended that players don't invest in Meter Gain, as Mummy Dearest has Meter Gain in her own Signature ability.

Myst-Match.name: Myst-Match
Myst-Match.sa1: While sharing the opponent’s same element, gain 1 stack of PRECISION every 3/2/1 second(s) and all HITS deal 100% bonus DAMAGE.
Myst-Match.sa2: Double’s PRECISION HITS deal 1/1.5/2% MAX HEALTH as damage to the opponent’s teammates.

role_strategy: Myst-Match is an offensive Double who uniquely aims to remain the same element as the opponent to gain a high damage boost and gain stacks of PRECISION. While benefiting from PRECISION, she will be able to deal damage to enemies off-field too.

Myst-Match is unique in such a way where she uses her high raw damage numbers to defeat the opponent consistently, rather than to use the DEBUFFs that most offensive Doubles try to inflict. To circumvent for the lack of DEBUFFS, enemies off-field will also continue to lose health off-field

Marquee Ability: Myst-Match is a unique offensive Double who uses the VOLATILITY Marquee Ability. While it may not consistently boost her damage or survivability well, it's at least usable for her because Myst-Match tends to not be the same element as the opponent.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Myst-Match is best built with Attack, Meter Gain, Special Cooldown and Piercing.
Special investment: Players can invest in Crit Damage to take the most use of her PRECISION.

Nail Biter.name: Nail Biter
Nail Biter.sa1: Gain MIASMA or BARRIER for 15 seconds each every 0.5/0.3/0.25 seconds while charging WYRM'S TAIL.
Nail Biter.sa2: While fully CHARGED, EVADE all attacks while DASHING. Successful DASH ATTACKS inflict 1/2/3 random DEBUFFS (excluding STUN or DOOM) for 10 seconds.

role_strategy: Nail Biter is an offensive Squigly who focuses on building up stacks of MIASMA and BARRIER to drain the opponent's health and reduce chip damage taken. She also applies 3 random debuffs when landing her DASH ATTACK, and EVADES attacks while she's DASHING with 2 WYRM'S TAIL stocks. This all taken together makes Nail Biter a very durable yet damaging longshot unit.

The quick and easy access to MIASMA allows Nail Biter to deal %-based damage just by being close to the opponent, making her very capable of making a big dent in opponents regardless of how much HP, Defense or defensive BUFFS they have. This is helped by her Atk being tied for the highest in the Gold Squigly pool.

EVADE is generally a very useful effect for getting in close, and Nail Biter having it on her DASH makes her very capable of closing in on the opponent safely. The condition of needing WYRM'S TAIL fully charged is very easy to accomplish at the end of combos, making her frighteningly consistent at getting combo starters in. DEADEYE will allow opponents to hit her through the EVADE on her DASH.
DEADEYE will allow opponents to hit her through the EVADE on her DASH.

While the DEBUFFS tied to her second ability are random, Squigly as a character can work in her dash attack a lot during combos, meaning that Nail Biter will often benefit from at least some of them. It is still not recommended to rely on this ability to apply specific debuffs like HEX or CURSE in a life or death situation, however.

Nail Biter can build up BARRIER and MIASMA stacks very quickly, but there is a minor consistency issue that may pop up due to her getting one of these buffs at random; She may for example get 5 stacks of BARRIER but in turn get few or even no MIASMA stacks. Players using her should keep this in mind.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability works with Nail Biter, since both conditions require her to be dead. EVIL DEAD can be useful on the offense to inflict both CURSE and WITHER, making it easier for the next fighter to defeat opponents. DEAD ALIVE is better to be used defensively, providing other teammates FINAL STAND to increase the longevity of your defensive fighters and stall for time. As an offensive fighter that doesn't rely on raw damage output due to her easy access to MIASMA, the player may benefit greatly from building a Critless copy.
As an offensive fighter that doesn't rely on raw damage output due to her easy access to MIASMA, the player may benefit greatly from building a Critless copy.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Nail Biter is best built with Attack, Piercing, and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Building Meter Gain may be redundant due to her easy access to MIASMA. Investing in Accuracy ensures that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by the opponent.

Near Death.name: Near Death
Near Death.sa1: Transfer 1 DEBUFF from yourself to the opponent and inflict GUARD BREAK for 15 seconds after every 7/6/5 seconds while not suffering a HIT (including blocked HITS).
Near Death.sa2: While the opponent is suffering from a DEBUFF, grant DEADEYE for 10/12/15 seconds when using a BLOCKBUSTER. Also while the opponent has 3 or more stacks of GUARD BREAK, BLOCKBUSTERS deal 50/75/100% bonus damage.

role_strategy: Near Death is an offensive fighter who excels at breaking guards to chain combos. She is rewarded with DEBUFF transfers, DEADEYE, and increased blockbuster damage, making her highly effective at dismantling defensive strategies.

Valentine is a multi-hit character who excels at trapping opponents in long combo chains, making it easy to activate her first Signature Ability. She can reset ground combos using COUNTERVENOM blockbusters or VIAL HAZARD special moves between hits. Note: This strategy works against non-heavy characters like Peacock and Marie For heavy characters such as Big Band, Near Death can spam MORTUARY DROP until GUARD BREAK stacks are applied COUNTERVENOM: DETOX and VIAL HAZARD: TYPE B is particularly noteworthy because of its ability to remove opponent's BUFFS since Near Death is countered heavily by IMMUNITY

DEADEYE provides Near Death the means to ignore the opponent's DEFENSE and also ignores BUFFS such as AUTO-BLOCK, UNFLINCHING, EVASION, or THORNS, allowing her to keep her long combo chain to deal with defensive opponents.
Marquee Ability: ICU is the recommended Marquee Ability to provide Near Death easy access to healing while on the offensive.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Near Death is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Nearly Departed.name: Nearly Departed
Nearly Departed.sa1: When using a BLOCKBUSTER at an ODD COMBO COUNT, gain INVINCIBILITY for 5/6/8 seconds.
Nearly Departed.sa2: Also RESURRECT teammates with 15/20/25% HEALTH if Squigly is below 50% HEALTH.

role_strategy: Nearly Departed is a fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her INVINCIBILITY while also providing the means to resurrect teammates. This allows her to act as an emergency secondary fighter that can resurrect your primary fighter.

The conditions to activate Nearly Departed's abilities relies on using a blockbuster with an odd combo count, which requires some practice to reliably keep count of Squigly's long string of combos: A full ground combo will always end with an odd combo count. This also works if the ground combo is extended with a SILVER CHORD (1 hit) followed by a dash attack (2 hits). A full ground combo followed by a launcher (swipe up) and INFERNO OF LEVIATHAN ends at an even count. Avoid doing the final hit of your ground combo before you do a launcher. At the corner with at least 1 DRAGON CHARGE, a grab followed by a full ground combo ends with an even count. Avoid doing the final hit of your ground combo and follow it with a BATTLE OPERA.

A full ground combo followed by a launcher (swipe up) and INFERNO OF LEVIATHAN ends at an even count. Avoid doing the final hit of your ground combo before you do a launcher.

With easy access to INVINCIBILITY, Nearly Departed can be used to counter opponents such as Dread Locks, Immoral Fiber, Painwheel with the TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability and many more. However, this will require constant application of INVINCIBILITY. Evergreen Evil can be paired with Nearly Departed to increase the duration of her INVINCIBILITY.
Evergreen Evil can be paired with Nearly Departed to increase the duration of her INVINCIBILITY.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability works with Nearly Departed, since both conditions require her to be dead. EVIL DEAD can be useful on the offense to inflict both CURSE and WITHER, making it easier for the next fighter to defeat opponents. DEAD ALIVE is better to be used defensively, providing other teammates FINAL STAND to increase the longevity of your defensive fighters and stall for time.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Nearly Departed is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant, but players can choose to build Crit Rate and Crit Damage.

Necrobreaker.name: Necrobreaker
Necrobreaker.sa1: Once per match when suffering a HIT that would be fatal, gain FINAL STAND for 5/10/15 seconds.
Necrobreaker.sa2: Gain 5/6/7% HEALTH per second while charging WYRM'S TAIL.

role_strategy: Necrobreaker is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to easily recover health while charging WYRM'S TAIL. Furthermore, Necrobreaker gains the ability to avoid death once by gaining FINAL STAND. The combination of both abilities allows Necrobreaker to continually recover her health from chip damage.
Given the unpredictable behavior of the AI, there's no real way for the player to encourage the activation of her second Signature Ability reliably as a defender.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability works with Necrobreaker, since both conditions require her to be dead. EVIL DEAD can be useful on the offense to inflict both CURSE and WITHER, making it easier for the next fighter to defeat opponents. DEAD ALIVE is better to be used defensively, providing other teammates FINAL STAND to increase the longevity of your defensive fighters and stall for time.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Necrobreaker is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Building Crit Rate and Crit Damage will further increase her damage potential.

Neuromancer.name: Neuromancer
Neuromancer.sa1: Drain 5/7/10% BLOCKBUSTER METER for each non-BLOCKBUSTER HIT blocked by the opponent.
Neuromancer.sa2: 10/12/15% of damage dealt from a BLOCKBUSTER is also suffered by the opponent's teammates.

role_strategy: Neuromancer is a fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around blockbuster usage to deal significant damage to both the opponent and their teammates. With the ability to drain meter just by simply attacking mindlessly, Neuromancer can easily charge up an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster for maximum damage and swiftly defeat the strongest teams.

Neuromancer is an excellent unit both in offense and defense. Offensively, equip multi-hit moves such as GAE BOLGA STINGER to easily drain the opponent's blockbuster meter. With a few blocked hits, Neuromancer should be able to charge up enough meter to use BUER OVERDRIVE for maximal damage. The ability to damage opponents in the bench makes Neuromancer ideal to handle support fighters such as Surgeon General and Persona Assistant without the need to use an OUTTAKE.
Marquee Ability: TAINTED BLOOD is the preferred Marquee Ability for Neuromancer as it allows her to play a defensive role.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Neuromancer is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output further. Meter Gain should be completely avoided due to her unmatched level of meter gain through her Signature Ability.
rift_battles: Defensively, Neuromancer is dangerous to face against given the aggressiveness of the AI, as a few blocked hits can quickly charge up an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster. With modifiers such as Transducer (charges meter faster) and catalysts such as Don't Poke the Buer and Darknut, it can be difficult to swiftly defeat Neuromancer before she charges up her meter. To counter this, use multi-hit fighters that can reduce meter, such as Diva Intervention.
To counter this, use multi-hit fighters that can reduce meter, such as Diva Intervention.

Offensively, Neuromancer is typically used for her very fast meter gain when attacking blocking opponents. She is a popular choice used against Into Thin Air Catalysts to complete a BLOCKBUSTER kill. Due to the popularity of Into Thin Air, defensive Fly Traps and Buzzkills may be built, so some Neuromancer may be built as a Critless Variant for safety against the Marquee Ability, TAINTED BLOOD.

Night Terror.name: Night Terror
Night Terror.sa1: Gain 2 stacks of MIASMA for 10 seconds after every 4/3/2 seconds while far away from the opponent.
Night Terror.sa2: Inflict IMMOBILIZE and FATIGUE for 10 seconds each every 4/3/2 seconds while near the opponent.

role_strategy: Night Terror is an offensive fighter with a unique Signature Ability that provides two different effects based on her distance from the opponent. When close to the opponent, she can inflict FATIGUE and IMMOBILIZE, powerful DEBUFFS that can create openings for attacks. When farther away, she can gain MIASMA, a potent BUFF that allows her to drain the opponent's health and meter by simply being nearby. However, since the conditions to activate each of her Signature Abilities are opposite, players will need to recognize when to close or open the distance between Night Terror and the opponent.

MIASMA is a powerful buff that can significantly increase Night Terror's damage output and survivability by draining HP and meter, while FATIGUE and IMMOBILIZE can create openings for her to land additional hits as well as prevent the opponent from moving. To make the most of Night Terror's unique abilities, players should try to stay close to the opponent to inflict FATIGUE and IMMOBILIZE, and then move away to gain MIASMA stacks. Once she has built up enough MIASMA stacks, she can dash back in and start draining the life and meter from her opponents. Note that Night Terror needs at least 6 seconds to gain the maximum amount of MIASMA possible, which gives her only 4 seconds to dash back in and start using it before the stacks start expiring. For this reason, pairing her with Evergreen Evil to make her MIASMA last longer can be beneficial.

Note that Night Terror needs at least 6 seconds to gain the maximum amount of MIASMA possible, which gives her only 4 seconds to dash back in and start using it before the stacks start expiring. For this reason, pairing her with Evergreen Evil to make her MIASMA last longer can be beneficial.

When using Night Terror, it is important to be aware of her weaknesses. For instance, fighters with moves that allow them to hit her quickly from afar even while under the influence of IMMOBILIZE, like Beowulf with GIGANTIC ARM or Robo-Fortune with her various beams, can make it unsafe for Night Terror to use Fukua's various projectiles. Night Terror is also very reliant on IMMOBILIZE in order to get her game plan going, as it makes keeping a distance and gaining MIASMA substantially easier. Therefore, opponents with access to IMMUNITY or a DEBUFF clear, like Splitting Image or Rose-Tinted respectively, can hinder her usability.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activate when a certain percentage of health is lost, which is unfavorable when used offensively. Players who are proficient at Fukua will have ways to minimize damage as much as possible and avoid getting hit. SPECTRAL SPITE is recommended to further increase her damage output at low health.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Night Terror is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that defenders don't resist her DEBUFFS. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like LOBS OF LOVE.

Nightshade.name: Nightshade
Nightshade.sa1: Gain DEADEYE for 4/5/6 seconds whenever the opponent suffers a DEBUFF.
Nightshade.sa2: Sekhmet hits deal 50/75/100% bonus damage. Opponents defeated by Sekhmet hits cannot be revived.

role_strategy: Nightshade is an offensive Eliza who rewards players for utilising Eliza’s moves to the fullest extent with constant DEADEYE and permanently killing opponents.

As an Eliza, Nightshade has a natural array to debuffs throughout her kit with moves like CHAOS BANISH or BURST applying guaranteed DEBUFFS, while other moves like SEKHMET BITE, OSIRIS SPIRAL and UPPER KHAT have high odds of applying their own DEBUFFS. When managing these moves correctly, Nightshade will retain consistent DEADEYE, ignoring many opponent buffs.

Nightshade also rewards players for using and staying in Sekhmet mode, amplifying her damage considerably alongside access to permakill, as a tradeoff for being unable to apply DEBUFFS while in Sekhmet mode.

Nightshade overall is a starter-like variant for a generally difficult character, and aims to teach the players the basics of Eliza’s gameplay with her constant DEBUFF application and high damage in Sekhmet mode

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work for Nightshade as both her Signature Abilities also cover both health regeneration and meter gain. However, RITUAL SACRIFICE is generally recommended for offensive use, providing easy access to blockbusters by sacrificing a weak fighter. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH is generally recommended for defensive use, providing full health to stall for time, but is dependent on the AI TAGGING OUT. BLOOD OATH can also be used offensively as a safety-net to heal back all your health when you make a mistake by sacrificing a weak fighter. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Nightshade as a Critless Variant
Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Nightshade as a Critless Variant
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Nightshade is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Meter Gain is a useful stat that Nightshade may use so she can activate Sekhmet Mode more often for more damage and access to permakill.

Ninja Star.name: Ninja Star
Ninja Star.sa1: 50/75/100% chance when hitting an attacking opponent to remove 1 opponent BUFF and inflict GUARD BREAK for 10 seconds.
Ninja Star.sa2: Projectiles deal 25/35/50% bonus damage for each DEBUFF applied to the opponent.

role_strategy: Ninja Star is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to remove an opponent's BUFF and inflict GUARD BREAK, while gaining increased damage bonus from projectiles for each DEBUFF applied to the opponent. This combination of abilities makes Ninja Star a strong offensive fighter that can deal with BUFF-heavy defenders such as Heavy Metal, Armed Forces and Plot Twisted.

Annie has numerous projectiles that are further boosted by Ninja Star's secondary Signature Ability. The stars that are produced during STAR POWER mode also counts as projectiles and will be affected by her Signature Ability. It is also recommended to equip projectile special moves and blockbusters such as CRESCENT CUT, SAGAN BEAM, PILLAR OF CREATION and GRAVITY SLINGSHOT that will deal extra damage. CRESCENT CUT and GRAVITY SLINGSHOT are particularly recommended as they can also inflict GUARD BREAK and IMMOBILIZE respectively, which would further increase her bonus damage. PHOTO BOP can also be a useful move as it transfers all DEBUFFS gained through modifiers or catalysts from herself to the opponent and increase her damage output.
Marquee Ability: Ninja Star will benefit from RED SHIFT to further increase her damage output easily through subsequent uses of blockbusters and special moves.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Ninja Star is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her GUARD BREAK is not resisted by enemies. Meter gain allows her to use her stronger, more projectile based attacks more often.

No Egrets.name: No Egrets
No Egrets.sa1: On CRITICAL HIT, DISABLE the opponent’s BLOCKBUSTERS, SPECIAL MOVES, and TAG-INS for 4/5/6 seconds.
No Egrets.sa2: While Parasoul is alive, increase the active Fighter’s ACCURACY by 3/4/5% per CRITICAL HIT until the COMBO ends (up to 30/40/50%).

role_strategy: No Egrets is an offensive variant with a Signature Ability that allows her to disable the opponent's moves and TAG INS upon a CRITICAL HIT. With this ability, No Egrets can easily control the battlefield by completely shutting down the opponent's counterattack and means to escape. No Egret's ability is guaranteed to land every time she crits, which synergizes heavily with Parasoul's play style and gameplay that revolves around critical hits. Given that the DEBUFFS only last for 6 seconds, a high crit rate is recommended to keep the opponent locked down for as long as possible.

No Egret's ability is guaranteed to land every time she crits, which synergizes heavily with Parasoul's play style and gameplay that revolves around critical hits. Given that the DEBUFFS only last for 6 seconds, a high crit rate is recommended to keep the opponent locked down for as long as possible.

With the added ACCURACY increase on CRITICAL HITS, No Egrets and her teammates reduce the chances of DEBUFFs getting resisted while increasing the chances of chance-based BUFF removal instances landing, like the ones tied to CANOPY BOUNCE, BEST FRIENDS FOREVER for Fukua, SCRUB N SMASH for Marie, and DRAG 'N' BITE for Squigly.

As one of the very few variants who can inflict DISABLE TAG INS, she can easily keep the opponent's current variant on screen until she defeats them. Because of this, she's great for fights where the player wants to take down the enemy's team in a specific order. However, as a silver Parasoul with a low base Attack stat and no damage dealing benefits from her Signature Abilities, she may struggle to deal with opponents quickly, especially if they're on the tanky side.

However, as a silver Parasoul with a low base Attack stat and no damage dealing benefits from her Signature Abilities, she may struggle to deal with opponents quickly, especially if they're on the tanky side.
As a control variant that does not rely on spawning TEARS, No Egrets has a lot more flexibility in her move choices, allowing players to use moves that suit their preferences.
Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for No Egrets, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, No Egrets is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating and No Egrets inflicting her DEBUFFS.

Noble Mogul.name: Noble Mogul
Noble Mogul.sa1: While Eliza is alive, all teammates gain BARRIER every 30/25/20 seconds.
Noble Mogul.sa2: While Eliza is alive, all LIGHT teammates deal 5/10/15% bonus damage for each stack of BARRIER applied to them. Also Eliza gains IMMUNITY while benefiting from BARRIER.

role_strategy: Noble Mogul is an offensive support Fighter that grants her teammates BARRIER and increases the damage to LIGHT teammates based on the number of BARRIER stacks. As a main fighter, she also gains IMMUNITY, which prevents new DEBUFFS from being applied to her.

Noble Mogul works best in a team setting. She works well with other BARRIER support variants like Rock Star and can deal respectable damage on her own after a few BARRIER stacks. Her main strength lies in her access to Eliza's kit, which is full of utility while also being immune to DEBUFFS. Noble Mogul's second ability stacks together, opening up the possibility of a team with three Noble Mogul's for increased damage.
Noble Mogul's second ability stacks together, opening up the possibility of a team with three Noble Mogul's for increased damage.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work well with Noble Mogul. RITUAL SACRIFICE can be useful to quickly charge up blockbusters. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH can be useful as a safety-net when a mistake is made to get her back to full health. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Noble Mogul as a Critless Variant
Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Noble Mogul as a Critless Variant
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Noble Mogul is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Similar to Scarlet Viper, Noble Mogul too can be built with Crit Rate and Crit Damage. These stats, combined with her Signature Ability, let her deal incredible damage for an Eliza.

Number Cruncher.name: Number Cruncher
Number Cruncher.sa1: 25/35/50% chance to gain 1 stack of BLESSING for 20 seconds every 5 COMBO HITS.
Number Cruncher.sa2: When reaching 5 stacks of BLESSING, remove all BLESSINGS and inflict 5 stacks of GUARD BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Number Cruncher is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around COMBO HITS to gain BLESSINGS and inflict GUARD BREAK. The combination of these two Signature Abilities allows Number Cruncher to be an aggressive fighter by continually engaging the opponent in close combat and breaking their blocks. While Number Cruncher can gain BLESSINGS, it is best to view this BUFF as a safety net, in case the combo is interrupted by BURST and blockbusters.
While Number Cruncher can gain BLESSINGS, it is best to view this BUFF as a safety net, in case the combo is interrupted by BURST and blockbusters.

Number Cruncher is a close range fighter which is unusual as Robo-Fortune is primarily a zoner with plenty of long range moves and blockbusters. It is recommended to equip Number Cruncher with plenty of moves and blockbusters that can reach high COMBO HITS easily such as CATASTROPHE CANNON ALPHA and CATASTROPHE CANNON OMEGA. For close range fights, a combo route that utilizes CIRCUIT BREAKER, ASSAULT BATTERY and MAGNETIC TRAP could also reach a high amount of COMBO HITS.
Marquee Ability: PING CHECK is the recommended Marquee Ability for Number Cruncher to increase her damage potential.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Number Cruncher is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Meter Gain will allow her to use blockbusters more often, while Accuracy will increase the chances of her gaining BLESSING, while also ensuring that her GUARD BREAK is not resisted.

Number One.name: Number One
Number One.sa1: Gain DEADEYE and HASTE for 10/12/15 seconds each when activating HYPE MODE.
Number One.sa2: 15/20/25% chance on HIT to gain ENRAGE for 15 seconds while benefiting from HASTE.

role_strategy: Number One is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants HASTE and DEADEYE when HYPE MODE is activated, allowing him to gain meter easily to charge blockbuster faster. While benefitting from HASTE, he is also able to get ENRAGES, which combined with DEADEYE greatly boost his damage output, despite low base attack stat.
While Number One is benefiting from DEADEYE, he can ignore UNFLINCHING, THORNS, EVASION, AUTOBLOCK, AND DEFENSE, allowing him to further increase his damage output and ignore the buffs mentioned.

Although Number One can gain HASTE via his first Signature Ability, it may be beneficial to equip AROO READY? That grants HASTE while also adding a stack of HYPE to provide Number One faster stacks of ENRAGE. HYPE MODE only lasts for 10 seconds, Equipping moves such as LUPINE PUMMEL and GEATISH TREPAK can help Number quickly gain his ENRAGES. The special move AROO READY? and WULF SHOOT is also recommended to give a level of HYPE, allowing you to reach HYPE MODE faster and activate it more often. Support fighters that can grant HASTE or decrease special move cooldown, like Rhythm Rider, Martial Outlaw or Harlequin can also be useful to pair with Number One.
Support fighters that can grant HASTE or decrease special move cooldown, like Rhythm Rider, Martial Outlaw or Harlequin can also be useful to pair with Number One.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability and will help keep Number One on the upper hand as he deals damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Number One is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown

Special Investment: As he naturally gains HASTE, try to avoid investing in Meter Gain, as Meter Gain caps at 100%. Crit Rate and Crit Damage are optional stats which players can invest in to further enhance his offensive potential.

Nunsense.name: Nunsense
Nunsense.sa1: When at an ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGE, gain 1/2/3 random BUFFS for 10 seconds any time the opponent gains a BUFF.
Nunsense.sa2: When at an ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGE, inflict 1/2/3 random DEBUFFS for 10 seconds after suffering any DEBUFF.

role_strategy: Nunsense is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that gives herself BUFFS when the opponent gains a BUFF and inflict DEBUFFS when she suffers from any DEBUFF. This combination of abilities allows her to stay one-step ahead of the opponent to compensate for her low base stats.

When playing Nunsense, keeping elemental advantage is critical. Due to the RNG nature of transmuting, this can be hard to do consistently and even if you can, Nunsense's Signature Ability still relies on your opponent gaining BUFFS or inflicting DEBUFFS to be of any use.

For mid-late game players, Nunsense is a moderately effective budget option for most elemental prize fights, where opponents will gain BUFFS while in a specific element. Nunsense is capable of benefiting off of these for little cost compared to Doublicious.
Marquee Ability: CHAOS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Nunsense as she has no other offensive abilities and will completely rely on inflicting DEBUFFS to wear down the opponent.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Nunsense is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Due to her very fragile nature, players can build HP or Block Proficiency on her to increase her survivability.
rift_battles: Nunsense is a great fighter to use against defenders with the Frost Armor catalyst, as she can deal DEBUFFS (via CHAOS) while gaining various BUFFS when the opponent gains ARMOR from the catalyst. Most available BUFFS are defensive such as REGEN, INVINCIBILITY, IMMUNITY and FINAL STAND which together forms a safety net for Nunsense that will allow her to defeat enemies without losing too much health points.

Nyanotech.name: Nyanotech
Nyanotech.sa1: Gain UNFLINCHING and BARRIER for 8/10/12 seconds each when launching a HEADRONE
Nyanotech.sa2: While benefiting from BARRIER and about to suffer a DEBUFF, 50/75/100% chance to prevent it and gain ENRAGE for 12 seconds.

role_strategy: Nyanotech is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that gives her BARRIER every time she spawns a HEADRONE, which also allows her to convert any incoming DEBUFFs into ENRAGE instead for the duration. This makes her an excellent choice in fights with modifiers or catalysts that can inflict tons of DEBUFFS, since she is practically immune to them and gains an increase in damage output every time it's attempted, as long as she spawns her HEADRONES regularly. UNFLINCHING provides extra safety when spawning a HEADRONE while allowing you to take advantaged fights during its generous duration. With consistent use of HEADRONES, Nyanotech is a good option against variants with recoil damage, as the BARRIER will take the damage instead of her actual health bar.
With consistent use of HEADRONES, Nyanotech is a good option against variants with recoil damage, as the BARRIER will take the damage instead of her actual health bar.

Players who are proficient in using Robo-Fortune will gain BARRIER naturally through the use of HEADRONES, which are often important for combo extension. Furthermore, her TAUNT (REALLY TALKS!) and MAGNETIC TRAP both grant BARRIER on use and can be an alternative option instead. Nyanotech's affinity to BARRIER makes her a natural partner to Rock Star, who can grant BARRIERS to teammates upon TAG IN, Starlight Rose, who can grant BARRIER upon well-timed BLOCKS, and Stone Sentinel, who gives BARRIER every 10 seconds.

Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Nyanotech is PING CHECK to further increase her offensive output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Nyanotech is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase her overall damage. Meter Gain will allow her to use her BLOCKBUSTERS more often.

Octoplasm.name: Octoplasm
Octoplasm.sa1: When TAGGING to or from Marie, the incoming Fighter gains 2 stacks of REGEN for 15 seconds and 10/12/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Octoplasm.sa2: While Marie is alive, WATER teammates’ hits have a 15/20/25% chance to inflict BLEED, SLIME, or QUIETUS for 15 seconds each while benefiting from REGEN.

role_strategy: Octoplasm is a support fighter with the ability to provide teammates with the water element, (including herself), with immense extra DPS and utility tools. While the condition of REGEN (including HEAVY REGEN) is somewhat limiting, her first ability fills in that need. The combination of SLIME and BLEED can become absolutely devastating to variants that can't convert them or that can convert bleed to regen (Valentines with the ICU marquee, COAGULATION modifier), especially when paired with buff removal.

Inflicting QUIETUS also allows teammates to shut down opponents' resistance stat. As she works with her own accuracy, this is a first for which quietus can be used on variants for its resistance removal effect without needing to build accuracy regardless to inflict it in the first place.

Water element variants of characters with a lot of hits will allow Octoplasm's second ability to trigger very frequently (Big Band, Umbrella, Fukua, Robo-Fortune and Squigly), with Squigly's BB3 (which inflicts 120 hits) essentially guarantees all debuff stacks to be applied at once.

Octoplasm is best used as a support for a main Water element carry, especially one that can gain REGEN on its own. This could be from an ability like Rage Appropriate, or from the kit itself, like Eliza's taunt on In Denile and Lapis Luxury. While switching her in to give herself and teammates the benefits of her first ability is an easy thing to do, having a front-runner that doesn't require any outside preparations to start steam rolling all opponents that can't resist debuffs is very convenient. Paired with Angel Maker, they form an especially deadly duo as both benefit immensely from the other's support, with both activated on tagging IN and OUT.
Paired with Angel Maker, they form an especially deadly duo as both benefit immensely from the other's support, with both activated on tagging IN and OUT.
The first ability to grant REGEN and meter can be seen as an upgraded version of Icy Hot's full ability, but is limited to her needing to tag IN/OUT and only applying to water element teammates.

Marquee Ability: Since Octoplasm would be on the bench, or swapping out regularly for the majority of the fight, either Marquee Ability can work with Octoplasm. IMPROVED INCINERATION will provide her some additional offensive output and meter, but the ENRAGE will be lost when tagging out again. Meanwhile, REINFORCED REVIVAL can be a useful option to provide some survivability on dead teammates and teammates that gain blessing/have a revival ability.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive support Marie, Octoplasm is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy and Tag Cooldown are optional stats to build on her that will allow her to be more consistent on and off the field.

Ogre Achiever.name: Ogre Achiever
Ogre Achiever.sa1: When the opponent attempts to gain a BUFF, Beowulf has a 25/35/50% chance to prevent it and gain IMMUNITY for 10/12/15 seconds.
Ogre Achiever.sa2: While in HYPE MODE, BLOCKBUSTERS have a 50/75/100% chance to grant permanent ENRAGE and heal for 10% HEALTH.

role_strategy: Ogre Achiever is an offensive fighter with the ability to deny an opponent's BUFFS to gain IMMUNITY for himself, preventing DEBUFFS. Furthermore, each use of blockbusters during HYPE MODE grants permanent ENRAGE and health, providing increased damage output and sustain for the fight. Altogether, this combination of abilities allow Ogre Achiever to be a solid offensive variant against BUFF heavy defenders that won't be easy to punish. BUFF removal also affects permanent BUFFS, as Ogre Achiever removes those BUFFS at the moment they are gained.
BUFF removal also affects permanent BUFFS, as Ogre Achiever removes those BUFFS at the moment they are gained.

Aside from Weekend Warrior, Ogre Achiever is the only other Beowulf variant with access to IMMUNITY, making him immune to DEBUFFS that can disrupt the player's strategy such as CURSE, HEX or DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS. Furthermore, the ability to prevent permanent BUFFS allows Ogre Achiever to be a counter to variants like Model Leader and Megalomaniac.

Beowulf has access to HASTE from moves such as AROO READY? to quickly charge blockbusters for every hit, allowing Ogre Achiever to spam blockbusters quickly and gain stacks of permanent ENRAGE. With access to a lot of command grabs like LUPINE PUMMEL and WULF SHOOT, it will be easy for Ogre Achiever to be aggressive and take advantage of the increased damage to defeat opponents without risk of getting knocked down.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability and will help keep Ogre Achiever on the upper hand as he deals damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Ogre Achiever is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Accuracy is the most important stat to build on Ogre Achiever, as this gives him a 75% chance to deny opponents buffs at 50% Accuracy. Meter Gain is also a recommended stat to build on him, but it can be ignored if used with a taunt.

Oh Mai.name: Oh Mai
Oh Mai.sa1: Gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 15/17/20 seconds and 5 stacks of PRECISION after defeating an opponent.
Oh Mai.sa2: When any fighter is defeated, all teammates gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 7/10/15 seconds.

role_strategy: Oh Mai is an offensive support fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around gaining ENRAGE for her and her teammates. The condition to activate her abilities requires the defeat of a fighter, allowing her to snowball teams or provide secondary fighters bonus damage to defeat opponents.

To maximize Oh Mai's first Signature Ability, it is recommended to equip COUNTER VENOMS that are each one-hit blockbusters to make use of all the stacks of PRECISION. This allows her to deal serious damage while bypassing any Signature Abilities due to PRECISION.

Oh Mai's secondary Signature Ability is where her support role lies, but it requires the defeat of your teammates. One way to make use of this ability is by bringing a weak fighter as the first fighter and let it get defeated to give stacks of ENRAGE to the next incoming fighter.

Marquee Ability: As Oh Mai will be in the fight, ICU is the recommended Marquee Ability, which provides her easy access to health regeneration while being IMMUNE to BLEED. TRAUMA CENTER will also allow her to work as a support variant.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Oh Mai is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

One Up.name: One Up
One Up.sa1: For every 8 COMBO HITS landed, gain DEADEYE for 5/7/10 seconds and BARRIER.
One Up.sa2: When reaching 8, 16, 32 and 64 COMBO HITS, reduce opponent's CURRENT HEALTH and BLOCKBUSTER METER by .5/.75/1% for each current COMBO HIT.

role_strategy: One Up is an offensive Big Band focusing on long combo strings for a mix of BUFFs and bursts of damage, uniquely dealing damage based on the opponent’s Current Health

One Up’s first Signature Ability is utility focused, providing DEADEYE and BARRIER to Big Band for every 8 combo HITS. This helps him deal with defensive enemy BUFFs, reflect damage, and sustain against BLEED or an opponent’s MIASMA To take further use of the BARRIER he gains, pair One Up with a Starlight Rose for added REGEN and ENRAGE buffs, while also having access to DEBUFF cleanse if he were to suffer CURSE. Maid of Honor also works similarly with cleanse and healing, but lacks any damage boosts for One Up

To take further use of the BARRIER he gains, pair One Up with a Starlight Rose for added REGEN and ENRAGE buffs, while also having access to DEBUFF cleanse if he were to suffer CURSE. Maid of Honor also works similarly with cleanse and healing, but lacks any damage boosts for One Up

The second Signature Ability builds on even longer combos, with certain combo counts doing bursts of damage based on the opponent’s CURRENT Health and also gaining BLOCKBUSTER Meter. This ability rewards long combo strings done by One Up, being able to do large amounts of sudden damage that the opponent would struggle to heal. Be aware, BLOCKBUSTER Meter is not gained on BLOCKBUSTER hits.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, One Up will benefit from SOLOIST as his Marquee Ability. This compliments Big Band's Prestige Ability that provides UNBLOCKABLE dash attacks while also supplementing HEAVY REGEN. Due to the nature of his Ability, One Up can also be built Critless.
Due to the nature of his Ability, One Up can also be built Critless.

Overclocked.name: Overclocked
Overclocked.sa1: Gain PRECISION and BARRIER after every 5/4/3 seconds not suffering a hit (includes blocked hits).
Overclocked.sa2: All attacks are UNBLOCKABLE while at 5/4/3 or more stacks of PRECISION, and 50% of incoming damage is reflected while at 5/4/3 or more stacks of BARRIER.

role_strategy: Overclocked is a fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around stacks of PRECISION and BARRIER to gain abilities for both offensive and defensive abilities. Stacks of PRECISION allows Overclocked's attack to be unblockable while stacks of BARRIER allows her to reflect incoming damage. This makes Overclocked a very versatile fighter that is excellent in both offense and defense.

To gain PRECISION and BARRIER, Overclocked must not suffer a hit for a few seconds. It is best to keep the distance between the opponent to allow those BUFFS to be gained, and then intercepting them when they come near. Once at three stacks of PRECISION, Overclocked can go first on the offense by a dash attack which will be unblockable to start combos before retreating back to position to regain those BUFFS. BARRIER is an excellent safety net to allow Overclocked increased survivability while also reflecting damage. Furthermore, the BARRIER is also timeless, which means that it will stay for the whole duration of the fight, assuming the opponent has no access to any BUFF removals.
