Defensively, Overclocked can be a threat through her unblockable attacks and damage reflect. Hence, players will have to continually pressure her by attacking (even if she's blocking) to avoid her from gaining PRECISION and BARRIER.

Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Overclocked depends on how she is going to be used. As an offensive fighter, PING CHECK may be useful to increase her damage output. DDOS meanwhile provides the ability to punish opponents when they use blockbusters via POWER SURGE, which is good for defensive use.
stat_investment: General Investment: If used offense, Overclocked is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown. If built defensively, she is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Resistance and Defense.
Special investment: On offense Crit Damage will increase her damage by taking use of her PRECISION.

Palace Plunderer.name: Palace Plunderer
Palace Plunderer.sa1: Gain EVASION for 7 seconds and grant all teammates 1/2/3% HEALTH every 5 seconds while not suffering a HIT (includes blocked hits).
Palace Plunderer.sa2: Every 15/12/10 COMBO HITS while benefiting from a BUFF, transfer 1 opponent BUFF to self and grant teammates ENRAGE for 30 seconds.

role_strategy: Palace Plunderer is an offensive support fighter with abilities that focuses on avoiding damage to support her team and stealing buffs from the opponents.

Palace Plunderer works best as the first main fighter to grant teammates long duration ENRAGE stacks. With EVASION and Umbrella's access to grab-based moves and long combo chains, Palace Plunderer will have no difficulty in activating her first Signature Ability. Furthermore, she has the ability to steal BUFFS from the opponent, allowing her to apply pressure without having to worry about defensive BUFFS like ARMOR, AUTO-BLOCK and FINAL STAND.
Marquee Ability: BITTER END is the recommended Marquee Ability for Palace Plunderer, as it allows her to survive longer in the match by having a FINAL STAND and HEAVY REGEN safety net.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Palace Plunderer is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Parasite Weave.name: Parasite Weave
Parasite Weave.sa1: 35% chance on CRITICAL HIT to gain MIASMA for 4/5/6 seconds. Also, while the opponent is not suffering from INVERSE POLARITY, inflict STUN for 3/3.5/4 seconds.
Parasite Weave.sa2: While the opponent is STUNNED, 25/30/35% chance on CRITICAL HIT to convert their STUN into INVERSE POLARITY for 8 seconds.

role_strategy: Parasite Weave is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to inflict STUN and INVERSE POLARITY on top of an on-crit MIASMA. This combination of DEBUFFS allows her to consistently damage the opponent while gaining more and more miasma to control the opponents BLOCKBUSTER METER.

To make use of Parasite Weave's ability, you can choose between making your CRIT RATE high and getting consistent STUN or keeping it low and getting STUN more often later in the combo, allowing you to extend combos to last longer. With the frequency in which these are going to apply the debuffs on the opponent, the Autoimmune catalyst in Rift Battles and Magicurl won’t be quite as effective against this Fighter.
The STUN only works for 4 seconds, so make sure Parasite Weaves CRIT RATE and ACCURACY is high enough to land MIASMA procs as reliably as possible.
Marquee Ability: THE FIRST CUT can be used as additional damage required you have BLEED in Parasite Weaves loadout, otherwise LEECH provides easy HP regen not totally covered by MIASMA.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Parasite Weave is best built with ATK%, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate is the most important stat for Parasite Weave. Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS won't be resisted by enemies.

Patched Up.name: Patched Up
Patched Up.sa1: 8/12/15% chance when either Fighter is HIT (includes blocked hits) to transfer 1 opponent BUFF to Ms. Fortune.
Patched Up.sa2: While benefiting from at least 3 stacks of any BUFFs, HITS (including blocked hits) inflict WITHER and CURSE for 4/7/10 seconds each.

role_strategy: Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Patched Up is BOOP to gain stacks of ENRAGE and further increase her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: Patched Up works as a mixed variant to play either offensively or defensively. As such, you can consider to build Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown for offence, or build her defensively with Health, Defence and Resistance
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her taking enemy BUFFS and reduce the chances that her DEBUFFS are resisted.

Pea Shooter.name: Pea Shooter
Pea Shooter.sa1: Projectiles deal 15/25/35% bonus damage for all teammates.
Pea Shooter.sa2: All projectiles have a 10/15% chance to inflict ARMOR BREAK for 3/6 seconds.

role_strategy: Pea Shooter is an offensive fighter that boasts consistently high damage among Peacocks, while also functioning as a great support for fighters that rely on projectiles. Her chance to inflict ARMOR BREAK on hit further boosts her offensive abilities, while making her a natural counter to defenders that rely on ARMOR such as Blue Screen, Armed Forces and Heavy Metal.

When used as a support, Pea Shooter can be paired with other fighters that use projectiles to deal greater damage, such as Parasoul with SILENT SCOPE or Cerebella with DIAMONDS ARE FOREVER. Two Pea Shooters can be paired together as the boost from her Signature Ability stacks, allowing her massive damage output.

Her second Signature Ability gives the entire team a chance to inflict ARMOR BREAK with their projectiles, not just herself. Because of this, she doesn't need to be on the field in order to fight defenders who can gain ARMOR. For example, Annie as a character can use Star Power in order to give her normal attacks the property to shoot stars as projectiles, making it very easy to trigger the ARMOR BREAK.

Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Pea Shooter as it provides the chance to reset the cooldown for her special moves which are mostly projectiles and reuse them almost immediately.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Pea Shooter is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her teammates inflicting ARMOR BREAK.

Persona Assistant.name: Persona Assistant
Persona Assistant.sa1: Every 20 seconds while Robo-Fortune is alive, she gains 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION and 3/4/5 stacks of ENRAGE for 5 seconds. Her teammates also gain 1 stack of BLESSING and BARRIER.
Persona Assistant.sa2: 50/75/100% chance for DASH ATTACKS to be UNBLOCKABLE while benefiting from ENRAGE.

role_strategy: Persona Assistant is an offensive support fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her stacks of PRECISION and ENRAGE, which allows her dash attack to be UNBLOCKABLE. Furthermore, Persona Assistant also supports her teammates by providing a stack of BLESSING and BARRIER to increase their survivability in fights. This allows Persona Assistant to support her teammates in the bench while also serving as a dependable offensive fighter in her own right.

When used offensively, Persona Assistant is best placed as a secondary fighter that can provide support to the main fighter, as she needs twenty seconds before her Signature Ability activates. Persona Assistant grants timeless BLESSING and BARRIER which acts as a safety net when a mistake is made. Hence, Persona Assistant is generally a great support fighter for all fighters, regardless of their Signature Abilities.

Persona Assistant gains UNBLOCKABLE dash attacks while any ENRAGE is active. While the ENRAGE present in her own Signature Ability is very short in uptime, this does still gives her the ability to hit through blocks, and there are support Fighters who can give her the ENRAGE she wants, like Starlight Rose, who coincidentally synergizes well with her due to Persona's own BARRIER support. Evergreen Evil can extend her ENRAGE buffs for up to 5 seconds longer, as well as any other buffs the team may get.
Evergreen Evil can extend her ENRAGE buffs for up to 5 seconds longer, as well as any other buffs the team may get.

Persona Assistant can be used defensively, but will mostly depend on her first Signature Ability to provide stacks of BLESSING and BARRIER to teammates, which helps in stalling for time. However, the time given is not a large amount by any means, and as such she's more often used on offense. Persona Assistant's second Signature Ability can be potentially dangerous on defense, as her unblockable dash attacks could result in a sudden combo that could catch you off guard and lose a fighter. However, this reliance on ENRAGE is not sustainable for defense, and should not entirely be relied on for her defensive value, where she's still better focused on sustaining and stalling for her team members.

Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Persona Assistant depends on how she is going to be used. On offense, PING CHECK gives her another way to gain ENRAGE for her second Signature Ability. It also makes her potentially more dangerous on defense for the same reason. DDOS meanwhile provides the ability to punish opponents when they use blockbusters via POWER SURGE, making them riskier to use for the player team.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Persona Assistant is best built with Attack, Meter Gain, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Damage will drastically improve her damage output while PRECISION is active, though because of the infrequency of her first Signature Ability, it may be ignored depending on player preference.

Phantom Threads.name: Phantom Threads
Phantom Threads.sa1: When the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN, Fukua gains BLESSING for 10/15/20 seconds and removes 1 opponents BUFF.
Phantom Threads.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, remove all BLESSINGS and gain ENRAGE for 10 seconds and heal for 5/7/10% HEALTH per BLESSING removed.

role_strategy: Phantom Threads is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her a stack of BLESSING while also removing a BUFF from the opponent when they are knocked down. Furthermore, a single use of a blockbuster will immediately remove all BLESSINGS to gain ENRAGE and regain some health per stacks of BLESSINGS removed. This combination of abilities makes Phantom Threads a very strong offensive fighter with access to BUFF removal, health regeneration, revival and increased damage output. The ability to remove BUFFS makes Phantom Threads a very strong counter to BUFF-heavy fighters like Heavy Metal, Meow & Furever, and Corrosive Agent.
The ability to remove BUFFS makes Phantom Threads a very strong counter to BUFF-heavy fighters like Heavy Metal, Meow & Furever, and Corrosive Agent.

Phantom Threads is a very straightforward fighter, as knocking down the opponent is easy to do with a simple combo. Hence, players will find themselves stacking multiple stacks of BLESSINGS with ease throughout the duration of the fight, which can be converted into stacks of ENRAGE for high damage output.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activates when a certain percentage of health is lost, which is unfavorable when used offensively. Players who are proficient at Fukua will have ways to minimize damage as much as possible and avoid getting hit. Given the ease to get stacks of BLESSINGS for revival, SPECTRAL SPITE is recommended for Phantom Threads to increase her damage output at low health. Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, Phantom Threads can be built as a Critless Variant.
Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, Phantom Threads can be built as a Critless Variant.

Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like LOBS OF LOVE or TWICE SHY.

Phantom Wrangler.name: Phantom Wrangler
Phantom Wrangler.sa1: HITS from SKELETAL SUMMONS deal 30% BONUS DAMAGE and have a 50% chance to inflict SLIME for 10/12/15 seconds.
Phantom Wrangler.sa2: Drain 2/3/4% BLOCKBUSTER METER per stack of SLIME on the opponent when they BOUNCE off a wall.

Once the opponent is inflicted with SLIME, every wall-bounce will DRAIN BLOCKBUSTER METER, allowing excellent meter control given you have the right moves equipped. HILGARD HAYMAKER, HOOVER MANUEVER, SCRUB N SMASH, and OUTTAKE can bounce opponents off walls.
HILGARD HAYMAKER, HOOVER MANUEVER, SCRUB N SMASH, and OUTTAKE can bounce opponents off walls.
For a fun combo, she can be paired with fighters like Parasite Weave and Freaky Friday to take use of their Crit Rate and BLEED to counter Dahlia variants with the NO TIME TO DIE Marquee Ability.
She can also be paired with Beast King to easily get a lot of debuffs and increase his damage.

Phantom Wrangler is a consistent dealer of QUIETUS, since both HILGARD'S HAYMAKER and HILGARD'S HOWL are moves that can reliably inflict the DEBUFF while also being SKELETAL SUMMONS that would benefit from Phantom Wrangler's first Signature Ability. When the opponent is inflicted with QUIETUS, more SLIME stacks can be inflicted reliably since RESISTANCE will now be ignored. With consistent application of QUIETUS, CARPAL PUMMEL is a recommended blockbuster to equip since it is also a SKELETAL SUMMON that benefits from the extra damage boost, while having the chance to be unblockable and inflict STUN.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Phantom Wrangler is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Pickle Baller.name: Pickle Baller

Pickle Baller.sa2: When any teammate EVADES an attack, grant REGEN for 6/8/10 seconds and 2 stacks of PRECISION.

Plot Twisted.name: Plot Twisted
Plot Twisted.sa1: Reflect 10% of all damage taken per DEBUFF on Squigly (max: 40%). Also, once per match, RESURRECT with 25/35/50% HEALTH and 4 random DEBUFFS for 15 seconds each.
Plot Twisted.sa2: Suffer a random DEBUFF for 4/6/8 seconds every 4 seconds. Squigly’s NON-BLOCKBUSTER HITS deal 1% MAX HEALTH as damage to the opponent per DEBUFF on either Fighter (max 3%).

role_strategy: Plot Twisted is a defensive fighter with reflect damage, activated by DEBUFFing herself. She remains as a staple self-reviving defender as well, risking herself with more DEBUFFS to reflect more damage, but can also use these DEBUFFs to fight back and deal high damage with every existing DEBUFF around.

Since her reflect damage is linked to DEBUFFs, you cannot use DEADEYE to negate her reflect damage, and rely on traditional sustain options to deal with her. Life steal, Barrier and Regen will be necessary to help mitigate reflect damage from Plot Twisted. Precision and Hex will also be typical modifiers that will disable her Signature Ability as well

Poltergust.name: Poltergust
Poltergust.sa1: Using a BLOCKBUSTER inflicts SLIME on the opponent for 10 seconds. BLOCKBUSTERS deal 50/75/100% bonus damage to opponents suffering SLIME.
Poltergust.sa2: When a BUFF on either Fighter expires or is removed, gain 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Poltergust is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that enables her to dish out massive amounts of damage using BLOCKBUSTERS when the opponent has SLIME. She capitalizes on the expiration of any BUFFS on the field to charge her blockbusters, making it easier for her to repeatedly use them against BUFF-heavy scenarios. Poltergust can be paired with support fighters that grant BUFFS such as Surgeon General, Sketchy and Lucky Lure to exploit her second Signature Ability for faster meter gain, especially as she herself does not have much in terms of BUFFS. Poltergust is very effective against opponents that rely on timed defensive BUFFS such as Untouchable, Armed Forces, Resonant Evil, and Heavy Metal. It is important to note that removing BUFFS does not trigger Poltergust's abilities. This also applies with DEBUFFS that removes BUFFS, like with how ARMOR BREAK removes ARMOR.

Allowing Poltergust to spend blockbuster meter to make blockbuster meter while dealing slime damage.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Poltergust is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Meter Gain is a stat that can either be beneficial or absolutely redundant depending on one thing; If the fight features a decent amount of BUFFS with timers. If that isn't the case, then Meter Gain is a good stat to use, as Poltergust is a variant who relies on her Blockbusters for damage, but if that IS the case, then she will have frequent access to her Blockbusters regardless and be better off using a different stat. As a result, it is recommended to have two sets of moves; One of them with Meter Gain included, and one where it isn't, switching between the two depending on player/enemy team compositions and Modifiers.
rift_battles: Poltergust is especially effective against nodes with the Frost Armor or Armor Rating catalyst, as she can easily charge up her blockbuster once the ARMOR stacks disappear. Furthermore, moves such as DRAG 'N' DROP can be used to deal massive damage while also removing any ARMOR via ARMOR BREAK.

Primal Prodigy.name: Primal Prodigy
Primal Prodigy.sa1: Gain 1 random BUFF for 10 seconds and 5% BLOCKBUSTER METER every 6/5/4 seconds while not suffering a HIT (includes blocked hits).
Primal Prodigy.sa2: When a BUFF on Peacock expires, inflict CURSE and DISABLE opponent SPECIAL MOVES for 6/7/8 seconds each.

role_strategy: Primal Prodigy is an offensive fighter that relies on the expiration of BUFFS to inflict CURSE and DISABLE SPECIALS onto the opponent. This unique trigger means that with the right timing, Primal Prodigy could potentially inflict these two DEBUFFS, locking down BUFFS and special moves, for the whole duration of the fight. This combination of abilities makes Primal Prodigy a great pick against BUFF heavy defenders.

The key with Primal Prodigy is to prevent getting hit altogether, including blocked hits. This can be achieved by playing smartly through precise timing of intercepts, using Peacock's Character Ability, THE HOLE IDEA, to dodge attacks or continually spamming Peacock's special moves and locking down the opponent from a distance. Note that the opponent may punish you by using a ranged blockbuster when being hit by special moves. To continually inflict CURSE and DISABLE SPECIALS for the whole duration of the fight, Primal Prodigy will have to dodge attacks for 12 seconds (third BUFF). Afterward, the DEBUFFS will refresh after every two BUFFS expired from her first Signature Ability.

Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Primal Prodigy, as it provides the chance to reset the cooldown for her special moves, which are mostly projectiles, and reuse them almost immediately.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Primal Prodigy is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Primed.name: Primed
Primed.sa1: Gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds when spawning a TEAR.
Primed.sa2: Detonated TEARS inflict BLEED for 3/4/5 seconds on HIT.

role_strategy: Primed is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her ENRAGE for every TEAR that is spawned. Furthermore, detonating these TEARS will inflict BLEED, making her an excellent offensive fighter that can deal significant amount of damage.

The main takeaway from Primed's abilities is the stacks of ENRAGE which, on top of her high ATK stat, can dish out a massive amount of damage. Hence, do not worry too much about detonating the TEARS for the BLEED unless it is part of your combo. To spawn TEARS, a simple air juggle followed by a down swipe can spawn two TEARS and grant two stacks of ENRAGE easily. Furthermore, equip moves such as NAPALM SHOWER and NAPALM SHOT to easily gain stacks of ENRAGE.

Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Primed, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Primed is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS.

Princess Pride.name: Princess Pride
Princess Pride.sa1: Gain REGEN for 4/5/6 seconds and BARRIER when spawning a TEAR.
Princess Pride.sa2: On TEAR DETONATION, consume all stacks of BARRIER and immediately recover 2/4/6% HEALTH per active TEAR. The detonated TEARS also deal 20% bonus damage per stack consumed.

role_strategy: Princess Pride is an offensive sustain fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her REGEN and BARRIER for every TEAR spawned. Furthermore, detonating these TEARS will immediately recover HEALTH, making her hard to bring down through chip damage, while doing bonus damage in trade for losing her TEARS and BARRIER.

While Princess Pride's abilities mostly increase her longevity and thus may seem like they should be used on defense, the AI is very unlikely to actually spawn TEARS, and even more unlikely to detonate them. As such she sees better use as an offensive Fighter with a knack for healing herself.

Princess Pride's base ATK stat is lower than average, but due to Parasoul's strong base kit and Marquee Abilities, she's still perfectly capable of putting a dent into enemies. Still, she does appreciate offensive BUFFS from her teammates if they have any.

It is not recommended to use TEAR-spawning moves that do no damage (NAPALM TOSS and NAPALM SHOWER) specifically to trigger her Signature Abilities, as Parasoul spawns enough TEARS during normal gameplay by default. Using these moves also makes her less effective as a damage dealer due to the moves taking slots that would otherwise go towards damaging moves.

Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Princess Pride, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%. Princess Pride also lacks ways to increase her own damage output otherwise, and as such she'll take whatever she can get. Due to the nature of Princess Pride's Signature Ability and the utility Parasoul's kit provides, it is suggested that players build a Critless copy of her if they can.

Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS.
rift_battles: Princess Pride can be an effective defender to stall for time with the Final Fight or Last Word catalyst. The FINAL STANDS from these catalysts can make her annoying to deal with. However, the AI still can't use her Signature Ability effectively, and she has no defensive capabilities otherwise, so there's a lot of better options for these catalysts.

Princess Pride can be a useful offensive fighter to use to acquire the maximum amount of points in health for the Rift score, as she has easy access to REGEN. However, Princess Pride has a below average ATK stat and while her Marquee Ability may help boost her damage, it may not be enough against defenders in triple nodes that have access to an increase HP bonus.

Prism Plumage.name: Prism Plumage
Prism Plumage.sa1: While Peacock is alive, all teammates TAG IN with 2 BUFFS based on their ELEMENTS for 5/7/10 seconds (except after teammate death).
Prism Plumage.sa2: While Peacock is alive, all projectiles have a 10% chance to inflict DEBUFFS based on the opponent's ELEMENT for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Prism Plumage is an offensive support fighter that can grant teammate BUFFS upon TAG IN or inflict DEBUFFS to opponents with a projectile. However, both of the BUFFS and DEBUFFS are based on the element of your teammates and opponent. This makes her difficult to plan out effectively, but simple to use in a fight.

Prism Plumage's Signature Ability allows variants to gain BUFFS that synergize with their own Signature Abilities. For example, tagging in Windswept will grant her EVASION, which can be used to activate the latter's Signature Ability to gain permanent PRECISION. Another example is to TAG IN Heavy Handed to gain PRECISION and deal massive damage while ignoring the opponent's Signature Ability with her CHARGE ATTACK.

On the opposite end, Prism Plumage's Signature Ability inflicts DEBUFFS that are commonly found in those respective elements. For example, inflicting CRIPPLE can negate the Signature Abilities of Fire variants such as Risky Ginger, Heavy Handed, and Thrill Shrieker. Similarly, inflicting ARMOR BREAK allows Prism Plumage to inflict damage against defensive water fighters that rely on ARMOR such as Heavy Metal and Blue Screen.

Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Prism Plumage, as it provides the chance to reset the cooldown for her special moves, which are mostly projectiles, and reuse them almost immediately. However, CAST PARTY should not be discounted due to her ability to BUFF her teammates by tagging them in.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Prism Plumage is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her teammates inflicting DEBUFFS.

Private Dick.name: Private Dick
Private Dick.sa1: 5% chance on HIT to STUN opponent for 2/2.5/3 seconds. Also, BLOCKBUSTERS deal 50% BONUS DAMAGE against opponents suffering from STUN.
Private Dick.sa2: When Big Band is about to suffer a DEBUFF, he has a 25/35/50% chance to prevent it and gain ENRAGE for 8 seconds.

role_strategy: Private Dick is an offensive variant with direct access to STUN and increased blockbuster damage against STUNNED opponents. This allows him to continually chain combos against the opponent and deal ample damage. Furthermore, his second Signature Ability provides an additional layer of protection against DEBUFFS, turning them into ENRAGE to further bolster his damage output.

Private Dick has a naturally low ATK stat and would need those ENRAGE stacks from his second Signature Ability to deal respectable damage against strong defenders. Due to this, it is advisable to bring him in fights where there are a lot of DEBUFFS from the modifiers or from the opponent's abilities to turn those into ENRAGES.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Private Dick will benefit from SOLOIST as his Marquee Ability. This compliments with Big Band's Prestige Ability that provides UNBLOCKABLE dash attacks while also supplementing HEAVY REGEN as a form of recovery.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Private Dick is best built with Attack, Piercing and Meter Gain.
Special investment: Accuracy is recommended for Private Dick to activate his SA more reliably and that his DEBUFFS will not be resisted by enemies.

Proton Pulse.name: Proton Pulse
Proton Pulse.sa1: 20% chance on HIT to inflict POWER SURGE for 10/15/20 seconds on both fighters while near the opponent. Non-BLOCKBUSTER HITS grant 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Proton Pulse.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, gain ENRAGE, REGEN, or EVASION for 10/15/20 seconds per stack of POWER SURGE on both fighters and remove all POWER SURGE.

role_strategy: Proton Pulse is an offensive Robo-Fortune who intends to build up stacks of POWER SURGE, before absorbing them all and converting it into ENRAGE and REGEN to maximize her offensive pressure upon using a BLOCKBUSTER which she charges quickly.

Proton is an easy to play Diamond Robo-Fortune as she works both for close or ranged combat, unlike her other offensive Diamond Robo-Fortune's who lean into primarily ranged attacks. In this nature, her playstyle may vary based on how she's used, with close combat Proton being able to stack POWER SURGES and gain BLOCKBUSTER METER more often for more buffs to convert into her buffs, while a ranged Proton can better utilize the buffs she gains for safe and high damage attacks.

Due to using BLOCKBUSTERS while suffering POWER SURGE, she is notably invincible upon using any BLOCKBUSTER to avoid any HEALTH lost, which also works to counter effects like Assassin's Greed HEALTH cut

Marquee Ability: As an offensive fighter, it is recommended to use the PING Marquee so that Proton can continue to build ENRAGE for more consistent damage, however, DDOS is a viable Marquee to use if you intend to inflict POWER SURGE more often to convert them for more damage more often. Due to the nature of her ability, it is also viable to build her Critless to better rely on her BLOCKBUSTER METER gain and REGEN
Due to the nature of her ability, it is also viable to build her Critless to better rely on her BLOCKBUSTER METER gain and REGEN
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Proton is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by enemies while being able to gain more BLOCKBUSTER METER.

Prototype.name: Prototype
Prototype.sa1: BLOCKBUSTER HITS have a 15/20/25% chance to inflict POWER SURGE for 10 seconds.
Prototype.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, gain 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Prototype is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around the constant use of blockbusters, which is enabled by her ability to gain meter every time she uses one. Prototype also inflicts POWER SURGE with her Blockbuster hits, which punishes the opponent's own use of Blockbusters.

A recommended moveset for Prototype involves the use of four blockbusters, two of which are CATASTROPHE CANNON ALPHA and CATASTROPHE CANNON OMEGA. These two blockbusters are ranged blockbusters (the latter of which is her unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster), allowing Prototype to spam blockbusters easily while staying far away from the opponent. Once the player has one out of four blockbusters ready, it's insanely easy to cycle through all of them in a short time, including her Unblockable. This makes her damage output deceptively high despite her relatively low base ATK stat.

POWER SURGE is not an especially powerful DEBUFF on offense, as it heavily relies on the opponent using Blockbusters. This is especially true for Robo Fortune, as CATASTROPHE CANNON ALPHA tends to inflict a lot of WITHER stacks, all but guaranteeing that the opponent has no meter after its use. However, Prototype can be paired up with Wunderkind, who lets the POWER SURGE stacks passively drain the enemy's HP.

Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Prototype is PING CHECK, as it gives her more damage through ENRAGE stacks if she can put a distance between herself and the opponent for a short time, which she can easily achieve with her ranged Blockbusters and Head drones.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Prototype is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase her overall damage. Meter Gain can be ignored due to Prototype's inherent ability to gain Blockbuster meter from her Signature Ability.

Psycommander.name: Psycommander
Psycommander.sa1: When FIRING your last remaining SHOT, gain FINAL STAND and 3/4/5 stacks of ENRAGE for 10 seconds each.
Psycommander.sa2: Gain DEADEYE and 1/2/3 stack(s) of EVASION for 10 seconds each when using a SPECIAL MOVE while benefiting from ENRAGE.

role_strategy: Psycommander is an offensive fighter with the ability to gain multiple stacks of ENRAGE, boosting her offensive abilities. While benefiting from ENRAGE, Psycommander gains DEADEYE and stacks of EVASION when using a SPECIAL MOVE, making her a deadly offensive variant that can defeat tough defenders easily.

Fire all your SHOTS to quickly gain FINAL STAND and ENRAGE. Players will have to be efficient in incorporating standard SHOTS in Black Dahlia's normal combos and repeat these combos to empty her SHOTS. An example would be as follows: Ground combo > Launcher > SHOT > Dash Attack > SHOT > Two Taps > SHOT Ground combo > SHOT > EMPOWER > SHOT > DOOR MAT > DEATH PENDULUM > SHOT
Ground combo > Launcher > SHOT > Dash Attack > SHOT > Two Taps > SHOT
Ground combo > SHOT > EMPOWER > SHOT > DOOR MAT > DEATH PENDULUM > SHOT

Once SHOTS are all fired, using a SPECIAL MOVE such as TEA SLIP or ONSLAUGHT is recommended to quickly activate her second Signature Ability and gain DEADEYE and EVASION. Psycommander can take advantage of EVASION by staying idle and baiting the opponent into attacking. This allows Psycommander to start combos easily while dealing significant damage through the stacks of ENRAGE.
Psycommander can be paired with fighters like Seraph Soldier, Starlight Rose, Palace Plunderer, Prism Plumage and Rerun which grants ENRAGE to easily activate her second Signature Ability.
With her own evasion, Psycommander pairs well with Pickle Baller, boosting her survivability, utility and meter gain.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Psycommander will benefit from METAL BREAKDOWN as her Marquee Ability to increase her damage output from ARMOR BREAK and the extra damage boost to her SPECIAL SHOTS.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Psycommander is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Psykid.name: Psykid
Psykid.sa1: When HITTING an attacking opponent, gain DEADEYE and inflict INVERSE POLARITY for 10/12/15 seconds each.
Psykid.sa2: 50/75/100% chance to reset the timers of all Umbrella's BUFFS and all opponent DEBUFFS except STUN and DOOM when the opponent BOUNCES off a wall.

role_strategy: Psykid is an offensive fighter with a powerful ability to reset timers of BUFFS and DEBUFFS after a wall-bounce. Furthermore, she can also easily gain DEADEYE, a strong BUFF that ignores DEFENSE and defensive BUFFS like UNFLINCHING, EVASION, THORNS and AUTO-BLOCK while also inflicting INVERSE POLARITY to counter healing defenders. Altogether, this combination of abilities provides Psykid the offensive edge to face against a lot of common defenders in the game.

Umbrella is a multi-hit fighter with very little means to face heavy BUFF defenders. DEADEYE alone brings a lot to the table on a lackluster kit and allows Psykid to turn Umbrella's multi-hit potential into a very powerful asset by ignoring certain defensive BUFFS. But Psykid's biggest strength is in her second ability to refresh BUFFS and DEBUFFS with a wall-bounce. This allows Umbrella's signature DEBUFF, SLIME, to be repeatedly refreshed and stacked to counter BUFF heavy defenders reliably, while also opening up lots of potential from support variants such as Prism Plumage, Surgeon General and Sketchy that can provide other meaningful BUFFS from the bench for additional utility.

To reliably inflict a wall-bounce, it is recommended to adopt a playstyle that takes advantage of Umbrella's OVERSTUFFED state and to push the opponent in the corner as much as possible. The blockbuster TONGUE TWISTER is an excellent move to fill the HUNGER METER towards OVERSTUFFED while providing healing and knocking the opponent to the far end for a wall-bounce. Furthermore, when OVERSTUFFED, Umbrella's DASH ATTACK can knock the opponent far for a wall-bounce as well and Umbrella's grab can be a reliable way for a wall-bounce if the opponent is already in the corner.

Marquee Ability: BITTER END is the recommended Marquee Ability for Psykid, as it allows her to survive longer in the match by having a FINAL STAND and HEAVY REGEN safety net. This also allows her to loop FINAL STAND.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Psykid is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her INVERSE POLARITY is not resisted by enemies.

Puddle Pirate.sa2: While the opponent has no BUFFS, PUDDLE HITS grant ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Puddle Pirate is an offensive fighter that centers around BUFF control, using her PUDDLES. Puddle Pirate also gains ENRAGE when an opponent has no buffs, providing needed damage and making use of IMMOBILIZE to keep the enemy pinned down under her water pressure.

Puddle Pirate will require moves that can provide PUDDLES such as WISH MAKER, BOBBLIN' BUBBLE, ACID REFLUX and UNDER THE WEATHER. To fully take advantage of Puddle Pirate's Signature Ability, it is best to corner the opponent as soon as possible through ACID REFLUX, and then use BOBBLIN' BUBBLE or UNDER THE WEATHER to spawn a PUDDLE. A PUDDLE in the corner is the easiest way to trap the opponent, causing them to lose BUFFS when knocked into puddles.

Furthermore, Purrfect Dark has a very high base ATK stat for a Silver variant and a second Signature Ability that relies on players to utilize her headless mode for a chance to instantly defeat opponents. This combination of abilities makes Purrfect Dark an excellent offensive fighter to use for beginners due to easy access to CURSE, while greatly rewarding those who can master the headless mode of Ms. Fortune. It is important to note that the DEBUFFS that Purrfect Dark inflicts are not permanent but timeless. Hence, these DEBUFFS can still be removed via TAG OUT or through Signature Abilities of fighters such as Silent Kill.

Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Purrfect Dark is BOOP to gain stacks of ENRAGE and further increase her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Purrfect Dark is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase her overall damage by taking use of her DEATH MARK. And Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by the enemy, while also increasing the chances of her second Signature Ability activating.

Purrminator.name: Purrminator
Purrminator.sa1: 10/12/15% chance to gain 1 stack of PRECISION and inflict DEATH MARK for 10 seconds when the opponent BLOCKS a HIT.
Purrminator.sa2: Each CRITICAL HIT permanently increases DAMAGE by 1/2/3%.

role_strategy: Purrminator is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around dealing critical hits to increase her damage output for the rest of the match. With good play and the right stat boosts, she can do a lot more damage as the match goes on, making her a good snowball DPS for the silver rarity.

Since Robo-Fortune is a high hit-count character, Purrminator's damage can increase very quickly with a high Crit Rate. It is especially recommended to equip multi-hit blockbusters such as CATASTROPHE CANNON ALPHA, which deals 30 hits on its own, to increase the chances of landing critical hits.

To maximize damage, it may be beneficial to perform a dash attack with Purrminator while the opponent is blocking and then quickly move back to avoid getting punished. This is to activate Purrminator's first Signature Ability, which has a chance to trigger from Robo-Fortune's multi-hit dash attack. PRECISION guarantees a critical hit, which will further increase Purrminator's damage output from her second Signature Ability.

While Purrminator's potential damage output is very high for her rarity, she pays for it by being relatively slow to start up and rather frail. When considering using her, the player should watch out for high chip damage, reflect damage and enemies so tanky that they may time her out. The second mention is especially the case when fighting Painwheels with their Marquee Abilities unlocked due to Purrminator's reliance on critical hits.
Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Purrminator is PING CHECK to further increase her offensive output, although her long-range moves don't have as many hits as her close-range ones.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Purrminator is best built with Meter Gain, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Rate is the most important stat for Purrminator, while Crit Damage will increase her overall damage. Despite being an offensive Robo-Fortune, Attack isn't a priority due to Purrminator's SA damage increase being applied to the base ATK stat rather than the base ATK + move stat increases.

Pyro-Technique.name: Pyro-Technique
Pyro-Technique.sa1: BLOCKBUSTER and SPECIAL MOVE HITS have a 20% chance to inflict WITHER and BLEED for 5/7/10 seconds.
Pyro-Technique.sa2: 20% chance on HIT to gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds if the opponent is suffering from WITHER or BLEED.

role_strategy: Pyro-Technique is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around inflicting WITHER and BLEED with her moves in order to gain stacks of ENRAGE. This makes her an excellent offensive fighter that can have significant DPS while controlling the opponent's blockbuster meter.

When using Pyro-Technique, it is recommended to equip blockbusters and special moves that are multi-hit or inflict BLEED such as CHECKMATE INCISION, LARYNGOTOMY and DEAD CROSS to increase the chances of landing at least 1 stack of WITHER or BLEED. Players should try to inflict at least one stack of WITHER or BLEED, which can help her easily stack ENRAGE. BLEED is abundant in Valentine's kit, which helps her gain ENRAGE faster. Once the opponent is suffering from BLEED, getting ENRAGE stacks is very easy, since Valentine's normal attacks naturally have a lot of hits.

Players should try to inflict at least one stack of WITHER or BLEED, which can help her easily stack ENRAGE. BLEED is abundant in Valentine's kit, which helps her gain ENRAGE faster. Once the opponent is suffering from BLEED, getting ENRAGE stacks is very easy, since Valentine's normal attacks naturally have a lot of hits.
Marquee Ability: ICU is the recommended Marquee Ability to provide Pyro-Technique easy access to healing while being IMMUNE to BLEED.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Pyro-Technique is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting WITHER, BLEED and gaining ENRAGE.

Rage Appropriate.name: Rage Appropriate
Rage Appropriate.sa1: Gain permanent ENRAGE when suffering a HIT (including blocked hits) that deals more than 10/7/5% MAX HEALTH.
Rage Appropriate.sa2: Every 15/12/10th COMBO HIT grants HEAVY REGEN and 2 stacks of ARMOR for 10 seconds each.

role_strategy: Rage Appropriate is an offensive fighter that turns the damage she receives into an increase in damage output. To increase her survivability, she also gains access to recovery via HEAVY REGEN and ARMOR. Altogether, these abilities provide Rage Appropriate a consistent way to deal damage while keeping her health high against tough defenders.

Unlike other Painwheels, Rage Appropriate ATK stat is average at best. Hence, she will rely on her permanent ENRAGE stacks to start dealing damage against some of the tougher defenders in this game. Due to Painwheel's low health pool, Rage Appropriate can activate her first Signature Ability easily as she is likely to take chip damage that is above the threshold, even when she's blocking. This is still a risky endeavor and it is a good idea to bring support variants for extra survivability such as Surgeon General or Fan Favorite.
Due to Painwheel's low health pool, Rage Appropriate can activate her first Signature Ability easily as she is likely to take chip damage that is above the threshold, even when she's blocking.
This is still a risky endeavor and it is a good idea to bring support variants for extra survivability such as Surgeon General or Fan Favorite.

On defense, Rage Appropriate can get the ENRAGES from her first Signature Ability very easily, making her a genuine threat in the case a mistake is made. However, her low health and her main survival method being tied to doing damage herself makes her easy to kill, and generally unfit for defense.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work with Rage Appropriate. GRUDGE will allow her to survive longer when she is hit by a critical hit through the ARMOR stacks while TAINTED BLOOD will allow her to act similarly to Dread Locks and dealing more damage when she is hit.

Stat Investment: Like any other offensive variant, investment in ATK and Piercing are very important to increase her offensive output in a fight. Any defensive stats are not recommended as they'll make it harder to trigger her permanent ENRAGE.
rift_battles: The Painwheel-specific catalyst, Don't Poke the Buer, along with Frost Armor synergizes well to overcome her low base HP. With multiple stacks of ARMOR from the catalyst and GRUDGE, it can be difficult to counter Rage Appropriate within the time limit without using the appropriate counters. To counter this, use multi-hit fighters that can remove BUFFS such as Silent Kill and Bloodbath with CHAOS BANISH.

Rain Shadow.name: Rain Shadow
Rain Shadow.sa1: 15% chance when landing a HIT (including BLOCKED HITS) to inflict ARMOR BREAK and POWER SURGE for 10/12/15 seconds each.
Rain Shadow.sa2: Every 5 seconds while Fukua is on the opponent’s side of the stage and while not STUNNED, opponents lose all current BUFFS and suffer STUN for 2/3/4 seconds.

role_strategy: Rain Shadow is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to inflict ARMOR BREAK and POWER SURGE when landing a hit (BLOCKED or not). Furthermore, while on the opponent's side of the stage for some time, the opponent will lose all current BUFFS and suffer STUN.
Rain keeps her gameplay very simple, working in a very aggressive playstyle by keeping the enemy on their side of the stage with STUN while removing any annoying defensive BUFFS alongside it.
While POWER SURGE is a weak DEBUFF, the reliable ARMOR BREAK she inflicts can help work as a consistent counter to ARMOR oriented defenders.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activates when a certain percentage of health is lost, which will often happen when used defensively. SPECTRAL SPITE is the recommended Marquee Ability to boost her damage Due to the nature of Fukua's moveset and Rain Shadow's utility of BUFF removal, she can also be built Critless.
Due to the nature of Fukua's moveset and Rain Shadow's utility of BUFF removal, she can also be built Critless.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Rain Shadow is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of Rain Shadow inflicting her debuffs and stops defenders from resisting STUN.

Rainbow Blight.name: Rainbow Blight
Rainbow Blight.sa1: When TRANSMUTING, gain BUFFS based on the resulting ELEMENT for 7/8/10 seconds.
Rainbow Blight.sa2: When TRANSMUTING, inflict DEBUFFS based on the resulting ELEMENT for 7/8/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Rainbow Blight is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that makes use of Double's Transmutation to inflict DEBUFFS and gain BUFFS depending on the corresponding element.

The BUFFS that Rainbow Blight gets are powerful BUFFS that increases her damage output (ENRAGE and HASTE) while making her immune to any crippling DEBUFFS (IMMUNITY, HEAVY REGEN, ARMOR). On the other hand, the DEBUFFS that Rainbow Blight inflicts are powerful DEBUFFS that can cripple the strongest defenders in the game. HEX is particularly noteworthy as it completely disables the opponent's Signature Ability, allowing her to face against defenders with powerful abilities such as Dread Locks, Resonant Evil, and Immoral Fiber.

HEX is particularly noteworthy as it completely disables the opponent's Signature Ability, allowing her to face against defenders with powerful abilities such as Dread Locks, Resonant Evil, and Immoral Fiber.

A lot of these BUFFS and DEBUFFS do not stack and do not reset upon transmuting to the same element before they expire. Hence, this makes Rainbow Blight a fairly RNG-dependent fighter since getting what you need when you need it in a pinch is down to chance, but the pros can outweigh the cons.

Marquee Ability: CHAOS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Rainbow Blight as inflicting tons of DEBUFFS through CHAOS can severely cripple even the toughest of defenders. Since it may take a few transmutations to get into an Elemental Advantage for CHAOS, Rainbow Blight's Signature Ability allows her to reap some benefits when transmuting into the wrong element. In particular, the BUFFS that she gain can increase her survivability in the fight which overcomes Double's low base health that renders her vulnerable to chip damage from blocking.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Nunsense is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: no Special Investment is needed for this fighter.

Raining Champ.name: Raining Champ
Raining Champ.sa1: While Umbrella is alive, the active Fighter gains 1 stack of BLESSING and UNFLINCHING for 15 seconds every 20/15/10 COMBO HITS.
Raining Champ.sa2: While Umbrella is alive, increase all teammates' ATTACK by 2/3/4% of the Fighter's CURRENT HEALTH for each stack of BLESSING currently on the Fighter.

role_strategy: Raining Champ is a unique offensive support fighter who grants the active fighter UNFLINCHING and BLESSING, while also increasing their Attack based on their current Health.

The UNFLINCHING granted by her first Signature Ability makes her teammates resistant to BURSTS after reaching a 10-hit combo, making her an excellent partner for combo-heavy fighters like Squigly, Umbrella, Big Band, or Black Dahlia. This also synergizes well with her BUFF conditions, which are triggered by maintaining a high combo count.

The BLESSING granted by her first Signature Ability provides teammates with a valuable safety net, giving them a second chance to recover after a mistake. When combined with UNFLINCHING, it allows fighters to push through enemy attacks without the fear of being knocked out. Pair this with a Marie who has the REINFORCED REVIVAL Marquee Ability, and fighters come back stronger and with increased health.

Her second Signature Ability is particularly unique, as it converts a portion of the active fighter's Health into bonus Attack. With 5 stacks of BLESSING, Raining Champ boosts the active fighter's Attack by 20% of their current Health. Naturally, fighters with high Health pools benefit the most from this effect. Characters like Big Band, Squigly, Black Dahlia, Eliza, Marie, Robo-Fortune, and Valentine are especially strong partners for maximizing this ability. Note that her damage boost is applied before any other damage modifiers like ENRAGE or DEATH MARK, meaning that her damage can scale even more.
Note that her damage boost is applied before any other damage modifiers like ENRAGE or DEATH MARK, meaning that her damage can scale even more.

Marquee Ability: Raining Champ will benefit more from BITTER END as her Marquee Ability for additional sustain and FINAL STAND. She will also benefit from SWEET VICTORY as it provides ENRAGE which increases her damage, the safety net BITTER END provides can be replaced with the BLESSING that she gains from her own Signature Ability. Due to her Signature Ability and access to healing through Umbrellas kit, she can also be built as a critless fighter.
Due to her Signature Ability and access to healing through Umbrellas kit, she can also be built as a critless fighter.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Raining Champ is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: HP is another stat you can build on Raining Champ as it synergizes well with her Signature Ability. If built critless, HP should be focused above Attack as it provides her with more damage.

Raw Nerv.name: Raw Nerv
Raw Nerv.sa1: Gain FINAL STAND for 15 seconds and inflict permanent DEATHMARK when your HEALTH drops below 25/35/50% HEALTH.
Raw Nerv.sa2: While benefiting from FINAL STAND, 5/7/10% chance on HIT to gain ENRAGE and 50% of all damage inflicted is regained as HEALTH.

role_strategy: Raw Nerve is an offensive fighter that promotes self-inflicted damage to increase her damage output through ENRAGE and DEATHMARK. She also has access to FINAL STAND and recovery to prevent herself from dying and providing an additional layer of safety. This provides a unique game plan and ability among other Painwheels.

Raw Nerv can activate her second Signature Ability from any source of FINAL STAND. Hence, support variants such as Valentine with TRAUMA CENTER, Fan Favorite, Raining Champ and Rock Star are good partners to pair with her.

Raw Nerv's main strength is her recovery ability, allowing her to regain her health back very easily while still dealing a lot of damage. This is especially good against opponents that can reflect damage such as Treble Maker and Dread Locks as Raw Nerv can simply recover her lost health back.
Marquee Ability: TAINTED BLOOD is the recommended Marquee Ability for Raw Nerv.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Raw Nerv is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to take the most out of her DEATHMARK.

Red Rider.name: Red Rider
Red Rider.sa1: STANDARD SHOTS inflict WITHER and HEAL BLOCK for 10/12/15 seconds each while near an opponent.
Red Rider.sa2: 25/35/50% of all damage inflicted is regained as HEALTH while the opponent is suffering from HEAL BLOCK.

role_strategy: Red Rider is an offensive fighter who can inflict WITHER and HEAL BLOCK with point-blank STANDARD SHOTS, giving her excellent meter control and a way to shut down healing variants. On top of that, she regenerates health by dealing damage while the opponent is suffering from HEAL BLOCK. All of these abilities make Red Rider a sturdy damage dealer who has an answer for several problematic abilities.

Black Dahlia's kit lacks health regeneration. Hence, Red Rider provides a unique niche in the pool of her variants, and can be used reliably against opponents with reflect damage. Furthermore, easy access to HEAL BLOCK allows Red Rider to be a reliable counter against opponents that regenerates a lot of HEALTH, such as Valentine variants with the ICU Marquee Ability or Black Dahlia variants with the NO TIME TO DIE Marquee Ability. Splitting Image is another notable variant that is hampered by HEAL BLOCK, as long as it is inflicted before she gains IMMUNITY. Once inflicted, Splitting Image will miss out on 30% of her MAX HP being regenerated, something that can be extended by tagging in Claw & Order or Shadow Puppet after inflicting the debuff.

Splitting Image is another notable variant that is hampered by HEAL BLOCK, as long as it is inflicted before she gains IMMUNITY. Once inflicted, Splitting Image will miss out on 30% of her MAX HP being regenerated, something that can be extended by tagging in Claw & Order or Shadow Puppet after inflicting the debuff.

Since Red Rider relies on DEBUFFS to activate her Signature Ability, she is ineffective against variants that have frequent access to IMMUNITY or DEBUFF clears such as Splitting Image, Dream Band and support variants such as Rose-Tinted and Model Leader.

While Red Rider has good utility and a decent ATK stat, she lacks ways to increase her own damage aside from what Black Dahlia's base kit gives her. This means she's more geared toward Rifts rather than Prize Fights. In Rift Battles, it can be beneficial to build her "critless" by intentionally avoiding upgrading her skill tree, more specifically the parts that increase Crit Rate. This allows her to be a reasonable counter against crit-punishing defenders such as Painwheel variants with TAINTED BLOOD as their Marquee Ability and Black Dahlia variants with NO TIME TO DIE. To fare against reflect damage, it is recommended to invest in HP, ATK, and Meter Gain/Special Cooldown.

In Rift Battles, it can be beneficial to build her "critless" by intentionally avoiding upgrading her skill tree, more specifically the parts that increase Crit Rate. This allows her to be a reasonable counter against crit-punishing defenders such as Painwheel variants with TAINTED BLOOD as their Marquee Ability and Black Dahlia variants with NO TIME TO DIE. To fare against reflect damage, it is recommended to invest in HP, ATK, and Meter Gain/Special Cooldown.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Red Rider will benefit from METAL BREAKDOWN as her Marquee Ability in order to increase her damage output through ARMOR BREAK and the extra damage boost to her SPECIAL SHOTS.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Red Rider is best built with Attack and Special Cooldown. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.

Special investment: Players are advised not to invest in Crit Rate and Crit Damage, as Red Rider's signature ability is perfect to counter Painwheels's TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability and Black Dahlia variants with NO TIME TO DIE. With these, players can also avoid unlocking the Crit Rate and Crit Damage nodes in her skill tree. Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her debuffs are not resisted by enemies, and investing in Meter Gain will allow Red Rider to spam her Tier 3 Blockbuster more often.

Red Velvet.name: Red Velvet
Red Velvet.sa1: Inflict HEX for 10/12/15 seconds when entering Sekhmet Mode, disabling opponent SIGNATURE ABILITIES for the duration of the effect.
Red Velvet.sa2: If an opponent TAGS OUT while suffering from HEX, the next opponent will be inflicted with 3 random DEBUFFS for 10/12/15 seconds.

role_strategy: Red Velvet is an offensive utility fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around inflicting HEX on the opponent. Any attempt for the opponent to TAG OUT will be greeted with three new random DEBUFFS that can cripple most fighters if RNG favors the player. As one of the very few fighters that can inflict HEX consistently and reliably, Red Velvet is a crucial fighter to have in teams to defeat defenders reliant on their Signature Abilities much easier.

Red Velvet has easy access to HEX, which completely shuts down opponent Signature Abilities, but is largely hindered by her abysmal base ATK stat. Thus, Red Velvet will need all the help and stat investment to actually deal good damage. Another option is to simply TAG IN a stronger fighter once HEX has been inflicted on the opponent. Claw & Order can reset the HEX placed by Red Velvet while doing large amounts of damage, making her one of the best partners for Red Velvet. Shadow Puppet can fulfill the same role, but is harder to get and raise, while also having less consistency on her ability to reset timers.

Claw & Order can reset the HEX placed by Red Velvet while doing large amounts of damage, making her one of the best partners for Red Velvet. Shadow Puppet can fulfill the same role, but is harder to get and raise, while also having less consistency on her ability to reset timers.

While HEX disables Signature Abilities, it cannot disable Marquee or Prestige Abilities. Depending on whether the opponent has these two unlocked, this may complicate fights. The earlier mentioned combination of Claw & Order and Red Velvet for example is very susceptible to Painwheel's Marquee Ability, as the former is very reliant on crits in order to work properly.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work well with Red Velvet. RITUAL SACRIFICE can be useful to quickly charge up blockbusters, allowing her to inflict HEX faster. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH can be useful as a safety-net when a mistake is made to get her back to full health. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Red Velvet as a Critless Variant
Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Red Velvet as a Critless Variant
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Red Velvet is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow Red Velvet to use her Signature Ability more often.

Regally Blonde.name: Regally Blonde
Regally Blonde.sa1: 50% chance to inflict CRIPPLE and reduce the opponent's BLOCKBUSTER METER by 25/35/50% when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER.
Regally Blonde.sa2: While near an opponent, DISABLE their SPECIAL MOVES and gain AUTO-BLOCK every 4/3/2 seconds. Both effects are removed when no longer near an opponent.

role_strategy: Regally Blonde is a fighter that specializes in meter control and lockdown with her Signature Ability. She has the chance to reduce Blockbuster meter when a Blockbuster is used, disables special moves while up close and punishes normal attacks through CRIPPLE and AUTO-BLOCK, increasing the difficulty of taking her down on defense. Regally Blonde's second ability only works while near the opponent. Hence, projectile special moves that can be activated from afar such as Robo-Fortune's various beams and Parasoul's NAPALM SHOT are great ways to counter her.

Regally Blonde's second ability only works while near the opponent. Hence, projectile special moves that can be activated from afar such as Robo-Fortune's various beams and Parasoul's NAPALM SHOT are great ways to counter her.

On offense, Regally Blonde has a unique niche of stopping BURSTS from defenders through DISABLE SPECIAL MOVES. Furthermore, the ability to reduce the opponent's blockbuster meter can be useful to prevent getting punished by unblockable Tier 3 blockbusters. She also has a high base ATK stat, meaning she can deal good damage even without steroids. The ability to inflict timeless CRIPPLE provides synergy with Hack n' Splash, who relies on CRIPPLE to deal %-based damage with headless crits. However, it isn't notable otherwise.

Marquee Ability: Parasoul's Marquee Abilities are inherently offensive. When used offensively, CRITICAL MASS is the superior Marquee Ability to deal significantly more damage as more TEARS are spawned. When used defensively, CRITICAL THINKING stands out more as it provides increased damage output with the least amount of investment, enabling Regally Blonde to deal some damage when punishing opponents without any investment in Crit Rate or Crit Damage which are inherently offensive.
stat_investment: General Investment: If used on offense, Regally Blonde is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage. If build defensively she is best built with HP, Resistance, Defense and Meter Gain.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS.
rift_battles: Regally Blonde's main role as a defender would to be stalled for time and reduce the amount of points the opponent can get by preventing a blockbuster finish. To achieve this end, catalysts such as Final Fight and Frost Armor are recommended.

Reimaged.name: Reimaged
Reimaged.sa1: The 1st COMBO HIT landed on Robo-Fortune converts 1 opponent BUFF into a random DEBUFF and grants ARMOR for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Reimaged.sa2: When defeated or DETONATING, reduce the opponent's BLOCKBUSTER METER by 100%. Also once per match, RESURRECT with 15/20/25% HEALTH and gain permanent REGEN and ENRAGE.

role_strategy: Reimaged is a defensive fighter who excels at turning enemy buffs into disadvantages and gaining defensive buffs in the process. Upon being defeated or detonating, she significantly hinders the opponent by draining their blockbuster meter and can resurrect once per match with a health boost and powerful, permanent buffs, making her a persistent threat.

When playing against Reimaged, it is recommended to use characters with long-chain combos such as Squigly or Valentine to avoid her first Signature Ability from activating multiple times. Furthermore, variants with access to CURSE like Dark Horse and Purrfect Dark or HEX like Heartless are recommended to remove the BUFFS that she can gain from her abilities.

Detonation is triggered when using CIRCUIT BREAKER. Hence, it is recommended to equip this move when placing Reimaged in defense to activate her second Signature Ability. Reduction of opponent's meter is useful to prevent the player from gaining the blockbuster finish points after her resurrection. To overcome this ability, bring variants that can gain meter easily such as Heavy Reign or have access to HASTE such as Snake Bite or Dark Horse.
Marquee Ability: As a defensive variant, DDOS is the recommended ability for Reimaged which allows her to inflict POWER SURGE to opponents, reducing their HP when they use a blockbuster.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Robo-Fortune, Reimaged is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Resistance and Defense.
Special investment: One can invest in Crit Resist to further reduce the damage she receives.

Rerun.name: Rerun
Rerun.sa1: All teammates TAG IN with ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds.
Rerun.sa2: COOLDOWN for TAG INS reduced by 25/35/50% for all teammates.

role_strategy: Rerun is a support fighter with a Signature Ability that grants ENRAGE upon TAG IN, allowing teammates and herself to do 20% more damage. Rerun's second Signature Ability compliments her first by reducing cooldown for TAG INS.

For players starting out, it can be effective to build a team based around TAG INS with characters such as Icy Hot, Scrub, Bassline, and Sketchy. All these fighters are Bronze fighters that can easily be obtained.
Sketchy is a direct counter to Rerun, as her Signature Ability to inflict CURSE upon TAG IN negates Rerun's own Signature Ability to provide ENRAGE.
Marquee Ability: As a support fighter, CAST PARTY is the recommended Marquee Ability for Rerun to support teammates with a chance of unblockable TAG INS.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Rerun is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Tag Cooldown will synergize with her Signature Ability.

Resonant Evil.name: Resonant Evil
Resonant Evil.sa1: Getting HIT has a 10% chance to grant ARMOR for 5/7/10 seconds.
Resonant Evil.sa2: 5% chance when HIT to STUN the opponent for 3/4/5 seconds while benefitting from ARMOR.

role_strategy: Resonant Evil is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants him stacks of ARMOR when hit. While benefiting from ARMOR, he has a chance to STUN the opponent when hit, allowing the AI a window to counterattack. This makes him a dangerous fighter to face without any preparation.

Marquee Ability: As a defensive variant, FRONTMAN is the recommended Marquee Ability for Resonant Evil, as it provides Resistance and damage reduction to make him more durable and more resistant to DEBUFFS.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Resonant Evil is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.
Special investment: Players are recommended to build Accuracy on Resonant Evil to increase the chances of gaining ARMOR and inflicting STUN.
rift_battles: Resonant Evil is a potent defender that synergizes very well with catalysts that grants ARMOR, such as Darknut and Armor Rating. Players will have to devise ways to remove his ARMOR while dealing significant damage to avoid activating Futile Resistance. Given his reliance on ARMOR, Autoimmune is a very useful catalyst to have to prevent DEBUFFS such as CURSE and HEX. Angry Flinch will also force the opponent to use CURSE or DEADEYE making him an annoying defender to face in rift.
playing_against: Generally, using characters that can deal massive damage in a low number of hits such as Cerebella, Beowulf, and Painwheel can be advantageous to lower the chance of activating his ability.

Resonant Evil's reliance on ARMOR is his greatest weakness as it makes him very vulnerable to DEBUFFS such as CURSE, HEX and ARMOR BREAK. CURSE prevents new BUFFS from being applied. HEX completely disables his Signature Ability. ARMOR BREAK removes his stacks of ARMOR while also increasing the amount of damage he receives.
CURSE prevents new BUFFS from being applied.
HEX completely disables his Signature Ability.
ARMOR BREAK removes his stacks of ARMOR while also increasing the amount of damage he receives.

Resonant Evil is countered by characters that can prevent, remove/steal BUFFS, inflict HEX and ARMOR BREAK, such as Doublicious, Purrfect Dark, Red Velvet, Silent Kill and Star-Spangled. Furthermore, characters such as Peacock, Parasoul, and Squigly all have a TAUNT that grants them IMMUNITY which can prevent STUN from being applied when hitting Resonant Evil.

Rhythm Rider.name: Rhythm Rider
Rhythm Rider.sa1: While Big Band is alive, all teammates gain HASTE and REGEN for 6/8/10 seconds after every 15 seconds.
Rhythm Rider.sa2: While benefiting from HASTE and REGEN, DASH ATTACKS inflict CURSE. Also when Big Band or any teammate gains a BUFF while the opponent is suffering from CURSE, its duration is increased by 3/4/5 seconds.

role_strategy: Rhythm Rider is an offensive and supportive fighter with a Signature Ability granting the whole team access to HEAVY REGEN, HASTE and CURSE through simple DASH ATTACKS.

Rhythm Rider is seen to have one of the easiest conditions to activate his Signature Abilities, keeping him an easy to use and very universal support for both survivability and utility. Without him needing to be on-field, he enables various other damage dealers to make use of his effects
Since any REGEN works for Rhythm Rider's second Signature Ability, pairing him with teammates who can gain REGEN, HEAVY REGEN or HASTE help him activate his 2nd Signature Ability more easily.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Rhythm Rider will benefit from SOLOIST as his Marquee Ability. This compliments his SA2 that inflicts CURSE on dash attacks while also providing another way to gain HEAVY REGEN as a form of recovery.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Rhythm Rider is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Players are advised to build Accuracy so that his CURSE is not resisted by Defenders, and be more likely to provide HEAVY REGEN and HASTE for himself and teammates alike.

Risky Ginger.name: Risky Ginger
Risky Ginger.sa1: Inflict DEATH MARK for 10/12/15 seconds and gain ENRAGE when HITTING an attacking opponent. A stack of ENRAGE is removed after each BLOCKED HIT.
Risky Ginger.sa2: With at least 5/4/3 stacks of ENRAGE, BLOCKBUSTERS become UNBLOCKABLE.

role_strategy: Risky Ginger is an offensive variant with a Signature Ability that rewards skill by increasing her damage output through stacks of timeless ENRAGE, inflicting DEATH MARK and unblockable blockbusters. Her condition to her Signature Ability relies on patience and skill, by intercepting an opponent, hence, there is a level of skill required to use her effectively but in her full potential, Risky Ginger can deal significant amount of (unblockable!) damage to the toughest of defenders. However, even while played suboptimally, Risky still rewards effectively high damage, with reliance on simple counter-attacks always providing at least 1 stack of ENRAGE and inflicting DEATH MARK.

Careful enemy selection may come in handy when playing Risky Ginger, as some characters are easier to intercept than others. Using her against opponents with a very quick dash such as Beowulf and Painwheel can make triggering her Signature Ability difficult. Using projectiles such as NAPALM SHOT on a dashing opponent will also trigger her Signature Ability. While more advanced, due to the ease of hitting an attacking opponent, manipulating the opposing AI can help ease the difficulty of getting enrage stacks, and being less reliant on dashing opponents to get more than 1 stack of ENRAGE overtime.
Using projectiles such as NAPALM SHOT on a dashing opponent will also trigger her Signature Ability.

While more advanced, due to the ease of hitting an attacking opponent, manipulating the opposing AI can help ease the difficulty of getting enrage stacks, and being less reliant on dashing opponents to get more than 1 stack of ENRAGE overtime.
Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Risky Ginger, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Risky Ginger is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output by taking maximum use out of her DEATHMARK

Robocopy.name: Robocopy
Robocopy.sa1: Once per match when suffering a HIT that would be fatal, gain 1/2/3 stacks of ARMOR and BARRIER. ARMOR lasts for 10 seconds.
Robocopy.sa2: For each 20% HEALTH lost by either Fighter, gain ENRAGE for 15 seconds and 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Robocopy is a fighter with a Signature Ability that allows him to survive a fatal hit as he pummels through opposing teams with stacks of ENRAGE and blockbuster meter. This makes him a great fighter to use for beginners, as he has an inherent safety net for survival while being able to deal significant damage.
When used offensively, Robocopy works well as a lead with an easy way to gain ENRAGE and BLOCKBUSTER METER for every 20% HP lost.

On the defense, Robocopy is simply a fighter that stalls for time once his first Signature Ability activates. However, this is easy to counter with OUTTAKES and fighters that can remove BUFFS via special moves and blockbusters such as Filia with DRILL TEMPERED, Eliza with CHAOS BANISH and Parasoul with CANOPY BOUNCE.

Marquee Ability: As a defensive variant, FRONTMAN is the recommended Marquee Ability for Robocopy as it provides Resistance and damage reduction to make him more durable and more immune to DEBUFFS. If used on offense, SOLOIST is recommended.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Robocopy is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance. If built offensively, Robocopy is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: If built offensively, the recommended stat for Robocopy is Meter Gain, as this combined with his second Signature Ability allows him to quickly spam Blockbusters.

Rock Star.name: Rock Star
Rock Star.sa1: While Filia is alive, teammates TAG IN with 1/2/3 stacks of BARRIER for 10 seconds.
Rock Star.sa2: When any teammate's BARRIER expires, they gain FINAL STAND for 10 seconds and 10/15/20% METER for all BLOCKBUSTERS.

role_strategy: Rock Star is a support fighter that grants teammates BARRIER upon TAG IN, while also providing FINAL STAND and METER when those BARRIERS expire. This allows teammates to TAG IN the fight without fear of getting punished, as Rock Star provides a variety of safety nets to ensure that they survive. In combat, Rock Star does not provide any significant abilities on her own. Therefore, it is best to keep her on the bench to support your other fighters from afar.
