As a support, Rock Star pairs well with variants who need blockbuster meter and FINAL STAND or variants that synergizes with BARRIER. Examples of team combinations are seen below:
Marquee Ability: LEECH is the preferred Marquee Ability for Rock Star
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Bad Hair Day is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant, as she is mainly a support.

Rogue Agent.name: Rogue Agent
Rogue Agent.sa1: Each HEAD HIT has a 25% chance to TRANSFER 1 opponent BUFF and convert it into 1/2/3 stack(s) of PRECISION.
Rogue Agent.sa2: PRECISION HITS grant EVASION and inflict DEATH MARK for 5/7/10 seconds. Each stack of EVASION is removed after an evaded HIT.

role_strategy: Rogue Agent is an offensive fighter with the ability to transfer opponent's BUFFS and convert them into stacks of PRECISION which will in turn, grant her EVASION while inflicting DEATH MARK to the opponent, allowing her to deal massive amounts of damage while ignoring a defender's Signature Ability. This combination of abilities on top of her high base ATK damage makes her a powerful offensive variant that is effective against some of the best defensive variants in the game.

Rogue Agent primarily requires mastery over Ms. Fortune's headless mode, turning her into a great offensive fighter that can remove opponent BUFFS while dealing significant damage through DEATH MARK and PRECISION. Furthermore, EVASION allows her to attack without fear of getting punished, providing an opportunity to re-start a headless combo loop easily.

For those who may not be proficient in Ms. Fortune's headless mode, it is recommended to equip NYAAAWN, a TAUNT which will grant three stacks of PRECISION to make use of Rogue Agent's second Signature Ability to gain EVASION and inflict DEATH MARK without the need to use headless mode.
Due to her access to EVASION, Rogue Agent pairs extremely well with Pickle Baller, allowing for an infinite loop of PRECISION and EVASION.
Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Rogue Agent is BOOP to gain stacks of ENRAGE and further increase her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Rogue Agent is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Damage will increase Rogue Agent overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION. Accuracy will also increase the chances of her stealing BUFFS and will ensure that her DEATH MARK isn't resisted by enemies.

Rose-Tinted.name: Rose-Tinted
Rose-Tinted.sa1: While Umbrella is alive, all teammates gain 1 stack each of BARRIER and THORNS for 5/7/10 seconds for every 25% HEALTH lost.
Rose-Tinted.sa2: While Umbrella is alive, she clears all teammate DEBUFFS every 30/25/20 seconds.

role_strategy: Rose-Tinted is a support fighter that provides herself and her teammates a stack of BARRIER and THORNS every time they lose a certain amount of health. She also clears her teammate DEBUFFS, making her an excellent support variant to be used on the bench.

As a support variant, Rose-Tinted can both be used offensively and defensively. When used offensively, her primarily role would be as a DEBUFF cleanser against certain modifiers for the player. Defensively, she works well to increase her teammates sustain without needing to be in the fight. BARRIER is a useful BUFF for sustain, especially for defenders with high health like Big Band variants. Furthermore, the BUFFS that Rose-Tinted provide synergizes very well with defensive Robo-Fortunes like Overclocked and Blue Screen that have activated their Prestige Ability. Her second Signature Ability helps her teammates get rid of DEBUFFS that would hamper their defensive performance, like CURSE and HEX.

BARRIER is a useful BUFF for sustain, especially for defenders with high health like Big Band variants. Furthermore, the BUFFS that Rose-Tinted provide synergizes very well with defensive Robo-Fortunes like Overclocked and Blue Screen that have activated their Prestige Ability. Her second Signature Ability helps her teammates get rid of DEBUFFS that would hamper their defensive performance, like CURSE and HEX.

As to counter her signature abilities, players may use OUTTAKE to bring her out into the field to prevent her signature abilities activating on other fighters. Fighters that have access to buff removal and deadeye can also be used to minimize the recoil damage taken from thorns. CURSE is also a good alternative, but will ultimately depend on the duration, as she will remove debuffs every once in a while.

Marquee Ability: Rose-Tinted will benefit more from BITTER END as her Marquee Ability for additional sustain and FINAL STAND. This is helpful since opponents will try to defeat her first to prevent her Signature Ability from activating.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Umbrella, Rose-Tinted is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Rough Copy.name: Rough Copy
Rough Copy.sa1: Any teammate gains permanent HASTE after facing an opponent with the same ELEMENT for 10/7/5 seconds.
Rough Copy.sa2: Any teammate inflicts permanent SLOW after facing an opponent of the same CHARACTER TYPE for 10/7/5 seconds.

role_strategy: Rough Copy is a support fighter that grants permanent HASTE to teammates while inflicting permanent SLOW to opponents after a short period of time. The condition to activate these abilities are dependent on either facing an opponent with the same ELEMENT or CHARACTER TYPE, which makes Rough Copy a fairly situational support fighter specializing in meter control. Double has the ability to change elements to be able to take advantage of the permanent HASTE.
Double has the ability to change elements to be able to take advantage of the permanent HASTE.

As a support fighter with very low stats, Rough Copy is better reserved in the bench, where she can support her teammates while keeping herself safe. It is important to note that Rough Copy does not need to be alive, hence using her as a suicide lead can be effective to inflict permanent SLOW, but only against other Fukuas.

Rough Copy will mostly be used for her first Signature Ability, allowing various fighters to easily gain permanent HASTE against enemies with the same ELEMENT which is very good to charge blockbusters quicker, especially for variants that require an unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster for their effects such as Blue Bomber.
When paired with fighters like Martial Outlaw, Rough Copy can help her teammates deal significant damage through HEAVY BLEED and ARMOR BREAK.
Marquee Ability: Both Fukua's Marquee Abilities are usable with Rough Copy but would not have any significant impact as she is likely placed in the bench.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Rough Copy is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Rusty.name: Rusty
Rusty.sa1: 5/7/10% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED for 3 seconds.
Rusty.sa2: Also converts 1/2/3 of the opponent's BUFFS into BLEED.

role_strategy: Rusty is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability revolving around BLEED effects. On top of an on-hit BLEED, Rusty is also capable of converting enemy BUFFS into BLEED, which allows her to consistently damage the toughest of defenders that rely on ARMOR such as Armed Forces, Heavy Metal, and Blue Screen.

Rusty is incredibly effective against BUFFS and is able to remove IMMUNITY and convert it to BLEED. To further increase her chances of activating her Signature Ability, equip multi-hit blockbusters such as DEATH CRAWL and BUER THRESHER. A single use of these blockbusters can easily inflict multiple stacks of BLEEDS.

Given her Bronze base stats, Rusty will rely on her BLEEDS to inflict significant damage against the opponent. Hence, she is easily countered by those who can convert BLEEDS into REGEN such as Bloodbath or any Valentine with the ICU Marquee Ability.

Marquee Ability: GRUDGE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Rusty as it provides a safety net to survive attacks from the opponent when a mistake is made while also increasing her damage output from the stacks of ENRAGE.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Rusty is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting BLEED and converting BUFFS. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.
rift_battles: Rusty excels against catalysts that grant BUFFS such as Autoimmune, Darknut, Armor Rating and To Be Precise. Furthermore, this also makes her effective against common defenders that rely on BUFFS such as That's All Folks!, Meow & Furever, and Overclocked.
With a low base ATK stat, Rusty is an effective counter against Painwheel nodes with the Don't Poke the Buer catalyst, as long as they have GRUDGE as their Marquee Ability.

Salty.name: Salty
Salty.sa1: Once per match, gain BLESSING and 3 stacks of ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds when falling below 35% HEALTH.
Salty.sa2: While benefiting from ENRAGE, THROWS have a 50% chance to inflict BLEED for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Salty is an offensive fighter that gains a timeless stack of BLESSING and ENRAGE stacks for a short period after losing enough health. The combination of the ENRAGE stacks and her second Signature Ability, which inflicts BLEED on throw hits, allows Salty to deal high amounts of burst damage once the health threshold is reached. Note that any ENRAGE will allow Salty to inflict BLEEDS with her throws, not just her own.
Note that any ENRAGE will allow Salty to inflict BLEEDS with her throws, not just her own.

The stack of BLESSING allows Salty to reach below the health threshold safely to get her ENRAGE stacks by allowing herself to get hit. However, this is still a risky play and is not recommended. It is best to use the BLESSING as a safety net when you make a mistake instead of a goal you strive towards. Since the ENRAGE stacks only last for a short period of time, Salty is often better used as a bleeder using her second Ability. Instead of relying on just her first Signature Ability's ENRAGE, it is better to bring support variants that can provide her with the ENRAGE she wants, such as Rerun and, in a less direct way, Inner Pieces.

Since the ENRAGE stacks only last for a short period of time, Salty is often better used as a bleeder using her second Ability. Instead of relying on just her first Signature Ability's ENRAGE, it is better to bring support variants that can provide her with the ENRAGE she wants, such as Rerun and, in a less direct way, Inner Pieces.

Marquee Ability: Salty will benefit from SWEET VICTORY as her Marquee Ability, further bolstering her damage output through ENRAGE stacks when she defeats an opponent. The ENRAGE stacks also activate her second Signature Ability, allowing her to inflict multiple stacks of BLEED. While BITTER END allows her to survive longer in the match by having a FINAL STAND and HEAVY REGEN safety net.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Salty is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting BLEED.

Sawed Apart.name: Sawed Apart
Sawed Apart.sa1: SPECIAL MOVE and BLOCKBUSTER HITS have a 25/30/35% chance to inflict a random DEBUFF for 10 seconds. These debuffs are removed if Painwheel is knocked down.
Sawed Apart.sa2: While Painwheel is the active Fighter, when a DEBUFF on the opponent expires, deal damage equal to 1/2/3% of their MAX HEALTH.

role_strategy: Sawed Apart is a Painwheel that inflicts random DEBUFFS and chips away at the opponent’s health when those DEBUFFS expire.
Due to her ability to reduce the opponent's HP in chunks, she’s very good at dealing with tanky fighters.
The flurry of random DEBUFFS she inflicts is also useful, as DEBUFFS like HEX, CURSE, BLEED, and INVERSE POLARITY can be applied.
She performs extremely well in Parallel Realms, where DEBUFFS you inflict only last half as long. This means the DEBUFFS she inflicts last just 5 seconds, rapidly chipping away at the opponent’s HP.

Painwheel’s kit synergizes well with her ability, as she has a lot of multi-hit special moves like CRUEL LILY, GÁE BOLGA STINGER, and DEATH CRAWL, as well as plenty of short-duration BLEED built into her kit.
Marquee Ability: GRUDGE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Sawed Apart, as it provides a safety net to survive hits when a mistake is made, while also increasing her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Sawed Apart is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting DEBUFFS. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

Scale Tipper.name: Scale Tipper
Scale Tipper.sa1: While Filia has more BUFFS or fewer DEBUFFS than the opponent, transfer 1 opponent BUFF every 2 seconds and inflict 1 random DEBUFF every second for 7 seconds.
Scale Tipper.sa2: When the current number of BUFFS and DEBUFFS between both Fighters is more than or equal to 17, the opponent suffers permanent DOOM for 10 seconds, bypassing all DEBUFF preventing effects.

role_strategy: Scale Tipper is an offensive Filia, able to steal enemy BUFFs and inflict DEBUFFs quickly to build up and inflict a 10 second permanent DOOM on the enemy.

Scale Tipper will need to find ways to inflict as many DEBUFFs as possible to inflict the permanent DOOM. Using moves like RINGLET SPIKE, FRENCH TWIST or GREGOR SAMSON can help her inflict stacks of BLEED on the enemy, and using WIDOW'S PEAK can also help inflict CRIPPLE and ARMOR BREAK on the opponent.

It is recommended to pair Scale Tipper with supports that can provide BUFFs off field so they be an help trigger her 2nd Signature Ability faster. Some variants like Stone Sentinel, Lucky Lure, Starlight Rose, Mad Malice and Angel Maker are some strong supports to use with her.
Some variants like Stone Sentinel, Lucky Lure, Starlight Rose, Mad Malice and Angel Maker are some strong supports to use with her.
Once the DOOM is inflicted, there is no way to remove it, it is only possible to pause the DOOM timer by tagging out and not switching back in, which can be challenging to manage.

Although mainly an offensive variant, Scale Tipper can also be used defensively since she has high base health, able to take away the Attacker's BUFFs, inflict constant DEBUFFs and even kill using DOOM.

Marquee Ability: Scale Tipper may use either Marquee Ability. LEECH will give Scale Tipper some reliable self-healing to keep her in the fight for longer. THE FIRST CUT will allow Scale Tipper to inflict more stacks of BLEED by changing them into permanent DEBUFFs, helping her to reach the 17 DEBUFFs necessary for DOOM.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Scale Tipper is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will allow her to activate her inflict DEBUFFS more reliably, and not be negated by the Resistance stat on enemies.

Scare Giver.name: Scare Giver
Scare Giver.sa1: Inflict WITHER and grant HASTE for 6/7/8 seconds each when the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN.
Scare Giver.sa2: 15/20/25% chance on HIT to grant ENRAGE for 10 seconds and to DRAIN 3/4/5% HEALTH from the opponent while benefiting from HASTE.

role_strategy: Scare Giver is an offensive fighter with the ability to control the opponent's meter while increasing her own. Furthermore, she also gains the ability to increase her damage output through ENRAGE stacks and directly DRAIN the opponent's health, providing a form of recovery for every hit landed on the opponent that is unique for Cerebella.

Cerebella does not have easy access to health regeneration, allowing Scare Giver to stand out with her DRAIN ability. On top of ENRAGE, Scare Giver can take down opponents easily while keeping her health generally high. Due to the relatively low chances of her second Signature Ability activating, Scare Giver benefits significantly from multi-hit moves, which is in direct contrast to her status as a low hit-count character. Moves such as CERECOPTER, PUMMEL HORSE, EXCELLEBELLA and GRAB BAG will synergize really well with her Signature Ability. A common combo to use is highly likely to trigger both Signature Abilities is MERRY GO-RILLA > D2 > PUMMEL HORSE > G5 or MERRY GO-RILLA > D2 > (in the corner) CERECOPTER.

Moves such as CERECOPTER, PUMMEL HORSE, EXCELLEBELLA and GRAB BAG will synergize really well with her Signature Ability.

With frequent access to HASTE, Martial Outlaw is a great support variant that will provide additional utility to Scare Giver by access to ARMOR BREAK and HEAVY BLEED from her attacks, further bolstering her offensive output.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Abilities will work with Scare Giver. UPPER HAND may be redundant as Scare Giver already has means to control the opponent's meter through WITHER. Meanwhile, RING LEADER can trap opponents and prevent them from escaping via TAG OUTS while also disabling their special moves, which may provide additional utility for Scare Giver.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Scare Giver is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is the most important stat for Scare Giver, as it increases the chances of her second Signature Ability activating. Due to her access to HASTE, Meter Gain can be ignored.

Scared Stiff.name: Scared Stiff
Scared Stiff.sa1: Gain UNFLINCHING after facing the same opponent for 25/20/15 seconds. UNFLINCHING is removed when the opponent TAGS OUT or dies.
Scared Stiff.sa2: Cannot suffer more than 15/10/5% HEALTH from a single HIT.

role_strategy: Scared Stiff is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to limit the maximum amount of damage suffered per hit, while gaining a timeless UNFLINCHING if fighting against the same opponent for long enough, making combos difficult for the duration. This makes Scared Stiff a decent tank against low hit-count fighters.

Scared Stiff works best against characters with high damage and low number of hit counts, such as Cerebella and Beowulf. However, given Scared Stiff's bronze base stats, Scared Stiff falls very short in higher tiers and can easily be defeated by performing a 20-hit combo.

While timeless UNFLINCHING is a bit annoying to deal with, it's removed as soon as she's not fighting the same fighter anymore, meaning it's not that scary in practice. It can also be removed through moves like Eliza's CHAOS BANISH or bypassed with DEADEYE, limiting its use even further on defense, not to mention the requirement of fighting the same fighter for at least 15 seconds making it slow to start up in the first place.
Marquee Ability: DEAD ALIVE is the better Marquee Ability to be used defensively, providing other teammates FINAL STAND to increase the longevity of your defensive fighters and stall for time.
stat_investment: General Investment: If built offensively, Scared Stiff is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. If built defensively, she needs HP, Defense, Resistance and Meter Gain.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Scarlet Viper.name: Scarlet Viper
Scarlet Viper.sa1: Inflict BLEED for 10/12/15 seconds on both Fighters when entering Sekhmet Mode.
Scarlet Viper.sa2: Gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds when suffering a DEBUFF.

role_strategy: Scarlet Viper is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that inflicts BLEED on both herself and the opponent when triggering Sekhmet. This is complimented by her second Signature Ability that grants her ENRAGE when suffering a DEBUFF, including BLEEDS. Hence, Scarlet Viper is a risky fighter that is able to dish out massive damage at the expense of her own life. To overcome the self-inflicted BLEED, equip SCARLET LADIES, which is a TAUNT that grants her REGEN to cancel the BLEED. This will allow her to have stacks of ENRAGE while keeping her health above the opponent through REGEN. Having supports like Seraph Soldier, Starlight Rose and Maid of Honor will also increase her regen and make her survive longer on the field.

Scarlet Viper can easily gain ENRAGE when suffering any DEBUFF, except for CURSE or HEX. This makes her a solid fighter to use against common DEBUFF-inflicting defenders such as Love Crafted.

RITUAL SACRIFICE can be useful to quickly charge up blockbusters that trigger Sekhmet, allowing her to inflict BLEEDS and gain ENRAGE quicker. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH can be useful to get her back to full health after her BLEEDS (although the SCARLET LADIES can easily provide REGEN to cancel the BLEED). stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Scarlet Viper is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow Scarlet Viper to use her Signature Ability more often. As a rare case, Scarlet Viper is an Eliza who's best build with Crit Rate and Crit Damage. Scrub.name: Scrub
Scrub.sa1: All teammates instantly recover 5/10/15% HEALTH when Valentine TAGS OUT.
Scrub.sa2: Teammates in reserve regenerate SCRATCH DAMAGE and gain BLOCKBUSTER meter 50/75/100% faster.

role_strategy: Scrub is a support fighter with a Signature Ability around healing. Scrub provides all teammates in reserve faster regeneration while also filling up their blockbuster meter quicker in the bench. This allows her to support her teammates while she's fighting in battle.

She can easily recover back her teammate's HEALTH by TAGGING OUT, making her a good fighter for beginners to use. However, Scrub has a very low base ATK stat as a Bronze, and is best kept in the bench to support teammates from afar.

For players starting out, it can be effective to build a team based around TAG INS with characters such as Icy Hot, Bassline, Rerun and Sketchy. All these fighters are Bronze fighters that can easily be obtained.
Marquee Ability: As a support fighter, TRAUMA CENTER is the recommended Marquee Ability to provide FINAL STAND to teammates as a safety net.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Scrub is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Sea Witch.name: Sea Witch
Sea Witch.sa1: Using a BLOCKBUSTER inflicts CURSE and GUARD BREAK for 6/8/10 seconds each.
Sea Witch.sa2: Using a SPECIAL MOVE grants HASTE and DEADEYE for 6/8/10 seconds each.

role_strategy: Sea Witch is an offensive water double with reliable access to CURSE, GUARD BREAK, HASTE and DEADEYE. Her buffs are complementary upon each other's activation, and aims to mix consistent usage of her Special Moves and Blockbusters to continue unrelenting pressure on the opponent, while remaining safe with the buffs she already gains. The main tactic with Sea Witch is to gain the DEADEYE and HASTE quickly through the use of her Special Moves, like CILIA SLIDE or BOGUS BUZZARD. In doing so, she can use the haste to quickly activate one of her blockbusters, possibly enabling both her BUFFS and DEBUFFS within the first combo. Once she can apply GUARD BREAK, she can start looping her combos consistently to continue spamming simple yet effective Special Moves and Blockbusters with very little consequences.

One of the weaknesses of Sea Witch is her low health and a lack of recovery. You must play very carefully and pair her with regeneration supports such as Surgeon General, Pickle Baller or Seraph Soldier. Or as an alternative use Minette Guest Star Dim Sum Delivery.

Marquee Ability: CHAOS is the recommended investment for Sea Witch, as inflicting tons of DEBUFFS through CHAOS can severely cripple even the toughest of defenders. This pairs even better for the likes of Sea Witch with her guaranteed access to CURSE, denying IMMUNITY to defenders, and enabling Sea Witch to apply more DEBUFFS before the opponent can prepare.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Sea Witch is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Special Cooldown is an important stat for her, as it allows her to keep a constant loop of DEADEYE and HASTE. Meter Gain should be completely ignored due to her access to HASTE.

Seraph Soldier.name: Seraph Soldier
Seraph Soldier.sa1: While Valentine is alive, the active Fighter gains ENRAGE for 10 seconds when dealing at least 10% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH from a single HIT. Also, your active Fire Element Fighter permanently increases DAMAGE by 0.25/0.35/0.5% every second.
Seraph Soldier.sa2: While Valentine is alive, 15/20/25% of all damage inflicted by the active Fighter's CRITICAL HITS is regained as HEALTH while that Fighter is benefiting from ENRAGE.

role_strategy: Seraph Soldier is an offensive support fighter with the ability to provide regeneration when teammates deal massive damage from a single HIT. With access to ENRAGE and the ability to permanently increase teammate's damage, Seraph Soldier brings in a lot of utility for variants that primarily focus on damage.

Fire Element Fighters usually focuses on damage. Variants like Beast King, Head Hunter, Fire Branded and Furry Fury have no to very limited access to healing, making them vulnerable, so they benefit most from Seraph Soldier's ability.
Marquee Ability: As a primary backline fighter to have in the bench, Seraph Soldier will benefit from TRAUMA CENTER to provide further support as a safety net to other teammates.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Seraph Soldier is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage by taking use of her Signature Ability fully.

Serpent Sin.name: Serpent Sin
Serpent Sin.sa1: SPECIAL MOVE HITS heal for 5/7/10% of Double’s MAX HEALTH.
Serpent Sin.sa2: Gain MIASMA for 3/4/5 seconds when the opponent gains a BUFF or suffers a DEBUFF while Double’s HEALTH is higher than the opponent’s.

role_strategy: Serpent Sin is an offensive Double who relies on SPECIAL MOVE HITS to constantly heal herself, while doing high damage through her attacks alongside MIASMA.

Serpent Sin is a unique Double with how much she heals, utilizing high hit SPECIAL MOVES to combo per hit. BOGUS BUZZARD and HORNET BOMBER are Double's main combo SPECIAL MOVES, both hitting 3 hits respectively, and in turn, enabling Serpent Sin to heal 30% each when used well.

To further amplify her healing while also doing considerable damage, Serpent Sin rewards constant DEBUFF application to gain short, but easy MIASMA, while also gaining it if the enemy gains BUFFS themselves. With the condition of her only needing to be at higher health, Serpent Sin especially wants moves that can inflict DEBUFFS quickly, like her moves CILIA SLIDE and BOGUS BUZZARD. One of Double's bread and butter combos is CILIA SLIDE > BOGUS BUZZARD > HORNET BOMBER. With this, Serpent Sin could heal up to 70% of her MAX HEALTH while gaining 2 stacks of MIASMA easily.

Marquee Ability: CHAOS is the preferred Marquee of Serpent Sin because she constantly gains MIASMA when the enemy suffers a DEBUFF, aiding her gain more stacks at a faster pace. Shadow Ops.name: Shadow Ops
Shadow Ops.sa1: Opponents suffer CURSE after 3/2/1 seconds while near a TEAR.
Shadow Ops.sa2: Gain THORNS every 3/2/1 seconds while near a TEAR.

role_strategy: Shadow Ops is a fighter with a Signature Ability revolves around inflicting CURSE and gaining THORNS while near a TEAR. The ability to inflict a timeless CURSE when opponents are near a TEAR makes Shadow Ops an excellent fighter to use against defenders that rely on BUFFS such as Armed Forces and Meow & Furever. Meanwhile, THORNS provides a defensive option for her, but given the unpredictability of the AI in spawning TEARS, Shadow Ops is best to be used in the offense with THORNS acting as a safety net.

To maximize the use of her ability, try to push the opponent into the corner as much as possible via grabs, combos and launchers. Once in the corner, all TEARS that are spawned in a juggle will be placed within a close distance, allowing you to continually attack the opponent without fear of any defensive BUFFS while granting you THORNS as a safety net to inflict more damage to the opponent.

Equip moves that can spawn TEARS easily, such as NAPALM SHOWER and NAPALM SHOT. Furthermore, CANOPY BOUNCE can also be equipped to remove any current BUFFS the opponent currently has before inflicting them with CURSE to prevent subsequent BUFFS.
Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Shadow Ops, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Shadow Ops is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that she can inflict CURSE reliably.

Shadow Puppet.name: Shadow Puppet
Shadow Puppet.sa1: 3/4/5% chance on HIT to reset the timers of all Fukua's BUFFS and all opponent DEBUFFS.
Shadow Puppet.sa2: Once per match when suffering a HIT that would be fatal, freeze time for 7 seconds and gain 3/4/5 stacks of MIASMA for 7 seconds. Time resumes if Fukua attacks.

role_strategy: Shadow Puppet is an offensive fighter with a unique Signature Ability that allows her to freeze time when suffering a fatal hit. During this time, she also gains 5 stacks of MIASMA, allowing the player to recover her health back easily to retaliate and finish the opponent. Furthermore, her first Signature Ability that can reset BUFFS and DEBUFFS is immensely powerful and can easily be combined with support fighters such as Surgeon General or Sketchy, which can lead to her gaining "timeless" IMMUNITY and inflict "timeless" CURSE. Even though the chance of activation is quite low, Fukua's combo game is great and her kit features a few high hit count moves, making it likely she can trigger it within a combo.

Shadow Puppet boasts one of the highest ATK stat in the game, and has easy access to MIASMA through her second Signature Ability and her Taunt, BREAKDOWN. This along with her ability to reset her own buffs means that she can brute-force her way through many fights.

Some interesting notes about her second Signature Ability and its activation: Shadow Puppet can activate her second Signature Ability when she "dies" from DOOM, damage reflection, and POWER SURGE. Shadow Puppet will not activate her second Signature Ability if she dies from Immoral Fiber's first Signature Ability. Double's Transmutation ability works while time is frozen. This can happen if Double "kills" Shadow Puppet with a grab and immediately blocks before time freezes. Shortly after time freezes, there's a split second where it unfreezes (which happens when Fukua is getting up after a knockdown). This can be abused by queuing up a Blockbuster right after a normal attack triggers the time stop, as it will start up the Blockbuster in that split second, giving the player character invincibility frames for the rest of the time stop and preventing Shadow Puppet from using Blockbusters herself. If Heart of Darkness steals Shadow Puppet's Signature Ability and uses Catellite Lives while time is frozen, the cat heads will enter the screen and then become frozen. This restarts time for about 1 frame before freezing again.

Shear Force.name: Shear Force
Shear Force.sa1: When either Fighter suffers a DEBUFF, gain 10% BLOCKBUSTER METER and gain BLESSING and AUTO-BLOCK for 10/12/15 seconds each.
Shear Force.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, inflict QUIETUS for 15 seconds and deal 10/12/15% bonus damage per BUFF applied to Filia. Also opponents defeated by BLOCKBUSTERS cannot be revived.

role_strategy: Shear Force is an offensive fighter that prevents revivals using BLOCKBUSTERS and deals extra damage for each BUFF applied to her. She gains BLOCKBUSTER METER, BLESSING and AUTO-BLOCK when she or the opponent suffers a DEBUFF.

Shear Force can inflict a significant amount of DEBUFFS and subsequently gain BUFFS and BLOCKBUSTER METER with Filia's base kit, with easy access to BLEED from RINGLET SPIKE and GREGOR SAMSON, as well as ARMOR BREAK and CRIPPLE on WIDOW'S PEAK.

She also inflicts QUIETUS when using Blockbuster, which grants her more BUFFS and increases her damage further. QUIETUS also allows her to easily counter BUFFS such as FINAL STAND and BLESSING, while also ignoring the opponents' resistance to ensure that she she can inflict more DEBUFFS.

Because of Shear Force's low base attack stat, she relies heavily on BUFFS to deal damage. Supports like Surgeon General, Pickle Baller and Starlight Rose that grant BUFFS would help Shear Force deal more damage. You can also use Dim Sum Delivery or other Guest Stars to get more BUFFS. This reliance on BUFFS makes opponents like Unholy Host and Dark Might with easy access to CURSE or BUFF removal one of the main weaknesses of Shear Force, severely decreasing her damage output. As Shear Force gets her own BUFFS and BLOCKBUSTER METER by inflicting DEBUFFS, opponents with IMMUNITY like Dream Band are among her other natural weaknesses.

Sheltered.name: Sheltered

Sheltered.sa2: On CRITICAL HIT, gain ENRAGE for 5/6/7 seconds.

role_strategy: Sheltered is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability revolving around critical hits. She has an inherent ability to increase the Crit Rate of hers and teammates, providing her a supportive role as well. On her own, Sheltered is a formidable attacker that can easily gain multiple stacks of ENRAGE with her critical hits, allowing her to deal serious damage against tough defenders despite her weak Bronze stats.

As a support, Sheltered raises the Crit Rate of her entire team, which is excellent for variants that rely on critical hits such as Freaky Friday and Bad Ms Frosty. Do be aware that some defenders punish strategies that rely on crits such as Painwheel and Galactic Glamour.

Silent Kill.name: Silent Kill
Silent Kill.sa1: 15/20/25% chance on HIT to REMOVE all DEBUFFS from self.
Silent Kill.sa2: 15/20/25% chance on HIT to REMOVE all opponent BUFFS.

role_strategy: Silent Kill is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that removes BUFFS from opponents and DEBUFFS from herself, allowing her to act as a cleanser while being immune to a majority of DEBUFFS. This makes her an amazing fighter that is highly sought after in high rank play for BUFF control.
Marquee Ability: ICU is the recommended Marquee Ability to provide Silent Kill easy access to healing which synergizes very well with her Signature Ability that removes all DEBUFFS on herself.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Silent Kill is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

rift_battles: Silent Kill excels in Rift Battles where BUFFS are common from modifiers and catalysts. Due to her Signature Ability, Silent Kill has the versatility to handle common defensive teams such as Blue Screen with Frost Armor and Dread Locks with Last Words just by simply playing normally and chaining combos.

Sketchy.name: Sketchy
Sketchy.sa1: While Peacock is alive, all teammates TAG IN with HASTE and IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds (except after teammate death).
Sketchy.sa2: While Peacock is alive, all opponents TAG IN with SLOW and CURSE for 5/7/10 seconds (except after teammate death).

role_strategy: Sketchy is a support fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around granting BUFFS when teammates TAG IN and inflicting DEBUFFS when opponents TAG IN.

Sketchy makes it very easy for teammates to gain IMMUNITY and inflict CURSE by using a single OUTTAKE. This makes Sketchy a very good support fighter to use in Prize Fights and Rifts to counter certain modifiers.
Marquee Ability: As a support fighter, CAST PARTY is the recommended Marquee Ability for Sketchy to support teammates with a chance of unblockable TAG INS.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Sketchy is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by enemies.

Snake Bite.name: Snake Bite
Snake Bite.sa1: Gain 1/2/3 stacks of EVASION and 25% BLOCKBUSTER METER when activating HYPE MODE.
Snake Bite.sa2: Gain permanent HASTE and 3/4/5 stacks of BARRIER when defeating an opponent while in HYPE MODE.

role_strategy: Snake Bite is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants him EVASION and meter when activating HYPE MODE, allowing him to stealthily intercept enemies without fear of being intercepted. Furthermore, after defeating an opponent while in HYPE MODE, he gains permanent HASTE and stacks of BARRIER which, respectively, allow him to charge his blockbuster meter quicker, and make it more difficult to take him down.

It is recommended to gain HYPE MODE as soon as possible to gain EVASION. At the start of the match, quickly THROW the opponent to gain one level of HYPE. WULF SHOOT is recommended to easily gain another level of HYPE while also gaining HASTE. The final level of HYPE can be obtained by a simply juggling the enemy, as the last hit from Beowulf's air juggle is a THROW. Once EVASION stacks are up, Snake Bite can easily sneak up to enemies while they are dashing to start a combo without fear of getting punished. With the highest ATK stat of all Beowulf's, this allows him to deal significant damage against defending teams while maintaining a full health by evading attacks.

Once EVASION stacks are up, Snake Bite can easily sneak up to enemies while they are dashing to start a combo without fear of getting punished. With the highest ATK stat of all Beowulf's, this allows him to deal significant damage against defending teams while maintaining a full health by evading attacks.

Blockbusters such as GEATISH TREPAK and LUPINE PUMMEL are highly recommended to be used as they can bypass blocking, making it easier for Snake Bite to continually deal damage to the opponent without retaliation.
Due to his easy access to BARRIER, Snake Bite is best paired with Starlight Rose, who gives enrage to further increase his damage output.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability and will help keep Snake Bite on the upper hand as he deals damage.

Snake Charmer.name: Snake Charmer
Snake Charmer.sa1: Using a SPECIAL MOVE grants 10/15/20% MORTUARY CHARGE and inflicts IMMOBILIZE and DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS for 10 seconds each. When becoming fully CHARGED, also gain ENRAGE.
Snake Charmer.sa2: When using a MORTUARY CHARGE, all teammates gain 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER every second and permanent ENRAGE for the rest of the match.

role_strategy: Snake Charmer is an offensive and setup support fighter with the ability to lock opponents in place without BLOCKBUSTERS through her SPECIAL MOVES. Furthermore, using a MORTUARY CHARGE provides a teamwide support in offense through meter and permanent ENRAGE.

Snake Charmer is able to quickly build up MORTUARY CHARGES by using various SPECIAL MOVES in her arsenal. This gives her fixed intervals of MORTUARY CHARGE, while also helping her lock the opponent in place with IMMOBILIZE so she cannot be punished for randomly attacking the air. She also DISABLES BLOCKBUSTERS, preventing sudden attacks by the opponent like a TIER 3 BLOCKBUSTER. Some characters have access to SPECIAL MOVES that allow them to hit from very far distances (like Robo-Fortune and Peacock), and thus need to be looked out for while aiming for a MORTUARY CHARGE while the opponent is IMMOBILIZED.

The single stack of ENRAGE helps her Attack stat be on par with other offensive Maries like Grin Reaper (only 400 less attack if both are level 60 Diamond). This allows her to deal significant damage and also charge her blockbusters faster. This is complemented by her first Signature Ability that passively increases the rate of accumulating STAR POWER. Do take note that the permanent BUFFS are not truly "permanent" and will be removed when exiting STAR POWER. Solid Gold.name: Solid Gold
Solid Gold.sa1: Every 15 seconds, permanently increase Attack by 25/30/35% and Crit Rate by 10/15/20% (even while benched).
Solid Gold.sa2: When either Fighter lands a CRITICAL HIT, 30/40/50% chance to gain ENRAGE and BLESSING for 10 seconds each.

While she has to wait in order to get to her full potential, Solid Gold's peak in terms of raw damage output is very high for her rarity. Even outside of her gradual attack increase she's very likely to receive 5 Enrage stacks while comboing due to her second Signature Ability. However, this is at the cost of her base Atk stat, which is tied for the lowest in the gold Peacock pool with Untouchable. As a result, while her peak is still high, she requires a combo to really get her damage going and even longer to truly reach the peak. Soul Crusher.sa1: Gain DEADEYE and inflict GUARD BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds each whenever the opponent gains a BUFF.
Soul Crusher.sa2: Deal 5/7/10% bonus damage for each BUFF or DEBUFF applied to the opponent.

role_strategy: Soul Crusher is an offensive fighter that benefits from the opponent having BUFFS. Gaining DEADEYE and inflicting GUARD BREAK is nothing new, since Black Dahlia has access to these in her moves and abilities. However, Soul Crusher gains an increase in damage the more BUFFS or DEBUFFS are applied to the opponent, making her a reliable counter against BUFF-heavy defenders.

Black Dahlia has a lot of different DEBUFFS that can be applied to the opponent, allowing Soul Crusher to deal significant damage even against defenders that do not rely on BUFFS. A list of DEBUFFS includes: DEATH MARK from Prestige Ability and BURST GUARD BREAK from Signature Ability and STAGE HAZARD IMMOBILIZE and DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS from MEDICI MOUSETRAP ARMOR BREAK from Marquee Ability and DOOR MAT CURSE from EMPOWER
DEATH MARK from Prestige Ability and BURST
GUARD BREAK from Signature Ability and STAGE HAZARD
IMMOBILIZE and DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS from MEDICI MOUSETRAP
ARMOR BREAK from Marquee Ability and DOOR MAT
CURSE from EMPOWER

A recommended set of moves to use with Soul Crusher includes STAGE HAZARD, inflicting multiple stacks of GUARD BREAK alongside her Signature Ability, DOOR MAT, an easy blockbuster to use that also inflicts ARMOR BREAK, MEDICI MOUSETRAP, which inflicts two DEBUFFS at once for extra bonus damage, and PARTING GIFT which deals additional damage for each DEBUFF stack on the opponent, which synergizes very well with Soul Crusher's second Signature Ability.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Soul Crusher will benefit from METAL BREAKDOWN as her Marquee Ability, increasing her damage output with ARMOR BREAK and the extra damage boost to her SPECIAL SHOTS.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Soul Crusher is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her GUARD BREAK is not resisted by enemies.

Soulbound.name: Soulbound
Soulbound.sa1: While not in STAR POWER and not benefiting from EVASION, well-timed BLOCKS grant 30/40/50% STAR POWER meter, 1/2/3 stack(s) of BARRIER, and allows Annie to EVADE all attacks for 3 seconds.
Soulbound.sa2: When activating STAR POWER, sacrifice 35% of MAX HEALTH to gain DEADEYE for 10/12/15 seconds. While in STAR POWER, BENCHED opponents suffer HEX and ALL opponents lose 1/2/3% HEALTH every second.

role_strategy: Soulbound is an offensive Annie focusing on rewarding skill with well-timed BLOCKS for safety with BARRIER & EVASION and retaliating with all enemies taking damage over time and off-field variant abilities being disabled from HEX.

Soulbound's first Signature Ability focuses on playing skillfully to provide the safety she requires to use her second Signature Ability. The well-timed BLOCKS prevent enemies from attacking Annie for the next 3 seconds thanks to the EVASION, while also providing STAR POWER and BARRIER. This Ability is focused as a setup strategy to enable the second Signature Ability. Despite that, the BARRIER and EVASION she gains helps her play riskier against the opponent, only needing to BLOCK once before starting her own combo immediately after.

Soulbound's second Signature Ability focuses on the main offensive power that she provides. When activating STAR POWER, she'll sacrifice 35% of her MAX HEALTH but gain DEADEYE as another form of safety against enemy BUFF. On top of this, she'll also be able to do damage over time to all enemies both on and off-field. This damage can chip at the enemy's health quickly, aiding Soulbound to kill each opponent faster as they tag in with less health from before. While she does sacrifice 35% of her MAX HEALTH, the BARRIER she gains beforehand will help absorb a majority of the damage it would otherwise deal to Soulbound. Using SAGAN BEAM can also heal Soulbound to reduce risks.

While she does sacrifice 35% of her MAX HEALTH, the BARRIER she gains beforehand will help absorb a majority of the damage it would otherwise deal to Soulbound. Using SAGAN BEAM can also heal Soulbound to reduce risks.

Soulbound's second Signature Ability also inflicts HEX on off-field opponents. This disables any off-field support abilities that could passively work off-field such as Megalomaniac's ARMOR and EVASION gain, Dark Might inflicting permanent CURSE and POWER SURGE, Evergreen Evil's 5 second buff extension & Meter Gain, Rose Tinted's DEBUFF cleanse, THORNS & BARRIER, or Model Leader's DEBUFF cleanse, ARMOR & ENRAGE. While not many defensive variants do have abilities that work off-field, Soulbound is now an effective counter to these type of defenders without relying on an OUTTAKE to take them down first.
Marquee Ability: Soulbound will benefit from RED SHIFT to further increase her damage output easily through subsequent uses of BLOCKBUSTERS and SPECIAL MOVES.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Soulbound is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: This variant does not need any Special Investment, but players may choose to invest in HP to get the most use out of her BARRIER.

Souls Sister.name: Souls Sister
Souls Sister.sa1: Gain 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second while far away from the opponent.
Souls Sister.sa2: Gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds when landing a HIT while far away from the opponent.

role_strategy: Souls Sister is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her meter and stacks of ENRAGE when attacking the opponent from a distance. This allows her to dish out significant damage while keeping her far from harm's way.

Souls Sister will have to make use of Fukua's access to long distance projectiles to fully make use of her Signature Ability. Special moves and blockbusters such as LOVE DART, LOBS OF LOVE (unblockable) and GOODNIGHT KISS is particularly recommended to hit opponents from afar. However, moves such as LOBS OF LOVE have a very long range and small hitbox, making it easily avoidable by the opponent. It is best to use the move while the opponent is trying to get back up after getting knocked down.

However, moves such as LOBS OF LOVE have a very long range and small hitbox, making it easily avoidable by the opponent. It is best to use the move while the opponent is trying to get back up after getting knocked down.

Given the aggressiveness of the AI, players will have to devise ways to safely provide distance to activate her Signature Abilities. Fukua's dash attack and unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster, TWICE SHY, is particularly effective to push the opponent to the far end of the stage and provide the needed distance.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activates when a certain percentage of health is lost, which is unfavorable when used offensively. Players who are proficient at Fukua will have ways to minimize damage as much as possible and avoid getting hit. Hence, it really does not matter which Marquee Ability is chosen for Souls Sister. SPECTRAL SPITE increases her damage output at low health, while WRAITH'S WRATH may allow her to survive fatal attacks.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Rough Copy is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow Soul Sisters to deal more damage.

Space Case.name: Space Case
Space Case.sa1: While RAVENOUS, inflict DOOM for 15 seconds when an opponent's HEALTH drops below 25/35/50%. DOOM is removed if Umbrella TAGS OUT or is defeated.
Space Case.sa2: When defeating an opponent, gain 3 stacks of PRECISION and 3 stacks of a BUFF determined by the opponent's ELEMENT for 10/12/15 seconds.

role_strategy: Space Case is an offensive fighter with the ability to inflict DOOM when the opponent's health drops below a certain threshold. When an opponent is defeated, Space Case will gain stacks of PRECISION and stacks of a BUFF determined by the opponent's element, which can be any of a mix of offensive and defensive BUFFS. The ability to inflict DOOM easily makes Space Case a strong offensive fighter that can potentially snowball fights.

Space Case needs to be in RAVENOUS to inflict DOOM, which can easily be achieved through a combination of combo routes that uses BOBBLIN' BUBBLE or ACID REFLUX among many others. Tapping onto the HUNGER METER icon will also produce a BUBBLE projectile, reducing the meter towards RAVENOUS. THROW moves will fill the meter up and out of the RAVENOUS state, and are therefore not recommended. WISH MAKER is a special move that DISABLES TAG INS, allowing Space Case to trap the opponent long enough for DOOM to activate.
WISH MAKER is a special move that DISABLES TAG INS, allowing Space Case to trap the opponent long enough for DOOM to activate.

Given Umbrella's long combo chains and access to THROW-based blockbusters and moves, there are not a lot of moves that can reliably use the PRECISION stacks from her ability. SLURP 'N' SLIDE is the only notable one-hit special move that deals massive damage while also inflicting ARMOR BREAK for increased damage afterwards.

Most of the BUFFS that Space Case obtains are defensive BUFFS that serves a safety net for a few seconds. The only notable BUFF for offensive use is ENRAGE, which further bolsters Space Case's offensive attributes to snowball the remaining fighters more easily.
Marquee Ability: BITTER END is the recommended Marquee Ability for Space Case, as it allows her to survive longer in the match by having a FINAL STAND and HEAVY REGEN safety net.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Space Case is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DOOM is not resisted by defenders.

Spell-Bent.name: Spell-Bent
Spell-Bent.sa1: SKELETAL SUMMON MOVES grant either REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds or BARRIER.
Spell-Bent.sa2: While benefiting from REGEN and BARRIER, HITS from SKELETAL SUMMONS deal an additional 1/1.5/2% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH and DRAIN 3% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Spell-Bent is an offensive fighter who utilizes SKELETAL SUMMONS to gain defensive BUFFS for increased survivability. Her offensive strength comes from her second Signature Ability, which enables SKELETAL SUMMONS to deal percentage-based damage to the opponent's max health and drain their meter. This enables her to deal significant damage to tough defenders, despite having a below average ATK stat.

To maximize her abilities, equip multi-hit SKELETAL SUMMONS like HILGARD'S HOWL, HOP TO IT, and REPETITIVE SKELETON IMPACT to trigger her second Signature Ability multiple times. HOP TO IT is a special move that is especially effective in the corner, where it can quickly take a large portion of the opponent's health
HOP TO IT is a special move that is especially effective in the corner, where it can quickly take a large portion of the opponent's health

Spell-Bent can be paired with support variants that utilize BARRIER, such as Starlight Rose, Maid of Honor and Noble Mogul. These three variants are noteworthy because they can provide additional damage bonus to make up for Spell-Bent's below average ATK.

Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Spell-Bent is IMPROVED INCINERATION to increase her damage output through a timeless stack of ENRAGE and extra blockbuster meter. Due to the nature of her signature Ability, it is recommended that players build Spell-Bent as a Critless variant.
Due to the nature of her signature Ability, it is recommended that players build Spell-Bent as a Critless variant.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Spell-Bent is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant, but players can choose to build HP to take the most use out of her BARRIER.

Splitting Image.name: Splitting Image
Splitting Image.sa1: While HEALTH% is lower than the opponent's, gain permanent IMMUNITY and recover 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second.
Splitting Image.sa2: Gain 5% BLOCKBUSTER METER and 1 stack of PRECISION after every 5/4/3 seconds while facing a Fukua, Filia, or a Light Element opponent.

role_strategy: Splitting Image is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that provides her with permanent IMMUNITY and recovery while her health is lower than the opponent. This makes her a very strong defensive fighter that can be very difficult to take down without using offensive fighters with substantial damage output. Furthermore, Splitting Image has a secondary Signature Ability that grants her meter and stacks of PRECISION when facing against certain opponents, which may be useful against certain matchups.

Splitting Image's first passive Signature Ability makes her immune to common BLEED strategies and DEBUFF spam via the CHAOS Marquee Ability. Her passive recovery is very strong, as it can potentially make her unkillable with enough investment or health bonus modifiers in high Prize Fight streaks. Players will have to use offensive fighters with high damage output such as Primed to reliably take her down. Splitting Image can still be inflicted with CURSE or HEX to prevent her permanent IMMUNITY by using a fighter with a lower health, however, once CURSE or HEX end and Splitting is at lower health than the opponent, she will immediately receive her permanent IMMUNITY.

Splitting Image can still be inflicted with CURSE or HEX to prevent her permanent IMMUNITY by using a fighter with a lower health, however, once CURSE or HEX end and Splitting is at lower health than the opponent, she will immediately receive her permanent IMMUNITY.
Like most defensive Fukua fighters, it is recommended to equip blockbusters such as INEVITABLE SNUGGLE and TWICE SHY, which is able to regain back some health depending on the damage dealt.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activates when a certain percentage of health is lost, which will often happen when used defensively. WRAITH'S WRATH is the recommended Marquee Ability for Splitting Image to increase her survivability, which may allow her to survive fatal attacks.
stat_investment: General Investment: If used on offense, Splitting Image is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. On defense, she should be built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: When used on offense, Crit Damage will allow her to deal through her stacks of PRECISION.
rift_battles: As a LIGHT element fighter, Splitting Image has access to very strong catalysts such as Last Words and Light Weight which, combined with her passive IMMUNITY and recovery, can make her difficult to take down. The Catalyst Final Fight also works very well with her passive recovery to delay her death as long as possible and reduce the amount of points that players can get.

Splitting Image is also used as a niche counter against some solo defenders like Shadow Puppet or Assassin’s Greed in Rift due to her Second Signature Ability and its synergy with the Tier 3 Blockbuster, Twice Shy. By taking time to accumulate meter and PRECISION, Splitting Image is able to safely defeat variants like Shadow Puppet without activating the Time Stop mechanic, while also being at full health thanks to the Tier 3 Blockbuster. Furthermore, she can also use Inevitable Snuggle if the catalyst Final Fight is active, allowing Splitting Image to not use her PRECISION, before timing and defeating the opponent with Twice Shy as FINAL STAND is about to expire. While niche in rift, this is important at higher tiers of gameplay since it has high odds of receiving the maximum Health Points and a Blockbuster finisher, minimizing the odds of being Revenged in Rift.

Stage Fright.name: Stage Fright
Stage Fright.sa1: The opponent suffers CURSE and HEX for 10/12/15 seconds when dropping below 25% HEALTH.
Stage Fright.sa2: Inflict a 30/25/20 second DOOM when defeated with a BLOCKBUSTER.

role_strategy: Stage Fright is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that can inflict CURSE and HEX on the opponent when their health drops below 25%. On top of that, she punishes the use of blockbusters by inflicting DOOM on the culprit on death. The combination of these abilities make Stage Fright a good budget option against defensive variants with on-death abilities such as Immoral Fiber. Lackluster stats as a Bronze can make it harder for Stage Fright to reduce the opponent's health below 25%. It is recommended to use stronger variants to bring down the health of the opponent slightly above 25% before switching to Stage Fright for her abilities. Stage Fright is best used in Rift on solo node attacks, due to her consistent HEX and CURSE combination to counter setups using the Final Fight catalyst. Furthermore, bringing her taunt, SNAKE CHARMER, can combine IMMUNITY into her move set as well, providing extra safety against the catalyst, Doomsday Device. Through this synergy, she can counter other variants like Assassin's Greed, Plot Twisted, Shadow Puppet or Death Wish on solo nodes. Do however take care of her attack due to those lackluster Bronze stats.

Lackluster stats as a Bronze can make it harder for Stage Fright to reduce the opponent's health below 25%. It is recommended to use stronger variants to bring down the health of the opponent slightly above 25% before switching to Stage Fright for her abilities.

Stage Fright is best used in Rift on solo node attacks, due to her consistent HEX and CURSE combination to counter setups using the Final Fight catalyst. Furthermore, bringing her taunt, SNAKE CHARMER, can combine IMMUNITY into her move set as well, providing extra safety against the catalyst, Doomsday Device. Through this synergy, she can counter other variants like Assassin's Greed, Plot Twisted, Shadow Puppet or Death Wish on solo nodes. Do however take care of her attack due to those lackluster Bronze stats.

Stage Fright's second Signature Ability is defensive, allowing her to inflict DOOM, which automatically defeats the opponent after a certain amount of time has passed. However, her mediocre stats as a Bronze and lack of defensive options make her easy to take down without blockbusters. It is best to use Stage Fright in offense instead by purposely allowing herself to be defeated by a blockbuster and bringing down a tough defender down with her. A Valentine with the move Forbidden Procedure equipped can allow Stage Fright to use this strategy multiple times by constantly dying and reviving, but in general it's very time-consuming and hard to pull off in a proper match.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability works with Stage Fright, since both conditions require her to be dead. EVIL DEAD can be useful on the offense to inflict both CURSE and WITHER, making it easier for the next fighter to defeat the opponent. DEAD ALIVE is better to be used defensively, providing other teammates FINAL STAND to increase the longevity of your defensive fighters and stall for time.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Stage Fright is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her debuffs aren't resisted by defenders.

Stand Out.name: Stand Out
Stand Out.sa1: 50/60/75% of all damage inflicted is regained as HEALTH as long as Eliza's health percentage is lower than her opponent's (also applies on Blocked hits).
Stand Out.sa2: When the opponent attempts to gain a BUFF, Eliza has a 25/35/50% chance to prevent it and gain 25% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Stand Out is a fighter with the ability to deny opponent's BUFFS to gain meter for herself. Furthermore, Stand Out has an inherent ability to recover health, which allows her to survive longer in fights. This combination of abilities allows her to be a strong BUFF denier which can be used both offensively and defensively. BUFF removal also affects permanent BUFFS, as Stand Out removes those BUFFS at the moment they are gained.
BUFF removal also affects permanent BUFFS, as Stand Out removes those BUFFS at the moment they are gained.

Boasting the third-highest ATK stat out of all Eliza variants, Stand Out can still bite into a fighter hard if given the chance. It also allows her first Signature Ability to heal a moderate amount of her health back if injured, although needing less health than the opponent makes it rather unreliable.

Stand Out is best used as a counter for BUFF-heavy variants like Megalomaniac, Heavy Metal, Corrosive Agent and Curl Scout. These fighters can gain BUFFS quickly which allows her to charge up her meter fast, though there is some RNG involved.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work for Stand Out as both her Signature Abilities also covers both health regeneration and meter gain. However, RITUAL SACRIFICE is generally recommended for offensive use, providing easy access to blockbusters by sacrificing a weak fighter. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH is generally recommended for defensive use, providing full health to stall for time, but is dependent on the AI TAGGING OUT. BLOOD OATH can also be used offensively as a safety-net to heal back all your health when you make a mistake by sacrificing a weak fighter. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Stand Out as a Critless Variant
Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Stand Out as a Critless Variant
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Stand Out is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: It is recommended that players don't invest in Meter Gain, as Stand Out has Meter Gain in her own Signature ability. However, when used against an opponent that might not gain a lot of buffs, Meter Gain could still be useful.

Star Child.name: Star Child
Star Child.sa1: Each HIT blocked has a 10% chance to inflict GUARD BREAK and ARMOR BREAK for 10/12/15 seconds.
Star Child.sa2: SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS deal 15/25/35% bonus damage.

role_strategy: Star Child is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around Annie's character ability and the ability to inflict GUARD BREAK and ARMOR BREAK while also increasing her BLOCKBUSTER damage. This allows her to put pressure on the opponent and deal respectable damage through her BLOCKBUSTERS.

Star Child also has a permanent damage boost to all SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS. This helps her remain a competitive early-game staple for newer players, working as an easy Annie to use with accessibly decent damage boosts. While the boosts are permanent, being a Bronze variant does hurt her long-term, and other variants able to also boost their damage will likely outshine Star Child quickly. In this way, she's a good introductory Bronze variant to use, but should be replaced when players get better at the game.

While the boosts are permanent, being a Bronze variant does hurt her long-term, and other variants able to also boost their damage will likely outshine Star Child quickly. In this way, she's a good introductory Bronze variant to use, but should be replaced when players get better at the game.

Marquee Ability: As a purely offensive variant, Star Child will benefit from RED SHIFT to further increase her damage output through subsequent uses of blockbusters and SPECIAL MOVES in her combos. Along with her second Signature Ability, this allows Star Child to deal high damage if she can pull off a combo that incorporates her SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS well.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Star Child is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting GUARD BREAK.

Star Shine.name: Star Shine
Star Shine.sa1: Gain a random BUFF for 8/10/12 seconds every 4 seconds. Also, gain 8/9/10% STAR POWER for each BUFF gained by either Fighter while not in STAR POWER MODE.
Star Shine.sa2: Remove all DEBUFFS and gain IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds and permanent PRECISION when activating STAR POWER MODE at full meter. Permanent PRECISION is removed when an opponent is defeated.

role_strategy: Star Shine is a fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to passively gain various BUFFS after a certain amount of time has passed. These BUFFS are random, excluding EVASION.
These BUFFS are random, excluding EVASION.

BENCH SUPPORT such as STARLIGHT ROSE or PICKLE BALLER greatly speed up her first activation time and are therefore highly advised to run in the back. EVERGREEN EVIL can make her keep her random BUFFS for longer.

With enough time or BUFFS gained on either side of the field, she can use her real game-altering ability by activating STAR POWER at full meter. Without any influence from bench support or the enemy's own BUFF gain, charging will take 20 seconds. With the activation, she removes all DEBUFFS (except HEX or Permanent DEBUFFS) and gains her Permanent PRECISION alongside a 12 second long IMMUNITY. As she does not benefit from anything for strictly being in STAR POWER mode, it is highly advised to strictly use STAR POWER to activate her ability and therefore turn it off rather quickly after turning it on. PRECISION is permanent and cannot be removed until an opponent is defeated. This allows Star Shine to deal significant damage by chaining long combo hits through Annie's tools without fear of activating Signature Abilities of defenders such as That's All Folks!, Immoral Fiber and Resonant Evil.

On the defense, Star Shine will have to rely primarily on her first Signature Ability for random annoying BUFFS such as UNFLINCHING, AUTO-BLOCK OR INVINCIBILITY. However, the second ability of Star Shine, while it does the same on defense, AI is less likely to use it correctly. She is easily countered by fighters that can remove BUFFS such as Silent Kill, Mean One, and Doublicious. A single OUTTAKE can also remove her BUFFS easily.
Marquee Ability: Star Shine will benefit from RED SHIFT to further increase her damage output easily through subsequent uses of BLOCKBUSTERS and SPECIAL MOVES.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Star Shine is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage. Crit Rate is an optional stat which players can choose to invest in as her PRECISION will not be used during the beginning of the match.

Star-Crossed.name: Star-Crossed
Star-Crossed.sa1: Well-timed BLOCKS STUN the opponent for 3/4/5 seconds and inflict GUARD BREAK. GUARD BREAK is removed when Parasoul TAGS OUT.
Star-Crossed.sa2: BLOCKBUSTERS deal 50/75/100% bonus damage against opponents suffering from GUARD BREAK.

role_strategy: Star-Crossed is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability revolving around inflicting STUN and GUARD BREAK when blocking an attack, which increases her blockbuster damage output significantly. The condition to STUN and inflict GUARD BREAK opponents requires a well-timed block and thus, Star-Crossed takes some skill to use effectively. However, when used correctly, Star-Crossed can deal massive amounts of damage.

A well-timed block means that the block has to occur at the precise moment when the enemy attacks. Players will rely on manipulating the opposing AI to reliably inflict STUN and GUARD BREAK on the opponent. Blocking immediately after finishing a ground combo has a high chance of being a well-timed block, since the enemy AI will assume you have failed your full combo.
Blocking immediately after finishing a ground combo has a high chance of being a well-timed block, since the enemy AI will assume you have failed your full combo.
Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Star-Crossed, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Star-Crossed is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.

Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS. Accuracy may be used so STUN and GUARD BREAK can be more easily inflicted and counter defenders with Resistance.

Star-Spangled.name: Star-Spangled
Star-Spangled.sa1: Gain BARRIER and inflict GUARD BREAK for 10/12/15 seconds each when breaking or landing a THROW.
Star-Spangled.sa2: While benefiting from BARRIER and the opponent is in the air, 15/20/25% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED and FATIGUE for 7 seconds each.

role_strategy: Star-Spangled is an offensive fighter that utilizes THROWS to gain BARRIER for survivability and GUARD BREAK to increase her aggression. Furthermore, her second Signature Ability has a chance to inflict BLEED and FATIGUE when hitting the opponent in the air, allowing her to slowly chip damage when facing against tough defenders.
Due to her access to BARRIER, Star-Spangled synergizes well with a lot of supports. Fighters like Starlight Rose and Maid of Honor will increase her damage output and survivability.

A common strategy to make use of her Signature Ability is to continually attempt to THROW the opponent. After the first attempt, the opponent will start breaking her THROWS. This leads to an easy way to inflict five stacks of GUARD BREAK while gaining five stacks of BARRIER at the same time. With Star-Spangled naturally high bulk, the BARRIER stacks provide a high amount of survivability. Players can bring Starlight Rose in the bench to provide additional support in the form of REGEN and ENRAGE for recovery and an additional boost to her damage. With GUARD BREAK, Star-Spangled can be very aggressive, forcing the opponent to the corner where she can then launch them into the air to activate her second Signature Ability. Use special moves and blockbusters such as CERECOPTER and EXCELLEBELLA that is multi-hit to increase the chances of inflicting BLEED and FATIGUE.

Special investment: Accuracy is the most important stat for Star-Spangled, as it ensures that defenders do not resist her debuffs.

Starlight Rose.name: Starlight Rose
Starlight Rose.sa1: While Annie is alive, all teammates' well-timed BLOCKS remove up to 2 DEBUFF(S) and grant BARRIER for 10/12/15 seconds.
Starlight Rose.sa2: While Annie is alive, all teammates gain ENRAGE and REGEN for 5/6/7 seconds each every 3 seconds while benefiting from BARRIER.

role_strategy: Starlight Rose is a support variant that can provide useful BUFFS for her teammates through her Signature Ability. She excels best when used offensively, as players will have greater control for well-timed BLOCKS to activate her abilities. BARRIER and REGEN are useful BUFFS to provide sustain, while ENRAGE provides increased damage output, making Starlight Rose an all-around great support variant for lots of different scenarios.
BARRIER and REGEN are useful BUFFS to provide sustain, while ENRAGE provides increased damage output, making Starlight Rose an all-around great support variant for lots of different scenarios.

The ability to remove DEBUFFS from a well-timed BLOCK allows Starlight Rose to be a very useful support to counter variants that rely on inflicting DEBUFFS such as Unholy Host and modifiers from Prize Fights or Catalysts in Rift Battles.

Starlight Rose can provide ENRAGE and REGEN with BARRIER from all sources. This means that variants that can grant BARRIER (especially timeless BARRIER) such as Corrosive Agent, Snake Bite, Feathered Edges and Overclocked can benefit from having her in the bench to provide a boost in damage and sustain, which is particularly useful in Rift Battles.

Marquee Ability: Depending on how you use her, both Marquee Abilities can be pretty useful. For offense, REDSHIFT is recommended, in case your main fighters have been defeated. For defending, BLUESHIFT is more optimal as it enhances her survivability, making her harder to be taken down.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Starlight Rose is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow her to use Blockbusters more often and punish the opponent.

Stellar Huntress.name: Stellar Huntress
Stellar Huntress.sa1: When RELOADING with 3 SHOTS or less remaining, gain 3 LIGHTNING SHOTS. LIGHTNING SHOTS DISABLE TAG INS and have a 10% chance to DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS for 10/12/15 seconds each.
Stellar Huntress.sa2: While the opponent is suffering from DISABLE TAG IN, LIGHTNING SHOTS deal 0.5/1/1.5% MAX HEALTH as bonus damage to the opponent's teammates. While the opponent is suffering from DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS, deal an additional 0.5/1/1.5% MAX HEALTH to all opponents.

role_strategy: Stellar Huntress is a Dark Gold Black Dahlia variant that specializes in reloading and using her LIGHTNING SHOTS to shut down her opponents and apply useful debuffs while also being able to inflict damage onto her benched opponents.

While she doesn’t boast a high base attack for a gold tier Dahlia nor have any direct ways of increasing her overall damage, Stellar Huntress’s 2nd Signature Ability gives her an opportunity to deal an instant 1.5% bonus damage to not only her current opponent that she faces, but also to any of her opponents' current teammates if the opponent is suffering from DISABLE TAG IN. Opponents suffering from DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS will also grant Stellar Huntress’s LIGHTNING SHOTS the ability to deal a separate 1.5% bonus damage multiplier, leading to the potential of having a 3% bonus damage multiplier total to LIGHTNING SHOTS when the opponent is suffering from both debuffs. Keep in mind the damage multiplier is based off the percentage of MAX HEALTH for all opponents, this can be quite useful against strong and HP heavy opponents, as no matter how tanky a variant might be, you’ll be able to guarantee a certain amount of damage will be applied to both them and their teammates.

Fortunately for Stellar Huntress, getting both the LIGHTNING SHOTS and debuffs needed to start up her gameplan is quite easy, as despite the fact that Stellar Huntress is a Dark Gold Dahlia, she has consistent way of gaining LIGHTNING SHOTS from her 1st Signature Ability In which reloading her chamber while having 3 SHOTS or less remaining causes her to gain her desired 3 LIGHTNING SHOTS. These SHOTS are very versatile and can be used to greatly extend Black Dahlia’s combos, as they stun the opponent in place giving her further openings to attack, set up various moves, reload, safely tag out, and many other options. Stellar Huntress’s 1st Signature Ability also grants any of these LIGHTING SHOTS the ability to inflict DISABLE TAG INS and has a 10% chance to also inflict DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS for 15 seconds each.

Putting this all together gives Stellar Huntress a simple gameplay flow consisting of gaining LIGHTNING SHOTS, using the LIGHTNING SHOTS to inflict DISABLE TAG INS and DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS, and lastly dealing significant bonus damage to the opponent and their teammates MAX HEALTH.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Stellar Huntress is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her debuffs are not resisted by enemies.

Stone Sentinel.name: Stone Sentinel
Stone Sentinel.sa1: While on Cerebella’s side of the stage, gain 40/50/60% damage reduction.
Stone Sentinel.sa2: While on the opponent’s side of the stage, the active Fighter gains 1 stack of BARRIER for 10 seconds every 10/7/5 seconds.

role_strategy: Stone Sentinel is a defensive and supportive Cerebella, taking way less damage than expected while attacking her as she cripples your damage, while also being a useful off-field BARRIER support.

Stone Sentinel is an unseemingly tanky opponent with her reducing your damage as you play more aggressively into her. Stone Sentinel is very effective at stalling the opponent during a fight with her reduced damage as she stays on her side of the field. She’ll be able to survive many attacks the longer she stays on her own side.

When facing her, there are a few ways to play around this: Using PRECISION or HEX will ignore the damage reduction that Stone Sentinel will take. Using modifiers like BLEED or MIASMA can quickly reduce her health passively since they will ignore the damage reduction entirely. DOOM will directly kill her on its activation, ignoring anything she could do. If you backdash to your own side of the stage, Cerebella will lose that damage reduction, and be much easier to brute force your way through her.
