While scary defensively however, she can also be useful offensively as an off-field support, providing BARRIER consistently to teammates for extra safety against chip or reflect damage. Furthermore, this would synergise well with supports like Rockstar or Starlight Rose who actively take advantage of active BARRIER stacks.
Marquee Ability: UPPER HAND is the better Marquee for Cerebella to deny the enemy from using Blockbusters while Stone Sentinel is unable to move
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive variant, Stone Sentinel is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: Crit Resist can be a used to avoid the likes of DESTRUCTION PILLAR or FERAL EDGE doing fixed damage against Stone Sentinel's damage reduction.

Summer Salt.name: Summer Salt
Summer Salt.sa1: Opponents lose 1 BUFF and 1/2/3% HEALTH every 2 seconds while near a TEAR.
Summer Salt.sa2: When DETONATING at least 3 TEARS at once, REMOVE all DEBUFFS and gain 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION. The detonated TEARS also deal 100% BONUS DAMAGE.

role_strategy: Summer Salt is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that is able to remove BUFFS and DEBUFFS easily through her TEARS, while gaining massive damage output from stacks of PRECISION and TEAR detonation. This combination of abilities, along with her naturally high base ATK stat, allows her to be an offensive juggernaut capable of defeating the toughest of defenders when played correctly.

BUFF removal is a very strong trait to have, allowing Summer Salt the ability to counter defensive fighters such as Heavy Metal, Resonant Evil, Blue Screen, Meow & Furever, and That's All Folks! that primarily relies on BUFFS. Furthermore, she is able to gain stacks of PRECISION, allowing her to counter on-death Signature Abilities of defenders such as Immoral Fiber, Kill Joy, and Plot Twisted. The main takeaway to Summer Salt's ability is her first Signature Ability to remove BUFFS. You can forgo her second Signature Ability by equipping special moves such as IMMUNITY TAUNT and EGRET CALL, which gives IMMUNITY to DEBUFFS and a maximum of 3 stacks of PRECISION on-demand.

The main takeaway to Summer Salt's ability is her first Signature Ability to remove BUFFS. You can forgo her second Signature Ability by equipping special moves such as IMMUNITY TAUNT and EGRET CALL, which gives IMMUNITY to DEBUFFS and a maximum of 3 stacks of PRECISION on-demand.

To maximize the use of her ability, try to push the opponent into the corner as much as possible via grabs, combos and launchers. Once in the corner, all TEARS that are spawned in a juggle will be placed within a close distance, allowing you to continually attack the opponent without fear of any defensive BUFFS.

Furthermore, equip moves that can spawn TEARS easily, such as NAPALM SHOWER and NAPALM SHOT. NAPALM TRIGGER can be useful to detonate TEARS in the middle of a combo, allowing you to gain stacks of PRECISION while also dealing massive amounts of damage to the opponent.
Marquee Ability: CRITICAL MASS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Summer Salt, as you can easily get 100% Crit Rate through moves, while Crit Damage is harder to reach 200%.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Summer Salt is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Meter Gain allow her to use Blockbusters more often.

Sundae School.name: Sundae School
Sundae School.sa1: When any teammate inflicts a DEBUFF (excluding STUN), increase its duration by 1/2/3 second(s).
Sundae School.sa2: When any teammate suffers a DEBUFF (excluding STUN), reduce its duration by 1/2/3 second(s).

role_strategy: Sundae School is a support fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around DEBUFFS. She increases the duration of DEBUFFS inflicted to the opponent, while reducing the duration of DEBUFFS that are suffered by teammates and herself.

Sundae School is best suited in a team with fighters that apply deadly DEBUFFS, such as BLEED, to the enemy team by extending them by 3 seconds. Some examples of fighters that inflict BLEED are Bad Hair Day Filia and Rusty Painwheel. She's also a good fit in fights that feature a lot of timed debuffs, where she'll shave off the debuff timers by 3 seconds.
She's also a good fit in fights that feature a lot of timed debuffs, where she'll shave off the debuff timers by 3 seconds.
Marquee Ability: Sundae School will benefit from choosing CHAOS as a Marquee Ability, helping her wear down her opponent with DEBUFFS, which are enhanced by her Signature Ability.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Sundae School is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Due to her very fragile nature, players can build HP or Block Proficiency on her to increase her survivability.

Superluminal.name: Superluminal
Superluminal.sa1: While Valentine is alive, the active Fighter’s SPECIAL MOVE COOLDOWNS recharge 70/85/100% faster while dashing or back-dashing. Successful DASH ATTACKS instantly refresh TAG INS.
Superluminal.sa2: While Valentine is alive, the active Fighter’s first SPECIAL MOVE HIT of a combo grants all teammates EVASION and the first BLOCKBUSTER HIT grants all teammates HASTE for 5/6/7 seconds each.

role_strategy: Superluminal is an offensive support based Valentine who rewards constant dashing and quick-swap synergies with HASTE and EVASION for off-field teammates.

Superluminal focuses on high pressure setups, since she decreases move cooldown to enable more combos more often, but only whilst you're dashing. This pairs incredibly well with the likes of Filia or Ms. Fortune who tend to use their high dash and backdash speed, while spamming high damage SPECIAL MOVES like RINGLET SPIKE and EL GATO respectively. Players using Superluminal will need to be careful of when they decrease their move cooldown, since without buffs like EVASION or UNFLINCHING, players may accidentally run head first into an enemy combo.

While there is danger horsing around and running amok for moves, she can also give EVASION when using a SPECIAL MOVE within a combo. With the EVASION that she provides, she enables safe tag-ins that can then push deadly combos afterward. Variants like Windswept or Rogue Agent could more safely tag in and actively use their abilities more easily. HASTE is also useful however to build faster BLOCKBUSTERS combos to grant more EVASION later, or just output more damage.
Marquee Ability: As a support-focused Valentine, TRAUMA CENTER is the recommended Marquee Ability for Superluminal so she can provide further support and safety.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Superluminal is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Surgeon General.name: Surgeon General
Surgeon General.sa1: While Valentine is alive, she gains a permanent ENRAGE every 60/45/30 seconds.
Surgeon General.sa2: While Valentine is alive, teammates gain IMMUNITY and HEAVY REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds every 30 seconds.

role_strategy: Surgeon General is an offensive support fighter with a Signature Ability that grants teammates IMMUNITY and HEAVY REGEN while granting her permanent ENRAGE every 30 seconds. With one of the highest base ATK stat of all Valentines, Surgeon General is capable of dishing significant damage while supporting teammates with two powerful BUFFS to keep them alive. This makes her one of the best fighters to have in the game as a crucial support fighter seen in most high rank play. It must be noted that she must remain alive (fighting or benched) in order for the BUFFS to take place.
It must be noted that she must remain alive (fighting or benched) in order for the BUFFS to take place.

On the offense, Surgeon General can support teammates while being fully capable of dealing with enemies by herself through pure raw damage. Defensively, Surgeon General provides two very strong BUFFS which grants healing and IMMUNITY to any DEBUFFS. This makes her easily splashable into any teams, especially defenders which primarily relies on BUFFS such as Armed Forces and Heavy Metal.
Marquee Ability: As an offensive support Valentine, TRAUMA CENTER is the recommended Marquee Ability for Surgeon General.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Surgeon General is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Temple Tyrant.name: Temple Tyrant
Temple Tyrant.sa1: Double's THROWS grant ARMOR for 20 seconds and remove 1/2/3 DEBUFFS from herself.
Temple Tyrant.sa2: When the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN after a THROW, inflict STUN for 4 seconds. DRAIN 2/3/4% HEALTH per second from STUNNED opponents.

role_strategy: Temple Tyrant is a fighter with a Signature Ability that grants amplifies her THROWS, granting defensive utility through HP DRAIN and ARMOR, while STUNNING enemies if the throw completes. While you don't need to roll for ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGES anymore for healing and debuff removal, a throw may be more finite of a resource to leverage.

Despite having a throw-based SA, Double has 0 moves that proc her SA. BEAST OF GEHENNA and GUN BLADES are NOT considered throw attacks. If the AI suffers enough throws, they will continuously break the throw making Temple Tyrant lose out on SA2 value. Throw only when you need to.

Temple Tyrant can be a useful fighter to use against fighters that can easily inflict DEBUFFS such as Sawed Apart, Blood Drive, Fatal Fray, and Purrfect Dark.
Marquee Ability: Temple Tyrant will rely completely on CHAOS as a Marquee Ability to wear opponents down via DEBUFFS such as ARMOR BREAK, DEATH MARK and BLEED when used offensively.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Temple Tyrant is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Due to her very fragile nature, players can build HP or Block Proficiency on her to increase her survivability.

Terror Byte.name: Terror Byte
Terror Byte.sa1: HEADRONE HITS (includes blocked hits) inflict INVERSE POLARITY and DISABLE opponent SPECIAL MOVES for 10/12/15 seconds each.
Terror Byte.sa2: While near an opponent suffering from a DEBUFF, both fighters gain 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second.

role_strategy: Terror Byte is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves INVERSE POLARITY and utilizing a mechanic of constant healing, while also applying SPECIAL DISABLE. Terror Byte acts to control and manage health where applying any debuff to the enemy will heal not only herself, but the enemy too. She rewards a high-risk, high-reward playstyle where managing INVERSE POLARITY will passively lower enemy health while gaining her own like a drain, but inflicting other debuffs would backfire and benefit the enemy more than Terror Byte herself. Terror Byte applies INVERSE POLARITY using HEADRONE hits, which can be gained safely while afar or if the enemy is knocked down. However, be careful of how many you gain at once since they leave you open to be attacked.

Terror Byte applies INVERSE POLARITY using HEADRONE hits, which can be gained safely while afar or if the enemy is knocked down. However, be careful of how many you gain at once since they leave you open to be attacked.

INVERSE POLARITY is a rare DEBUFF that is not accessible to most fighters. This allows Terror Byte to have a niche against defenders that gain REGEN easily, most notably Valentine variants with the ICU Marquee Ability or Black Dahlia variants with NO TIME TO DIE Marquee Ability.
Applying SPECIAL DISABLE benefits Terror Byte to be less afraid of enemy BURSTS, and can extend for long combos to maximize the healing and inverse she will continuously apply

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Terror Byte is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

That's All Folks!.name: That's All Folks!
That's All Folks!.sa1: 15% chance when HIT to inflict ARMOR BREAK for 10 seconds and grant 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION and 1 stack of EVASION.
That's All Folks!.sa2: While Peacock is alive, opponents have 50/60/75% reduced CRIT RATE.

role_strategy: That's All Folks! is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her EVASION and stacks of PRECISION while also inflicting ARMOR BREAK to the opponent. This makes her a very dangerous "slippery" character to fight against, as EVASION can proc in the middle of a combo, allowing her to counterattack and punish you with a guaranteed critical hit from PRECISION. Her second Signature Ability further solidifies her defensive role by reducing the opponent's crit rate, making it difficult for fighters that rely on crit rate, such as Double with the CHAOS Marquee Ability and Parasoul to fight. However, it's also a double-edged sword for any Painwheel with a Marquee Ability the player might want to team up with her, as That's All Folks will make it drastically harder for her to trigger her Marquee Ability when hit.

Using characters with relatively low hit count such as Cerebella and Beowulf are recommended to decrease the chances of activating her ability while still doing some damage. Furthermore, these characters have special moves that bypass blocking, such as MERRY GO-RILLA and WULF SHOOT.

When facing That's All Folks!, it is recommended to use fighters that can inflict CURSE such as Purrfect Dark and Shadow Ops or HEX to completely disable her Signature Ability such as Red Velvet to prevent her from gaining her BUFFS.
Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for That's All Folks!, as it provides a chance for all Special Moves to reset immediately.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Peacock, That's All Folks! is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating.

Thrill Shrieker.name: Thrill Shrieker
Thrill Shrieker.sa1: 50/75/100% chance to gain ENRAGE when gaining a DRAGON CHARGE. Each ENRAGE is removed when a charge is spent.
Thrill Shrieker.sa2: The opponent suffers damage equal to 25/35/50% of their current HEALTH when tagging out while Squigly has ENRAGE.

role_strategy: Thrill Shrieker is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to gain timeless ENRAGE for every DRAGON CHARGE. However, the highlight to her abilities is her second Signature Ability that allows her to automatically reduce up to 50% of the opponent's health from a single OUTTAKE while she has ENRAGE. This allows her to defeat the strongest defenders such as Heavy Metal and Brain Freeze without much effort by continually spamming OUTTAKE, as long as she can maintain her ENRAGE.

While Thrill Shrieker can gain ENRAGE by gaining DRAGON CHARGE, her second Signature Ability simply relies on her benefitting from ENRAGE. Hence, using support fighters that can grant ENRAGE to her, such as Rerun or Oh Mai are also an option.

It is recommended to equip more than one BASSO BUFFO to allow her to keep using OUTTAKE on the opponent. Furthermore, pair her up with Harlequin which reduces the cooldown of special moves to easily spam OUTTAKES and reduce the opponent's health.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability works with Thrill Shrieker, since both conditions require her to be dead. EVIL DEAD can be useful on the offense to inflict both CURSE and WITHER, making it easier for the next fighter to defeat opponents. DEAD ALIVE is better to be used defensively, providing other teammates FINAL STAND to increase the longevity of your defensive fighters and stall for time.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Thrill Shrieker is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Building Crit Rate and Crit Damage will further increase her damage potential.

Tidal Traveler.name: Tidal Traveler
Tidal Traveler.sa1: Puddle HITS grant IMMUNITY for 10/12/15 seconds.
Tidal Traveler.sa2: While benefitting from IMMUNITY, BUBBLE attacks deal 25/35/50% bonus damage. Also DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS and inflict ARMOR BREAK for 15 seconds each (also applies on blocked hits).

role_strategy: Tidal Traveler is an offensive fighter that utilizes PUDDLE HITS to gain IMMUNITY. BUBBLE attacks are empowered and inflicts ARMOR BREAK and DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS, allowing Tidal Traveler to dish out respectable damage consistently. Access to IMMUNITY is a unique feature of Tidal Traveler that is not shared with other Umbrella variants.
Access to IMMUNITY is a unique feature of Tidal Traveler that is not shared with other Umbrella variants.

Tidal Traveler will require moves that can setup PUDDLES such as WISH MAKER, BOBBLIN' BUBBLE, ACID REFLUX and UNDER THE WEATHER. These special moves and blockbusters are recommended as they can easily set up PUDDLES in a simple combo. An easy way to use her ability is to equip multiple BOBBLIN' BUBBLE and a TONGUE TWISTER. Push the opponent to the corner and spam bubble attacks to deal damage to the opponent. TONGUE TWISTER is used to reset combo chains, allowing you to repeat spamming bubble attacks again.

An easy way to use her ability is to equip multiple BOBBLIN' BUBBLE and a TONGUE TWISTER. Push the opponent to the corner and spam bubble attacks to deal damage to the opponent. TONGUE TWISTER is used to reset combo chains, allowing you to repeat spamming bubble attacks again.

While BUBBLE attacks and other moves that produce puddles lower Umbrella's Hungern meter and therefore lower her damage output, with salt grinder and tongue twister you are able to be overstuffed for most of your BUBBLE attack hits (namely, Bobblin' Bubble). It is not advised to play the long combo game with her.
Marquee Ability: BITTER END is the recommended Marquee Ability for Tidal Traveler, as it allows her to survive longer in the match by having a FINAL STAND and HEAVY REGEN safety net.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Tidal Traveler is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by enemies.

Time Thief.name: Time Thief
Time Thief.sa1: When landing a HIT while throwing her head, Ms. Fortune gains HASTE for 10 seconds and deals damage equal to 50/75/100% of her ATTACK.
Time Thief.sa2: 50/75/100% of the damage suffered while in HEADLESS MODE is regained when Ms. Fortune recalls her head.

role_strategy: Time Thief is an offensive fighter who regains health in headless mode by recalling her head. Her Signature Ability grants HASTE and deals damage based on her attack when throwing her head, encouraging players to switch between headless mode for healing and dealing damage.

Time Thief's ability to regain health back is invaluable when fighting against defenders that can reflect damage such as Dread Locks and defenders that can gain THORNS such as Plot Twisted, Megasonic, Criminal Mind and Rose-Tinted.
Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Time Thief is BOOP to gain stacks of ENRAGE and further increase her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Time Thief is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Meter Gain should be completely avoided due to her access to HASTE.

Timeless Hero.name: Timeless Hero
Timeless Hero.sa1: Gain ENRAGE, AUTO-BLOCK or REGEN every 30/25/20 COMBO HITS. These BUFFs are removed when suffering a HIT.
Timeless Hero.sa2: Once per match when obtaining all of the above BUFFS, gain 50/75/100% BLOCKBUSTER METER and infinite STAR POWER.

role_strategy: Timeless Hero is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her timeless BUFFS depending on combo count thresholds, which can be easily reached with the right moves. When all three different BUFFS are obtained, Timeless Hero gains infinite STAR POWER and maximum blockbuster meter to deal a significant amount of damage as she gains a massive boost in damage and combo potential from STAR POWER mode. The BUFF that Timeless Hero can obtain are ENRAGE, AUTO-BLOCK and REGEN, which when obtained can increase her damage output while also sustaining herself in a fight and recovering from chip damage.
The BUFF that Timeless Hero can obtain are ENRAGE, AUTO-BLOCK and REGEN, which when obtained can increase her damage output while also sustaining herself in a fight and recovering from chip damage.

There is a bit of RNG involved in order to obtain all three BUFFS and players may find themselves having multiple stacks of one BUFF but not the other. It may be beneficial to bring support fighters such as Surgeon General for HEAVY REGEN and equip special moves such as REFLECTION NEBULA and RE-ENTRY for AUTO-BLOCK and ENRAGE respectively. Fighters such as Icy Hot, Rerun and Starlight Rose can also give REGEN and ENRAGE, or both respectively.

All buffs gained through combo thresholds will be removed when Annie suffers any hit (including bursts!), promoting a more cautious play style, lest the player lose part of their DPS and survivability. Fortunately, the infinite STAR POWER stays once it's been achieved, making it much easier to gain the buffs again once lost.

Timeless Hero is the only Annie variant whose Signature Ability clashes with her Prestige Ability, due to using infinite STAR POWER not being classified as "being spent" and therefore soft locking Timeless Hero out of gaining Prestige gauge. In order to get access to her Prestige, players might have to delay doing big combos so they can fill the Prestige gauge without gaining the infinite STAR POWER.
Marquee Ability: Timeless Hero will benefit from RED SHIFT to further increase her damage output easily through subsequent uses of blockbusters and special moves.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Timeless Hero is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow her to use Blockbusters more often.

Toad Warrior.name: Toad Warrior
Toad Warrior.sa1: Gain 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second while near an opponent.
Toad Warrior.sa2: Deal 25/35/50% bonus damage while a BLOCKBUSTER is fully charged.

role_strategy: Toad Warrior is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her meter while near the opponent and increased damage output. Her ability takes advantage of Cerebella's high stats to deal massive burst damage while rewarding the player for staying next to the opponent longer, either through the use of longer combos or by knocking the opponent into the corner.

Running multiple blockbusters increases the chance of having one on standby for an increased boost in damage while also having a powerful combo finisher in the form of that blockbuster. Knowing when to use blockbusters is important for Toad Warrior as a missed or blocked blockbuster can reduce overall damage capacity.
Be wary of fighters and catalyst such as Megalomaniac, Dark Might, Wither Forecast and Blockbusted as they have inherent meter control built in or punish you for using blockbusters.
Fighting Robo-Fortune's with DDOS Marquee using Toad Warrior is also not recommended as POWER SURGE will heavily punish her and with no method of regaining HP, there's a risk of her dying.
Marquee Ability: UPPER HAND is the best marquee for Toad Warrior, as it allows her to control the opponent's meter on throws.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Toad Warrior is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Meter Gain should be completely ignored, as Toad Warrior's Signature Ability already grants enough Blockbuster Meter.

Tomb & Gloom.name: Tomb & Gloom
Tomb & Gloom.sa1: Inflict WITHER, CURSE, QUIETUS or HEX for 5/7/10 seconds when using a BLOCKBUSTER or SPECIAL MOVE.
Tomb & Gloom.sa2: Also gain 1 stack of EVASION for 5/7/10 seconds when using a BLOCKBUSTER.

role_strategy: Tomb & Gloom is an offensive utility fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to inflict one out of four powerful DEBUFFS to the opponent when using a blockbuster or special move. At the same time, she also gains EVASION when she activates a blockbuster, allowing her to intercept the opponent without fear of getting punished.

Each of the four DEBUFFS that Tomb & Gloom are powerful in their own right. However, there is RNG involved in determining which DEBUFF can be inflicted which may be a hindrance depending on the opponent, especially since she has a very low base ATK stat. Hence, it is best to equip multiple blockbusters and special moves, especially those that can trigger Sekhmet, and use them consecutively in order to increase the chances of landing the DEBUFF that is needed. WITHER removes 5% blockbuster meter every second and can be stacked CURSE prevents the opponent from gaining new BUFFS QUIETUS ignores RESISTANCE and bypasses the effects of FINAL STAND and BLESSINGS HEX disables the opponent's Signature Ability
WITHER removes 5% blockbuster meter every second and can be stacked
CURSE prevents the opponent from gaining new BUFFS
QUIETUS ignores RESISTANCE and bypasses the effects of FINAL STAND and BLESSINGS
HEX disables the opponent's Signature Ability

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability will work for Tomb & Gloom. RITUAL SACRIFICE can be used offensively to provide easy access to blockbusters by sacrificing a weak fighter. Meanwhile, BLOOD OATH can be useful as a safety-net to recover back health by sacrificing a weak fighter. Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Tomb & Gloom as a Critless Variant
Due to the nature of Eliza's Marquee Ability and the utility her kit provides, it is suggested that players build Tomb & Gloom as a Critless Variant
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Tomb & Gloom is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow Tomb & Gloom to use her Signature Ability more often.

Treble Maker.name: Treble Maker
Treble Maker.sa1: Heal for 5/7/10% of your MAX HEALTH after every 10th COMBO HIT suffered.
Treble Maker.sa2: When HIT while above 50% HEALTH, reflect 15/25/35% of the incoming damage.

role_strategy: Treble Maker is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants him healing after a certain number of hits, while also reflecting damage done to him while having more than 50% health. This makes him have a similar role as Dread Locks as they both rely on reflect damage, though Treble Maker focuses more on staying alive longer.

Treble Maker is a natural counter to multi-hit characters such as Filia, Valentine, and Robo-Fortune as he can easily regain health that is lost through combos. When using these characters, it is recommended to use strategies or variants that can inflict HEAL BLOCK or INVERSE POLARITY to counter his healing abilities. On the other hand, using characters that deal massive damage in a low number of hits such as Cerebella, Painwheel and Beowulf can be dangerous due to his reflection damage ability. The best strategy to counter Treble Maker is to use fighters with access to PRECISION and can deal massive amounts of burst damage, such as Parasoul and Ms. Fortune. Thrill Shrieker is a notable counter to Treble Maker through her ability that can simply remove 50% of his health and prevent the reflection damage through a single OUTTAKE.
Thrill Shrieker is a notable counter to Treble Maker through her ability that can simply remove 50% of his health and prevent the reflection damage through a single OUTTAKE.

Marquee Ability: As a defensive variant, FRONTMAN is the recommended Marquee Ability for Treble Maker, as it provides Resistance and damage reduction to make him more durable and more immune to DEBUFFS.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Treble Maker is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.
Special investment: Crit Resist is also recommended to stop players from using fighters like Cosmic Rebel and Triple Threat.

Trigger Happy.name: Trigger Happy
Trigger Happy.sa1: 50/75/100% of the damage dealt by STANDARD SHOTS is also suffered by the opponent's teammates.
Trigger Happy.sa2: Gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds each time the opponent's teammates take damage.

role_strategy: Trigger Happy is an offensive fighter that utilizes STANDARD SHOTS to deal damage to the opponent's teammates on the bench, which will also provide her stacks of ENRAGE. This allows her to reliably increase her damage output while taking down enemies resting in the back, making her a unique Bronze variant. Trigger Happy will only get one stack of ENRAGE per shot, even if she is damaging two benched enemies. As such, there is not much difference between fighting two or three enemies.
Trigger Happy will only get one stack of ENRAGE per shot, even if she is damaging two benched enemies. As such, there is not much difference between fighting two or three enemies.

Trigger Happy can easily maintain 2–3 stacks of ENRAGE throughout the fight if used correctly. Her damage output can be further increased through the use of DEATH MARK, ARMOR BREAK, GUARD BREAK, and DEADEYE, all of which can be found in Black Dahlia's kit. Trigger Happy will have to rely on these tools outside of fighting teams, since her Signature Ability won't function against a single enemy.

Incorporating SHOTS into her combos is key to using her Signature Ability efficiently. See below for basic combos to use: G5 > Swipe Up > SHOT > DEATH PENDULUM > SHOT G5 > SHOT > EMPOWER > SHOT > DOOR MAT > DEATH PENDULUM > SHOT
G5 > Swipe Up > SHOT > DEATH PENDULUM > SHOT
G5 > SHOT > EMPOWER > SHOT > DOOR MAT > DEATH PENDULUM > SHOT
Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Trigger Happy will benefit from METAL BREAKDOWN as her Marquee Ability, increase her damage output with ARMOR BREAK and the extra SPECIAL SHOT damage boost.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Trigger Happy is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Triple Threat.name: Triple Threat
Triple Threat.sa1: Gain IMMUNITY, UNFLINCHING or INVINCIBLE for 9/12/15 seconds when activating STAR POWER. The BUFF is removed when exiting STAR POWER.
Triple Threat.sa2: 33% chance when using a SPECIAL MOVE to reset all BUFF timers and gain 20/25/30% STAR POWER meter.

role_strategy: Triple Threat is a fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her one of three BUFFS when activating STAR POWER. These BUFFS are inherently defensive but given the unpredictability of the AI in activating STAR POWER, it is best to be used on the offense. These BUFFS can also be reset through the use of special moves through her secondary Signature Ability. With careful usage of her abilities, Triple Threat could potentially sustain her BUFFS long enough to be completely INVINCIBLE throughout the fight. Players can easily switch between BUFFS by quickly activating and deactivating STAR POWER until the wanted BUFF is gained.
Players can easily switch between BUFFS by quickly activating and deactivating STAR POWER until the wanted BUFF is gained.

INVINCIBLE and IMMUNITY are the two most useful BUFFS, as it renders her immune to damage and DEBUFFS that can be inflicted through modifiers or catalysts. Furthermore, it is useful to remember that INVINCIBLE is a very rare BUFF, whereas IMMUNITY can be gained through support fighters such as Surgeon General and Sketchy. The timers of the BUFFS gained from support fighters can also be reset through her secondary Signature Ability, allowing Triple Threat a longer duration of IMMUNITY, HEAVY REGEN or HASTE. Triple Threat can also gain ENRAGE and UNFLINCHING through RE-ENTRY and NORTH KNUCKLE, respectively.

The timers of the BUFFS gained from support fighters can also be reset through her secondary Signature Ability, allowing Triple Threat a longer duration of IMMUNITY, HEAVY REGEN or HASTE. Triple Threat can also gain ENRAGE and UNFLINCHING through RE-ENTRY and NORTH KNUCKLE, respectively.

Marquee Ability: Triple Threat is best to be used offensively, as players will have greater control on when to activate her Signature Ability. Hence, RED SHIFT is the recommended Marquee Ability to further increase her damage output easily through subsequent uses of blockbusters and special moves.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Tripe Threat is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase her BUFFS refreshing. While investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage.

True Self.name: True Self
True Self.sa1: Fukua's successful KICK attacks grant a stack of SHADOW KICK (max. 10). Regain 1/1.5/2% MAX HEALTH when gaining a SHADOW KICK stack. The next BLOCKBUSTER used after reaching 10 SHADOW KICK stacks will summon GRENDEL'S HAND to HIT the opponent.
True Self.sa2: When GRENDEL's HAND successfully HITS, gain UNFLINCHING for 10/12/15 seconds. When gaining a SHADOW KICK stack while benefiting from UNFLINCHING, deal 2/2.5/3% MAX HEALTH as damage to the opponent and gain 2/3/4% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: True Self is an offensive Fukua, relying on a unique mechanic coming via SHADOW KICKS. Building up SHADOW KICKS allows her to eventually throw out another attack, with a GIGAN hand (Specifically, Grendel's) coming from they sky directly onto the opponent.

To gain SHADOW KICKS, True Self must hit the opponent with attacks that use her kicks. Below mentions all known attacks that give a SHADOW KICK Dash 1 and Dash 2 both give 1 charge of SHADOW KICK L2 and L3 give 1 charge of SHADOW KICK A1 gives 1 charge of SHADOW KICK, A3 gives 2 charges of SHADOW KICK Sweep gives up to 3 charges of SHADOW KICK Players are able to view how many SHADOW KICKS they have earned when looking at their MODIFIER icons, or pausing the game and scrolling to find how many SHADOW KICKS they have gotten. The maximum stacks of SHADOW KICKS True Self can hold is 10

Without UNFLINCHING, gaining a SHADOW KICK will heal True Self a small amount. With UNFLINCHING, gaining a SHADOW KICKS will now also do additional damage and give extra BLOCKBUSTER meter to Fukua. Neither effect will work however if True Self is already at 10 stacks of SHADOW KICK.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, SPECTRAL SPITE is recommended for True Self, which gives her more damage the lower her health percentage is. Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, it is recommended that players build her as a Critless Variant.
