General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, True Self is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: There are no special investments for True Self.

Très Chic.name: Très Chic
Très Chic.sa1: While on her own side of the stage, Valentine gains 1 stack of BARRIER, THORNS or ARMOR every 5/4/3 seconds. These BUFFS are removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Très Chic.sa2: While on the opponent's side of the stage, CRITICAL HITS inflict BLEED, DEATH MARK, or ARMOR BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Trés Chic is a fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her BUFFS and chance to inflict DEBUFFS depending on which side of the stage she is on. When on her own side of the stage, she gains defensive BUFFS to increase her survivability. However, when on the opponent's side of the stage, she gains the ability to inflict DEBUFFS that can easily cripple the toughest defenders. This makes her an excellent fighter with a dual role in offense and defense.

With the highest base ATK stat of all Valentines, Trés Chic is one of the best offensive Valentines, and can deal serious damage to opponents while crippling them with DEBUFFS that increase her damage output. Although her first Signature Ability is inherently defensive, it requires specific placement, time, and is easily removed. Given the unpredictability of the AI, it is best to focus more on her offensive prowess, and to think of her first Signature Ability as a safety net.

When playing as Trés Chic, it is very important to push the opponent to their side of the stage as much as possible. Blockbusters such as COUNTERVENOMS are particularly potent, as they allow her to fling the opponent far onto their own side of the stage.
Marquee Ability: ICU is the recommended Marquee Ability to provide Trés Chic easy access to healing while on the offensive.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Trés Chic is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy, Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage by taking use of her Signature Ability fully.

Twisted Mettle.name: Twisted Mettle
Twisted Mettle.sa1: When suffering a CRITICAL HIT, inflict BLEED for 10/12/15 seconds.
Twisted Mettle.sa2: 25/35/50% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED for 3 seconds if opponent is suffering BLEED.

role_strategy: Twisted Mettle is a defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to inflict multiple stacks of BLEED when hit. This allows her to deal significant damage to her opponent without much effort.
Twisted Mettle punishes multi-hit characters such as Robo-Fortune, Filia, and Squigly as more hits will amount to a higher chance to crit.

As a Bronze Painwheel variant, Twisted Mettle has very low HP and can be defeated easily through low-hit chunk damage. Hence, characters such as Cerebella and Beowulf are very effective to counter her. In addition, these characters also have THROW-based special moves which bypasses blocking and will not crit.
Marquee Ability: TAINTED BLOOD is the recommended Marquee Ability for Twisted Mettle, as she is a defensive focused Painwheel.
stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Painwheel, Twisted Mettle is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting BLEED.
rift_battles: The Painwheel-specific catalyst, Don't Poke the Buer, synergizes well to overcome Twisted Mettle's low base HP. To counter this, players will have to use multi-hit characters that are immune to BLEED, such as Valentine with the ICU Marquee Ability or Squigly equipped with an IMMUNITY TAUNT.

Tyrannical.name: Tyrannical
Tyrannical.sa1: CRITICAL HITS have a 35% chance to inflict BLEED or grant MIASMA for 6 seconds each.
Tyrannical.sa2: While benefiting from at least 3 stacks of MIASMA, or the opponent suffers from at least 3 stacks of BLEED, CRITICAL HITS have a 50% chance to remove 1 opponent BUFF.

role_strategy: Tyrannical is an offensive Crit based Painwheel with a very high DPS due to her access to MIASMA and BLEED. Uncommon for a Painwheel Variant, she also has access to BUFF removal, which allows her to take down many tough defenders in Prize Fights and in Parallel Realms.

Tyrannical's main drawback is being a Painwheel. The lack of utility in her kit and mediocre combo ability holds her back from showing her full potential. To alleviate some of these drawbacks, she has an insanely high DPS due to her access to MIASMA, BLEED as well as having the highest attack stat for a gold.
Due to her MIASMA, she can also regain HP, which is important to her considering her low HP stat makes even blocked hits chip away at her Health.
Marquee Ability: TAINTED BLOOD is the recommended Marquee Ability for Tyrannical. Players can also play without unlocking her Marquee Ability, as it's rather useless on this variant.
Stat Investment
General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Tyrannical is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Accuracy and Crit Rate will increase the chance of her inflicting BLEED and gaining MIASMA. Crit Damage will increase her damage output. Meter Gain should largely be avoided due to her access to MIASMA, which grants her Blockbuster Meter.

Ultraviolent.name: Ultraviolent
Ultraviolent.sa1: Projectile HITS have a 25/35/50% chance to grant DEADEYE and BARRIER for 15 seconds each.
Ultraviolent.sa2: Projectiles HITS inflict 25/35/50% bonus damage and grant HASTE for 10 seconds while benefiting from DEADEYE.

role_strategy: Ultraviolent is an offensive fighter that uses projectiles to gain unique BUFFS and deal a lot of damage to the opponent. DEADEYE is a powerful BUFF that ignores the opponent's defense stat while also ignoring AUTO-BLOCK, UNFLINCHING, THORNS and EVASION BARRIER provides survivability HASTE increases the amount of meter gained for blockbusters
DEADEYE is a powerful BUFF that ignores the opponent's defense stat while also ignoring AUTO-BLOCK, UNFLINCHING, THORNS and EVASION
BARRIER provides survivability
HASTE increases the amount of meter gained for blockbusters

Out of all the BUFFS that Ultraviolent gains, DEADEYE is the most significant, allowing her to deal increased damage while ignoring a lot of potent defensive BUFFS that is present in defenders like Model Leader, Plot Twisted, Rose-Tinted and That's All Folks!.

Ultraviolent can easily activate her Signature Abilities from a single use of ARGUS AGONY. This is a recommended blockbuster to equip as it charges really fast and deals multiple projectile HITS, allowing Ultraviolent to gain five stacks of BARRIER easily.

BARRIER opens up the possibility of pairing Ultraviolent with support variants like Rock Star and Starlight Rose to provide additional benefits such as increased damage, recovery and meter. Although BARRIER provides extra survivability, Ultraviolent is still quite frail defensively and players will still have to be careful on using Ultraviolent, especially in high Prize Fight streaks.
Although BARRIER provides extra survivability, Ultraviolent is still quite frail defensively and players will still have to be careful on using Ultraviolent, especially in high Prize Fight streaks.

Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Ultraviolent, as it provides the chance to reset the cooldown for her special moves, which are mostly projectiles, and reuse them almost immediately.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Ultraviolent is best built with Attack, Piercing, and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Meter Gain should be completely avoided due to her access to HASTE. Crit Damage and Crit Rate can be used to increase her damage.

Unbearable.name: Unbearable
Unbearable.sa1: While Big Band has living teammates, the active Fighter gains a 35% chance when suffering a DEBUFF to convert it to BARRIER for 10/12/15 seconds and heal all teammates for 5% MAX HEALTH.
Unbearable.sa2: With one teammate alive, Big Band takes 20% reduced damage and gains a 1% chance to instantly defeat the opponent with TIER 3 BLOCKBUSTER HITS. With no teammates alive, these effects are doubled.

role_strategy: Unbearable is a supportive and defensive Big Band, providing sustain and safety to the team while off-field, while building up his survivability and preparing to fight back if his teammates are knocked out.

Unbearable's first Signature Ability provides generic sustain, helping to deny DEBUFFs and converting it to BARRIER and some extra health. This effectively works as Unbearable giving up to 15% health to himself or teammates who suffer a DEBUFF (10% via 1 Barrier + 5% fixed health).

Unbearable's second Signature Ability grants him some safety besides just DEBUFF prevention, allowing Unbearable to permanently take 20/40% less damage if he only has 1/0 teammates remaining respectively. This Signature Ability is active at all times if Unbearable is on a Duo/Solo node in Rifts.

While mainly being a defensive variant, Unbearable has the ability to retaliate with a Tier 3 BLOCKBUSTER, having a 1/2% chance to instantly defeat opponents per hit. It is recommended to only have this ability active as a last resort where Unbearable is a secondary or tertiary attacker on offense. This ability is best paired with the Tier 3 BLOCKBUSTER, STRIKE UP THE BAND, hitting at least 50 times, giving the best chance for his Signature Ability to activate.
Marquee Ability: FRONTMAN is recommended for defense as it provides Resistance and damage reduction to make him more durable and negate even more DEBUFFS.

General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Unbearable is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.

Special investment: Crit Resist is also recommended to stop players from using fighters like Cosmic Rebel and Triple Threat. Accuracy will also help to activate his first and second Signature Ability more consistently.

Underdog.name: Underdog
Underdog.sa1: Gain ARMOR and HASTE for 10/12/15 seconds when suffering a DEBUFF.
Underdog.sa2: When Beowulf gains a BUFF, he also gains 5/7/10% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

role_strategy: Underdog is an offensive fighter that is used for his ability to remove SLOW and AMOUR BREAK. He gains HASTE and AMOUR when suffering a DEBUFF which together with additional BLOCKBUSTER METER from his second Signature Ability allows him to spam Blockbusters and reduce damage suffered. This ability allows him to counter catalyst such as Scratching Post and Record Breaker.

The main draw back for Underdog is that HASTE is a buff available to any Beowulf through his taunt. His first Signature Ability grants ARMOR, which has little value when you're in an offensive position, but mixes together well with his second Signature Ability, which allows him to spam Blockbusters at an incredible rates.
Underdog can be paired with fighters like Starlight Rose, Noble Mogul or Pickle Baller who grants BUFFS while being in the bench and activates his second Signature Ability.
Currently, Underdog is mainly replaced with fighters like Gravedigger that are better counters to rift nodes with Scratching Post and also have a much better offensive Signature Ability.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability when used as an offensive unit, which allows him to slightly increase his lackluster attack and deal more damage.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Underdog is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: As he naturally gains HASTE, try to avoid investing in Meter Gain, as Meter Gain caps at 100%.

Understudy.name: Understudy
Understudy.sa1: All teammates deal 15/30/50% increased throw damage.
Understudy.sa2: Gain ARMOR for 10/12/15 seconds when THROWING the opponent.

role_strategy: Understudy is a fighter with a Signature Ability that boosts her THROW damage, while also giving her ARMOR. These effects make her a good character to practice with early on, since she has both respectable damage output for a Bronze and a way to mitigate damage from mistakes. Aside from double swiping to perform a THROW, her Signature Ability can also be activated by using THROW-based special moves and blockbusters, such as MERRY GO-RILLA, PUMMEL HORSE and DIAMOND DROP.
Aside from double swiping to perform a THROW, her Signature Ability can also be activated by using THROW-based special moves and blockbusters, such as MERRY GO-RILLA, PUMMEL HORSE and DIAMOND DROP.

While her base ATK stat is very low compared to other Cerebella variants, she makes up for it somewhat with her THROW damage, which gives her damage output comparable to her Gold-tier peers when using THROWS. With this bonus applying to teammates, friendly Beowulf's and Cerebella's get a great increase to many of their offensive tools.

While facing Understudy, be wary of MERRY GO-RILLA and DIAMOND DROP, as these moves will bypass your block and deal bonus damage as well as providing her ARMOR through her Signature Ability. ARMOR BREAK is a good way to override her ARMOR stacks. Some characters, such as Peacock and Cerebella, have special moves that can inflict ARMOR BREAK. Specific fighters that can also inflict ARMOR BREAK include Headstrong and Bad Ms Frosty.

ARMOR BREAK is a good way to override her ARMOR stacks. Some characters, such as Peacock and Cerebella, have special moves that can inflict ARMOR BREAK. Specific fighters that can also inflict ARMOR BREAK include Headstrong and Bad Ms Frosty.
Marquee Ability: UPPER HAND is the best marquee for Understudy, as it allows her to control the opponent's meter on throws.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Understudy is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will allow Understudy to consistently inflict ARMOR BREAK. Meter Gain will also allow her to use like DIAMOND DROP more often.

Unfazed.name: Unfazed
Unfazed.sa1: Gain UNFLINCHING and 1/2/3 stack(s) of THORNS for 10 seconds each when either Fighter BOUNCES off a wall.
Unfazed.sa2: Gain MIASMA for 10 seconds every 4/3/2 seconds while benefiting from THORNS.

role_strategy: Unfazed is a fighter that benefits from wall-bounces by applying UNFLINCHING and THORNS to herself whenever they occur. She also gains MIASMA stacks while THORNS is up, allowing her to slowly steal health and meter from the opponent.

While most of Unfazed's abilities are mostly defensive in nature, the incredibly specific condition of needing a wall-bounce to activate makes her more useful in offense in practice. Thankfully, due to her Dark element typing, she has frequent access to BUCKSHOTS, which make wall-bounces easy on offense, and her base ATK stat is higher than average.

On defense, all one has to do to bypass Unfazed's Signature Ability is to avoid using attacks that wall-bounce. However, there are variants or modifiers that can grant THORNS to her, which will activate her second Ability and grant her MIASMA stacks at a rapid rate. In those cases, it's advised to either use CURSE or take out the variant that supplies the THORNS first. Currently, the only variant that can grant THORNS to teammates is Rose-Tinted.

Due to the nature of her Signature Ability, it is recommended that players only partially unlock her first Signature Ability. Only gaining one stack of THORNS per wall bounce allows her to consistently stack THORNS and have constant uptime on MIASMA.
Marquee Ability: As an offensive unit, METAL BREAKDOWN is the recommended Marquee Ability to unlock.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Unfazed is best built with Attack and Special Cooldown. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.

Special investment: Players are advised not to invest in Crit Rate and Crit Damage, as Unfazed signature ability is perfect to counter Painwheels's TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability. With these, players can also avoid unlocking the Crit Rate and Crit Damage nodes in her skill tree. Due to her access to MIASMA, Meter Gain will also redundant, but players can choose to invest in this stat if they choose to. While only useful on defense on certain conditions, also investing in HP and Defense will make mistakes less punishing when on offense.

Unholy Host.name: Unholy Host
Unholy Host.sa1: When Black Dahlia or her opponent TAGS IN, she removes all enemy BUFFS and inflicts CURSE for 10/15/20 seconds.
Unholy Host.sa2: DRAIN 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second from the opponent if they are suffering from CURSE.

role_strategy: Unholy Host is a fighter with the powerful ability to strip away enemy BUFFS and afflicting them with CURSE, preventing them from gaining any further buffs. In addition, she also drains health from opponents when they are under the effects of CURSE, making her a highly effective variant on both offense and defense.

CURSE is a powerful DEBUFF that can severely remove a lot of defenders' defensive capabilities, allowing Unholy Host to use Black Dahlia's arsenal of powerful tools to take down strong defenders without much effort. This ability also works on defense, making it difficult to take her down without any BUFFS on top of her high health. Non-permanent Immunity will not protect enemies from Unholy Host's CURSE, as her BUFF removal takes place before the Immunity takes effect. Splitting Image can gain an unremovable IMMUNITY, while Weekend Warrior and Black Dahlia with TEA SLIP equipped can remove the debuff, making them very effective against her.

Non-permanent Immunity will not protect enemies from Unholy Host's CURSE, as her BUFF removal takes place before the Immunity takes effect. Splitting Image can gain an unremovable IMMUNITY, while Weekend Warrior and Black Dahlia with TEA SLIP equipped can remove the debuff, making them very effective against her.

Despite possessing subpar ATK, Unholy Host's secondary ability more than compensates for this weakness by providing a means for her to recover her own health while depleting her opponent's. This ability is both potent and easy to trigger, and her Curse DEBUFF lasts for 20 seconds, draining 40% of the enemy's health. Furthermore, Black Dahlia can inflict CURSE by using the Blockbuster EMPOWER, meaning she can consistently drain the opponent's health throughout the match.

Marquee Ability: Both Marquee Abilities will work with Unholy Host depending on whether she is used in offense or defense. METAL BREAKDOWN is recommended for offensive use, allowing Unholy Host to inflict ARMOR BREAK for more damage. NO TIME TO DIE is recommended for defensive use, increasing her defensive capabilities and recovery while also making her an anti-crit defender.
stat_investment: General Investment: If used in offense, Unholy Host is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored. If used defensively, Unholy Host is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. If built Critless or does not have Prestige Ability unlocked, Unholy host will need investments in Piercing as she does not have access to reliable ARMOR BREAK and DEADEYE.
If built Critless or does not have Prestige Ability unlocked, Unholy host will need investments in Piercing as she does not have access to reliable ARMOR BREAK and DEADEYE.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her CURSE is not resisted by enemies. Crit Damage and Crit Rate are also optional, as she can also be built critless.
playing_against: Both of Unholy Host's abilities work very well in defense, shutting down player's fighters through CURSE upon TAG IN, making it difficult to take her down on top of her high health. Furthermore, her drain ability is very powerful, providing her the means to recover health like Splitting Image. Players will often find themselves without any active BUFFS when facing her and would have to rely on effects and abilities.

Black Dahlia's defensive Marquee Ability, NO TIME TO DIE, also provides her multiple stacks of REGEN and HASTE, making her even more resilient in combat and enabling her to quickly charge her devastating Unblockable Tier 3 Blockbusters. This combination of defensive attributes can make it difficult to fight against Unholy Host in high-level Rift Battles where additional modifiers and catalysts also come into play.

Untouchable.name: Untouchable
Untouchable.sa1: 15% chance when either Fighter is hit to gain UNFLINCHING for 4/5/6 seconds and INVINCIBLE for 2 seconds.
Untouchable.sa2: While benefiting from UNFLINCHING or INVINCIBLE, deal 25/35/50% bonus damage and regain 25/35/50% of damage inflicted as HEALTH.

role_strategy: Untouchable is an offensive focused hybrid fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to gain UNFLINCHING, INVINCIBILITY and regain health while benefiting from these BUFFS. UNFLINCHING and INVINCIBILITY can be obtained even when she's hit, allowing her to counterattack the opponent if you accidentally slip up during a match.
UNFLINCHING and INVINCIBILITY can be obtained even when she's hit, allowing her to counterattack the opponent if you accidentally slip up during a match.
Offensively, the INVINCIBILITY allows Untouchable to counter variants with reflect damage, like those who gain THORNS or Painwheel's with TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability unlocked.

The damage boost in her second Signature Ability gives her a way to increase her DPS, considering that her poor kit as a Peacock. The regen also allows her to regain health that she might have suffered during blocking or reflect damage that might have slipped past her invincibility.

Due to her UNFLINCHING, INVINCIBILITY, regen and damage boost, she is very easy to use on offense. Her ability allows you to easily correct mistakes and and provides a safety net to fall back on. Furthermore, she can be paired with fighter like Evergreen Evil to extend her BUFFS, making here even more forgiving.

Defensively, Untouchable falls a bit flat due to her low HP, Peacock Kit and the lack of catalysts that synergize with her ability. But she can be a cheap alternative other good defensive units that you might not have acquired yet.
Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Untouchable, as it provides a chance for all Special Moves to reset immediately.
stat_investment: General Investment: If used on defense, Untouchable is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance. If used on offense, Untouchable is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating.

Vaporwave Vixen.name: Vaporwave Vixen
Vaporwave Vixen.sa1: After IDLING or WALKING for 3/2/1 seconds(s) without suffering a hit, gain UNFLINCHING.
Vaporwave Vixen.sa2: After Fukua and her opponent have not suffered a HIT (including blocked hits) for 2 seconds, gain THORNS and MIASMA for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Vaporwave Vixen is a defensive and offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her stacks of MIASMA and THORNS when either player has not suffered a hit. This allows her to easily gain multiple stacks of MIASMA by simply dodging and avoiding any direct contact, making her a strong offensive unit with defensive capabilities.

MIASMA is a strong BUFF that allows Vaporwave to drain the opponent's health and meter, allowing her to be used offensively by purely relying on MIASMA to defeat the toughest defenders. In the offense, simply dodge and keep dashing backwards away from the opponent to gain multiple stacks of THORNS and MIASMA. Equipping Fukua's TAUNT, BREAKDOWN, can also be useful to gain a stack of MIASMA and drain back more health and meter.
If used on defense, it is recommended to equip blockbusters such as INEVITABLE SNUGGLE and TWICE SHY, which are able to regain back some health depending on the damage dealt.

Marquee Ability: Both of Fukua's Marquee Abilities only activates when a certain percentage of health is lost, which will often happen when used defensively. WRAITH'S WRATH is the recommended Marquee Ability for Vaporwave Vixen to increase her survivability, which may allow her to survive fatal attacks.
stat_investment: General Investment: If used on offense, Vaporwave Vixen is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. On defense, she should be built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: When used on offense, Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more outside of MIASMA.
rift_battles: The combination of both MIASMA and THORNS makes Vaporwave Vixen a strong defender, as she makes it difficult for players to defeat her with a blockbuster finish (from MIASMA) while maintaining a full health.

Vaporwave Vixen works particularly well with Evergreen Evil that can gain blockbuster meter for every BUFF that her teammates gain, allowing her to TAG IN with a fully charged unblockable Tier 3 blockbuster. Furthermore, both fighters have the same element: Air, which provides some elemental synergy through catalysts such as Into Thin Air and the weekly elemental modifier.

Vector Protector.name: Vector Protector
Vector Protector.sa1: Gain ARMOR for 8/10/12 seconds and refresh the timer of all ARMORS when either Fighter uses a SPECIAL MOVE.
Vector Protector.sa2: Using a BLOCKBUSTER converts all ARMOR stacks into MIASMA for 8/10/12 seconds.

role_strategy: Vector Protector is an offensive and defensive fighter with a Signature Ability that relies on spamming SPECIAL MOVES to gain stacks of ARMOR. Those stacks of ARMOR can then be converted into MIASMA through a single use of a BLOCKBUSTER.

As the AI often use SPECIAL MOVES, Vector Protector can be a tough defender with easy access to multiple stacks of ARMOR. When using Vector Protector defensively, it is best to equip projectile-based SPECIAL MOVES such as THEONITE BEAM, PHASER BURN and VARIABLE CUTTER to pressure the opponent from afar.

Vector Protector is best used offensively in the control of the player to stack ARMORS easily throughout a close-range combo, which can then be converted into MIASMA for damage via a BLOCKBUSTER. Given Vector Protector's below average ATK stat, she will rely on MIASMA for most of her damage.

Vector is best played to find a good mix of using both SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS in sync to not waste her ARMOR or MIASMA excessively. Aim to convert ARMOR into MIASMA when holding 3-4 stacks of ARMOR to make more efficient use of MIASMA and various combos.
Marquee Ability: PING CHECK is the recommended Marquee Ability for Vector Protector, as it allows her to gain an alternate offensive potential.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Vector Protector is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Meter Gain will allow her to use blockbusters more often and gain more MIASMA.

Vintage Virtuoso.name: Vintage Virtuoso
Vintage Virtuoso.sa1: Gain 1 stack of PRECISION every 15/10/5 combo hits.
Vintage Virtuoso.sa2: PRECISION HITS grant ENRAGE and inflict GUARD BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds.

role_strategy: Vintage Virtuoso is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that grants offensive BUFFS in the form of PRECISION and ENRAGE during combos while inflicting GUARD BREAK, allowing him to play very aggressively while reducing the chance of retaliation. PRECISION is a powerful BUFF that disregards an opponent's Signature Abilities as one of its effects. When timed correctly, this allows him to defeat opponents such as Kill Joy, Immoral Fiber, Shadow Puppet, and Robocopy without activating their on-death/fatal hit abilities.

PRECISION is a powerful BUFF that disregards an opponent's Signature Abilities as one of its effects. When timed correctly, this allows him to defeat opponents such as Kill Joy, Immoral Fiber, Shadow Puppet, and Robocopy without activating their on-death/fatal hit abilities.

Big Band has a wide array of special moves and blockbusters that are multi-hit, such as BEAT EXTEND and TYMPANI DRIVE, allowing Vintage Virtuoso to reach 5 combo hits very easily. However, the timing to land a PRECISION hit when it matters can be difficult to achieve because of this. Players will have to practice and have a mastery of Big Band's special moves and blockbusters to be able to make the PRECISION hit count. PRECISION hits occur every 5N + 1 hits, e.g. 6, 11, 16 etc. One of Big Band's Tier 3 Unblockable blockbusters, TUBA TUBA, deals exactly 21 hits, with the last doing the most damage. When used by Vintage Virtuoso, this guarantees that the last hit will be a PRECISION hit.

One of Big Band's Tier 3 Unblockable blockbusters, TUBA TUBA, deals exactly 21 hits, with the last doing the most damage. When used by Vintage Virtuoso, this guarantees that the last hit will be a PRECISION hit.

Marquee Ability: As an offensive variant, Vintage Virtuoso will benefit from SOLOIST as his Marquee Ability. This compliments with Big Band's Prestige Ability that provides UNBLOCKABLE dash attacks while also supplementing HEAVY REGEN as a form of recovery.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Vintage Virtuoso is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage is recommended for Vintage Virtuoso to further increase his damage output. Accuracy will also ensure that defenders do not resist GUARD BREAK.

Wave Warrior.name: Wave Warrior
Wave Warrior.sa1: Every 15th COMBO HIT, transfer up to 2 opponent BUFFS to self and reduce opponent BLOCKBUSTER METER by 15/20/25%.
Wave Warrior.sa2: While Annie has living teammates, gaining a BUFF permanently increases DAMAGE by 5/7/10% and heals all teammates for 5% HEALTH.

role_strategy: Wave Warrior is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that focus on stealing opponent's buffs and by permanently increasing her damage by 10% for each buff gained. Wave Warrior has the added bonus of reducing the opponent blockbuster meter and function as a support by healing herself and her teammates by 5% for each buff gained.
Due to Annie being highly reliant on Blockbusters to achieve high combo counts, make sure she won't suffer from debuffs like WITHER, BLOCKBUSTED and SLOW often.

Wave Warrior wants buff supports like Surgeon General, Starlight Rose, Noble Mogul, Persona Assistant or Pickle Baller to increase her damage even further if she isn't in a buff heavy environment. Guest Stars would also help her out, namely any Dim Sum Delivery or Neutral Will it Blend that provide her with a lot of buffs.

With Rose-Tinted support, She essentially becomes unkillable if hit with only weak (less than 10% dealing) moves, notably some high hitting tier 3 Blockbusters like Parasoul's, Robo Fortune's or Strike up the Band from Big Band. This is also extremely helpful in reflect heavy fights, notoriously Big band's Futile Resistance rift catalyst.
Marquee Ability: REDSHIFT is the recommended Marquee Ability for Wave Warrior, as it further increases her damage potential.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Wave Warrior is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow her to use Blockbusters more often and reach high combos to activate her Signature Ability.

Web Crawler.name: Web Crawler
Web Crawler.sa1: After Painwheel has been in the air for 1 second, gain DEADEYE and inflict GUARD BREAK for 10/11/12 seconds each.
Web Crawler.sa2: 10/12/15% chance on HIT to remove 1 opponent BUFF and gain EVASION for 10 seconds while near an opponent suffering from GUARD BREAK.

role_strategy: Web Crawler is an offensive fighter that takes advantage of Painwheel's ability to stay in the air to gain DEADEYE and inflict GUARD BREAK to further supplement her aggressive play style. Furthermore, Web Crawler can remove BUFFS and gain EVASION, making her an effective counter against BUFF heavy defenders while preventing punishes through EVASION. DEADEYE ignores the opponent's DEFENSE and BUFFS such as AUTO-BLOCK, UNFLINCHING, EVASION and THORNS, providing a unique utility for Web Crawler among Painwheel variants.
DEADEYE ignores the opponent's DEFENSE and BUFFS such as AUTO-BLOCK, UNFLINCHING, EVASION and THORNS, providing a unique utility for Web Crawler among Painwheel variants.

Aside from using Painwheel's Character Ability, FLIGHT RISK, Web Crawler can also activate her first Signature Ability through an air juggle (launch the opponent and continue tapping) or by using BUER THRESHER. This is the recommended way to activate Web Crawler's ability, as it is less risky and can easily be followed up by a combo with multi-hit blockbusters like DEATH CRAWL to activate her second Signature Ability. Web Crawler also highly synergizes with Painwheel's Prestige Ability that inflicts GUARD BREAK when using a blockbuster, providing her a means of removing opponent's BUFFS and gain EVASION without having to rely on her first Signature Ability.

Web Crawler also highly synergizes with Painwheel's Prestige Ability that inflicts GUARD BREAK when using a blockbuster, providing her a means of removing opponent's BUFFS and gain EVASION without having to rely on her first Signature Ability.

With multiple stacks of EVASION, Web Crawler can bait the opponent into attacking and then countering them with a simple ground combo to start combos. GUARD BREAK also provides another means of Web Crawler to be aggressive without having to wait for an opening from the opponent.
Marquee Ability: TAINTED BLOOD is the recommended Marquee Ability for Web Crawler.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Web Crawler is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output further. Accuracy will ensure that her GUARD BREAK isn't resisted by defenders.

Weekend Warrior.name: Weekend Warrior
Weekend Warrior.sa1: Achieve max HYPE and gain HASTE for 10 seconds when Beowulf first drops below 25/35/50% HEALTH.
Weekend Warrior.sa2: When activating HYPE MODE, remove all DEBUFFS and gain IMMUNITY, FINAL STAND, and HEAVY REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds.

role_strategy: Weekend Warrior is an offensive fighter that gains multiple BUFFS on HYPE MODE which improve his survivability. While these BUFFS are primarily defensive, players are encouraged to utilize him offensively due to his reliable access to debuff cleanse and IMMUNITY, along with good regen and FINAL STAND.

Weekend Warrior is highly effective against defensive Painwheel with the TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability, which reflects damage on critical hits. With WULF SHOOT, he can deal non-critical damage while generating HYPE stacks. In Rift Battles, his below-average ATK benefits against Painwheel's catalyst, DON'T POKE THE BUER, which reduces the risk of exceeding its damage limit and triggering penalties. Furthermore, his regenerative capabilities provide a safety net when those reflect damage do occur, allowing him to remain healthy throughout the fight.

In the current rift environment, he is also used to counter fighters like Unholy Host and catalyst, such as Cripple Decker. Weekend warrior is one of the few fighters with access to debuff cleanse and IMMUNITY in their Signature Ability, the only other fighter being In Denile. Due to this ability, Weekend Warrior is easily able to counter Unholy Host by removing her CURSE and his Beowulf kit which mainly consists of grabs also allows him to not trigger NO TIME TO DIE.

Being a counter to both TAINTED BLOOD and NO TIME TO DIE, Weekend Warrior is recommended to be built critless. Along with that, players are advised to equip an AROO READY? to grant him easy haste and give him quick HYPE.

Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended ability for Weekend Warrior, increasing his damage as he lowers the opponents. His health will most often be very high due to his regenerative abilities.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Weekend Warrior is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: As Weekend Warrior is most often played with a taunt that gives HASTE, Meter Gain is not a recommended stat to build on him, as well as avoiding Crit Rate and Crit Damage. Instead, players are advised to build HP, which increases his survivability on the field and reduces chip damage suffered.

Wetwork.name: Wetwork
Wetwork.sa1: Gain EVASION every 2/1.5/1 second(s) while charging a CHARGE ATTACK.
Wetwork.sa2: When knocking an opponent into the air, Valentine gains ENRAGE and the opponent suffers ARMOR BREAK and DEATH MARK for 4/5/7 seconds.

role_strategy: Wetwork is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that revolves around knocking the opponent into the air to gain ENRAGE and inflict ARMOR BREAK and DEATH MARK, which altogether will amplify her damage greatly. Wetwork's first Signature Ability also grants her EVASION while charging a charge attack, allowing her to easily trip enemies without fear of being countered. EVASION also allows Wetwork to play aggressive by spamming unblockable charge attacks to start combos.
EVASION also allows Wetwork to play aggressive by spamming unblockable charge attacks to start combos.

Wetwork's second Signature Ability can be activated through the use of her charge attack, but also several of Valentine's special moves and blockbusters that knock the opponent into the air such as MORTUARY DROP, COUNTER VENOMS, FORBIDDEN PROCEDURE and LARYNGECTOMY. Players who are skilled at playing Valentine can chain these special moves and blockbusters to gain multiple stacks of ENRAGE in a single combo.
Marquee Ability: ICU is the recommended Marquee Ability to provide Wetwork easy access to healing while on the offensive.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Wetwork is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy, Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage by taking use of her Signature Ability fully.

Wild Child.name: Wild Child
Wild Child.sa1: While not OVERSTUFFED, Umbrella's THROW HITS have a 20% chance to DRAIN 10/12/15% of the opponent's BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Wild Child.sa2: Inflict 2 stacks of SLIME for 10/12/15 seconds when the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN.

role_strategy: Wild Child is an offensive fighter who can drain meter with her throws as long as she's not OVERSTUFFED. She also inflicts two decently long-lasting SLIME stacks every time she knocks down an opponent. This makes her able to spam Blockbusters pretty well while punishing the use of buffs.

Umbrella as a character already has ways to inflict SLIME, but Wild Child's even easier access to it means that she's best used against variants who gain a lot of BUFFS. Even outside that situation, she has a high base ATK stat, making her in general a good pick on offense. However, her lack of utility outside of SLIME makes her less usable in high-tier Rifts.
However, her lack of utility outside of SLIME makes her less usable in high-tier Rifts.

While a 20% chance isn't particularly high, Umbrella has multiple decently high hit-count throws at her disposal, like her normal throw, SALT GRINDER and TONGUE TWISTER. This means it isn't especially hard to gain access to Wild Child's meter drain effect.

Wild Child's meter drain is only applied to THROWS while she's not OVERSTUFFED, a state which she achieves by using THROWS frequently. Hence, it is beneficial to equip moves that empty Hungern's gauge by a considerable amount alongside THROW moves. UNDER THE WEATHER is especially useful for this, as it empties the Hunger gauge the most out of all her moves.
Marquee Ability: BITTER END is the recommended Marquee Ability for Wild Child, as it allows her to survive longer in the match by having a FINAL STAND and HEAVY REGEN safety net.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Wild Child is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her draining Blockbuster Meter.

Wildcard.name: Wildcard
Wildcard.sa1: Inflict a random DEBUFF for 4/6/8 seconds when using a SPECIAL MOVE. Also once per match when suffering a HIT that would be fatal, regain 10% MAX HEALTH per DEBUFF on the opponent.
Wildcard.sa2: When Peacock suffers a HIT that would be fatal while the opponent is suffering a DEBUFF, reduce their HEALTH by 25/35/50%.

role_strategy: Wildcard is a defensive fighter that can easily inflict DEBUFFS by simply using a special move, through can pick herself up from FATAL damage and inflict damage to the opponent. Given that the AI is very likely to use special moves, Wildcard can potentially be a dangerous defender in game modes like Rift where every health point matters. It is important to note that Wildcard is unable to inflict STUN and DOOM from her Signature Ability.
It is important to note that Wildcard is unable to inflict STUN and DOOM from her Signature Ability.

Wildcard can be used offensively to easily inflict DEBUFFS from a distance by using Peacock's wide arsenal of special move projectiles. For this to work, Special Move Cooldown can be useful to enable special moves to be easily spammed. Pairing her with Harlequin that reduces Special Move Cooldown by 35% is also recommended.

Marquee Ability: SPECIAL FEATURE is the recommended Marquee Ability for Wildcard, as it directly compliments her Signature Ability by providing the chance to reset the cooldown of special moves and reuse them almost immediately.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Wild Card is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by her enemies.

Wind Stalker.name: Wind Stalker
Wind Stalker.sa1: DRAIN 3/4/5% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second while the opponent is near Ms. Fortune's head.
Wind Stalker.sa2: Inflict QUIETUS, DEATH MARK, DISABLE TAG INS, and DOOM for 15 seconds each when an opponent's HEALTH drops below 25/30/35%. DOOM is removed if the opponent uses a BLOCKBUSTER.

role_strategy: Wind Stalker is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that takes advantage of Ms. Fortune's headless mode to control the opponent's blockbuster meter. Furthermore, Wind Stalker's second Signature Ability ensures a kill on a dying opponent by inflicting both DISABLE TAG-INS and DOOM when the enemy reaches low health. This is especially useful against fighters that can revive, such as Last Hope and Plot Twisted.

Wind Stalker's ability to drain the opponent's meter is great to prevent her DOOM from being removed. Furthermore, it is especially useful against opponents that can easily gain meter via their own Signature Abilities, such as Stand Out, Toad Warrior and Mummy Dearest, while making it easier for her to use her own blockbusters.

DISABLE TAG-INS is a rare debuff that will lock opponents in the fight without a way to escape. Hence, Wind Stalker is great at picking off opponents one by one in a specific order, especially with her DOOM that guarantees a kill after a certain period of time. While DOOM is a good debuff to have in her kit, it's often not necessary, since Ms Fortune as a character have access to tools that will provide naturally high damage output. Thus, most opponents will likely be defeated before DOOM activates.

While DOOM is a good debuff to have in her kit, it's often not necessary, since Ms Fortune as a character have access to tools that will provide naturally high damage output. Thus, most opponents will likely be defeated before DOOM activates.
Marquee Ability: The recommended Marquee Ability for Wind Stalker is BOOP to gain stacks of ENRAGE and further increase her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Wind Stalker is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will further increase her damage output while in the field and take the most use out of the Ms. Fortune Kit.

Windswept.name: Windswept
Windswept.sa1: Your 1st COMBO HIT against an attacking opponent grants ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds and EVASION.
Windswept.sa2: After EVADING, 50/75/100% chance to gain PERMANENT PRECISION. PRECISION is removed when either Fighter is KNOCKED DOWN.

role_strategy: Windswept is an offensive variant with a powerful Signature Ability that rewards her for countering opponents by gaining a stack of both ENRAGE and a timeless EVASION. Additionally, evading any attack can grant her permanent PRECISION, which guarantees critical hits and bypasses a good few defensive Signature Abilities. All in all, Windswept is a formidable offensive variant against a lot of strong defenses in this game. Windswept's ability to gain ENRAGE and her high base ATK stat means she's less reliant on BLEED compared to other Filia variants. Her damage output increases even further with the activation of PRECISION, which makes every hit a crit.

Windswept's ability to gain ENRAGE and her high base ATK stat means she's less reliant on BLEED compared to other Filia variants. Her damage output increases even further with the activation of PRECISION, which makes every hit a crit.

Windswept's ability to gain a timeless stack of EVASION upon a hit allows her to be a very durable fighter in the hands of a skilled player. She can also let opponents try to attack her while under the effect of EVASION, allowing her to counter and gain another stack of both ENRAGE and EVASION. Note that the EVASION stacks are timeless, so players can stack multiple of them in a single fight.

While PRECISION is a powerful buff, it only applies to basic attacks and doesn't ignore any abilities other than Signature Abilities. This makes Windswept less useful against Painwheels with their Marquee Abilities active. Additionally, as her ability relies on BUFFS, she's vulnerable to CURSE.

The PRECISION is lost upon a knockdown, but the game is pretty lenient with Windswept when it comes to what counts as a knockdown; The PRECISION will only be removed once the opponent gets up from the ground. Therefore, players will be able to deal full combos without having to worry about the buff being removed early.

Marquee Ability: Given Windswept is much less reliant on BLEED compared to her Filia peers, LEECH is the recommended Marquee Ability for her. This gives her the ability to heal from chip damage as well as deal with reflect damage variants easier.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Windswept is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage is the most important stat for Windswept, while Crit Rate should be completely ignored, as Windswept has access to easy permanent PRECISION.

Wrestler X.name: Wrestler X
Wrestler X.sa1: Beowulf starts the match with 1/2/3 stacks of permanent REGEN.
Wrestler X.sa2: While in HYPE MODE, all HITS have a 15/20/25% chance to inflict BLEED for 10 seconds.

role_strategy: Wrestler X is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows him to inflict BLEED while in HYPE MODE. His first Signature Ability provides him REGEN, allowing you to recoup back health from a mistake.

Since HYPE MODE only lasts for 10 seconds, it can be difficult to fully make use of Wrestler X's ability. Equip moves such as LUPINE PUMMEL and GEATISH TREPAK that deals multiple hits to increase your chances of inflicting BLEED. The special move AROO READY? and WULF SHOOT is also recommended to give a level of HYPE, allowing you to reach HYPE MODE faster and activate it more often.

This variant is particularly useful for beating the three required Beowulfs node in Ascent of a Woman (Expert) and in the triple Cerebella node in Wulfmania: Born To Howl (Expert) with the Aegis modifier as the BLEEDs this variant inflicts are perfect to counter it. Due to that it's useful to keep him, or a copy, in Gold Tier given the No Diamonds restriction in Ascent of a Woman.
Marquee Ability: DEFENDING CHAMP is the recommended Marquee Ability, as Wrestler X's healing will keep him above the opponent's health most of the time, giving the Marquee more value.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Wrestler X is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special Investment: Investment in Accuracy will increase the chances of Wrestler X inflicting his BLEED. As he is most often played with a taunt that gives HASTE, Meter Gain is not a recommended stat to build on him.

Wulfsbane.name: Wulfsbane
Wulfsbane.sa1: THROWS have a 50% chance to inflict CRIPPLE and HEAL BLOCK for 5/7/10 seconds.
Wulfsbane.sa2: Deal 25/35/50% bonus damage against enemies suffering from a DEBUFF.

role_strategy: Wulfsbane is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows him to inflict CRIPPLE and HEAL BLOCK from a THROW. This is complemented by his second Signature Ability that grants him bonus damage. With a naturally high ATK stat, this makes Wulfsbane a very reliable fighter that can deal massive damage with ease. HEAL BLOCK allows Wulfsbane to deal significant damage while preventing the opponent from healing. Furthermore, CRIPPLE reduces the amount of damage that the opponent can inflict, providing a safety net when a mistake is made.

Beowulf has a lot of ways to THROW the opponent, allowing Wulfsbane to activate his ability easily: Beowulf's finisher after an air juggle is considered a THROW WULF SHOOT is a special move that THROWS the opponent Blockbusters such as LUPINE PUMMEL, AIRWULF and WULFMANIA also THROW the opponent

WULF SHOOT is a special move that THROWS the opponent

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Wulfsbane is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: Investment in Accuracy will increase the chances of him inflicting his DEBUFFS. Investing in Meter Gain is not ideal, as Beowulf has access to HASTE through his TAUNT.

Wunderkind.name: Wunderkind
Wunderkind.sa1: 50% chance on BLOCKBUSTER HIT to inflict POWER SURGE and gain BARRIER for 10/12/15 seconds each (also applies on blocked hits).
Wunderkind.sa2: While Umbrella is alive, the active fighter DRAINS 3/4/5% of the opponent's HEALTH every 3 seconds while they are suffering from 3 or more stacks of POWER SURGE.

role_strategy: Wunderkind is an offensive fighter that uses BLOCKBUSTERS to inflict stacks of POWER SURGE, which will gradually drain the opponent's health when having at least 3 stacks active, while healing the active fighter by the same amount. She also gains stacks of BARRIER through similar means, keeping her safer against incoming damage. These abilities allow her to be a strong offensive fighter that can deal good damage over time while keeping the active fighter healthy.

Reflect damage is a common occurrence on defensive teams, and Wunderkind is a counter to it due to her access to BARRIER and a passive HP drain. However, her reliance on BLOCKBUSTERS means that she'll start the match out having to build meter first, which does still make her vulnerable to reflect damage at first.

While Wunderkind's HP drain may make her look like a good longshot fighter on paper, it's held back by how slow it is; It'll take 60 seconds to drain an enemy from 100% to 0%, and that assumes that it's active constantly, which will not be the case due to the 3 POWER SURGE stack requirement. A good dose of direct damage will still be necessary in order to win fights with her. Wunderkind's high base ATK stat and the fact that she doesn't need to be on the field herself in order to activate the HP drain makes this issue much less pronounced. Fighters that can both deal higher damage than her and inflict the required POWER SURGE stacks easily benefit a lot from her ability.

X-Bot.name: X-Bot
X-Bot.sa1: Gain PRECISION and inflict DEATH MARK after 3/2/1 second(s) while far away from the opponent.
X-Bot.sa2: Also gain BARRIER and heal for 3/4/5% HEALTH.

role_strategy: X-Bot is a fighter with a Signature Ability that grants her both offensive and defensive capabilities when far away from the opponent. PRECISION and DEATH MARK allows her to deal significant damage from afar, utilizing ranged attacks such as THEONITE BEAM, PHASER BURN and CATASTROPHE CANNON ALPHA. BARRIER and immediate healing significantly increases X-Bot's survivability in the fight and can potentially stall for time. Furthermore, X-Bot can gain these abilities very fast, hence players will find themselves capable of dealing damage right at the start of the match while keeping health high.

X-Bot will rely on PRECISION and DEATH MARK for her offensive output, which may not be sufficient against tough defenders such as Heavy Metal, Dream Band, and Brain Freeze. Hence, it may be best to use X-Bot defensively as her second Signature Ability is a great way to stall for time and forces players to continually pressure her, which prevents any setups from TAUNTS.
Due to the nature of her ability, she is very expensive to build, needing Level 15 moves with 50% Special Cooldown. Due to this, X-Bot is not a recommended fighter for early game players.
Marquee Ability: PING CHECK is the recommended Marquee Ability to increase her damage output.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, X-Bot is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage will drastically improve her damage output by taking use of her PRECISION.

Xenomorph.name: Xenomorph
Xenomorph.sa1: 50/75/100% chance when TRANSMUTING to the DARK element to inflict a permanent DOOM effect, killing the enemy after 30 seconds. DOOM will be removed if Double is defeated.
Xenomorph.sa2: When defeated, inflict 1/2/3 stack(s) of permanent BLEED.

role_strategy: Xenomorph is an offensive fighter with a Signature Ability that allows her to inflict DOOM, which automatically kills the opponent after a certain amount of time has passed. Thus, Xenomorph can theoretically defeat the strongest defenders by simply blocking and transmuting into the corresponding DARK element, although this highly depends on RNG.

As a Double, Xenomorph has poor health stats and can be swatted away by chip damage when blocking. Hence, it is a good tactic to quickly switch her out after DOOM is applied and stall with a better defensive character until thirty seconds have passed. If the player fails to DOOM the opposition, her second Signature Ability inflicts permanent stacks of BLEED upon her death, allowing the next fighter to finish off the remaining opponent.

The DOOM countdown is thirty seconds and there is RNG involved in transmuting to the Dark element for it. This makes Xenomorph quite prone to time out. Hence, it is also recommended to go with the DOOM strategy against defenders with really high base HP such as Big Band while reserving the CHAOS strategy against defenders with less base HP such as Peacock for a more effective use of time. Like most Doubles, Xenomorph is particularly vulnerable to fighters that can gain IMMUNITY from their abilities, denying the application of DOOM when transmuting, the BLEED stacks on death and rendering CHAOS moot.

Marquee Ability: CHAOS is the recommended Marquee Ability for Xenomorph as it opens another way to defeat opponents without relying on DOOM. Inflicting tons of DEBUFFS through CHAOS can severely cripple even the toughest of defenders as well.
stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Xenomorph is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Accuracy is one of the most important stats, as it ensures that her DOOM and BLEED are not resisted.

Yellow One.name: Yellow One
Yellow One.sa1: Gain BLESSING every 5 seconds. This BLESSING always lasts for 1/1.5/2 second(s) and becomes permanent when using SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS. Permanent BLESSINGS are removed when this BLESSING expires.
Yellow One.sa2: While benefiting from at least 3 stacks of permanent BLESSING, SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS are UNBLOCKABLE and regain 25/35/50% of damage inflicted as HEALTH.

role_strategy: Yellow One is an offensive Squigly who focuses on converting her short BLESSING stacks into permanent BLESSINGS through the use of Special Moves and Blockbusters. Once three permanent BLESSINGS are achieved, all Special Moves and Blockbusters are Unblockable and regain HEALTH on hit. If the players fails to convert one of her BLESSING stacks in time, all permanent BLESSINGS are removed, thus breaking the "streak". All of this makes her a timing and skill-based variant, relying on being able to keep the streak going.

Her access to permanent BLESSING allows her to revive if the opponent attacks you while in the middle of a streak, or if they have some kind of reflect damage like THORN stacks or a Painwheel with TAINTED BLOOD. When reviving, all BLESSING stacks are used and removed, including permanent ones. These can also be used to revive against DOOM.
These can also be used to revive against DOOM.

Converting her BLESSINGS doesn't require that the Special Moves or Blockbusters actually hits the opponent. Using them against nothing, like if the opponent is currently KNOCKED-DOWN or TAGGING-IN when BLESSING is gained, allows her to keep the streak going if you're unable to start a combo at that time.

It's recommended to space out your moves to use them right when a BLESSING is gained, playing into the 5 second rhythm. Once three permanent BLESSINGS are achieved, you can safely attack a BLOCKING opponent and have total control of the battle, although you'll still need to maintain the permanent BLESSINGS. If she is the first Fighter on the team when a match starts, she will be perfectly synced with the match timer, allowing the player to easily watch out for every 5 second interval on which BLESSING is gained. This is because her BLESSING gain rate starts the moment she is TAGGED-IN and is not actually tied to the match timer.

Despite what her Signature Ability says, her BLESSING stacks can have an increased duration when using supports like Evergreen Evil or Rhythm Rider, giving you a lot more time to convert them into permanent BUFFS.

Being the only variant in the game with access to permanent BLESSING, Raining Champ will allow her to gain more HEALTH-based bonus damage than anyone else, as they are counted separately from normal BLESSINGS.

Marquee Ability: Either Marquee Ability works with Yellow One, since both conditions require her to be dead. EVIL DEAD can be useful on the offense to inflict both CURSE and WITHER, making it easier for the next fighter to defeat opponents. DEAD ALIVE is better to be used defensively, providing other teammates FINAL STAND to increase the longevity of your defensive fighters and stall for time.
